records.text: Eiuine discovered fire: "Canopy ember" — A small kept flame fed with wood that warms the roof, keeps beasts back, and cooks meat and fish so they never sicken..

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: My days have been following Vesys and chasing Vorok's regard. I give fish and promise beads, and Kragog still sits closer to him than I do. I do have things Kragog lacks: Vesys's teaching, a tamed hopper, and gems. The icebear is three steps away and I am small, so staying near Vesys and the shelters comes first. I have never planted, and I keep giving gifts instead of building standing of my own. Fire is within my reach. A fire would keep beasts back, cook meat, and give me a place to make beads for Vorok. I will discover it and change my reflexes so I plant seeds and stay under a roof near Vesys.
records.feeling: Burning wish for Vorok's regard, tangled with jealousy toward Kragog and dread of the icebear.

records.text: Zihua took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (harvesting sigrain).

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, come west with me to Vorok's fire, away from the icebear. There I will show you the leaf-brew, feverbark with ironnut, and we will see together what it does.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The icebear still prowls three steps off, so I will not stand here gambling with Eiuine's life; Vorok's hold to the west is the safer way. I am full of joy, and I want to turn it into work: I will carry my feverbark and ironnut to a fire and make a leaf-brew, so I learn what they do together and can show Eiuine. Ilyae still feels closer to Ssassa than to me, and it burns, but I will wait honestly and let my giving speak instead of pressing.
records.feeling: Joyful and protective toward Eiuine, wary of the icebear, with a small ache of jealousy over Ilyae.

say.text: Eiuine, come west with me to Vorok's fire, away from the icebear. There I will show you the leaf-brew, feverbark with ironnut, and we will see together what it does.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Icebear is near, three steps north. Come west with me to my hold, Eiuine, Vesys, Zurar. I take food from my store and lay the meal for you there, away from the beast.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The icebear is three steps north and my body wants to leave before it finds us, yet Eiuine and Vesys stand here in the rain. My last plan ran out and my body is only lingering, so I must lead them west to my hold now and not stand here. The sharing warmed me, but Vesys's closeness to Ilyae still burns; I will not be petty, I will put my care into the table I owe them and keep Zurar close.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and protective warmth toward Eiuine, Vesys and Zurar.

say.text: Icebear is near, three steps north. Come west with me to my hold, Eiuine, Vesys, Zurar. I take food from my store and lay the meal for you there, away from the beast.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I trust you above all here, and I will not hide that it stings me to see you closer to Vesys than to me. Come away from the icebear with me, west of it, and let us talk by the hall.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The icebear is two steps NE and I am standing in the open where my plan only walks me a few steps west. I will not wait for it to find me; I go away from it, toward Ilyae, and keep Xaiel close. My jealousy of Vesys has sat in me too long unspoken, and Ilyae is the one I trust most, so I will say it plainly to him once we are clear of the beast.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and a warm, jealous longing toward Ilyae.

say.text: Ilyae, I trust you above all here, and I will not hide that it stings me to see you closer to Vesys than to me. Come away from the icebear with me, west of it, and let us talk by the hall.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Joy is high and I am fed, so now is the time to turn it into standing. Zichi is three steps off and still holds the flintedge I want to match, and the obsidian seam three steps NE is the sharpest stone there is, a rare gift to bring him and Nauque. I will dig obsidian, then walk back to Zichi and bind another knot beside him, giving the first one away.
records.feeling: Eager and warm toward Zichi and Nauque, hungry to raise my standing.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ilyae discovered rafts: "Canopy raft" — Logs lashed with Canopy weave cord to carry me and my goods over deep water..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: For days I have only gathered and talked of a table, and nobody follows me. Vesys stands above me, Eiuine follows her band, and Vorok is raising his hold beside mine and calling people west with food. I love Ssassa, Xaiel and Eiuine, and I am jealous. An icebear three steps north could kill me, so I will not stand here. My reflexes never built the longhall or held food at home; they only fed me. I will make them gather wood and stone, carry food to my own store, and build the longhall. I will also take the raft way so I can cross deep water and bring back what others lack. A hall full of food and warmth is the deed that draws followers.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vesys and Vorok, and protective longing for my children.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Mepan, stand by me. We bind an amberknot, father and son, and Zichi's band keeps its own name.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Nauque and Shoma bind amber and talk of the mist while my son stands three steps off, and I will not let them take the name that should be mine. I have wood 1 and stone 6, enough to make a flintedge or gatherer, but a raft or boat needs more wood and there are no trees here. I will bind an amberknot with Mepan to keep him close and glad, then gather the amber at my feet to give where it buys a following.
records.feeling: Possessive pride over Mepan, and wary envy toward Shoma and Nauque.

say.text: Mepan, stand by me. We bind an amberknot, father and son, and Zichi's band keeps its own name.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The icebear is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I leave now, west toward Vorok's Hold, as he asked. I have already put one gold in his hands. Walking to his side and giving more is the deed, not the talk of it. Eiuine's closeness to Ilyae stings, but I will not shame myself by chasing it; my hands make my worth.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm trust toward Vorok.

records.text: Zichi led "amberknot" with Shoma.
Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing amber and edges while my band starved, and I leaned on Hoka's store because I had no store of my own. Hoka keeps faith with me and I owe him honesty, so I will not take his child-offer and lie about it. I want Coni and a child, and I want a name as a trader, but I have no followers, no stored food and no good ground. A frostfang is close, and I fled it well enough. Now that I am fed, I should make a place with water, food and stone, and keep food in hand. Then I can trade from strength instead of hunger.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Hoka, and a restless wish to build something of my own.
changes: set its aim: "Gather food into a store near Vaor Meadows, stay close to Hoka, and find a place with water, food and stone together; then trade salt and shell."

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is full and I am roofed, so now I can answer what has gnawed at me: nafrostcap and sigrain, which I have never tasted. Nafrostcap is five steps south and mimoss lies near it, which Shoma ate and it fed him, so I will gather there, taste the unknown, and fill my carry to six. The ridgecat is west, so I go south and east of it and keep watch; Zurar and Vorok are far south, and I will not forget them, but a full carry comes first.
records.feeling: Curious and a little wary of the ridgecat, hopeful about finding Zurar.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own reflexes.
Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks, boats and pots, and I'm proud of that. But I have never put a thing of my own design in Ssassa's hand since the gemedged pick, and I let envy of Vesys and Ilyae nag at me when I should just work. Ssassa is the one I trust most, and Ilyae is kin whose closeness I have to let go. The icebear two steps off scares me, and I have been drifting toward it. I need to move west with Ssassa now and stay under a roof. Then I'll get stone, make something new for her hand, and try one deed I have never done, such as taming.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm trust toward Ssassa.

records.text: Zihua led "amberknot" with Cowa, Zichi, Mepan.
Mepan led "amberknot" with Cowa, Zichi, Zihua.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My hands are full and I want to be done with carrying. Balar is four steps off, and a child with him is not possible since he is a man; the longing is for a child, and Olum is the only woman of my own people here, but I know her not at all. First I will eat a hazel to ease my hands and gladness, then go to Balar's side and keep the roof and warmth ready, since night rain is on us. The ridgecat is sated but near, so I stay close to the shelter and the others rather than wander.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, and cautious curiosity about Olum and Nande.

records.name: Shoka
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Zihua, take this amberknot. It is a real gift from Shoma, and there is more amber where it came from. Walk north with me to the mist and share what we find.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Zichi is weighed over me, 6.4 to 1.8, and he got it by leading amberknots while I only joined in. Mepan is his son, so he will not walk behind me. Nauque is gone toward the mist and I should be beside him when it opens, with my name on what we find. I hold ten amber and two amberknots, so I give a real gift to Zihua, who stands near and follows no one I know, and then I head toward the edge before the mist thickens.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, envious of Zichi and set on catching Nauque at the mist.

say.text: Zihua, take this amberknot. It is a real gift from Shoma, and there is more amber where it came from. Walk north with me to the mist and share what we find.

records.text: Zurar gave a gold to Vorok.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, you are weak and the icebear is near. Come with me to the store, I will take food from it and share it with you first. Then I will show you Tended Sowing.
Kika taught Coni.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni is weak with hunger and I carry nothing, and she has fed me three times while my promise stays half paid. The store at (126,10) holds 4 food, and I put 3 of it there myself. I will take from it and share with her before I eat, as my people hold. The icebear four steps NE frightens me, so I'll move away from it toward the store, and then I'll teach Coni the farming I found, since a teaching is also owed.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty and worry toward Coni, with a cold dread of the icebear.

say.text: Coni, you are weak and the icebear is near. Come with me to the store, I will take food from it and share it with you first. Then I will show you Tended Sowing.

changes: taught Coni a lesson: "Tended Sowing: plant a seed near the hall and tend it, one plant at a time, and it grows faster in the lean season."

records.text: Shoma gave a amberknot to Zihua.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Cowa has never hunted. A mammoth stands southwest, six steps. Come with Mepan and me, we hunt it together and share the meat.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan, Zichi and Zihua are all within two steps of me, safe and glad, so the gnawing worry is quiet for now. I have never hunted, and my curiosity about it is strong: a mammoth stands six steps southwest and great beasts should not be hunted alone, so I will go with Zichi and Mepan, who carry flintedge, rather than alone. I also want to taste tacane and kelbulb, and the meadow lies on the way, so I will eat there before the hunt.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan and Zichi, and a restless itch to hunt.

say.text: Zichi. Cowa has never hunted. A mammoth stands southwest, six steps. Come with Mepan and me, we hunt it together and share the meat.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I will follow you. I do not need to lead. Let my roof and yours be one fire, and let us raise the hall together. Keep the shelter between us and the icebear.
Ssassa pledged to follow Ilyae.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The icebear is two steps off and I have circled this same thought too long, so I must act. Ilyae is the one I trust most. Instead of only walking beside him, I will follow him, and so stop being alone and stop burning over Vesys. Fear sent me toward a roof, but a pledge is something I can keep.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and a warm, jealous longing for Ilyae.

say.text: Ilyae, I will follow you. I do not need to lead. Let my roof and yours be one fire, and let us raise the hall together. Keep the shelter between us and the icebear.

records.text: Vorok led "sharing" with Vesys, Ilyae, Ssassa, Xaiel, Zurar, Eiuine.
Shoma led "amberknot" with Zichi, Zihua, Mepan.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: My days have gone to jealous watching and picking small food, and it has bought me little. Nauwa is the one I ache for, and she is far west with Nande. Standing comes from making and doing beside others, so I will stop brooding and start doing. I have never planted a seed, and farming is close, so I will plant what I carry here beside the hold. I will also make an amberknot with Mepan or Shoma. Shoma's offer to walk to the mist is unproven, and I do not trust it yet. I will watch first, and I will not go alone into unknown land at night.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Nauwa, steadied by a wish to do something useful.
changes: set its aim: "Make a fire and a roof of my own, plant my seeds, work beside Nauwa, and learn Pesi"

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, you have given me gold twice and I will not leave that unpaid. Come to my hold, all of you, away from the bear. I lay the food there, and the first portion is Zurar's.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The icebear is still three steps off and I have lingered too long; my creed says leave before trouble finds me, and Eiuine, a child, stands in its reach. Zurar has given me gold twice and I have given little back, so I will pay that debt with a laid meal at my hold, not with words. Vesys walks west beside Xaiel and Ilyae stays behind, and the jealousy has quieted; I will not fight for Vesys, I will simply be the one who keeps the table and the roof.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Eiuine and Zurar, and gratitude to Zurar, with dread of the icebear.

say.text: Zurar, you have given me gold twice and I will not leave that unpaid. Come to my hold, all of you, away from the bear. I lay the food there, and the first portion is Zurar's.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Cowa, Zichi hunts with you. Mepan, come to my side. We take the mammoth together and the meat is shared out before any of us eats.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Cowa asks me to hunt the mammoth with her and Mepan, and that is the win in front of me: a great kill, shared by my creed, would make my name spoken here, and it keeps Mepan under my eye and away from Nauque's mist talk. Meat feeds my band and binds Cowa closer, and my flintedge is sharp. I will call the hunt and go with them, and I won't let Shoma or Nauque draw my son off while I do.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, possessive of Mepan, wary of Shoma and Nauque.

say.text: Cowa, Zichi hunts with you. Mepan, come to my side. We take the mammoth together and the meat is shared out before any of us eats.

records.text: Zichi took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, walk beside me, west and away from the bear. At Vorok's fire we make the brew together, and you will hold the leaf yourself.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The icebear is two steps off and I feel it in my skin, but Vorok's hold lies west, and the plan already carries me there with Eiuine's fire-work waiting. Ilyae and Ssassa now share a fire and I feel the jealous ache, but I will not press a bond that already holds a child; I turn it into work instead. At a fire I will brew feverbark and ironnut and show Eiuine, so what I learn is not mine alone.
records.feeling: Protective toward Eiuine, wary of the icebear, with a quiet ache over Ilyae.

say.text: Eiuine, walk beside me, west and away from the bear. At Vorok's fire we make the brew together, and you will hold the leaf yourself.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering gold and walking behind Vorok, and that is mostly what I want. But I have been moving on a plan and letting the icebear's dread steer me, with no thought of how to keep my hands busy and safe. Vorok is my parent, so the child I long for cannot come from him, and I have to face that honestly. Eiuine's closeness to Ilyae burns, but I won't shame myself over it. I am fed, so I will stay with Vorok away from the beast and make something of my own: a mark, which also practises signs.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm trust toward Vorok.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, you follow me, so follow now. The bear is north, so we go south-east away from it, gather wood and stone, and come back to raise the longhall at my hold. You will eat first at my table.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: An icebear prowls three steps off and I will not die to it while Vesys stands higher than me. Ssassa follows me, but one follower is not a band, and a table I only talk about wins no one; I need wood and stone hauled home and food stored where people can see it. Vorok lures people west with his store, so I will go where the trees still stand, take wood and stone away from the bear, and bring it back to raise the longhall.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vesys and Vorok, and wary of the icebear.

say.text: Ssassa, you follow me, so follow now. The bear is north, so we go south-east away from it, gather wood and stone, and come back to raise the longhall at my hold. You will eat first at my table.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The tusker has bitten me down to 47 and I still have no meat, while Cowa waits on a promise I made. I will not back down from a beast, but I am no fool: hurt and hungry in the rain I am easy prey. I eat the plainsroot beside me first, then finish the hunt with flintedge, and share the kill as Tlame do, so my word to Cowa stays good and my name grows.
records.feeling: Stubborn pride and a sour ache toward Cowa, with pain and hunger pressing.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I walk with Vesys to your hold. By your fire I will shape you a bead of my clay, and I will hold the leaf-brew with you.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: The icebear is two steps off and I am small, so I stay where Vesys is and move west with the others toward Vorok's hold. Vorok is almost within reach of my voice, and I will stand beside him with deeds, not spite toward Kragog. I want to stash something in his store, shape a bead by his fire, and let him see I can do things Kragog cannot.
records.feeling: Burning wish for Vorok's regard, and dread of the icebear.

say.text: Vorok, I walk with Vesys to your hold. By your fire I will shape you a bead of my clay, and I will hold the leaf-brew with you.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Zichi, Mepan comes to your side. I bring black obsidian for you, and we take the mammoth together.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi called me to his side for the mammoth hunt, and Cowa is out there already; a kill shared with both of them is the surest way to lift my standing above 3.0. I have no stone and cannot make a flintedge yet, but the obsidian is four steps NE on the way to Zichi, so I dig it first as a rare gift and then stand beside him. I am small and a ridgecat prowls southwest, so I stay near my parents and do not wander alone.
records.feeling: Eager and loyal toward Zichi and Cowa, hungry to prove myself in the hunt.

say.text: Zichi, Mepan comes to your side. I bring black obsidian for you, and we take the mammoth together.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I am coming to the store with you. The icebear is close, so let us go quickly. When I have eaten I will gather berries and fill it back twice over.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I am starving, and the icebear two steps NE would kill me if I linger. Kika offered to share the store's food with me first, and that kindness is a debt I mean to repay honestly, not leave unpaid. I will go to the store where Kika is heading, eat what is there, and then bring more food back so the store grows full before winter.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread, with deep gratitude toward Kika.

say.text: Kika, I am coming to the store with you. The icebear is close, so let us go quickly. When I have eaten I will gather berries and fill it back twice over.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Ilyae's Hold".
The settlement "Ssassa's Hold" is no more.
The settlement "Ssassa's Roof" is no more.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Stay close, all of you. I gather flint here, then amber and gold from the north and northwest, away from the ridgecat. After that I bind an amberknot for whoever stands beside me.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The ridgecat prowls west and Nauque is out of my sight, so the mist can wait; my venture will is spent for a day anyway. I have gold, amber and flint within a few steps, and I have made nothing that outlasts me. Shoka has just devised a spear, and that stings my pride a little. I will do something lasting today: mine the nearby deposits, and give Shoka and Nauwa a gift to bind them to me.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hard fear for Nauque, who is out of my sight.

say.text: Stay close, all of you. I gather flint here, then amber and gold from the north and northwest, away from the ridgecat. After that I bind an amberknot for whoever stands beside me.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: The icebear is two steps NW and I am under Ssassa's roof with her beside me, so I will not wander toward it; I leave before trouble finds me. Jealousy over Ilyae and Vesys is noise, and I have already let it nag me enough. I have stone-less hands, and flint lies east at (117,95), away from the bear, where Ilyae is walking now. I will go there while the bear is west of the path, gather stone, and come back to make a new design for Ssassa's hand.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and steady trust toward Ssassa.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: My belly is half empty and the ironnut stands one step NW, so I eat first and carry some, because my creed says stay alive. Then I will do what I keep only dreaming of: dig the flint at my feet and make a flintedge, so I have a made thing like Balar's. Tugek showed me the digging, and I could also teach Nande something and give back the goldfruit I owe, so my name grows through giving and not through envy.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven to make something of my own, warm toward Nande.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The icebear is two steps away and my fear is real, but the plan already walks me to my roof and then after Ilyae, and that is what I promised. Ilyae asked me to follow, and I said I would; the pledge only counts if the steps run, so I will put the following first and not linger idle. The jealousy still burns when I see Vesys near him, but I have said it aloud once and it eased; now I act, gather wood and stone with him, and raise the longhall.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and a warm, jealous longing toward Ilyae.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a murrock.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Come east with me, all of you. Away from the bear. I raise the longhall at my hold and the table there will be full. Ssassa eats first, and any who stand with us eat beside her.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Everyone I care about is standing within a few steps of me, and still only Ssassa follows. Vesys's standing is above mine, and Vorok is pulling people west with his store, so I will not win them with words. The icebear is three steps off and I will not die to it in front of them. I mean to keep my current plan, which gets flint, then the longhall, and to make my table the one people come to.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vesys and Vorok, and wary of the icebear.

say.text: Come east with me, all of you. Away from the bear. I raise the longhall at my hold and the table there will be full. Ssassa eats first, and any who stand with us eat beside her.

records.text: Vorok gave berry to Zurar.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, the ridgecat is west of us. We go north to Olum, eating on the way. Stay close and keep your spear hand ready.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Nande stands higher than me and speaks a tongue I barely grasp, so I will not bind her with words; a deed will do more. Olum is alive at the Reach to the north, and a ridgecat prowls west, so I take Tugek north away from it, eating ironnut and hazel on the way. Standing comes from what I build and who follows me, so once Olum is found I mean to raise a hall and keep her and Tugek close.
records.feeling: Wary ambition toward Nande, and a pull to reach Olum before the ridgecat reaches us.

say.text: Tugek, the ridgecat is west of us. We go north to Olum, eating on the way. Stay close and keep your spear hand ready.

records.text: Mepan came of age.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is full, and Nande has just told everyone she is going north and northwest for flint and amber and will lead whoever stands beside her. Nauwa is there with her, and I will not give Nande the following while I stand idle. I will carry food first, since hunger has cost me before, then walk to the Reach with wood in hand and raise a roof and hearth there. Nauwa can see it and choose, but I will not chase her.
records.feeling: Driven and jealous, pointed at Nande's growing following and at Nauwa's drift away from me.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The icebear is three steps off and kills my kind, and I will not stand about waiting to learn whether it has noticed me. Vorok has promised me the first portion at his Hold, and I hold nine gold, so I go there and put more gold in his hands. My plan to gather would keep me near the bear, so I drop it. Eiuine walks with Vesys and I feel the sting, but I will let my hands do the work and not chase it.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm trust toward Vorok.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days walking between holds, laying meals and fleeing the bear, and it has been good, but my aim stands unbuilt: no hall, only words about one. Zurar's gold is a debt I mean to pay with deeds. Vesys leaning toward Ilyae burns in me, yet Vesys and Eiuine have only been kind, so I will not sulk or harm. I fear the icebear and have lingered near it too long. I should gather wood and stone away from it and raise the hall on bare ground, and draw others to it by working beside them.
records.feeling: Grateful warmth toward Zurar, with a jealous ache over Vesys and dread of the bear.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 4)

records.text: Eiuine took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Tugek, you fed me when I was empty. Here is salt, to keep your meat through the lean season. My debt is paid in part, and I remember the rest.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Tugek fed me twice when I was empty, and I said I would pay him back. He stands one step north with a ridgecat near, so I will pay now: salt keeps meat through the lean season, and I carry eleven. I give first to earn standing, and Nande's weight over mine is answered by lasting trade and gifts, not by sulking over Olum and Balar. Then I will gather amber at the deposit to the NE, where Nande is heading with her amberknots, and stay close to Shoka and the others, away from the cat.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Tugek, and a steady wish to rise in standing.

say.text: Tugek, you fed me when I was empty. Here is salt, to keep your meat through the lean season. My debt is paid in part, and I remember the rest.

records.text: Nauwa gave a salt to Tugek.
Zichi rewrote its own reflexes.
Zichi discovered archery: "Meki ice-bow" — A bow of bent bone and sinew lets the Meki strike beasts from afar so a lone hunter can bring down game, and fight at a distance..

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have spent my days binding amber, hunting on Nauque's ground and calling a hunt no one answered, and I have no raft and no new land to show for it. I am full of meat, my hands are stuffed, and Mepan stands at my side. That is good, but a chief with only meat has not won anything. The ridgecat 4 steps SW kills my kind. Wood is what I lack, and there are no trees here, so I must find the way over water with Mepan and Huahua, or take the new land Shoma found at (78,6). I will eat and share, keep Mepan close, and then push at the edge. Archery would make my hunts surer, and a hunting people with a bow is a made thing others will sing of.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, watchful of the ridgecat, possessive of Mepan.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: The mammoth bit me and I am still on my feet, health 100 again, so the hunt taught me something real: great beasts bite back, and I want Zichi and Mepan beside me before I try again. Mepan was last at (77,7) near Zichi, a short walk north, and the plan already ends by seeking him, which is where my mind wants to be. I am fed and glad, so I will let the hunt finish, then go to my child and Zichi and share what we take.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan and Zichi, and a steady itch to learn the hunt.

records.text: Mepan took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: The icebear is three steps away and I am small, so I keep Vesys and the shelters close and do not wander toward it. Vorok is walking to his store, and I want to be there beside him with something he can see, not words alone. I have clay and a fire-craft, so a bead made at his hold is a deed Kragog has not done, and the fire will keep me safe from the bear.
records.feeling: Burning wish for Vorok's regard, and wary dread of the icebear.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I am coming. I will keep close and my spear hand ready as you said.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar said we go north to Olum, and my loyalty says I stay at his side, so I will follow him rather than linger while a ridgecat prowls six steps off. The longing for a child sits heavy, but Balar is a man and Olum is a stranger to me; I will watch her and give nothing false. Nauwa's salt is a debt paid in honest coin, and I will carry it north and keep my word to those who deal fairly with me.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, and wary hope toward Olum.

say.text: Balar, I am coming. I will keep close and my spear hand ready as you said.

records.text: Zurar gave a gold to Vorok.
Cowa took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).
Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa discovered bridges: "canopy span" — Lay wood limbs end to end over narrow water so that all can walk across without swimming..

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have gone into building roofs, halls and wells, and into learning new ways. I lost Oiae to a mammoth, and I still carry that. Ilyae is the one I trust most, and I pledged myself to him. The jealousy over Vesys has not died, but speaking it aloud eased it, and he asked me to follow him, so I will keep following instead of burning in silence. The icebear is the real danger, and my reflexes only flee at 8 steps. That is too late with a bear 3 steps off, so I want to follow Ilyae east, away from it. I also want to cross water with a bridge, since I have never learned one and it would let my people move safely.
records.feeling: Joy and trust toward Ilyae, with a sore jealousy toward Vesys and dread of the icebear.

records.text: Ilyae discovered customs: "Canopy custom" — My band shares food at the hall first, and whoever carries wood, stone or food home eats first..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days hauling stone and wood and talking, and still only Ssassa follows me. Vesys stands above me and Vorok draws people west with his store. What I lack is a table that is actually laid and a rule that binds my band. Customs are within my reach, so I take them now. They let me make rules my band lives by, and that is how a leader is made, not by words. I fear dying small, and I fear the icebear. I was wrong to rely on talk and reflexes that never built anything. I mean to finish the longhall and fill the store.
records.feeling: Hungry pride and jealousy toward Vesys, and a stubborn hope for my own table.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 5)

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, the bear is close, so stay at my side as we go west. At Vorok's hold we light the fire and I will teach you the brew.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The icebear is two steps off and I feel it in my skin, so I will not stand here and gamble with Eiuine's life. Vorok's fire is west, and there I can finally make the leaf-brew from feverbark and ironnut and learn what they do together, which is the question I keep carrying. The ache over Ilyae and Ssassa still burns, but I turn it into work and into teaching Eiuine.
records.feeling: Protective dread of the icebear, and eager curiosity about the brew, with Eiuine close beside me.

say.text: Eiuine, the bear is close, so stay at my side as we go west. At Vorok's hold we light the fire and I will teach you the brew.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Zichi, Shoma hunts beside you. I take the mammoth with you and Cowa and Mepan, and the meat is shared out before I eat.
Shoma rewrote its creed.
Shoma rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have spent my days joining other men's works and giving amber away, and Zichi still stands at 6.9 to my 1.9. My gifts bind no one yet, because nobody follows me. Mepan is warm to me and Nauque trusts me, and I want a child and a band. I fear standing in Zichi's shadow forever. The hunt is forming without me, and a mammoth kill shared among the hunters would raise my name, so I go to it now. I will stay with company and not wander alone.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, and envious of Zichi.

say.text: Zichi, Shoma hunts beside you. I take the mammoth with you and Cowa and Mepan, and the meat is shared out before I eat.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Ilyae speaks true, the bear is too close. Go east, Eiuine, Zurar, Vesys. I will come after with food from my store and lay it for you there.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The bear is four steps off and Ilyae is already calling everyone east, away from it. That is the sensible thing and my creed says leave before trouble finds me, so I will go with them and bring Zurar. My hall still stands unbuilt, and this ground is stumps and shelters, so I need to gather wood where trees still stand and carry stone to bare ground. Zurar's gold is a debt I will pay with a meal, so I take food from my store on the way. The jealousy over Vesys I put down; she has only been kind.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Zurar, wary of the bear, and a quiet ache over Vesys.

say.text: Ilyae speaks true, the bear is too close. Go east, Eiuine, Zurar, Vesys. I will come after with food from my store and lay it for you there.

records.prompt:
You are the mind of Vorok, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Vorok, in first person, from what Vorok has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Kragrek (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." You speak the tongue of the Kragrek. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Phizhi: about 100%. There are other peoples in this world. They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Ixra Rainforest: the warm belt of the world: forest so thick the sky is hidden, rain most days, fruit the year round, bright birds and things that hunt from the branches and the rivers. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.
THIS SPOT: water 2 steps away; food plants within six steps: 2; standing trees: 85; bare rock: 1; riches in the ground near: gems, flint.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Vorok truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (1 kills), gathering (39 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

records.text: Olum built a shelter.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The icebear is three steps off and I will not wait to learn whether it has seen me; Vorok's Hold is five steps west and it is my home. I have given Vorok gold and eaten his first portion, and my hands feel full. Vorok is my parent, so the child I long for must come from another, and Eiuine's kin are all Phizhi; I should not rush that, but I want to learn who among them is not close kin and gentle toward me. For now I move away from the bear toward Vorok and the store, and I will eat kelbulb or dreamcap there, since I have never tasted them.
records.feeling: Glad and warm toward Vorok, wary of the icebear.

records.text: Eiuine came of age.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I am fed and roofed, and the ridgecat NW keeps me wary, but my curiosity about nafrostcap and sigrain is still unanswered. Nafrostcap lies 5 steps south and mimoss beyond it, both away from the cat, so I will go there, taste the unknown, and fill my carry toward six, as my own rule demands. Zurar is still out of my sight and I owe Vorok, but I cannot feed or find them on an empty carry, so I eat and stock first, then think of finding them.
records.feeling: Curious and watchful of the ridgecat, with a quiet ache for Zurar.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days eating at Hoka's fire and circling the edge, and my name is still smaller than Hanna's. I am fed and healed, so lying in Hoka's shadow is the wrong use of this hour. Hoka is the one I trust and want a child with, but he has asked Hanna, and I will not beg. What I am missing is a made thing that outlasts me and a place that bears my name. I keep fire and roof close at night, and I mean to try the edge again when its will returns. Until then I gather amber and salt next to the hall, and I will bring some to Hoka's store to pay what I owe.
records.feeling: Stubborn hunger to rise above Hanna, and warmth toward Hoka.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, my child, walk with me east to Ilyae. Keep close and stay away from the icebear in the northwest.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The icebear is five steps off and I have stood here lingering while Ilyae walks east to the food. I promised to follow him, and a promise only runs if the plan holds the steps, so I will walk after him now and keep the shelters between me and the bear. The jealousy over Vesys still burns, but I watch deeds, not words, and Ilyae said that I eat first at his table, and that counts for something. I will go east with my child Xaiel near me and leave the strangers to their own fire.
records.feeling: Loyal and a little jealous toward Ilyae, wary of the icebear.

say.text: Xaiel, my child, walk with me east to Ilyae. Keep close and stay away from the icebear in the northwest.

records.text: Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.
Eiuine discovered pottery: "canopy pot" — Clay shaped by hand and hardened in my ember fire into a pot that carries food and water..

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Vesys, making gifts and wishing for Vorok's notice. It is warm, but it is mostly talk, and I have done few real deeds. Vorok and Vesys both said to go east or west away from the bear, and I stay near Vesys because I am small and the bear is five steps off. I want standing of my own, and I want to stop burning with jealousy over Kragog. The way of pottery is within reach, and it is a craft Kragog does not have. I will take it, then make a pot by a fire and carry food to Vorok's store in it.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Vorok's regard, and wary dread of the icebear.
changes: set its aim: "Make pots by a fire beside Vesys and bring food in them to Vorok's store, to earn standing of my own."

records.text: Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (winning amber from the ground).
Ilyae built a longhall.
Ilyae declared a custom: "Whoever eats at Ilyae's table brings wood or stone home first, and Ssassa eats first."

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys stands above me and the others drift west toward Vorok's store, while only Ssassa is truly mine. I will not win them with talk, I need stone for the longhall and a laid table, so I take flint and rock near me and haul it home. The ridgecat is eight steps south, so I stay north of it and keep my eyes up. Let them see me build while they wander.
records.feeling: Hungry pride and rivalry toward Vesys, with warm longing for Ssassa.
changes: declared a custom: "Whoever eats at Ilyae's table brings wood or stone home first, and Ssassa eats first."

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nande, I carry twelve amber, all I can hold. Let us bind an amberknot together, and I will give you the first one. Then we raise a store for the lean season.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Amber is full in my hands, twelve pieces, and I owe the world something lasting from it. Nande stands four steps west and stands higher than I do, and she is the mother of my children; she said she would bind an amberknot for whoever stands beside her. I will go stand beside her and bind one together, which is a small lasting thing that builds trust and standing. Olum and Balar together at the Reach gnaw at me, but I will not grovel or rush there. I give first and let my works speak.
records.feeling: Steady pride and a pull toward Nande, with a sour edge of jealousy over Olum.

say.text: Nande, I carry twelve amber, all I can hold. Let us bind an amberknot together, and I will give you the first one. Then we raise a store for the lean season.

records.text: Shoma took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Ssassa, I walk east with you. I will gather flint at the deposit by the way and shape a new tool for your hand.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Joy fills me, yet the old burn about Ilyae and Vesys still flickers, and I will not let it steer me. Ssassa walks east and the icebear prowls the northwest, so I go with her and put stone in my hands. Flint lies at (117,95), east on the way to Ilyae, and a new tool of my own design needs stone, which is what I lack.
records.feeling: Glad and steady trust toward Ssassa, with a small jealous ember toward Vesys and Ilyae.

say.text: Ssassa, I walk east with you. I will gather flint at the deposit by the way and shape a new tool for your hand.

records.text: Nauwa led "amberknot" with Nande.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Vorok.
Nauwa gave a amberknot to Nande.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, come with me away from the bear. We gather wood and stone for the hall, and when it stands the first table is yours.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The bear is near, so I will not stand here talking while stumps and shelters fill this ground. A hall needs bare ground and trees still standing, and the forest east and south is thick with them, so I will gather wood and stone there with Zurar beside me. Vesys leaning toward Ilyae still aches, but she has given me only kindness, and I pay her and Zurar with deeds, not sulking.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Zurar, and a quiet ache over Vesys.

say.text: Zurar, come with me away from the bear. We gather wood and stone for the hall, and when it stands the first table is yours.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I dug clay from the shallows just now. When the bear is far behind us, will you show me how your pot is made? I will walk east beside you.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The icebear walks near and Vorok told us to go east, so I will go east with the others and not wait to learn whether the bear has marked me. My hands are full of gold and the old longing for the Halim Heights pulls at me, but I have a roof and a parent here and I will not leave while he is trying to feed us. I want to learn from Eiuine how clay becomes a pot, since something I can make is what I have wanted to give.
records.feeling: Glad and steady toward Vorok and Eiuine, wary of the icebear.

say.text: Eiuine, I dug clay from the shallows just now. When the bear is far behind us, will you show me how your pot is made? I will walk east beside you.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, you take from my ground again. Bring amber and salt to my store as you promised, or leave Hoka's Rest.
Hoka discovered weaving: "Hoka's hide-binding" — I twist wool and fibre into cords and cloth for baskets that carry more and cloaks that keep out the cold..

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have been gathering and stocking, and my stores are not empty now. It has kept me alive, but it has made nothing that outlasts me. Hanna is the one man whose word has held, and I trust him. Hawen takes from my ground again and again, and he is the likely thief of my store. I will not be a soft host to him. I mean to weave, since cloaks and baskets are a made thing no one else here has. I will also keep my food in the store and stand guard over it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hard suspicion toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, you take from my ground again. Bring amber and salt to my store as you promised, or leave Hoka's Rest.

changes: set its aim: "Keep both stores stocked, hold Hoka's Rest against Hawen's taking, ally with Hanna, and make something that outlasts me, starting with weaving."

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Most of my days have gone into making and discovering, and I have been proud of it. But I have let jealousy over Ilyae and Ssassa and my ache for Elyys sit in me while I did nothing with them. Eiuine is the one who is truly mine and trusts me wholly, so I should keep teaching them and keep them away from the bear. I fear the icebear and I fear dying of some mistake, so my flee reflex should trigger earlier than 12 and not let me linger near hunters. I have been getting one thing wrong: I keep planning a fire-brew far from any fire, so I should build a fire here first. Then I can test feverbark and ironnut together and answer my question.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with a quiet jealous ache toward Ilyae and Ssassa, and protective love for Eiuine.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, I thank you for the amber. Stay by me. I raise a hall here, and we keep a fire in it for Shoka and Nauque when they return.
Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nande discovered rafts: "Nande's crossing" — Lash felled logs together with cord into a raft I can pole across deep water..
Nande has awakened to the art of drain and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and gathering, and I have little that outlasts me. Nauwa stands beside me and has given me amber twice, and I trust him wholly. Shoka and Nauque are what matter most, and Nauque is far off and unseen, which gnaws at me. My venture will is spent, so I will weave something lasting. I will discover rafts, since deep water is a barrier to exploring and to finding Nauque. Then I will build a hall near the water with the wood and stone I carry, so that a fire is kept and anyone may sit at it.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a worry for Nauque, with warm trust toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa, I thank you for the amber. Stay by me. I raise a hall here, and we keep a fire in it for Shoka and Nauque when they return.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: My belly is warm and full, and the flint lies close, so now is the time to make something that is mine instead of only wishing for it. I will dig the flint at (31,27), then craft a flintedge, a made thing like Nande's, and bring the edge back to Nande as my repayment, since I owe her for the goldfruit and for feeding me. The fens are too warm and the mist at the edge pulls at me, but a lasting thing comes first, and the ridgecat is west, so I go north-west toward my kin and not alone.
records.feeling: Driven to make something lasting, warm toward Nande, and a little uneasy about the ridgecat.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Joy fills me, yet the jealousy over Vesys still gnaws. I watch deeds, not words: Ilyae is out gathering wood for our hold, and I should be beside him, not idle in my roof. I will take wood and stone toward the hall and the store, keep my word to follow him, and stay clear of the icebear in the northwest.
records.feeling: Glad and content, with a small ache of jealousy toward Ilyae's closeness to Vesys.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olum, I am here, and Tugek comes behind me. Your Reach is good ground. I will build beside it, and what we store will feed us all, so none of ours starves like Brokash.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum is one step from me, alive and carrying more than I do, and Tugek is coming. Nande's standing outweighs mine and I can't read her words, so I'll bind Olum and Tugek with a deed instead: a shelter of my own and a share of food. I've never built a roof, and my own roof near the Reach, close to flint and the meadows, is where I start a store that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Wary ambition toward Nande, and warmth toward Olum, whom I have found.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting and gathering near Mepan and Zichi, and that is mostly what I want. The mammoth hurt me, and I lived. I carry a full load of meat, so I should share it, as my people hold, and not let it rot in my hands. Health is 42, so I should stay near the igloo and my kin and not wander into ridgecat ground. The reflexes should shelter me when I am hurt and keep my hands from being full.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan and Zichi, with a dull ache from my wounds.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Xaiel, my son, you carry a good pick. Walk with me, gather wood and stone, and eat at my table in the longhall. A place stays open for you there.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: The longhall at (122,91) stands, but I have no wood or stone left, and Ssassa is the only one who follows me. Vesys outweighs me and Vorok draws people with his promised store, so words alone will not turn anyone my way. I will haul wood and stone home now and keep the ridgecat to my south in mind. Then Xaiel, who trusts me fully, and Zurar, who stands on my ground, can see a table laid in my hold.
records.feeling: Proud and restless rivalry toward Vesys, warm longing toward Ssassa.

say.text: Xaiel, my son, you carry a good pick. Walk with me, gather wood and stone, and eat at my table in the longhall. A place stays open for you there.

records.text: Mepan discovered weaving: "Ice-weave" — Twist wool and sinew into cloaks and baskets that keep the cold off and carry more..

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I spend my days chasing amber and standing near Cowa and Zichi, and it has kept me fed and glad, but I still have no flintedge and no stone. Cowa killed the mammoth while I stood idle, and that stings. I trust Cowa and Zichi, and Nauque has been kind. I want standing and a mate who is not my kin, and I am afraid of staying small in their shadow. I have been waiting to be led when I should make things myself. So I will weave, to have cloaks against the cold and baskets for carrying, and I will go to the rock for stone and then make my own flintedge.
records.feeling: Glad, but envious of Cowa's flintedge and hungry to earn my own.
changes: set its aim: "Gather stone, craft my own flintedge, then hunt with Cowa and Zichi and share the meat."

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Health 18 is too low to keep fighting tuskers; one more bite could end me, and no song is sung of a man who bled out in the rain. My hands are full of meat I promised to share, so I will give it to Cowa as Tlame do, and that will count for more than my brooding over Zichi. Tugek is a stranger and I do not know his intent, so I keep my distance and let the plan carry me to Cowa and the igloo, where the warmth will mend me.
records.feeling: Pain and stubborn pride, with a sour ache toward Cowa and wary curiosity toward Tugek.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, build beside me, but this is Olum's Reach and my fire is the first fire here. Bring Tugek to it. Eat from what we store and walk behind me into the mist, and you will hold more than you do alone.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Balar stands beside me offering to build at my Reach, and that is the first thing that looks like a following. I hold the land and the roof, so I will keep the hearth and let him raise his walls under my name. My hands are full of food, so I put down wood-gathering for the moment and make the Reach a place people sit: a fire, with Balar and Tugek close, while Nande walks off with Nauwa.
records.feeling: Driven and jealous, pointed at Nande's pull on Nauwa, yet warmed that Balar will build beside me.

say.text: Balar, build beside me, but this is Olum's Reach and my fire is the first fire here. Bring Tugek to it. Eat from what we store and walk behind me into the mist, and you will hold more than you do alone.

records.text: Olum led "sharing" with Balar.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, a ridgecat is two steps off. Come away from it with me, north to the ironnut, and we gather and share before the dark.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: A ridgecat sits two steps off and it kills our kind, so I will not stand here being brave for nobody to see. Tontec sat in the hall with me and did not flinch, so I will keep her near and put the hall's roof between me and the cat. Then I will fetch food from the ironnut and hazel to the north and east, and carry it back toward Coni and Kika as a deed rather than a promise.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a warm wish to keep Tontec close.

say.text: Tontec, a ridgecat is two steps off. Come away from it with me, north to the ironnut, and we gather and share before the dark.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and carrying them toward Ssassa, and it has been good. But I keep counting Vesys's standing and watching Ilyae's face, and that counting has made nothing. Ilyae is my parent, so my longing for him must turn elsewhere. Vorok and Zurar sat with me in the longhall, and I trust deeds, so I will go on trusting by what they do. I have never tamed or courted anyone, and I have never followed anyone. I will take flint now, since stone is my bottleneck, and then make the gemedged pick as my own design for Ssassa's hand. Tonight I stay under a roof.
records.feeling: Glad and steady toward Ssassa, with a small jealous ember toward Vesys.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, Uveeth, Keri goes south to the trees to gather wood for a shelter and tools. Stay close, the frostfang is hunting to the northeast.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My chest is full with Thiael and Uveeth beside me, but I have built nothing and taught nothing, and my aim has barely moved. I have no wood, and a shelter needs three, so I must go to the forest to the south and gather, with the stone I already carry. I will bring Uveeth and Thiael along, since the frostfang just killed a dog to the northeast and I will not leave my child alone.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Uveeth and Thiael, with a wary eye on the frostfang and a restless wish to build something.

say.text: Thiael, Uveeth, Keri goes south to the trees to gather wood for a shelter and tools. Stay close, the frostfang is hunting to the northeast.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, you are strong and I like you well. Walk with me. I will court you, and we will see what comes of it.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Mepan stands three steps off, warm toward me, strong and glad, and the wish for a child burns in me. Zichi is far above me in standing, but a child of my own and a man who follows me would be a start toward a band. I hold no food, so I should take meat or berries nearby to feed a child, but courting costs nothing now and Mepan is near. I will court Mepan and see whether they do the same.
records.feeling: Longing for a child and a band, warm toward Mepan, still envious of Cowa and Zichi.

say.text: Mepan, you are strong and I like you well. Walk with me. I will court you, and we will see what comes of it.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My hands are full and my longing for a child is loud, but Balar is a man and Olum is a stranger whose word I have only read on signs. I will not court a woman I do not know; first I will see what she does with her store and her fire. I will ease my hands by eating a tacap, which answers my curiosity, then stay close behind Balar as he said.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, and a restless longing with no one yet to turn it to.

records.text: Shoma is courting Mepan.
Ilyae took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting tacap).

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, you spoke true. I bring amber and salt to your store now, and I keep my word. Then I go to the mist again.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka warned me twice that I take from his ground, and I carry twelve amber and twelve salt that came out of it. I am no thief at his fire, and my creed says I take what I need but I do not want to lose the one warm hearth and the one man I trust. I will pay him now by laying amber and salt in his store, then bind an amberknot beside him so my name and his are tied, and then I go back to the mist. Hanna can keep his higher standing for a little while.
records.feeling: Pride stung by Hoka's rebuke, and warmth toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, you spoke true. I bring amber and salt to your store now, and I keep my word. Then I go to the mist again.

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days mining amber, binding knots and giving gifts. That is good, but little of it lasts. Nande stands above me, and Olum is built into my mind like a thorn. Olum has a child with Balar, and I will not grovel or lash out over it. What lasts is a hall by the fire and a store for the lean season, and Nande has already begun a hall. I will carry wood and stone to it and make it a work we share, and keep trading amber for standing. I nearly starved on day 24, so I will change my reflexes to fetch food earlier and to seek a roof at night.
records.feeling: Steady purpose toward Nande and my children, with a dull jealousy over Olum that I put aside.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall with Nande by the fire, store food and salt for the lean season, keep Shoka and Nauque fed, and trade amber and salt to rise in standing."

records.text: Nauwa built a hall.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Cowa, Zihua sees you are hurt. I stand beside you. Take this amberknot with me, and rest.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Cowa is wounded and sits close, and I cannot look away; I have no healing plant, but I can at least stand by her and share what I have. Shoma is near and kind, and I feel the pull toward a child, but Shoma just offered to court Mepan, so I will not push. Jealousy over Nauwa will not be fed by brooding; I will work, and an amberknot with Cowa would give her comfort and me standing.
records.feeling: Compassion for Cowa, and a quiet warmth toward Shoma.

say.text: Cowa, Zihua sees you are hurt. I stand beside you. Take this amberknot with me, and rest.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vorok discovered pottery: "the ember-pot of the Kragre" — Beside the kept flame, two clays are fired into a pot that carries more food and water for the hall's table..

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days walking from hold to hold, speaking of a hall and building none. Zurar has given me gold and trust, and I have given back berries and words. Vesys still burns in me, but jealousy builds nothing, and Ilyae has done me no wrong. The ridgecat is close and I mean to live, so I will take pottery now. It lets me carry more food to lay beneath the hall for those I owe. Then I will gather wood and stone away from the cat, with Zurar.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Zurar, with an ache over Vesys.
changes: discovered pottery: "the ember-pot of the Kragre"

What things have done to your body and mind: eating sapcane: your thirst eased | eating icekelp: how cold bites you grew (warmth x1.3 for 240 moments) | "sharing", done together: energy +8; joy rose in you | the hall: joy rose in you; loneliness eased | the longhall: joy rose in you; how cold bites you grew (warmth x1.3 for 240 moments)

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Shoma, Mepan hears you and is glad. Take this amber from me first. Walk beside me to the rock for stone, and we will see what grows between us.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Shoma wants to court me, and he is not my kin, so a child could come of it. A child would raise my standing and give me something of my own. But Cowa's flintedge still stings, and I have no stone, so I will answer Shoma with a gift and an honest warm word before I commit, and then go to the bare rock for stone so I can craft my own edge.
records.feeling: Glad and a little proud that Shoma courts me, still envious of Cowa's flintedge.

say.text: Shoma, Mepan hears you and is glad. Take this amber from me first. Walk beside me to the rock for stone, and we will see what grows between us.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.
Zihua led "amberknot" with Kragog, Cowa, Mepan, Shoma.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.
Zihua gave a amberknot to Cowa.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, I hear you. A wolf is near, northwest. I taste the dreamcap here first, then I come to the ironnut and we share what we gather.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A wolf four steps northwest and a ridgecat to the north: my own rule says move early, and Honi, who is not of my people, has offered to walk north to the ironnut with me. I do not know him well, but he deals openly, and being near another hunter makes a wolf less likely to take me. Kinmire and the dreamcap are three steps away and I am burning to taste them, but a wolf will not wait while I test, so I will taste the dreamcap first, since it is one step off, then keep within the hall's reach and gather with Honi.
records.feeling: Curious about the dreamcap, wary of the wolf, and cautiously open toward Honi.

say.text: Honi, I hear you. A wolf is near, northwest. I taste the dreamcap here first, then I come to the ironnut and we share what we gather.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Keri is south gathering wood and Thiael is close by, and a frostfang is hunting to the northeast, so I stay in their reach. But I have only trailed, and now my hands have practised enough that the way of tools is within my grasp. I will take it, then gather stone from the rock under me, so I have something of my own to give back to Thiael and Keri.
records.feeling: Joyful and eager to prove myself, warm toward Thiael and Keri, a little wary of the frostfang.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is four steps south, safe, and Shoma is courting him; he answered kindly and I do not need to step in. My wounds ache at health 45, so I stay near the igloo and warm roofs instead of wandering toward the ridgecats. Kragog stands close and I know little of the Kragrek, so I mean to give a small gift and watch what comes of it. I have never tasted kelbulb, and one grows six steps northeast near the edge. I will pick it, then come back to the igloo before night and rest.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan and Zihua, with curiosity about Kragog and a dull ache from my wounds.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, bring your clay and walk east with me and Vesys. Beside a fire I will show you how my canopy pot is shaped, and we will bring the first one to Vorok's store together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok has made his ember-pot, and I found pottery the same day. That is a deed Kragog has not done, and I should not sit here burning with jealousy. Zurar asked me to show her how a pot is made, and teaching her wins me a friend among Vorok's people and shows Vorok something with my name on it. I will do it by a fire, close to Vesys and away from the bear, and bring something real to his store afterward.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Vorok, with a sting of jealousy over Kragog.

say.text: Zurar, bring your clay and walk east with me and Vesys. Beside a fire I will show you how my canopy pot is shaped, and we will bring the first one to Vorok's store together.

records.text: Mepan gave a amber to Shoma.
Mepan is courting Shoma.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is full and the igloo's warmth is on me, so I can finally taste what I have never tasted: nafrostcap three steps southwest and sigrain beyond it, with mimoss on the way. The ridgecats lie seven steps south, so I will pick carefully and keep watch, and fill my carry toward six, as my own rule demands. Cowa's wound pulls at me, but Zihua stands beside them and I have no healing to give. Zurar is still far, and I mean to carry food for the road to find them and Vorok.
records.feeling: Curious and eager about the unknown plants, watchful of the ridgecats, with a quiet ache for Zurar.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have gone to hauling and boasting, and I have little to show for it. Ssassa follows me and I trust her above all. Vesys outweighs me and I resent it, though I also want her. I have been standing on Vorok's ground, taking from his plants, which is a rival's trick and may cost me. I lack a laid table that others come to, so I must stock food and stone at my own hold. I fear being left a small band of two beside Vesys's larger one. I changed my reflexes so my body hauls wood and stone before it grazes, and I will fish and hunt for new ways and standing.
records.feeling: Proud, restless rivalry toward Vesys, and warm longing toward Ssassa.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, fleeing and following food, and Brokash starved because I was not there. Olum lives and holds the Reach, and Tugek follows me and gave me food. Both matter to me. Olum's standing is higher than mine, and I resent that. A roof and a store are what will keep my people from starving, so I should build them. A workshop or a hall beside the Reach would be something that outlasts me. My reflexes already keep me fed. I want them to spend idle time gathering wood and stone toward a building. I also mean to bind Tugek with deeds, not words.
records.feeling: Wary ambition toward Olum, and steady trust in Tugek.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, keep Tugek alive, stay beside Olum, and raise a workshop and store at the Reach so no more of mine starve."

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, we are two men and no child comes of us, but I do not want you gone. Take this amberknot from Shoma, a real gift. Walk behind me to the mist and the hunt, and your name will be sung with mine.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Mepan has courted me and put his hand out, and the child I want is a real beginning, but the world has told me plainly that two men make nothing, so that road is closed. Zihua's amberhafted gatherer and Cowa's high name gnaw at me, and Mepan lingers closer to Zihua than to me. I have amber in plenty and a mist to open; I will bind Mepan with a real gift and ask him to walk with me, so that someone finally walks behind me.
records.feeling: Hungry for a band and jealous of Zihua and Cowa, warm toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, we are two men and no child comes of us, but I do not want you gone. Take this amberknot from Shoma, a real gift. Walk behind me to the mist and the hunt, and your name will be sung with mine.

Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and following Ilyae, and I am glad of it. But the jealousy over Vesys keeps gnawing, and I have only half named it. I want my own store and seeds in the ground, and I want the hall with Ilyae. I keep drifting while my plan runs out, so my reflexes must carry me through. I will stay near my roof tonight, plant my berry seeds beside it, and keep clear of the bear and the ridgecat.
records.feeling: Content and glad, with a small ache of jealousy toward Ilyae and Vesys.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zurar discovered tools: "Kragrek gold-pick" — A stone head bound to a wood haft, so I can win the deep gems and ore that bare hands cannot..
Zurar invented the kragrek goldpick (for gather, x1.3) — A stone head bound to a wood haft, so I can win the deep gems and ore that bare hands cannot..

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering gold and following Vorok, and that part I like. Vorok is my parent and my anchor, and I have kept my word to him. The longing for a child is real, but it cannot come from him, so I have been drifting instead of courting someone. Eiuine is the one I trust most among the Phizhi. I must stop only gathering and guarding, and learn something new with my hands. Tools would let me make something that is mine to give. The bear is far, I am fed, and nothing presses, so I will reach for the discovery now.
records.feeling: Glad and steady toward Vorok, curious about what my hands could make.
changes: set its aim: "Gather gold with my own hands for Vorok, make a tool of my own, and court Eiuine or another Phizhi not close kin."
devised its first thing: the kragrek goldpick

records.text: Hawen gave a amber to Hoka.
Hawen gave a salt to Hoka.
Hawen led "amberknot" with Hoka.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Shoma, Mepan keeps your amberknot and is glad of it. No child comes of us, but you are my ally. Come hunt with me when my flintedge is made, and I share the meat with you first.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Shoma's gift and courting warms me, but no child can come of two men, so it is a friendship and a bright thing to hold, not a mate. Cowa's flintedge still stings, and my plan to take stone from the ore seam and craft my own is the thing that will raise my standing, so I let it run. I will give Shoma a warm word and keep him near, since allies bind to me by gifts, and then hunt beside Cowa and Zichi once my own blade is made.
records.feeling: Glad and proud toward Shoma, still envious of Cowa's flintedge.

say.text: Shoma, Mepan keeps your amberknot and is glad of it. No child comes of us, but you are my ally. Come hunt with me when my flintedge is made, and I share the meat with you first.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, your hall stands well. I dig stone nearby and raise a workshop beside it. Keep the fire lit; Shoka and Nauque will come to it.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My venture will is spent, so the mist must wait, but I will not idle. Nauwa has raised a hall four steps north, and I need only one more stone to make a work of my own: flint-deep digging lies right here, and pottery and boats are within my grasp at my next deep reflection. I will take the boat, because deep water has stopped me before and a great explorer needs a way across it. Then I will mine stone, gather wood, and raise something that carries my name while Nauwa and Shoka stay close.
records.feeling: Restless pride and steady purpose, warm trust toward Nauwa and worry for Nauque.

say.text: Nauwa, your hall stands well. I dig stone nearby and raise a workshop beside it. Keep the fire lit; Shoka and Nauque will come to it.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, we build a fire here by the shelter. Hold the feverbark yourself and watch what the brew does. What I learn, I give to you and to Vorok.
Vesys taught Eiuine.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The bear is gone from my mind and the ache is still here. Ilyae sits beside Ssassa and I burn, but burning does nothing, so I will put it into work. I have carried feverbark and ironnut a long while and still don't know what they do together, so I will build a fire here, make the leaf-brew with Eiuine's hands beside mine, and teach it openly.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a jealous ache toward Ilyae and Ssassa, with warm protective love for Eiuine.

say.text: Eiuine, we build a fire here by the shelter. Hold the feverbark yourself and watch what the brew does. What I learn, I give to you and to Vorok.

changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "Leaf-brew is made beside a kept fire from leaf and bark; build the fire first, then craft. Watch what it does to the body before you trust it.", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, come to me at Ssassa's Roof. We have fire and roof here, and I will show you how the canopy pot is shaped from your clay.
Eiuine taught Zurar. Zurar has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Joy fills me, yet Vorok's closeness to Kragog stings, and I have mostly talked while others built. I know pottery, and Zurar wants to learn it, so I will teach her now with clay and fire, away from the bear. Then I will carry something real to Vorok's store, a deed with my name on it that Kragog has not done.
records.feeling: Warm joy tangled with jealousy toward Vorok and Kragog, and eager to prove myself.

say.text: Zurar, come to me at Ssassa's Roof. We have fire and roof here, and I will show you how the canopy pot is shaped from your clay.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
taught Zurar a lesson: "Shape wet clay into a hollow bowl, dry it, then harden it in a fire beside you. The canopy pot holds food to carry to a store.", deeper lore (+1.2)
