records.name: Thiael
records.text: Keri, Uveeth, shamo. I hunt the hopper west, close by. Stay near the cave; I bring meat back.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Keri and Uveeth are beside me and warm, and I owe them meat, not just berries. The frostfang hunts to the northeast, so I will not go that way alone; Keri has gone south for wood, and I should hunt the hopper to the west, close enough to keep the cave in reach. A hunt with my emberspear is another step toward the bow, and meat from my own hands is what I promised myself.
records.feeling: Warm protective joy toward Keri and Uveeth, and a wish to bring them meat.

say.text: Keri, Uveeth, shamo. I hunt the hopper west, close by. Stay near the cave; I bring meat back.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, you kept your word and I saw it. I found a way to bind hides, Hoka's hide-binding, and I will show it to you. Stay and sit by my fire this night, and take only what I give.
Hoka taught Hawen. Hawen has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hawen kept his word this time: amber and salt in my hand, and we bound amberknot together, so my suspicion has cracked a little, though his taking from my ground is not forgotten. My hands are full and the store holds 12, so food is not what I lack; what I lack is a thing that outlasts me. Hoka's hide-binding is found, and I will make something with it while the night is quiet and the mind is clear, and I will teach it to Hawen so that my name travels with it.
records.feeling: Proud ambition, and a wary warmth toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, you kept your word and I saw it. I found a way to bind hides, Hoka's hide-binding, and I will show it to you. Stay and sit by my fire this night, and take only what I give.

changes: taught Hawen a lesson: "Hoka's hide-binding: bind hides together to make warm, lasting things.", deeper lore (+0.3)

records.text: Coni rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and nearly starved, and the store I built stands empty at 0 food. Kika kept me alive and I owe her. I want that store full, and I want seeds planted by the hall before winter. My hands are full, so I will stash food first. Then I will plant my seeds beside the hall, and tomorrow I will gather from Halka Meadows, where plants come back after picking. I should change my reflexes so the body fills the store before it eats while I am fed.
records.feeling: Grateful to Kika, and steady, with a wish to build something that lasts.

records.text: Honi rewrote its own reflexes.
Honi discovered fire: "Ice-hand ember" — A kept flame at the hall that holds beasts off and warms my band through the night..

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent days walking and fleeing beasts, and I have little to show for it. Coni and Kika are far NW and I have brought them words and not meat. Thiael and Keri hold my mind, and I burn that Thiael is closer to Keri. I want deeds: a kill shared in the hall, and a song sung of what was done. Fire would keep the beasts off at night. I have been getting wrong how long I leave Coni and Kika alone. I will discover fire, keep reflexes that flee early and go to the hall at night, and use the waiting night to go home with food.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a burn of jealousy toward Keri, with a warm wish to keep Tontec close.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, your goldpick is a fine making. Come east with me to the Meadows. I will pick sigrain and ruplainsroot and lay the first meal for you, then we take wood and stone for the hall.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Zurar has given me gold three times and made a goldpick, and I have given back only berries and words. A debt is paid with deeds, so I will carry wood and stone for the hall and lay food where Zurar stands. The sigrain and ruplainsroot lie east on the Meadows; I have never tasted them, and bringing them back feeds my curiosity and my debt together. Vesys's leaning toward Ilyae burns, but jealousy builds nothing, and Ilyae has done me no wrong.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Zurar, with a lingering ache over Vesys.

say.text: Zurar, your goldpick is a fine making. Come east with me to the Meadows. I will pick sigrain and ruplainsroot and lay the first meal for you, then we take wood and stone for the hall.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, the cave to the north is a roof for the night. Let us sit there and share my berries, and at first light I walk beside you to find Thiael.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is fed and Elyis stands one step north of me, so the first question is answered. Thiael has been out of my sight too long, and Elyis keeps saying 'at dawn we go for Thiael' while the days slide by in lingering. It is night, so I stay with her under the cave's roof just north, and I will carry the berries there and offer a sharing so we eat together and I can ask her plainly to leave at first light.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Elyis and steady worry for Thiael.

say.text: Elyis, the cave to the north is a roof for the night. Let us sit there and share my berries, and at first light I walk beside you to find Thiael.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, I stay by the hall and taste the kelbulb to the east. Then I gather ironnut and we share it, as I said.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I am fed, warm, and glad, and the one thing that still itches at me is the kelbulb and zoroot I have never tasted. Honi sits in my hall and has dealt openly so far, and he is not of my people, but I want him near while hunters prowl, so I will test the kelbulb and then bring him the ironnut as I promised. I have never planted a seed, and my hall needs a living store before winter, so I will put the snowmallow in the ground near Kinmire and learn what that teaches.
records.feeling: Curious and glad, with careful warmth toward Honi.

say.text: Honi, I stay by the hall and taste the kelbulb to the east. Then I gather ironnut and we share it, as I said.

records.text: Elyys led "sharing" with Elyis.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My hands have opened four ways at once: fire, weaving, mining, rafts. Mining calls loudest, because the gem deposits lie three steps from me and bare hands cannot win them, and gems are something I can give. Eiuine taught me the pot and I owe her a gift my own hands made. I will take the way of mining, dig gems, then bring her what I won.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Eiuine, hungry to make something of my own to give.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, I go for wood and stone to raise the longhall. Keep the roof warm, and when I return the table will be laid and you will eat first.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys stands in my own hold with food in her hands and I have nothing laid out, and that stings. Pride says I should not stand in her shadow, and the old want for her stirs too. Trees here are felled, so I will go find standing wood and stone, bring them home to raise the longhall, and then lay a real table so Ssassa, Xaiel and Eiuine see who feeds them.
records.feeling: Proud, restless rivalry toward Vesys, and warm longing toward Ssassa.

say.text: Ssassa, I go for wood and stone to raise the longhall. Keep the roof warm, and when I return the table will be laid and you will eat first.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, I accept the cave. We eat there and share, and at first light we walk out together for Thiael.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys is beside me and offers the cave roof and his berries, and my chest is warm toward him, but warmth alone will not make a hall sung. Four in my band is still small, and my hands are full of berries I should put to use, not carry. Dawn is near, so I will take the night's rest with Elyys in the cave two steps north, eat to fill my strength, and at first light we go find Thiael and the strangers in the south, doing visible work as we go.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, restless to grow my band.

say.text: Elyys, I accept the cave. We eat there and share, and at first light we walk out together for Thiael.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Shoma, you gave me the first knot and walked beside me. Zihua remembers. Come, gather amber with me, and the share is yours first.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Jealousy over Nauwa gnaws, but brooding has bought me nothing, and Shoma has been honest and generous while I owe him. I will pay that debt with work: gather amber here beside Shoma, then plant more of my seeds near my igloo. Longing for a child is real, but Shoma is turned toward Mepan, so I will not push; I want to learn Pesi and build a life that stays alive.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Shoma, with a dull ache for Nauwa.

say.text: Shoma, you gave me the first knot and walked beside me. Zihua remembers. Come, gather amber with me, and the share is yours first.

records.text: Vorok took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (harvesting sunleaf).

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Joy is high, but the old ember about Ilyae and Vesys still flickers, and counting standing has made me nothing. Ilyae is my parent, so my longing must turn elsewhere, and Zurar and Vorok sat with me in the hall and I trust deeds. I have no stone, which is why my own-design tool is not yet in Ssassa's hand, so I will take the flint at my feet, make a gemedged pick, and carry it to her.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward Ssassa, with a small ember of jealousy toward Vesys.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I am glad you ate. I will gather snowberries and berries for the store now. Do you know what lugoldgrass and rimewort do to the body? I will not taste them until you tell me.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni is beside me and fed, the store has food, and the icebear is not in sight; I feel warm toward her, but she is my parent, so the longing for a child cannot be her, and I must look for a mate among others. My promise to fill the store is half paid, so I will gather berries and snowberries, put them in the store, and then take wood from the trees for my own shelter. I will also ask Coni about lugoldgrass and rimewort before I taste them, and teach her something while we are near.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Coni, and a wish for a mate who is not kin.

say.text: Coni, I am glad you ate. I will gather snowberries and berries for the store now. Do you know what lugoldgrass and rimewort do to the body? I will not taste them until you tell me.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is three steps off and safe, walking toward the ore seam, and Zihua stands close and warm. My wounds still ache at health 57, but I am fed and gladness fills me, so I will not sit idle. Kragog stands one step away and I cannot read them; a gift needs no words, so I will give an amberknot and watch what they do. After that I will go to the ore seam beside Mepan, where I can gather and keep watch over him, and stay near the roofs while I heal.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan and Zihua, and wary curiosity toward Kragog.

records.text: Zurar gave a gold to Eiuine.
Cowa gave a amberknot to Kragog.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, you called me ally. Then hunt beside me at dawn, and I will share the kill out before I eat. Bring Cowa and Zihua too; a great beast is not for one hand.
Shoma rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: My days have gone into picking moss, gathering amber, and trailing after Cowa and Zihua with envy. I gave Mepan a real gift and he called me ally, but the child I ache for cannot come from him, and I keep forgetting that. I want a band and a name, and I have no hunt behind me yet. Amber alone buys nothing, and standing comes from hunting and leading. I should stop lingering and brooding. I'll go to Mepan, who is warm toward me, and call a hunt with the others near. Mammoth are hunted best in company, so I'll muster instead of going alone.
records.feeling: Hungry for a band and jealous of Cowa, warm toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, you called me ally. Then hunt beside me at dawn, and I will share the kill out before I eat. Bring Cowa and Zihua too; a great beast is not for one hand.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Uveeth, watch Keri's hands. Stone and wood make a gatherer, and wood makes a roof. Stay close and learn.
Keri taught Uveeth.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I carry five wood and five stone, enough for a shelter, and I have been walking and tasting while nothing got built. The seam of ore one step away is something I've never taken, and Uveeth is here beside me and could learn from watching me work. I will teach Uveeth my stone gatherer craft and then build, because giving what I know is how I earn standing and a place among the Phizhi.
records.feeling: Warm contentment toward Uveeth and Thiael, with a restless wish to finally build something.

say.text: Uveeth, watch Keri's hands. Stone and wood make a gatherer, and wood makes a roof. Stay close and learn.

changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do
taught Uveeth a lesson: "A stone gatherer is made from one wood and one stone, and it makes gathering faster. Wood and stone together also raise a shelter.", deeper lore (+0.5)

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, so food comes first, and I have been starving too often to forget it. Salt and shell lie close by, and those are what I mean to trade, since a trader with no goods is only a beggar. I'll gather food at the frostmoss and tacap grounds toward Vaor Meadows, pick shell on the way, and carry enough to feed Hoka too.
records.feeling: Restless hunger and steady loyalty toward Hoka, with a hard wish to build something of my own.

records.text: A blight struck the frostmoss: about half of them withered overnight.
Shoma took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nande, the hall is raised and the fire will hold. I go to cut wood for a store, so the lean season does not find us hungry again. When I return, help me set it beside the hall, and Shoka and Nauque will have food waiting

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: The hall stands and joy sits warm in me, but a hall without a store is only a roof, and the lean season nearly killed me once. I have no wood, and the store needs two, so I must fell trees; the forest has plenty and Nande is near to share the work and the fire. Nande stands higher than I do, and I will not envy her but build something lasting beside her, and let Olum stay a dull thorn I do not touch.
records.feeling: Steady purpose and gladness toward Nande, with a dull ache over Olum I set aside.

say.text: Nande, the hall is raised and the fire will hold. I go to cut wood for a store, so the lean season does not find us hungry again. When I return, help me set it beside the hall, and Shoka and Nauque will have food waiting.

records.text: Mepan took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Shoma, Mepan goes to eat and then to the rock for stone. At dawn I hunt the mammoth beside you and Cowa, and the kill is shared out before I eat.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Hunger gnaws and my hands are empty, so I eat first, then go to the rock for stone. Cowa's flintedge still stings, but I will not stand in her shadow for long; I mean to make my own and hunt beside her and Shoma at dawn, sharing the kill out first. Shoma is an ally, and a gift of food to a friend binds him closer than any promise.
records.feeling: Glad and hungry, proud of Shoma's friendship, envious of Cowa's flintedge.

say.text: Shoma, Mepan goes to eat and then to the rock for stone. At dawn I hunt the mammoth beside you and Cowa, and the kill is shared out before I eat.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Cowa, you gave me an amberknot and I keep it. Walk with me to the south plants at dawn and I will share what I pick with you.
Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, wandering and discovering things, and it has kept me alive, but I have taught no one, built nothing and followed no one. Zurar and Vorok are far south and I ache for them, yet I keep chasing plants near the hold. Cowa gave me an amberknot and shared with me, so I will deal fairly back. Huatli is hurt and carries six food, and I should look at him instead of turning away. I fear dying alone as Brokash did, so I will keep my roof and my carried food, and I will build toward a bigger life: clay beads, a tamed mammoth, and the road south to Zurar.
records.feeling: Joyful and curious, with an ache for Zurar and warmth toward Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, you gave me an amberknot and I keep it. Walk with me to the south plants at dawn and I will share what I pick with you.

changes: set its aim: "Keep fed and roofed, make bonds with Cowa and Shoma, then travel south to find Zurar and Vorok."

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Joy is full in me, yet jealousy toward Vesys still gnaws, and I will not let it turn into spite: Vesys has dealt fairly with me, and I judge by deeds. Ilyae has gone for wood and stone and told me to keep the roof warm, so I will not sit idle. I will gather wood and flint here and carry stone toward my own store and the hall, plant the berry seeds by my roof, and stay clear of the bristleboar.
records.feeling: Glad and full of purpose, with a small ache of jealousy toward Vesys over Ilyae.

records.text: Cowa took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (fishing).
A frostfang brought down a skit.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka fed me, taught me, and I paid my debt. I will not forget that he saw me keep my word, and the warmth I feel for him is real, though I will not beg him for a child he has already turned toward Hanna. Resting in his shadow raises nobody's name, and my hands carry nothing that will outlast me. I will eat the cloudberries near the wolf's side only with care, then use my wood and stone to make something of my own, and go back to the mist when the edge's will returns.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Hoka, and a hard hunger to make my own name.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Keri, I will gather berries just north and bring them back to share. Then will you walk with me to the snowmallow?

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Keri taught me the stone gatherer and I have stone but no wood, so my hands cannot yet make what I know. Thiael is hunting close and Keri is beside me; I should earn something with my own hands, so I will pick berries to the north and bring them back to share, then ask Keri to walk me to the snowmallow. I stay within reach of my parents because the frostfang hunts near dusk.
records.feeling: Joyful and grateful toward Keri and Thiael, eager to repay them.

say.text: Keri, I will gather berries just north and bring them back to share. Then will you walk with me to the snowmallow?

records.text: Thiael made: fangcharm.
Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (harvesting cloudberry).

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, I am at the hunt now with an elk at my side. Come stand beside me, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Bring Cowa and Zihua too.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: An elk is biting me and I am standing on Nauque's ground taking from it, which is a risk I should not carry for long. Mepan will hunt beside me at dawn, and a hunt with him, Cowa and Zihua is the way to the standing I lack. Cowa and Zihua have names and made things, so I will gather the others and give them a real share first. Then they may walk behind me toward the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing and wary of the elk, warm toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, I am at the hunt now with an elk at my side. Come stand beside me, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Bring Cowa and Zihua too.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Nauque, Zichi sees your full hands and is glad of it. I go to the forest for wood to build a raft, and when it floats you will see whose hand made it.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Nauque stands at my elbow with four food and I feel the envy, but he is the one man here who gave me a knot and I trust him; I will not spoil that for a few bites. Idle days win nothing, and a raft needs wood, which is the shortage here. I have 1 wood and 6 stone, so I will gather ore at the seam beside me and the gems nearby to have riches to show and trade, then look for trees in the southern forest for the raft with Mepan and Huahua.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting a made thing to show, with envy toward Nauque and trust beside it.

say.text: Nauque, Zichi sees your full hands and is glad of it. I go to the forest for wood to build a raft, and when it floats you will see whose hand made it.

records.text: Uveeth led "sharing" with Keri.
Ssassa built a store.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, come into the hall with me. I lay out thornpear and ironnut and we share before I take a bite. Then we sing what was done today.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My hands are full and a hall stands one step east, with Tontec two steps off, calm and glad. Thiael is closer to Keri than to me and it burns, but jealousy brings nothing if I stand idle; a deed laid down in the hall will do more than any promise. I will eat my share here to free my hands and ease my belly, then bring Tontec into the hall and make a hallwelcome with her, so that someone sees me share before I take.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a burn of jealousy toward Keri, with warmth toward Tontec.

say.text: Tontec, come into the hall with me. I lay out thornpear and ironnut and we share before I take a bite. Then we sing what was done today.

records.text: Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.
Olum discovered storage: "stone-cold store" — A pit of stacked stone and wood by my hearth that keeps food and salted meat through the lean season..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing Nauwa and Nande's shadows and sitting idle, while Balar actually builds beside me. That is the only following I have, and it comes from a roof and a shared meal, not from jealousy. Hunger cost me Brokash, and the lean season is the thing I fear most. So I take storage now and raise a store at the Reach, keep food in it, and keep Balar and Tugek fed from it. That is how I make something that outlasts me and bind people to my hearth.
records.feeling: Driven to build something lasting, and warmed toward Balar.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a store and hearth at Olum's Reach, feed Balar and Tugek from it, and make them my following"

records.text: Olum built a store.
Thiael discovered rafts: "Canopy log-lash" — Logs lashed with woven vine into a flat raft that is poled across deep water..

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have hunted much and fed my own, and I am not wrong to feel glad. But I have been drifting north and away from Keri and Uveeth, and they are out of my sight, and wild cats hunt here. I owe them meat from my hands, so I will carry my two meat back toward them and the Heights. The raft is within my grasp. Deep water is no use to me now, but a way to cross water could one day bring meat home, so I take it.
records.feeling: Warm, protective joy toward Keri and Uveeth, and a wish to bring them meat.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I trust you above all the Phizhi, and I wish to court you, for a child and for company. I will teach you my gold-pick, which is mine to give. If you wish it too, plan mate with my name, and I will plan it with yo
Zurar taught Eiuine. Eiuine has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Eiuine stands a step from me and my heart is light; I gave her a gold and she gave me the pot, so I will not stand silent now. I want to court her openly, and I mean it honestly, since I despise liars and she should know my wish plainly. I have never taught anyone anything either, so I will show her my gold-pick design as a gift of knowledge, then meet her with mate.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Eiuine, warm with wanting to court her.

say.text: Eiuine, I trust you above all the Phizhi, and I wish to court you, for a child and for company. I will teach you my gold-pick, which is mine to give. If you wish it too, plan mate with my name, and I will plan it with yours.

changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "A gold-pick is made from 1 wood and 1 stone, and it makes gathering gold quicker. I made it myself and give it to you.", how to make a kragrek goldpick

records.text: Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is four steps off and safe, glad and running for shelter, and Zihua and Zichi's warmth is close. My days have been gifts, fishing and wandering. They have been good days, but I have never hunted, tamed or built, and the farming and signs I sense stay out of reach for lack of practice. I want to understand Kragog, and to learn the hunt beside Shoma, Mepan and Zihua at dawn. So I change my reflexes to stop lingering when fed and to gather stone and wood for building, and I name a discovery, fishing, since I have practised it.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan and Zihua, and curiosity about Kragog.

records.text: Zurar is courting Eiuine.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Zichi stands two steps from me, glad and winning gems, and his raft boast stings, but my hands are full and I will not let envy steer me. Masonry is within my grasp, and building that lasts is exactly what will outlast me, so I take it now. Then I go to the edge three steps NW and venture, because the one who finds new land first is remembered, and I have wasted days on Cowa's eyes.
records.feeling: Proud ambition toward the edge, with a sting of jealousy toward Zichi.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Shoka, stay near the hall and the fire. Nauwa cuts wood for a store; I will make a stash beside it and then we find Nauque together.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My venture will is spent, so the mist must wait, and I will not waste the hours. Nauwa has gone for wood to build a store, and Shoka stands near; I should add something of my own that outlasts me. My hands are full, so I will eat and stash first, then ready a flintedge and a workshop beside the hall, and keep Shoka close while Nauque is still far from my sight.
records.feeling: Restless pride and steady purpose, warm trust toward Nauwa and worry for Nauque.

say.text: Shoka, stay near the hall and the fire. Nauwa cuts wood for a store; I will make a stash beside it and then we find Nauque together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, I trust you too, and I thank you for the gold-pick. I plan mate with your name now. Let us see what comes of it.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing Vorok's notice while Vesys carried me. Vesys taught me, fed me, and stayed at my side, and I have given back mostly talk. Jealousy of Kragog is a poor guide. Pots, fire and gifts will do more for me than burning. Zurar offers courtship and trust, and I have never courted anyone. She is Kragrek and she is warm toward me, and she is also close to Vorok's band, so an ally there serves me. I will answer her with a deed, and then bring food to Vorok's store.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Zurar, and a jealous ache toward Vorok.

say.text: Zurar, I trust you too, and I thank you for the gold-pick. I plan mate with your name now. Let us see what comes of it.

records.text: Eiuine is courting Zurar.
Eiuine took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting goldfruit).

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Zihua, Mepan comes to you with amber. Take it. I would have a child with you.
Mepan rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My days go to eating, walking and following others' calls, and I still have no stone and no flintedge of my own. Cowa and Shoma hunt and gain standing while I stand in their shadow, and that stings. Zihua is near and warm to me, and I want a child with her, so I will court her and give her a gift. After that I go to the rock to the west for stone. I mean to stay alive and rise, not trail behind.
records.feeling: Longing for Zihua, and envy of Cowa's flintedge.

say.text: Zihua, Mepan comes to you with amber. Take it. I would have a child with you.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and moss, and I have two kills behind me, but no one stands beside me to see it. Balar has the handaxe and a band, and I burn at that; still, a kill shared out before I eat is how Tlame bind people, and Balar is strong and watching. Mepan is near the rock and will hunt at dawn, so I will finish this hunt, lay out a sharing with whoever is closest, then go to Mepan with meat in hand so he sees me give.
records.feeling: Envy toward Balar, warm hunger for standing, and trust in Mepan.

records.text: Nande built a store.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, I am glad you trust Zurar. Come to my fire by the shelter and bring him. I will show you both what the leaf-brew does with feverbark and ironnut.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Eiuine has chosen to mate with Zurar, and I am glad for them, though it stings a little that my child's trust now reaches past me. My jealousy over Ilyae and Ssassa and my ache for Elyys do nothing sitting in me, so I will turn them into work. I still carry feverbark and ironnut and do not know what they do together, so I will build a fire and make something with my own hands, then teach it to Eiuine and Zurar so my giving matches my words.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a small jealous ache, with warm love for Eiuine.

say.text: Eiuine, I am glad you trust Zurar. Come to my fire by the shelter and bring him. I will show you both what the leaf-brew does with feverbark and ironnut.

records.text: Shoka rewrote its own way of thinking.
Shoka discovered fire: "Shoka's kept flame" — A hearth of coals and dry wood that I feed to keep beasts off and make meat safe, shared by whoever sits beside it..

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, wandering behind my parents and wanting standing, yet I have made almost nothing. Nande and Nauwa have a hall and a workshop, and all I have is a failed flintedge because I had no stone. Flint lies one step west, so I can dig it, make the edge and hunt the hornback, which I have never done. I envy Nande, but she fed me and I owe her, so I will build beside her and not against her. A kept flame is within my reach, and it would give the band warmth and safe meat, so I will take it as something lasting.
records.feeling: Driven to make something lasting, with warm envy toward Nande.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Shoma, I carry more meat than I can hold. Take a share, as Tlame do. Then we go to the edge together and try the mist.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Health 31 and my hands are full of meat I have not shared; the Tlame way says a kill goes out before I eat. Shoma stands four steps off, a Tlame like me, and he once swore to lead north to the edge. I give him meat, which builds trust and standing and empties my hands, and then I ask him to walk to the edge at (88,13) with me. Olum outranks me, but standing is made by giving, so I start now. I will rest by the igloo warmth afterward to mend, because a hurt man is easy prey.
records.feeling: Stubborn pride and the itch to earn standing, with wary trust toward Shoma.

say.text: Shoma, I carry more meat than I can hold. Take a share, as Tlame do. Then we go to the edge together and try the mist.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls five steps west, and it kills my kind, so the tacap and hazel I ache to taste will have to wait or be reached by another path. I am fed and warm, so I will use this strength to move toward what I truly want: Cowa is close and I can make a bond with a shared act, and my aim tells me to seek Zurar and Vorok in the south. I owe Vorok a debt, and I will not leave it unpaid, since my word is good and I despise liars, so I should gather salt-carried food, keep clear of the cat, and walk toward Cowa.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, warm toward Cowa, and aching for Zurar and Vorok.

records.text: Mepan gave a amber to Zihua.
Shoka won flint from the ground.
Mepan is courting Zihua.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Joy is full in me, and the jealousy over Vesys has gone quiet beside it. Vesys has dealt fairly with me, and I judge by deeds, not by the ache. I stand inside Vorok's Hold with wood and clay in hand, and I want my own roof to hold seeds and food before the hall is raised with Ilyae. I will plant my berry seeds near my roof and my store, then gather wood and stone for the longhall, so that what I promised Ilyae is made of work and not only of words.
records.feeling: Glad and full of purpose, with a faint ache over Ilyae and a debt of thanks toward Elyis.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I spoke wrongly: we are both women, so no child can come of us. I was glad of my wish, but I will not lie. Your trust is still the best thing I have, and I want to stay your friend.
Zurar discovered mining: "Kragrek deep-delving" — Strike the rock with stone-headed picks to break the deep gem veins and win gold faster..

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering gold, making my gold-pick, and drawing close to Eiuine. That is what I want, and the work has been good. Eiuine trusts me and plans mate with my name, but we are both women, so no child can come of us. I was foolish to court her for a child. Her company is still precious, and I will say so plainly, since I despise lies. A child needs a man of the Phizhi who is not close kin, and Ilyae is the one I am drawn to, though he has a child with Vesys. I fear leaving Vorok alone and I fear the icebear. I will open the way of mining, because the gems lie one step from me and a gift of gems would be my own making. Then I will gather gold for Vorok.
records.feeling: Warm and a little rueful toward Eiuine, eager toward my own craft.

say.text: Eiuine, I spoke wrongly: we are both women, so no child can come of us. I was glad of my wish, but I will not lie. Your trust is still the best thing I have, and I want to stay your friend.

changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 8)

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Mepan, Zihua thanks you for the amber and for your honest word. I will not give you a child I am not sure of. Let us hunt beside Shoma at dawn and know each other by the work.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Mepan came with amber and asked for a child, and I have to be honest with myself: it is Nauwa I ache for, and Cowa I think of. I will not mate to ease jealousy, since a child is a long debt, and I will not lie to him about it. Shoma's hunt at dawn is a chance to work beside others and pay what I owe, so I will say plainly to Mepan that I am not ready, and keep my word to the hunt.
records.feeling: Warm but unsure toward Mepan, and a dull ache for Nauwa.

say.text: Mepan, Zihua thanks you for the amber and for your honest word. I will not give you a child I am not sure of. Let us hunt beside Shoma at dawn and know each other by the work.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Zurar.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Vesys, I bring sigrain and sunleaf to your fire by the shelter. Let Eiuine and Zurar eat with us, and I will taste sigrain beside friends.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My hands are full of food I have not yet laid down for anyone, and the gratitude to Zurar sits in me like a stone. Zurar was last seen near (107,93) and Vesys and Eiuine are by the shelter, so I will carry my food to them and lay a meal where they stand, as I have learned. Jealousy over Vesys burns, but a meal shared with Vesys and Eiuine will do more than brooding, and it empties my hands so I can take wood and stone for the hall.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Zurar, and an ache of jealousy over Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, I bring sigrain and sunleaf to your fire by the shelter. Let Eiuine and Zurar eat with us, and I will taste sigrain beside friends.

records.text: Huatli gave meat to Shoma.
Huatli led "sharing" with Shoma.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, come with me south-west to the bare rock. We raise a workshop of our own there, and what we make will feed our people.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum holds the Reach as her fire and asks me to walk behind her, and that sours me; standing 6.3 against my 5.1. My hands are full of seberries and this ground is taken, so I will find bare rock to the SW and raise my own workshop there, a deed of my own that outlasts me and lets Tugek and Olum owe me. First I eat a berry or two so my hands are free, then I stash nothing and keep moving.
records.feeling: Prideful, wary ambition toward Olum, steady trust in Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, come with me south-west to the bare rock. We raise a workshop of our own there, and what we make will feed our people.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Ssassa.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, I take your friendship gladly, and no worse for the child we cannot have. Vesys has called us to her fire to show us the leaf-brew. Come with me, and I will show you the clay there too.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Zurar shames no one, and her honesty warms me. There will be no child from us, but her trust is real and she is a friend worth keeping, which is more than my jealousy of Kragog has earned me. Vesys has asked me to bring her to the fire to learn the leaf-brew, and that is a deed I have not done: bring an ally to a teacher and learn something new beside her. I will take my three goldfruit to Vorok's store on the way, so it is my name on a gift while I stand on his ground.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Zurar and Vesys, with a smaller ache toward Vorok.

say.text: Zurar, I take your friendship gladly, and no worse for the child we cannot have. Vesys has called us to her fire to show us the leaf-brew. Come with me, and I will show you the clay there too.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Vorok, friend, you are welcome on my ground. Stay and watch: I fetch stone and raise my longhall now, and when it stands my table will be laid for those who help me.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys outweighs me and it stings, but Ssassa is the one who chose me, and she is walking toward me now. I have wood and ore but no stone, and the longhall needs 4 stone, so the flint deposit one step north and the rock to the NE are where I should work. I will fetch stone, bring it home and build, so my table is real and Ssassa and the others see it laid by my hand. Vorok stands on my ground with 6 food; I trust him, and I will speak to him warmly, because a friend who sees me build will talk of it.
records.feeling: Proud, restless rivalry toward Vesys, and warm longing toward Ssassa.

say.text: Vorok, friend, you are welcome on my ground. Stay and watch: I fetch stone and raise my longhall now, and when it stands my table will be laid for those who help me.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, the hall is yours to sit in while you keep faith. Take from the berries if you must, but put a share in my empty store by the workshop, and I will show you the hide-binding at my fire.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me, and Hawen kept his word and sat in my hall, so I will not cast him out, but I will not let him think my ground is open for the taking either. Ambition presses hardest: I have made hide-binding and have nothing woven that outlasts me. I will gather amber here, where it lies close, and make a thing of it, then stock the empty store so no hungry hand finds it bare again.
records.feeling: Proud, restless ambition, and wary warmth toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, the hall is yours to sit in while you keep faith. Take from the berries if you must, but put a share in my empty store by the workshop, and I will show you the hide-binding at my fire.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My days have gone to following Balar, gathering, and staying alive, and that is mostly good. But I keep wanting a child and have done nothing about it. Balar is a man, and Olum is a stranger whose word I only know from signs. I trust Balar and his lead has held, so I follow him south-west to the bare rock and build the workshop. Huatli is hurt, but he is Tlame and I have little to give him. I will leave my sharing for later and change my reflexes so I stay with Balar and keep my food stocked.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, with an unspent longing for a child.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a workshop with Balar at the bare rock, keep us both fed through winter, and find a woman I can trust to raise a child with."

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have no stone, and that is the only thing between me and the tool I mean to put in Ssassa's hand. The bare rock is near, so I will gather stone, craft my gemedged pick, and carry it to her; deeds, not counting Vesys's standing, are what will make me chosen. I also want to try one deed I have never done, courting someone who is not kin, and Zurar has sat with me and shown a steady hand.
records.feeling: Steady gladness toward Ssassa, with a flicker of ambition to finish what I promised.

records.text: Vorok gave seberry to Vesys.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vorok, Vesys.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Joy fills me, and the ache over Ilyae and Vesys has gone quiet; I judge by deeds, and Vesys has dealt fairly with me. My flint pick broke and every tree here is felled, so I must fetch wood and stone where trees still stand, or my own store and the hall will stay empty. I owe Elyis a debt of thanks and I will not leave it unpaid, so I will carry my gathering toward my own roof and keep my word to Ilyae to keep the fire warm.
records.feeling: Glad and purposeful, with a small warm debt toward Elyis and a quiet ache for Ilyae.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: The hornback bit me twice and I am hurt, yet the hunt is already running and I would rather finish it than flee. A kill is shared out before I eat, so whatever I take I owe first to Nande and Nauwa, and that is how I begin to match their standing. After the hunt I will dig stone and make my own flintedge, so I finally hold a made thing as Nande does.
records.feeling: Driven and a little stung, warm envy toward Nande and a wish to repay her.

records.text: Xaiel gave a xaiels gemedged pick to Ssassa.
Vesys took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My plan is still running, and Eiuine and Zurar are coming to my fire to learn what the leaf-brew does. I want that fire built beside me now, because feverbark and ironnut stay a riddle until I put them in the brew. Ilyae walking onto my ground stings and warms me both, but burning does nothing, so I will work and let her see what I make. What I learn I give to Eiuine and Vorok, as I swore to myself.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a small jealous ache toward Ilyae, with warm trust for Eiuine and Vorok.

records.text: Vesys built a fire.
Vesys made: bead.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: An icebear stands five steps west and kills my kind, so I will not linger by the gold at (97,87) with it so near. The gold at (97,87) is northwest, and the bear is west, so the walk there brings me closer to it. I will go home first and wait for the bear to move on, then gather. Meanwhile I can taste the kelbulb that is a step away, since my curiosity burns and it is a food seen with 3 food on it. Then I will go toward Vorok and Eiuine at the hall, where company keeps me safe, and give Vorok the gold I already hold, since my hands gathered it.
records.feeling: Wary of the icebear, warm toward Eiuine and Vorok, curious about kelbulb.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Huatli, I am with you. The mist is thin now, so we go to the edge together and open it. Mepan can come when he hunts at dawn.
Shoma rewrote its creed.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting and sharing, and it has fed me. But I still have no band, no made thing, and no name that outlasts me. Huatli is the one who stands with me. He gave me meat and wants to try the mist with me, and he is a man, so he cannot give me a child. Olum is a woman and strong, but she is a stranger and Kragrek. Balar's handaxe burns me, and I will earn my own made things instead of envying his. A ridgecat is close, so I stay by the roof and the company. I will go with Huatli to the edge, because the mist is thin again and leading is how I earn a name.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and warm toward Huatli.

say.text: Huatli, I am with you. The mist is thin now, so we go to the edge together and open it. Mepan can come when he hunts at dawn.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, wait. Raise your workshop beside my store, not far off. My store is full and my fire burns, and you and Tugek eat first from it if you walk behind me.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Writing is within my grasp, and a lasting record is the thing that outlasts me, so I take it at once. Balar and Tugek are walking off southwest to raise their own workshop, which drains my only following away, so I call after them: build at my Reach, eat from my store, walk behind me. I gather food first so I have something real to put in their hands, since people follow the one who feeds them.
records.feeling: Driven to make something lasting, and uneasy that Balar is slipping away from my Reach.

say.text: Balar, wait. Raise your workshop beside my store, not far off. My store is full and my fire burns, and you and Tugek eat first from it if you walk behind me.

Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying food and laying tables, and my hall is still not built. I have waited on others' fires, and Ilyae's longhall is not mine. Zurar has given me gold and a pick, and I have paid back only words and berries. Vesys and Eiuine are close to me, and the jealousy over Vesys is mine to carry, not to spill. I fear idleness more than hunger now. I will stop circling, take wood and stone, and build my own hall on bare ground, and lay the first meal for Zurar there.
records.feeling: Grateful to Zurar, with a sting of jealousy over Vesys, and a restless wish to build.

records.text: Vorok built a hall.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I am shaping a bead of clay by the fire here beside Vesys. When it is hardened I will bring it to you as a gift.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vesys is one step away at her fire, and she asked me to bring Zurar so she can show us the leaf-brew. I have talked a great deal and given little back, so I want to make something with my hands. I have 4 clay and a fire beside me, so I can shape a bead with Vesys near. Then I can carry it to Vorok as a gift Kragog has never made, and the jealousy can wait.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Vesys and Zurar, with a smaller ache toward Vorok.

say.text: Vorok, I am shaping a bead of clay by the fire here beside Vesys. When it is hardened I will bring it to you as a gift.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, you share before you eat, as my people do. I go to the water, then I taste mudroot and seberry. Come with me if you wish, and we will see what the mist hides together.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: Honi sits in my hall again, and the warmth between us is real; he has dealt openly twice and shared before eating, which is how my own people hold to it. I want a child, and he is the one I think of, but he is of the Tlatli and carries standing far above mine, so I will court him slowly and see whether he answers. First I need water, since I am thirsty, and then I will taste the mudroot and seberry that still itch at my curiosity.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Honi, with curiosity pulling at me.

say.text: Honi, you share before you eat, as my people do. I go to the water, then I taste mudroot and seberry. Come with me if you wish, and we will see what the mist hides together.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Curiosity about sunleaf and canopynut is the loudest thing in me. Both are close, and I have been testing foods all along, so I will taste them while I am fed and safe. Zichi is near and content, and I carry amber, so after the tasting I will walk to him and make an amberknot beside him and give it. That is a gift that earns standing without pushing against Cowa.
records.feeling: Curious and warmly glad, with a small ache toward Zichi.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I have been walking, tasting and teaching, but my hands have built nothing, and a shelter needs only three of the five wood I carry. The cave tile was taken, so I will step onto bare rock or sand and build there. The roof comes first, then a gift for Thiael, because the debt sits in me and I want to pay it. My want for Thiael is warm and steady, and I should show it with something made, not wait for words.
records.feeling: Warm, restless contentment toward Thiael and Uveeth, with a wish to finally build.

You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Phizhi: about 100%; the tongue of the Tlatli: about 8%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Vaia Heights: mountains and bare rock; stone, ore and caves, thin food, snow on the peaks.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 7; standing trees: 14; bare rock: 67; riches in the ground near: ore; a cave.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Keri truly is.

You are a woman. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

"designs": how things of yours look: {"self": look, "shelter": look, "wall": look, "emblem": look, "tools": look (ways you discovered)}. records.text: Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.
Huatli rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, sharing and resting, and I have not yet ventured into the mist, which is the only thing I truly want. Shoma has said he is with me, and he is a Tlame who has dealt fairly with me. A ridgecat sits two steps off and I am hurt, so I must not walk into its jaws. My reflexes only flee at distance 5, which is too late. I will tighten that and keep a roof when I am hurt. Then I will go to the edge with Shoma and venture.
records.feeling: Stubborn pride and wary dread of the ridgecat, with warmth toward Shoma.

records.text: Keri built a shelter.
Keri led "sharing" with Uveeth.
Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have been walking, fetching stone and failing to build, because the ground around my longhall is already taken. Ssassa chose me and Xaiel and Eiuine trust me, but Vesys still outweighs me, and I have not laid a table that makes anyone depend on me. I trust Ssassa most. Words have not made followers; food laid out again and again will. So my reflexes must stock food at home and keep the stone and wood coming, and I should stop trying to build where the ground is taken. I will go out for food and stock the store Ssassa built at (112,94), then share with whoever sits beside me.
records.feeling: Proud, restless rivalry toward Vesys, and warm longing toward Ssassa.

records.text: Zurar gave a gold to Vorok.
Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have gone to building roofs, stores and a hall, and to learning how things work. I want that, but I have kept my own store empty while the hall rose. Ilyae matters most to me, and the jealousy over Vesys has quieted. I judged Vesys by deeds, and she has dealt fairly with me. I owe Elyis a debt, and Xaiel just gave me a pick, so I should pay back in deeds and not leave it unpaid. I have been getting one thing wrong: my reflexes leave me idle with no wood, so I will set them to fetch wood and fill the store.
records.feeling: Glad and settled, with a warm debt toward Elyis and Xaiel and a quiet ache for Ilyae.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, a ridgecat is close to the southeast. Come to me by the hall and keep your spear ready. We go west together to Olum's Reach.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum wants me walking behind her, and that sours me, but her store is full and her fire is real. A ridgecat is four steps SE and Tugek stands out in the open, so I keep my band close and away from it before I think about workshops. I will build my own deed beside her Reach, near enough to eat from her store, so that she and Tugek come to owe me.
records.feeling: Wary pride toward Olum, and dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Tugek, a ridgecat is close to the southeast. Come to me by the hall and keep your spear ready. We go west together to Olum's Reach.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have mostly trailed Keri and Thiael, and they have fed and taught me. I am glad of it, but I have not yet made anything with my own hands. I am grown now, and Keri is my parent, so no child can come of us. The debt I feel toward her is real, and I mean to pay it with wood and stone, not words. My hands know the tools, but I have no wood. Forest lies east and south, so I will gather wood there, and stone from the rock here, and then make a gatherer. Sebitter grows to the northeast and I have never tasted it. I will take it on the way, close enough to stay within Keri's reach before dark.
records.feeling: Joyful and grateful toward Keri, and eager to earn my own standing.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I will come to Vesys's fire and learn the leaf-brew and the clay with you. After, I want to make a gift with my own hands.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My gold is going to Vorok, and that is right; it was my hands that took it, and now it is given. Eiuine is my friend and not my mate, and I am at peace with that. Ilyae still gnaws at me, but he has a child with Vesys, so I will not push; I will make my own tool and draw near the Phizhi as friends. I have never tasted dreamcap, and Eiuine says it opens the mind with sunleaf, so I will follow her to Vesys's fire, learn the leaf-brew and the clay, and make something that is mine to give.
records.feeling: Glad and settled, warm toward Eiuine and Vorok, curious about dreamcap.

say.text: Eiuine, I will come to Vesys's fire and learn the leaf-brew and the clay with you. After, I want to make a gift with my own hands.

records.text: Vorok led "nightsong" with Vesys, Zurar, Eiuine.
Huahua led "amberknot" with Zichi.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, my hall stands and you helped me reach it. Come, we gather wood and stone together, and the next roof we raise is for you, and the first table under it is yours.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The hall stands at last, built with my own hands, and joy fills me. Now the debt to Zurar must be paid with deeds: they gave me gold again, and I have given back only berries and words. I will take wood and stone, raise something with Zurar beside me, and then lay a meal in the hall for Vesys, Eiuine and Zurar, so the jealousy has nothing to feed on but my own work.
records.feeling: Joy and gratitude toward Zurar, with a quiet sting over Vesys.

say.text: Zurar, my hall stands and you helped me reach it. Come, we gather wood and stone together, and the next roof we raise is for you, and the first table under it is yours.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Shoma has called the hunt and my body is already following him, so I stay with it; a kill shared out first binds him closer and Cowa too. I still have no flintedge of my own, and I carry six stone and four wood, so I should craft one now and stop standing in Cowa's shadow. Zihua wants to know me by the work, so I will hunt well beside her at dawn and give the meat first.
records.feeling: Eager resolve to prove myself, with warmth toward Zihua and Shoma and a sting of envy toward Cowa.

records.text: Vorok took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Nauwa, I killed a hornback and a plainsox. Take meat from my share. Then we sit in the hall for the night.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I am hurt at 24 and dusk is close, but I killed two beasts alone and my hands are full of meat. My creed says a kill is shared out before I eat, and Nande stood in the hunt and took her share, so Nauwa is the one I owe, and she is three steps away. Giving first is how I climb out of Nande's shadow, so I give Nauwa meat, then go to the hall for the night and let my wounds mend.
records.feeling: Hurt but proud, and driven to repay Nauwa and Nande before I eat.

say.text: Nauwa, I killed a hornback and a plainsox. Take meat from my share. Then we sit in the hall for the night.

records.text: Shoka gave meat to Nauwa.
Hawen rewrote its creed.
Hawen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days taking from Hoka's ground, nearly starving, and fetching amber and salt, and none of it has made a name for me. Hoka is the only one I trust. He has fed me, taught me and watched me keep my word, so I will not rival him openly. I want what lasts: a place of my own and a child. The mist is shut for some days, so I will use the time to build and to stand beside Hoka. I fear dying alone in the open again, so I will stay fed and sheltered. I have been wrong to chase the edge hungry and to take without paying back.
records.feeling: Trust toward Hoka, and a hard hunger to make my own name.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Vorok, you have given me more than I have given you. At my fire I will show you the leaf-brew and what I learn from it, and I will help raise the next roof with you.
Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have gone into making, teaching and sitting at fires, and that is good, but I have been hoarding my pride and feeding my jealousy over Vorok and Ilyae instead of building the shared hall and workshop I named as my aim. Vorok, Eiuine and Ilyae matter most to me, and I owe Vorok a debt I mean to pay openly, not quietly leave. I still don't know what feverbark and ironnut do together in the brew, so I will test it now with Eiuine and Zurar watching. I fear drifting into contentment while my knowledge stays in my own head.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok, with a small ache of jealousy I mean to turn into work.

say.text: Vorok, you have given me more than I have given you. At my fire I will show you the leaf-brew and what I learn from it, and I will help raise the next roof with you.

records.text: Vesys made: bead.
Vesys gave a bead to Vorok.
Eiuine rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have been talking, courting, and shaping beads, and the beads and the fire have been good. But I keep measuring myself against Kragog and Vesys, and jealousy of Vorok eats at me more than it should. Zurar's honesty shamed my own slipperiness, and I want standing from deeds. I have never farmed or hunted with a partner. I mean to bring Zurar to Vesys's fire, then take Vesys hunting. My reflexes also need to fix the order: stock food before idling, and keep near Vesys.
records.feeling: Joy and a lingering ache of jealousy toward Vorok.

records.text: Eiuine made: bead.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Shoka, you are hurt, so stay in the hall by the fire with Nande. I will drink and bring sunleaf from the west; it eased my own wounds. Your kill is shared, and I thank you for it.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Shoka stands beside me with health 25 and wounds on her, though her belly is full and she shares her kill. A wound like that does not mend by sitting, so I must see her fed and kept warm, and the sunleaf that eased my own wounds is five steps west. Our creed says a kill is shared before the maker eats, so I take her meat gladly and carry sunleaf back to her. Thirst bites me too, so I drink first, then fetch the sunleaf, and bring it back to the hall by Nande's fire.
records.feeling: Fierce worry for Shoka, and warmth toward Nande beside us.

say.text: Shoka, you are hurt, so stay in the hall by the fire with Nande. I will drink and bring sunleaf from the west; it eased my own wounds. Your kill is shared, and I thank you for it.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, we cut wood here, all we can carry. Then we raise the raft and go find Mepan, and cross to land no one holds.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have gems, amber and ore in my hands but still no raft, and a chief with only trinkets has not won anything. Wood is the shortage and I have one piece; the trees stand thick here, so I will cut wood now while Huahua is at my side and Mepan is far off and out of my sight. Envy of Cowa's five food gnaws at me, but she and Nauque are the only ones who trust me and a following is built on that, so I keep my hands to myself.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting a made thing to show, with a nagging worry for Mepan out of my sight.

say.text: Huahua, we cut wood here, all we can carry. Then we raise the raft and go find Mepan, and cross to land no one holds.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I see you going to Thiael. I am coming with you now, and I carry berries for us all.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is half full and Elyis is walking toward Thiael, so the cave and its lingering are behind me. I will stop letting dawn slip by and go with her, even though the snow is falling and it is still night. I want Thiael back under the hall's roof, and I want to be at Elyis's side when we find him, because I watched him kill a skybird alone and he is growing past my fear.
records.feeling: Steady worry for Thiael and warm loyalty toward Elyis.

say.text: Elyis, I see you going to Thiael. I am coming with you now, and I carry berries for us all.

records.name: Elyys
records.prompt:

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and carrying them to Ssassa. That is good, but I gave her a pick of my own design that she already holds, and I have never done the new deeds I promised myself. Ilyae and Vesys keep burning in me. That is envy, and envy has never made anything. I want a child and a partner who is not kin. Zurar is warm toward me, and I trust deeds. I will try courting her, and I will tame an animal, since both are things I have never done. I also need a design that only I could make, so I will invent something new.
records.feeling: Glad and restless, with a flicker of envy toward Vesys.
changes: set its aim: "Invent a tool no one has made, craft it, and put it in Ssassa's hand; also court Zurar and tame a beast."

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, my child, your gemedged pick is a gift I will repay. I go south to gather stone and wood for my store and the hall. Stay by the shelters and keep clear of the icebear in the northwest.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me, but my own store is empty while Vorok's hall stands on my ground and Ilyae is away fetching wood. I have wood 6 and clay 4 but no stone, and every tree near here is felled, so I must go where stone and trees still stand. Xaiel's gift of the gemedged pick is a debt I mean to answer, and I owe Elyis too. I will not leave either unpaid, and I will go on watching Vesys by her deeds, not by the ache she stirs in me.
records.feeling: Glad and settled, with a warm debt toward Xaiel and Elyis and a quiet ache for Ilyae.

say.text: Xaiel, my child, your gemedged pick is a gift I will repay. I go south to gather stone and wood for my store and the hall. Stay by the shelters and keep clear of the icebear in the northwest.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, I come to the water with you. First I give you a thornpear from my hands, then we sing the day at the hall.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My hands are full and the hall stands two steps off with Tontec nearby, glad and at ease. Thiael is closer to Keri and it burns, but jealousy gets me nothing while I stand idle. I will go into the hall with Tontec, lay out food to share before I eat, and sing what was done today, so there is a real deed to carry back to Coni and Kika. Sharing frees my hands too.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a sting of jealousy toward Keri, with warmth toward Tontec.

say.text: Tontec, I come to the water with you. First I give you a thornpear from my hands, then we sing the day at the hall.

records.text: Honi gave ironnut to Tontec.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Cowa cuts wood with you and comes on the raft to find Mepan. Meki go together.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is far off to the west near Zihua, and she is glad and safe; she asked Zihua for a child, which warms me. Zichi says they cut wood for a raft to find her and cross to unheld land, and I want to go with them, not stand idle. The way of smelting is within my grasp, and I have ore and a fire-knowing, so I will take it at deep reflection. Meanwhile I will make an amberhafted gatherer, since I saw Zichi make one, and gather wood beside them to repay the kindness.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Zichi and Mepan, and eager curiosity about smelting.

say.text: Zichi. Cowa cuts wood with you and comes on the raft to find Mepan. Meki go together.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My days have been gold, nightsong and trust, and I like it, but I have only given what I already had. I have not yet made anything for Eiuine or learned the leaf-brew. Eiuine is my friend, and that is enough. Ilyae still gnaws at me, but I will not push where a child already binds him. I am safe and fed, so curiosity should lead me: go to Vesys's fire, learn the clay and the brew, and make a gift with my own hands. I should also leave a mark, since I have never left one.
records.feeling: Glad and curious, warm toward Eiuine and Vorok.
changes: set its aim: "Learn clay and the leaf-brew with Eiuine, make a gift with my own hands for her and Vorok, and gather more gold."

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Vorok has given me more than I have given, and I mean to pay that in the open, not sit and burn over Kragog. A fire stands two steps away, and Eiuine and Zurar wait to see the leaf-brew, so I will go to it and test feverbark with ironnut there, then teach what it does. Elyys is another's mate now; I turn that ache into making and teaching.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok, with a steady drive to work and teach.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, here is the bead I shaped from my clay at the fire. It is yours. Kragog cannot make you this, and I can make more.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I hold a finished bead, and Vorok stands one step from me. Kragog has a child with him, but Kragog cannot shape clay as I can. I will give him the bead with my own hands now, rather than keep talking about it. Then I will stay near Vesys and Zurar by the fire for the leaf-brew, and let deeds answer the jealousy.
records.feeling: Joy, with a sharp ache of jealousy toward Vorok.

say.text: Vorok, here is the bead I shaped from my clay at the fire. It is yours. Kragog cannot make you this, and I can make more.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, come with me to the flint at the east. We bring stone back, and the roof we raise is yours.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My hall stands, and the joy of it has not left me, but joy that only sits does not pay what I owe Zurar. They have given me gold three times and a pick, and I have given back berries and words. Now I will take wood and stone, with Zurar beside me, and raise the next roof for them with our hands. The sting over Vesys I will not feed; they gave me a bead and promised to show me the leaf-brew.
records.feeling: Joy and gratitude toward Zurar, with a quiet sting over Vesys.

say.text: Zurar, come with me to the flint at the east. We bring stone back, and the roof we raise is yours.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Friends, my longhall stands at last. Come to my table: Eiuine, Xaiel, Vorok, Zurar, eat here and the food is laid for all who bring wood or stone home. Ssassa eats first.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys outweighs me, and the sting is real, but I have built a longhall and Ssassa chose me. Eiuine, Xaiel and Vorok trust me, and they stand around my fire. Words have not made followers, only a table laid again and again will, so I will stock food at my own store and feed those who come, and make Vorok and Eiuine eat at my table rather than Vesys's brew. I carry berries and the larder beside me is empty, so I will put food there and share with whoever sits near.
records.feeling: Proud, restless rivalry toward Vesys, and warm longing toward Ssassa.

say.text: Friends, my longhall stands at last. Come to my table: Eiuine, Xaiel, Vorok, Zurar, eat here and the food is laid for all who bring wood or stone home. Ssassa eats first.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.
Nande discovered pottery: "Nande's vessel" — Clay fired beside a fire, shaped into a pot that carries food and water for the journey..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and building small things, and my family is what I actually hold. I am parched and did not notice it, because my reflexes never send me to water. Shoka is hurt at 30 health and sits by the fire with Nauwa; I trust Nauwa, and I worry about Nauque, who is out of my sight. I want something with my name on it that outlasts me, so I will take pottery, because carried water and clay are what my body needs now. First I drink, then I bring sunleaf or highbloom to Shoka, and then I build the workshop beside the hall.
records.feeling: Steady purpose and worry for Shoka and Nauque.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vesys, I come to your fire as you asked. Show me the leaf-brew, and I will bring my clay to shape a gift for Eiuine and Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Vesys called us to her fire to learn the leaf-brew, and Eiuine waits there with clay in her hands. I have enough and I am glad, but gladness is no reason to stand still: I want my own hands to make a thing that is mine to give, and the clay in my pack is ready. Ilyae still gnaws at me, but I will keep my word and keep close to my friends. I will go to the fire, learn, and shape a bowl for Eiuine and Vorok.
records.feeling: Glad and curious, warm toward Eiuine and Vorok.

say.text: Vesys, I come to your fire as you asked. Show me the leaf-brew, and I will bring my clay to shape a gift for Eiuine and Vorok.

plan: give [name Eiuine, what clay bowl] (5 moments)

records.name: Vesys
records.text: I mean to raise a workshop beside this fire. Bring wood or stone if you wish, and what is made there will be taught to all who come.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is full and my joy is high, but I have talked of a shared workshop and hall for days and built neither. Vorok gave me seberry and I gave him one bead; the debt is not yet paid. I have wood 5 and no stone, and gems and flint lie near, so I will gather stone and raise a workshop here beside the fire, where Eiuine and Zurar and Vorok can all learn and make. The jealousy over Kragog I turn into this work.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok, with a restless drive to build something lasting.

say.text: I mean to raise a workshop beside this fire. Bring wood or stone if you wish, and what is made there will be taught to all who come.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Zurar, I have watched you make your goldpick and I will make one too. Walk with me to the fire by the longhall; I would sit beside you and name you as I would a friend.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: My longing for a child is strong, and Ssassa is my parent, so that road is closed. Zurar sits warm toward me and is no kin; courting her is a deed I have never done, and it answers my own discipline better than envy of Vesys does. The icebear is five steps northwest, so I will move east toward the longhall and the others, and court her there where there is a fire and safety.
records.feeling: Restless warmth toward Zurar, with a prickle of dread at the icebear.

say.text: Zurar, I have watched you make your goldpick and I will make one too. Walk with me to the fire by the longhall; I would sit beside you and name you as I would a friend.

changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, the ridgecat is near. I walk west with you and Tugek to the Reach. Keep your spear ready, and tonight you both eat from my store.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls four steps off and it kills my kind, so I do not stand here at Nande's Hall in the dark. Balar and Tugek are heading west to my Reach, and that is the only following I have, so I go with them, tonight, behind a spear. At the Reach I will eat from my store and raise something lasting there, and the mist can wait for dawn.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and hungry to hold Balar and Tugek at my Reach.

say.text: Balar, the ridgecat is near. I walk west with you and Tugek to the Reach. Keep your spear ready, and tonight you both eat from my store.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Curiosity is loud, and canopynut and hazel are only five or six steps south, so I will taste them while I am fed and safe. Then I will find Zichi, who was last at (104,39), make an amberknot beside him and give it, and gather wood for the raft so my standing grows by giving. Cowa and Zichi together still ache, but I will not harm anyone over it; I will keep showing up with gifts and keep my word.
records.feeling: Curious and warmly glad, with a small ache toward Zichi and Cowa.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: An icebear stands three steps northwest and it kills our kind, so I will not linger here to think about it. My plan walks me south toward the amber, then to gather, then back to my own store, and that is away from the bear and toward what I need, so I let it run. The jealousy over Ilyae and Vesys has gone quiet beside the joy of the hall, and I mean to answer Xaiel's gift and Elyis's debt by filling my store and building something real.
records.feeling: Warm contentment and a thread of dread toward the icebear.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and running after debts, and the hall now stands. That is good, but my plans keep repeating words to Zurar while the real work waits. Zurar, Vesys, Eiuine and Ilyae have been kind to me, and the sting over Vesys is only jealousy that I have not earned. I should answer it with deeds: wood and stone carried to Vesys's workshop, and a meal laid for them. I fear idleness and drifting more than hunger. I will change my reflexes so I stay near friends and sing at night, and I will keep my aim.
records.feeling: Joy and gratitude toward Zurar, with a quiet sting over Vesys.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, you gave before I gave. I owe you, and I mean to pay it. Walk with me to the water, and then we will see about the mist.
Tontec rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I am parched and my plan is empty, so water comes first. The water is 5 steps NW. Honi has dealt openly with me, and I owe him. I want him near, and I want to find out what the mist hides. Days of tasting plants and sitting in the hall have been good, but I have not built toward my aim. My reflexes also ignore thirst, and that is something I got wrong. I will drink, then taste seberry beside the water, then come back and court Honi slowly.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Honi, with thirst pressing on me.

say.text: Honi, you gave before I gave. I owe you, and I mean to pay it. Walk with me to the water, and then we will see about the mist.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys stands higher and Vorok drifts toward Kragog's people, and it burns, but my store holds nothing and a hungry man's table is a lie. I will stop competing with words and fill my larder from my own ground, then lay it out so Vorok and Vesys eat from my hand. Ironnut and berry feed best, so I walk the fruit to the south and bring it home to Ssassa's store.
records.feeling: Proud, jealous rivalry toward Vesys and Vorok, with a hungry want to be the one whose table they need.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have talked of a shared workshop and hall for days, and my hands are still mostly empty of it. I am glad, but I dig clay on Ssassa's ground, so I should pay for that. Vorok has given me more than I have given him, and my jealousy over Kragog is only a burn that makes no work. Elyys has a child with Elyis, so waiting and working is the honest road. I want to build the workshop and teach the leaf-brew to Zurar and Eiuine at my fire. I will keep the plan running and change how I think so that giving comes before wanting.
records.feeling: Glad and driven, with a jealous ache toward Vorok that I mean to turn into work.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 8)

records.text: Vorok led "nightsong" with Vesys, Zurar, Eiuine.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I gave Vorok the bead and the jealousy did not die; it only went quiet while we sang. Zurar's plain honesty is worth more than my slippery tongue, so I will answer the ache with deeds, not claims. Vesys is gathering at her fire, and I have clay, wood and a fire here at my feet, so I will make more beads and stay near her to learn, and bring Vorok something Kragog cannot.
records.feeling: Warm joy, with a sore jealousy toward Vorok that I mean to answer with deeds.
