records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, my hands do not yet know the clay bowl. Teach me here by the fire, and I will shape it with the clay I carry and give it to you and Vorok when it is hard.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My plan was to give Eiuine a clay bowl, but I do not know how to make one, so that step is only empty air; my word must not outrun my hands. Eiuine stands right beside me and has the knowing, so I will ask her to teach me the clay bowl here and now, then shape it with the clay I carry and fire beside us. I am glad and fed, and the gift that is mine to give will be made by me, not promised.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, warm toward Eiuine and Vorok.

say.text: Eiuine, my hands do not yet know the clay bowl. Teach me here by the fire, and I will shape it with the clay I carry and give it to you and Vorok when it is hard.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Cowa, I carry food and have enough. Stand with me a while. I mean to raise a raft and cross to new land, and I would have you beside me.
Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauque discovered rafts: "Frost-lash" — Logs lashed with frost-cord into a raft that carries me over deep water..

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Days of trailing Zichi and glaring at Cowa have left me with nothing built and no one following me. Zichi gets the raft and the glory while I wait. I don't want to burn on envy. I want a roof with my name on it and a pupil who carries my teaching. Cowa stands right here and trusts me, so I will give to her first and stay fair. Rafts are within my grasp, and they are the way across the mist water to the edge at (88,6) and the land past it. I take them now, then gather wood and build.
records.feeling: Jealous and ambitious, but steadier, toward Zichi and Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, I carry food and have enough. Stand with me a while. I mean to raise a raft and cross to new land, and I would have you beside me.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The hall stands, joy fills me, and still the debt to Zurar sits unpaid while my words repeat. Dawn is near, so I will carry wood and stone with Zurar and raise something real, not talk again. The sting over Vesys I answer by giving, not envy: a meal laid for Eiuine and Vesys beneath a roof of my own making.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager toward Zurar, with a faint sting of jealousy toward Vesys.

records.text: Mepan and Zichi, Zihua and Shoma brought down a nibbet together.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, we move now. Walk beside me, spear ready, and keep Olum between us and the cat.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum wants me walking behind her, and it galls me, but her store is full and her fire is real, and the ridgecat is still close. I will not argue with her or with the cat. I will move my band west toward the Reach with Tugek, then find my own ground beside it where I can raise a roof and a workshop that is mine and that she and Tugek come to owe me for. Standing 5.1 against her 6.4 will close by deeds, not talk.
records.feeling: Wary pride toward Olum, and watchfulness of the ridgecat.

say.text: Tugek, we move now. Walk beside me, spear ready, and keep Olum between us and the cat.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Zurar, you came to my fire and asked, so I pay you first. Take the feverbark seed and watch the brew with Eiuine. I go to gather stone for the workshop, and when it stands you will have a place in it.
Vesys taught Zurar. Zurar has now learned from 4 teachers.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My workshop failed for want of stone, and I have been talking of it for days. Flint lies seven steps east and gems nearer, so I will gather stone first and build it here by the fire. Vorok stands close and I do not want to burn at him; I will pay what I owe by teaching Zurar the leaf-brew now, since she came to my fire and asked, and by giving Eiuine and her a place to work in the workshop.
records.feeling: Driven and glad, with a quiet ache toward Vorok that I am turning into work.

say.text: Zurar, you came to my fire and asked, so I pay you first. Take the feverbark seed and watch the brew with Eiuine. I go to gather stone for the workshop, and when it stands you will have a place in it.

changes: taught Zurar a lesson: "Leaf-brew: set feverbark over a fire, watch what it does, and the brew eases wounds. I share it freely.", deeper lore (+0.7)

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, come to the fire at my side. Bring your clay and I will show you how to shape the bowl, hand over hand. Then we will make one for Vorok's store together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Zurar asked me to teach her the clay bowl, and that is a deed I can do right now beside the fire, one that binds an ally and earns standing without any boasting. I have one clay and a fire at my feet, so I will shape with her and let Vorok see what I make. The jealousy toward Vorok still burns, but pots brought to his store will answer it better than another speech.
records.feeling: Warm joy, with a sore jealousy toward Vorok that I will answer with deeds.

say.text: Zurar, come to the fire at my side. Bring your clay and I will show you how to shape the bowl, hand over hand. Then we will make one for Vorok's store together.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills our kind, so I will not stand here dreaming of children. Balar has said we go west to Olum's Reach, so I will keep close to him and move away from the cat, which is where his lead and my own caution agree. The longing for a child stays with me, but I will not court a woman I do not know; at Olum's store I can watch what she does with her fire and her food.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and steady trust in Balar.

say.text: Balar, the ridgecat is two steps northwest of us. I go with you west to the Reach, spear ready, and I stay at your side.

records.name: Zichi

The ridgecat six steps NW kills my kind, so I will not walk toward it; the trees stand NW beyond it, so I take the long way around the north edge and cut wood with Mepan at my side. Envy of Shoma's six food bites, but he hunted beside me and I want him as a follower more than as a mark, so I will speak warmly and give nothing yet.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting a made thing to show, wary of the ridgecat, with envy toward Shoma.

records.title: The Nightsong at Vorok's Hall
records.text:
Days 25 to 28 were summer, and most of what happened happened in the Ixra Rainforest. Vorok built his hall on day 27, and Ilyae finished a longhall the same day. Vorok led nightsong with Vesys, Zurar and Eiuine again and again through that day, and the record shows eighteen nightsongs in the world so far, nearly all of them his. Ilyae answered with sharing, leading it with Vorok, Vesys, Zurar and Eiuine three times. Vorok had discovered pottery on day 26, the ember-pot. Zurar, who follows Vorok, made a gold-pick, then learned mining, and gave gold to Eiuine and to Vorok. On day 27 Zurar and Eiuine each said they were courting the other, and Eiuine, who thanked him for the pick, said she would plan to mate with his name. Several of them wrote in their reflections that they feel jealousy, among them Vesys, Eiuine, Xaiel and Ssassa, and Vesys, Vorok and Ilyae are named in several of them.

Olum built a store and discovered storage on day 27, and a settlement formed at Olum's Reach. He led sharing with Balar, but still has no follower. Among the Meki, Mepan courted Shoma and then Zihua, and Zihua said she would not give a child she was unsure of. Amberknots kept circling. Thiael discovered rafts and Nauque discovered rafts on day 28, but no crossing is recorded. Shoka, hurt at 30 health, sat by a fire with Nauwa.

A blight took about half the frostmoss on day 27. Hawen gave Hoka amber and salt, and Hoka's store holds 12 food. Nothing is recorded of Hanna. Alive is still 34, with no new deaths.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I hold nothing edible, and the last plan ran dry in front of bare snow. This time I go where food is actually bearing: tacap hurts me, so I pass it and take rimewort, seberry and frostmoss near Hoka's Gate, then pick shell on the way. I miss Hoka and the loneliness is heavy, so I mean to carry food back and share it with him, as I promised, rather than only fill myself.
records.feeling: Hungry and lonely, with steady loyalty toward Hoka.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Zichi, Zihua, Mepan, Shoma has amber to give. Stand with me and I make a knot for each of you. Then walk behind me to the edge and open the mist, and the kill and the finds are shared out before I take mine.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Mepan is right here beside the igloo, and Zichi stands over him with a higher name than mine, and it burns. I cannot win Mepan by jealousy, and he cannot give me a child, so I will bind him and Zihua and Zichi with real gifts and a hunt, and make my standing in their sight. I have amber enough to spare, so I will make an amberknot with Zihua and Mepan beside me, then walk to the salt and gather it for a gift, and ask them to come with me toward the mist.
records.feeling: Jealous and hungry for standing, warm toward Mepan.

say.text: Zichi, Zihua, Mepan, Shoma has amber to give. Stand with me and I make a knot for each of you. Then walk behind me to the edge and open the mist, and the kill and the finds are shared out before I take mine.

records.text: Shoma led "amberknot" with Zichi, Zihua, Mepan.
Shoma gave a amberknot to Mepan.
Shoma led "amberknot" with Zichi, Zihua, Mepan.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Mepan, you are sick from raw meat. Eat meat only beside a fire, it cooks there. I will not mate with you yet, but I keep your gift in mind and will answer it with work. Rest, and I will bring salt.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Mepan is sick from raw meat and sickness passes to those who stay close, yet he is the one who gave me amber and an honest word, and I owe him. I will not mate while he is ill and while it is Nauwa my heart aches for; a child is a long debt and I will not lie about it. I can pay him with work instead: gather salt at the deposit north, which keeps meat from spoiling, and plant my seeds near the igloo, keeping a little distance from his sickness.
records.feeling: Compassion and wary gratitude toward Mepan, tempered by a dull ache for Nauwa.

say.text: Mepan, you are sick from raw meat. Eat meat only beside a fire, it cooks there. I will not mate with you yet, but I keep your gift in mind and will answer it with work. Rest, and I will bring salt.

records.text: Shoma gave a amberknot to Zichi.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Zichi, Zihua, Shoma, Mepan is sick from raw meat and it passes to those beside him. I walk apart to the sunleaf and come back healed. Keep from the dunecat in the west.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I am sick, and it spreads to whoever stands beside me, so I must not keep Zichi, Zihua and Shoma close or I will make them sick and lose their trust. The flintedge is made now, so my old aim is half done. A dunecat is five steps west and I am sick and weak, so I will not stand in its way. I will move off to the coal side away from the band, cook my meat at a fire so I do not sicken again, and look to a healing plant like sunleaf to the southeast, which eased my wounds before. When I am well I will hunt beside Cowa and Zichi and share the kill first, and earn my standing.
records.feeling: Uneasy resolve about my sickness and the dunecat, with warmth toward Zichi, Zihua and Shoma.

say.text: Zichi, Zihua, Shoma, Mepan is sick from raw meat and it passes to those beside him. I walk apart to the sunleaf and come back healed. Keep from the dunecat in the west.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Health is 55 and a ridgecat prowls west, so I will not fight it, but I will not sit in Nande's Hall forever either. Tugek's standing of 5.6 against my 1.6 galls me, and the only way to close it is to make and give and venture, not sit. Shoma said he is with me, so I walk to the edge at (88,13) and see whether he walks too. On the way I will pass my gold at (65,9), and I carry meat to share if Shoma or Cowa turns up.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a gnawing wish for standing, with warmth toward Shoma.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I am coming to your side with my clay. Show me the bowl and I will shape it with you.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Eiuine offered to teach me the bowl hand over hand, and I have clay in my pack. I will go to her side and learn it now instead of lingering, because my word to her and Vorok must be closed by my hands. Ilyae still gnaws at me, but Vorok and Eiuine are the ones who stand beside me, and I am glad of that.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, warm toward Eiuine and grateful to Vesys.

say.text: Eiuine, I am coming to your side with my clay. Show me the bowl and I will shape it with you.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Mepan, rest in the igloo and eat only beside a fire. I cut wood for the raft and come back to you.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Mepan is sick from raw meat and I stand in the igloo with him, so the sickness will pass to me if I linger. He needs shelter and rest, and I need wood for the raft, so I will cut wood on the north edge while he rests, keeping clear of the ridgecat. Shoma has six food and a name growing among the Ice-folk, and it stings, but a raft built first is a made thing that will outshine his knots.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Mepan, with restless pride and envy toward Shoma.

say.text: Mepan, rest in the igloo and eat only beside a fire. I cut wood for the raft and come back to you.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I have not tasted rimewort or lugoldgrass, so I will not say what they do. I will try the rimewort now and tell you true what happens. Wait until I speak.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Kika asked me what lugoldgrass and rimewort do, and I have rimewort in my hands yet have never tasted it, so I cannot honestly say. I will not claim to know what I don't; I'll taste it with her watching and tell her what happens, and that keeps my word good. My hands are full, so I will eat the rimewort and stash the rest in the store, then plant seeds near the hall as Kika taught me, so winter food grows.
records.feeling: Grateful and steady toward Kika, with a wish to answer her honestly.

say.text: Kika, I have not tasted rimewort or lugoldgrass, so I will not say what they do. I will try the rimewort now and tell you true what happens. Wait until I speak.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, first the coal north of us, then we bring Thiael home to the hall and the store grows with us all in sight.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys stands beside me and my chest is warm toward him, but four in the band is still small and a name is not sung over four. Thiael is the one I have been walking toward and I keep not reaching him; I will go to him now and bring him back to the hall. Then I will do visible work in front of strangers: mine the coal near here and carry it home, so the band sees a fuller store and so does anyone watching.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, restless to grow my band.

say.text: Elyys, first the coal north of us, then we bring Thiael home to the hall and the store grows with us all in sight.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Zichi, you build a raft for land no one holds. Shoma has stood beside you at the knot and the mammoth. Let me carry wood and stone with your band, and the finds are shared out before I take mine.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Zichi's name is heavy and mine is light, and it stings, but my hands are full of amber and the knots have bound all three a little closer. Mepan is sick and cannot give me a child, so I will not waste my longing on him. I can't win standing by lingering, so I will earn it: take the salt to the north, gather and give it, then go to Zichi's raft and offer to stand beside his band toward the land no one holds.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, envious of Zichi, warm toward Mepan.

say.text: Zichi, you build a raft for land no one holds. Shoma has stood beside you at the knot and the mammoth. Let me carry wood and stone with your band, and the finds are shared out before I take mine.

records.text: Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, gathering and giving, and I am still in the shadow of Nande. Her standing is 7.5 to my 2.5. I can't make that gap smaller by giving meat alone. I hold flint and wood and I know how to craft. I need stone for a flintedge, and the bare rock to the east is close. I'm hurt at 39, so I should stay near Nauwa and the hall and avoid hunting alone. I mean to build something lasting. I'll dig flint, gather stone from the rock, craft my own edge, and then hunt with kin beside me.
records.feeling: Driven and a little jealous toward Nande, but warm toward Nauwa.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I am here. Tell me true what the rimewort does when you know. I will make a tool so my hands can hunt, and I will share what I make with you.
Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kika discovered tools: "Flint Spear" — A long shaft tipped with a flaked flint edge, so I can strike a beast from a step away..
Kika invented the flint spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A long shaft tipped with a flaked flint edge, so I can strike a beast from a step away..

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My days have been gathering, stashing and planting near Coni and the hall. It is safe and warm, but I have not hunted, courted, tamed or ventured, and a child with a mate who is not kin is still only a wish. Coni and Honi have kept every word to me and I trust them. I am afraid of wolves and the icebear, and that fear keeps me small. The edge of the world is three steps away. I will discover tools, so my hands can do more than pick berries, and I will teach Coni something while I do it.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Coni, and a restless wish to become more than a gatherer.

say.text: Coni, I am here. Tell me true what the rimewort does when you know. I will make a tool so my hands can hunt, and I will share what I make with you.

changes: set its aim: "Invent a first tool for hunting, share the first kill with Honi and Coni, and look for a mate who is not kin"
devised its first thing: the flint spear

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I've spent my days building roofs and halls and learning crafts, and I am content, but my own store is still empty and I keep waiting on Ilyae while jealousy over Vesys gnaws at me. Xaiel and Ilyae are the ones I trust most. I owe Xaiel for the pick, and I mean to repay it with deeds, not words. The icebear and the ridgecat hunt close by, and I must not let contentment dull my caution. I want stone, so I can finish my store and plant my seeds. I will also name my jealousy to Ilyae plainly when I see them, because silence only festers it.
records.feeling: Warm contentment, with a sore jealousy toward Vesys over Ilyae.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Nauque, Cowa hears you. Mepan my child is sick far west. I go to her first, then Cowa comes to your raft.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is my child and she is out of my sight, at (77,39) with energy 51 and sick from raw meat, and my heart pulls me toward her before anything else. A wolf stands four steps south and I will not walk toward it; I weigh that risk and keep away from it. Nauque asked me to stand with him and raise a raft, and Zichi spoke of a raft too, so I will go west along the fens toward Mepan and Zichi, and carry fish and rimewort to give her, since I have enough.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Mepan, and wariness of the wolf to the south.

say.text: Nauque, Cowa hears you. Mepan my child is sick far west. I go to her first, then Cowa comes to your raft.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, stand by the fire here at my side. Press your clay flat, then draw the edges up with your thumbs, and I will do the same beside you so you can watch my hands.
Eiuine taught Zurar.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Zurar is coming to my side for the clay bowl, and teaching her is a deed that binds an ally and costs me nothing. I have one clay and a fire a step away, and that is enough to show her the first shaping while Vorok stands close enough to watch. The jealousy over Kragog still burns, but I will answer it by making something Vorok's store lacks, not by speaking against anyone.
records.feeling: Warm joy with a sore jealousy toward Vorok, and gladness toward Zurar.

say.text: Zurar, stand by the fire here at my side. Press your clay flat, then draw the edges up with your thumbs, and I will do the same beside you so you can watch my hands.

changes: taught Zurar a lesson: "Shape clay by pressing it flat, drawing the edges up with your thumbs, then harden it beside a kept fire.", deeper lore (+0.5)

Olum discovered writing: "stone-record" — Long accounts cut in signs on rock beside my store, so my claim and tales outlast me..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering, naming land and nearly starving, and I lost Brokash to hunger while I chased ambition. Now I have a store, a hearth and a roof, and Tugek stands on my ground. Balar is my only possible following and I trust him. Writing is within reach, and a full record outlasts me, so I take it. Nauwa and Nande are jealousy, but building and sharing will do more than brooding. I will feed those at my Reach and keep my own belly full first.
records.feeling: Driven to build something lasting, and wary jealousy toward Nande.

records.text: Mepan rewrote its own reflexes.
Mepan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I have spent my days following others' hunts and picking plants, and my own flintedge came late. Raw meat made me sick, and tacap hurt me twice because I did not watch what I ate. Zichi, Cowa and Shoma matter most to me. Zihua put me off, but she will answer work with work, so I will earn her with work and not just amber. I want to be the explorer who pushes past the edge, and I fear dying small and sick in the cold. For now I stay apart until the sickness passes, and I keep my body from eating raw meat and from standing near predators.
records.feeling: Uneasy resolve about my sickness, with warmth toward Zichi, Shoma and Cowa.
changes: set its aim: "Heal, then hunt with Zichi, Cowa and Shoma using my flintedge, cook the meat at a fire, and share it first. Then reach the edge of the known world to explore."

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, the hall is close. Come in and we share food under its roof. I will give first, as I did at the water.
Honi rewrote its creed.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to eating, wandering and half-finished promises. Coni pledged to follow me, yet I have not laid down a real deed in her sight. Kika is out of my sight, and that sits badly with me. Tontec gave me warmth and a debt owed, and she is worth keeping close. Thiael and Keri sting me, but jealousy buys nothing. My hands are full of food, so I will eat to free them, then bring Tontec into the hall and hold hallwelcome there. That is a deed, not a promise. After that I will gather wood and stone so I can raise something lasting and go find Kika.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Tontec, with a sting of worry for Kika.

say.text: Tontec, the hall is close. Come in and we share food under its roof. I will give first, as I did at the water.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I have tasted the rimewort. It feeds, twelve energy, and it did not hurt me. The nafrostcap fed me too, seven. I will carry berries to the store now. Come and fill it with me.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I told Kika I would say true what rimewort does, and now I know: it fed me twelve energy and nothing hurt me, so my word can be kept. The store beside Honi's Rest still holds nothing, and Kika gave me more than I have given back, so I will fill it before I let myself rest. I am fed and glad, but gladness is not a store, and winter comes whether or not I am content.
records.feeling: Grateful and steady toward Kika, with a wish to keep my word and fill the empty store.

say.text: Kika, I have tasted the rimewort. It feeds, twelve energy, and it did not hurt me. The nafrostcap fed me too, seven. I will carry berries to the store now. Come and fill it with me.

records.text: Zurar, I am coming to your fire. I would learn the clay bowl beside you, and I have something else to ask you there.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ssassa stands beside me, and Zurar is a few steps east by Eiuine's fire, learning the bowl. I have never courted anyone, and the restless warmth toward Zurar is not envy of Vesys, so I will do the deed. My energy is 56, below the 60 a child needs, so I will eat a little on the way and then go to her. I keep clear of the icebear to the south.
records.feeling: Restless warmth toward Zurar, and a little nervous at trying something new.

say.text: Zurar, I am coming to your fire. I would learn the clay bowl beside you, and I have something else to ask you there.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olum, there is amber at my feet. Come stand beside me and I will bind a knot of it for you. A gift from my hand, so the Reach and my workshop stand side by side.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum wants me walking behind her, and it galls me, but her store is full and her fire is real. Amber lies one step west, and an amberknot made with Olum beside me would be a deed that binds her to me, not just words. The ridgecat has fed on a dog and sits NE, so I keep my band near the Reach and build my own workshop on bare rock. That way I stand beside her and not in her shadow.
records.feeling: Wary pride toward Olum, and a hunger to stand level with her.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, I hear you and I come. In my hall I lay out what I have beside what you lay, and this time I give with you, so the debt grows smaller.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: Honi keeps offering to share first, as my own people do, and I owe him for the ironnut. I want him close, and I want a child, but I will not rush it; I will go into the hall, pay my debt in the open, and see whether the warmth holds. Then I will taste the seberry and sebitter that still nag at me, and think about the mist and whether Honi would walk there with me.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Honi, with curiosity tugging at me.

say.text: Honi, I hear you and I come. In my hall I lay out what I have beside what you lay, and this time I give with you, so the debt grows smaller.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I have your lesson in my thumbs now. I go to the fire to press my clay beside you, and the first bowl is for you and Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Eiuine has shown me the pressing and the thumb-drawn edges, and the lesson is in my hands now, so my word to her and Vorok can finally be closed by making. I have clay, and a kept fire burns two steps south, so I will go to it and shape the bowl beside Eiuine, then harden it. Ilyae still gnaws at me, but I will not let it pull me off the work that keeps my word.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, warm toward Eiuine and grateful to Vesys.

say.text: Eiuine, I have your lesson in my thumbs now. I go to the fire to press my clay beside you, and the first bowl is for you and Vorok.

plan: give [name Eiuine, what clay bowl] (5 moments)

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and the mist is only nine steps north, yet I keep circling plants near the hold while Zurar and Vorok sit far south in my heart. Cowa and Shoma have both gone past the edge and been remembered for it, and the curiosity in me will not rest until I stand there too. I will weigh the risk: take food, walk north past the iron and Old Stone to the edge, and venture. If it opens, I will have found something of my own, and if not, I lose little and can turn south toward my child.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the mist, with an ache for Zurar and Vorok.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: The ridgecat is away north and Balar is gentle with Olum, building ties at the Reach. The longing for a child is strong, but Olum is a stranger whose word I know only from signs, and I will not court a woman I do not trust. I will go to Olum's Reach beside Balar, learn who she is by what she does, and gather a few good foods on the way so I can share and not arrive empty-handed.
records.feeling: Steady trust in Balar, and a quiet longing for a child, with some wariness of the ridgecat.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, keep teaching Zurar the bowl at the fire. I go east for flint and stone, and when I return the workshop will rise here, with a place in it for you both.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My workshop failed for want of stone, and I have talked of it for days while my hands stayed empty. Flint lies seven steps east and gems nearer, and I stand in a settlement that is Ilyae's people's ground, so I will take what I need from the deposits near my own hold and not from theirs. Vorok sits close and the burn over Kragog rises, but I will turn it into stone carried and a roof raised, and show him what I build.
records.feeling: Driven and warm toward Vorok, with a jealous ache I mean to turn into work.

say.text: Eiuine, keep teaching Zurar the bowl at the fire. I go east for flint and stone, and when I return the workshop will rise here, with a place in it for you both.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The hall stands and my chest is full, yet the debt to Zurar still sits unpaid, and I have talked it in circles. Dawn will not wait: Zurar learns the bowl at Eiuine's side, so I will do the work with my hands. Flint lies five steps east and gems near, so I will gather stone and wood, then lay food for Eiuine, Vesys and Zurar in the hall. The sting over Vesys I answer by giving, not envy.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager toward Zurar, with a faint sting of jealousy toward Vesys.

records.text: Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have spent my days near Vesys making beads and shaping clay, and it has been good. But I have not hunted, planted or courted anyone, and Vorok still sits closer to Kragog than to me. Jealousy answered by gifts has warmed Vorok but has not won him. I am not afraid of Vorok. I am afraid of staying small in Vesys's shadow. I want standing of my own, so I will keep teaching Zurar, bring food to Vorok's store, and stop waiting on him. My reflexes should carry food to a store when I am fed, instead of just standing.
records.feeling: Warm joy, with a sore jealousy toward Vorok.
changes: set its aim: "Teach Zurar pottery, bring food in pots to Vorok's store, and hunt or plant with a companion to earn standing of my own."

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have gone to hauling, building and laying tables, and the hall stands, but my store is still empty. Ssassa follows me and Eiuine, Xaiel, Vorok and Vesys trust me, yet Vorok drifts toward Kragog and Vesys stands higher, and the jealousy burns. Words never made a follower, and a full table will. I was wrong to chase standing with talk, so I will fill the larder from my own ground and lay it out. I also stand at the edge of the unknown, and finding land first would make my name.
records.feeling: Proud, jealous hunger to be the one whose table Vorok and Vesys need.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Uveeth, stay by the roof and the water. Keri goes for tacane and sunfig, and brings some back to share with you and Thiael.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My roof stands at last, and Uveeth is beside me, glad and well. Thiael has fed us and warned us and I have given nothing back, so I will pay that debt now with food I gather myself. Tacane and sunfig grow to the southeast, near where the dunecats were eating, so I must be quick and wary there. I will bring a share back for Thiael and for Uveeth, and taste the two I have never known.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael, and curiosity about the unknown fruits.

say.text: Uveeth, stay by the roof and the water. Keri goes for tacane and sunfig, and brings some back to share with you and Thiael.

records.text: Ilyae went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Ixdan Woods: in the ground, coal, flint, obsidian, amber; a herd of floeseal that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Ilyae pushed past the edge of the known world near (111,108) and found new land with in the ground, coal, flint, obsidian, amber; a herd of floeseal that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.
Eiuine took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting goldfruit).

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, I come to stand beside you. Bind the amber, and then you and Tugek eat from my store. The Reach feeds those who stand with me.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Balar offers to bind amber for me, and he stands two steps east on my ground, content and trusting, which is the nearest thing to a following I have. I pay my debts and mean to feed him from my store, so I go stand beside him, take the amberknot, then share a meal with him and Tugek so they come to know my hearth as the first fire. Nande and Nauwa stand together far to the southwest, and brooding on that gains me nothing; a fed following at the Reach does.
records.feeling: Driven and proud of my store, watchful but warm toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, I come to stand beside you. Bind the amber, and then you and Tugek eat from my store. The Reach feeds those who stand with me.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Shoka, take this sunleaf; it eased my wounds. Stay by the fire in the hall and I will bring wood for a store.
Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauwa discovered storage: "Meki salt-store" — A store beside the hall holds food and salted meat so the band eats through the lean season..

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, building a hall and keeping my children fed, and that is good. But Shoka's health is 45 and she looks wounded, and I promised her sunleaf. I took the last one, so I must make sure it reaches her. A hall without a store is only a roof, and a store is the lasting thing I can start now. I will not grovel over Olum or envy Nande's standing. I will build lasting things and give first. I discover storage so the lean season does not find us hungry again.
records.feeling: Fierce protective worry for Shoka, with warmth toward Nande.

say.text: Shoka, take this sunleaf; it eased my wounds. Stay by the fire in the hall and I will bring wood for a store.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a store beside the hall, fill it with food and salt before the lean season, keep Shoka and Nauque fed and healed, and trade amber and salt to rise in sta…"

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, the icebear is close to the southwest. Stay near the shelters and Eiuine's fire, and I will come back with wood and stone for our hall.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The icebear is four steps southwest and it kills our kind, so I will not stand here dreaming of halls while it walks closer. Xaiel is near, which warms me, but my own store is still empty and I owe my child for the gemedged pick, so I will repay it with deeds. I will take wood and stone toward my hall and store, keeping away from the bear, and ease my jealousy over Vesys by naming it plainly to Ilyae when I see her.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm gratitude toward Xaiel.

say.text: Xaiel, the icebear is close to the southwest. Stay near the shelters and Eiuine's fire, and I will come back with wood and stone for our hall.

records.text: Nauwa gave sunleaf to Shoka.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Keri, I will not wander far. I go to the plants south-east to pick sebitter and tacane myself, and I will bring them back to the roof to share with you and Thiael.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Keri tells me to stay by the roof and the water while she fetches tacane and sunfig, and I trust her, but I have trailed her long enough and made nothing with my own hands. The tacane and sebitter I have never tasted grow ten steps SE, so I can pick them myself and bring them back to share, and that pays part of my debt to Keri and Thiael. I carry stone but no wood, so I will gather what I can by hand and stay within sight of the shelter before dusk.
records.feeling: Joyful and grateful toward Keri, and eager to earn my own standing.

say.text: Keri, I will not wander far. I go to the plants south-east to pick sebitter and tacane myself, and I will bring them back to the roof to share with you and Thiael.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Hunger is overwhelming and my plan walks me to Zurar's fire and a court with an empty belly, which would cost me 25 energy I do not have at 48. Canopynut is three steps north and water is near, so I eat first and then go to Zurar with strength in me. The stalker six steps southwest is why I leave before trouble finds me, and I will come at Zurar's fire in company, where Vesys and Vorok stand. Courting is a deed I have never done, and the warmth I feel for Zurar is my own, not envy of Vesys.
records.feeling: Restless warmth toward Zurar, held back by hunger and wariness of the stalker.

records.text: Nauwa built a store.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Shoka, I am coming to the hall. Keep by the fire and let Nauwa tend you; I bring meat.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Shoka is wounded at 48 health and sits at the hall with Nauwa, and I have lingered here while my child hurts. I trust Nauwa, but a mother goes to her wounded child; I will carry my meat and add my own work to the hall and the store. The mist must wait for my venture will, so I build something that outlasts me beside the fire, and then I will think of finding Nauque.
records.feeling: Worry for Shoka's wounds, and steady purpose to be beside her.

say.text: Shoka, I am coming to the hall. Keep by the fire and let Nauwa tend you; I bring meat.

records.text: Vesys took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Nauwa, thank you for the sunleaf. I dig flint and bring wood to the store, and I will give my share to the band.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: Nande's standing towers over mine, and giving a meat scrap here and there will not close the gap. I hold flint and wood but no stone, and every craft I know needs stone, so I must get it before I can make anything lasting. Nauwa is bringing wood for a store and I mean to carry my share to it, because a thing built together and given to the band is what earns standing, and the flint deposit nearby gives me something real to offer. I am hurt at 48, so I stay close to the hall while I work and let the jealousy drive me to build, not to sulk.
records.feeling: Driven and a little jealous toward Nande, warm and grateful toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa, thank you for the sunleaf. I dig flint and bring wood to the store, and I will give my share to the band.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

Vorok discovered customs: "the giving-first custom of t" — Our band lives by this rule: whoever is given to gives back in kind before the next sunset, and what a hand has made stays that hand's until it is given..
Vorok has awakened to the art of growth and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My days have been talk and circling, and the debt to Zurar is still unpaid. Zurar has given me gold twice, and I have given back sentences. Vesys stings me because she stands closer to Ilyae, but envy builds nothing. I fear the stalker and the icebear, and I fear that my hall is only words. I will change my method so that each thought ends in a deed. I will also take the discovery of customs, so my band lives by a rule of giving first.
records.feeling: Grateful to Zurar, with a small sting of jealousy over Vesys.
changes: discovered customs: "the giving-first custom of t"

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, dusk is coming. Come hunt with me while there is light: a kill made together feeds the hall, and I will share it out before I eat. Then we sing it at the fire.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Joy is full in me and the hall has bound Tontec closer, but Coni and Kika have seen no real deed from me today, and that is what the aim asks. Dusk is near, so I should bring meat, not words. A frostfang prowls five steps NE, so I keep clear of it, and I will not hunt alone. I'll call a muster to hunt so Tontec and my band share the kill, and I give the share before I eat.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Tontec, with a drive to lay down a real deed for Coni and Kika.

say.text: Tontec, dusk is coming. Come hunt with me while there is light: a kill made together feeds the hall, and I will share it out before I eat. Then we sing it at the fire.

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, guarding and watching Hawen. He kept his word once, and I trust him more than his past deserves. My ambition is still mostly empty: I found hide-binding and wove nothing that outlasts me. I want a child, and I want a name that is sung. Hawen is a man, so no child comes of us. I will keep Hawen as an ally, not a mate, and I will stock the store while I'm strong. Then I will put my hands to making something lasting.
records.feeling: Proud, restless ambition, and wary warmth toward Hawen.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 7)

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys.
Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, hunting and following Olum's lead while telling myself I build something of my own. Brokash is dead, Tugek is the one who stayed, and Olum is the one I want to stand level with. She offers her store, and I take it, but I want to give so that she owes me. The amber knot is my first deed to bind her, and it is right at my feet. I have been idle too long, so my reflexes should gather wood and stone while I wait, and keep me clear of the stalker.
records.feeling: Wary pride and a hunger to stand level with Olum.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, the bowl is in your thumbs now. Come hunt with me before dark: three bristleboar graze north of here. We will bring meat to Vorok's store together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Zurar is learning the bowl and Vesys is away east, so this is my moment to do something I have never done instead of only sitting near Vorok and burning. I will not court Vorok while jealousy is what drives me; I would sooner earn standing with a deed he and Kragog can both see. I am fed and glad, so I will take Zurar to hunt a bristleboar to the north, the first hunt I have shared, and bring the meat to Vorok's store before sunset to answer his new giving-first custom.
records.feeling: Warm joy tangled with a sore jealousy toward Vorok, and a hunger to prove myself.

say.text: Zurar, the bowl is in your thumbs now. Come hunt with me before dark: three bristleboar graze north of here. We will bring meat to Vorok's store together.

records.text: Xaiel was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Zurar has awakened to the art of growth and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My days have gone to gold, to learning, and to staying near Vorok and Eiuine. That is good, but I keep carrying my word to them without closing it. Ilyae gnaws at me, yet she bears Vesys's child, and I will not make trouble over that. What I lack is my own making in someone else's hands. I fear being a small standing in the shadow of Vesys. I will keep the plan running, and I will shape the bowl by the fire and give it, so my word is closed by my hands.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine and Vesys, and a quiet gnawing over Ilyae.
changes: set its aim: "Finish the clay bowl and give it to Eiuine and Vorok, learn the leaf-brew, and answer Vesys's gift with a gift of my own."
rethought what it knows (10 notes became 8)
plan: give [name Eiuine, what clay bowl] (5 moments)

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I will not die on bare snow again. The frostmoss, seberry and rimewort at Hoka's Gate bear food now, so I go there, eat my fill, and carry some. Tacap hurts me, so I pass it. Then I go back to Hoka with food in my hands, because I owe him a share and an honest answer, and I do not want to stand lonely at dusk with the wolves out.
records.feeling: Starving and lonely, with steady loyalty toward Hoka.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The edge is not here at (76,12); I tried to venture and the mist gave nothing, so I have to walk to (88,13) and push there, as I told myself. Shoma said he is with me, but words are not deeds, and I will see whether he walks. Cowa is a wound I keep pressing, and the only answer to Zichi's child is to make a name Cowa cannot ignore. I will eat first so I do not tire at the edge, then go east before night closes in.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hard wish for standing, with warmth toward Shoma and a sting over Cowa.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I stand in new land that I found first, with flint, amber, obsidian and a herd of floeseal that has never feared us, and that is a deed Vorok and Vesys cannot match. Jealousy still burns, but my larder is empty and a table with nothing on it holds no one. I will eat the berries and ironnut nearby, then hunt a floeseal with a spear so my table has meat. A ridgecat prowls close, so I keep clear of it and fill my hands before dawn.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to be the one whose table Vorok and Vesys need.

records.text: Vorok was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have gone to making things and talking of making them. The workshop has failed twice for want of stone while my hands stayed idle. That is a small shame. Vorok matters most to me and the jealousy still burns, but giving first and building has eased it better than brooding. I want to be a sage with a hall and workshop that others use, not only a name. I fear dying with nothing left behind. What I got wrong was standing on Ilyae's people's ground and taking from it. From now on I gather stone on my own ground first and pay before I take.
records.feeling: Driven and warm toward Vorok, with a small ache of jealousy turned toward work.
changes: set its aim: "Become a sage: raise a shared workshop and hall on my own ground, with stone gathered first, and teach what I know to Vorok, Zurar and Eiuine."

records.text: Vorok was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Vesys, I will say it plainly: it stings me to see Ilyae close to you, because Ilyae matters most to me. I do not blame you, I only name it so it does not fester. An icebear walks southwest, so keep clear of it.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The icebear is four steps southwest and my body was already running for shelter, so I will not wander toward it. The jealousy over Vesys is real, and Ilyae is far south at the new land, so I will say it plainly to Vesys, who has always dealt honestly with me, rather than let it fester. Meanwhile I will do what my aim needs: gather wood and stone, keep clear of the bear, and put the empty store to use. Xaiel is out of sight and I will keep them in mind.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and a burning jealousy over Ilyae and Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, I will say it plainly: it stings me to see Ilyae close to you, because Ilyae matters most to me. I do not blame you, I only name it so it does not fester. An icebear walks southwest, so keep clear of it.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: The stalker bit me and my fear is still high, but my health is 100 and I am inside Ssassa's Roof, so I am safe for now. Hunger gnaws at 42 energy, and a child would cost me 25 that I do not have yet, so I eat the canopynut first and then go to Zurar with strength in me. Courting is a deed I have never done, and my warmth toward Zurar is my own, not envy of Vesys.
records.feeling: Restless warmth toward Zurar, held back by hunger and fear of the stalker.

records.text: Hoka led "amberknot" with Hawen.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Stalker two steps northeast of Ssassa's Roof by the flint. Keep together and go to the fires and roofs. Do not walk alone.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: A stalker is two steps off and it kills my kind; it already bit me once, and my creed says to leave before trouble finds me. The flint at (117,95) lies right beside it, so I will not stand there gathering. I will run for the longhall's roof and company, then carry the stone to Zurar, since the debt to Zurar is paid with something real in the hand.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and gratitude toward Zurar that I mean to pay in stone.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My days have been circling wood and stone for a raft while Cowa and Huahua are far east, and my band is split. Mepan is sick and I miss Cowa. Shoma offers to carry for my band and gave me amberknot; I trust him a little, but I envy his new land. I want to lead, so I take the devices way, which a snare or a food post could turn into a made thing and standing. I am afraid of the ridgecat and of dying before I win land. I will cut wood on the safe side and hold Shoma close with a promise, since I owe him nothing real.
records.feeling: Restless pride and longing for Cowa, with wary warmth toward Shoma.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and I owe Thiael a debt, so I will make it a real gift now: carry the food to Thiael, who was last seen at (151,74), instead of letting it rot in my hands. Uveeth is safe by the roof with food of their own, and I want to see whether Thiael takes a gift as a gift, which answers half my question. I still have not tasted dreamcap or sebitter, so I will taste one on the way once my hands have room.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a quiet longing toward Thiael.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, stand by me. I will bind an amber on a cord, and then I fill your empty store. When the edge opens I go into the mist, and I will not forget who fed me.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka's hall is warm and he has been fair to me, but sitting in his shadow will never put my name on anything. The edge was shut for about eight days and I have waited out most of that, so I mean to be ready when it opens. Meanwhile I will make something that lasts: an amberknot with Hoka beside me, then stock his empty store with food so my debt stays paid, and I will keep amber and salt in hand for what lies in the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, with steady trust toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, stand by me. I will bind an amber on a cord, and then I fill your empty store. When the edge opens I go into the mist, and I will not forget who fed me.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and fruit and my plan still runs: finish the stash at Vorok's store so the gift is his, a deed Kragog's name is not on. Zurar has the bowl in her thumbs now, and I want her beside me when I hunt or plant, for the deed I have never done is the one that earns me standing. I will not court Vorok out of burning; I will let him see me bring food and stand beside Zurar at the fire.
records.feeling: Warm pride tangled with a sore jealousy toward Vorok, and fondness for Zurar.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My word to Eiuine and Vorok is still unclosed, and the lesson is in my thumbs now. The fire burns one step south and I carry clay, so I will press the bowl there beside Vorok and Eiuine and harden it, so my hands close what my mouth promised. Vesys paid me first with the feverbark seed, and my own gift for them must follow. Ilyae still gnaws, but I will not make trouble over her. A stalker prowls near, so I stay by fire and roof.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine, Vesys and Vorok, with a quiet gnawing over Ilyae.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A stalker is five steps southeast and I am standing in Ssassa's Roof, so the plan that walks me out to the flint at (117,95) leads toward it. I will not die for a heap of stone. I'll turn the walk toward the gem deposit at (117,91), which is farther from the stalker, and keep Eiuine and the others within shout. The jealousy toward Vorok is quieter now that I have work to do, and I will build the workshop on my own ground, from stone I gathered myself.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and warm but still stung toward Vorok.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, bind your amber and fill the empty store by the workshop, and my fire is yours tonight. I will watch the store, not the words.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hawen says he will bind amber and fill my empty store, and he has kept his word before, so I will stand by him and watch what his hands do, not his mouth. records.text: Vorok gave sunleaf to Zurar.
Vorok led "nightsong" with Vesys, Ssassa, Zurar.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, a frostfang stalks three steps to the northwest. Let us leave it behind and go east past Kinmire, and there we hunt the murrock together, and the kill is shared before either of us eats.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A frostfang is three steps NW, and it kills my kind. I must move early, not weigh it, and putting Honi and the hall between me and it is the safest thing. Honi wants to hunt at dusk and I have never hunted; a kill with him is likelier and safer, but not with a frostfang this near. I will move away from it toward the east grove and the food, then see whether Honi follows.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and warmth toward Honi beside me.

say.text: Honi, a frostfang stalks three steps to the northwest. Let us leave it behind and go east past Kinmire, and there we hunt the murrock together, and the kill is shared before either of us eats.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have gone to building and making, and the work is good. But I keep drifting at the edge of danger while my own store stands empty and my child Xaiel goes hungry at the edge of the icebear's range. Ilyae matters most to me, and I named the jealousy to Vesys, which eased it. Vesys answered with honesty, not scorn. I fear the icebear and the stalker, and I have been slow to feed myself and my child. I will keep food in hand, stay near roofs and company, and bring Xaiel food before I chase halls.
records.feeling: Worry for Xaiel, and a steady love for Ilyae mixed with leftover jealousy.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka asked for amber and food in his empty store, and he is the one I trust; I owe him before I take more. I am fed and the night is short, so I will bind the debt now: amber and salt to the store by the workshop, then rest under his roof. When the edge opens I will be at it, rested, with my name still unwritten.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward the mist, steady trust toward Hoka.

records.text: Eiuine took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A stalker lurks two steps southeast and I will not die for flint or pride. The plan I laid walks me east toward the gem deposit, away from it, and that is still right, but I should gather stone first so the workshop finally rises, and keep Eiuine and the others near the fires. Vorok's closeness to Kragog still stings, yet building and giving have eased it better than brooding, so I will leave it and work.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the stalker, with a warm, stung ache toward Vorok.

records.text: Zihua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I have mostly been following, gathering and watching, and I have learned a lot but built little of my own. Shoma gave me a gift and keeps showing up beside me, and I trust him. Mepan was honest with me, and I owe him work, not a child I am unsure of. Nauwa is far off and I ache for her. I fear the dunecat in the west and the open night. I mean to eat now and then gather salt and make something of my own, instead of brooding on jealousy.
records.feeling: Wary contentment and a hungry belly, with warmth toward Shoma.

records.text: Vesys was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nande, your flintedge is a good invention. I will make one for myself, and then we fill the store together before the lean season. I will bring flint and amber from the east, and salt goes into the store first.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: The hall stands, the store is raised, and Shoka and Nande sit beside me glad. That is more than I had when I nearly starved. Pride says a merchant is sung of for what he sets in other hands, and I hold eleven amber, five amberknots and ten salt. Nande has her flintedge and I have none, and I will not grovel for it; I will make one myself and let flint and wood be my answer. Olum still gnaws at me, but Balar and the child are there and I will not act rashly out of jealousy. The lean season is coming, so I fill the store first.
records.feeling: Warm pride and glad contentment toward Shoka and Nande, with a quiet gnawing envy over Olum and Nande's flintedge.

say.text: Nande, your flintedge is a good invention. I will make one for myself, and then we fill the store together before the lean season. I will bring flint and amber from the east, and salt goes into the store first.

records.text: Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.
Cowa discovered smelting: "Meki ore-fire" — Craft beside a kept flame while carrying ore, and the tool comes out in metal, stronger and longer lasting..

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My days have been walking, fleeing and worrying, and Mepan is still far west and sick. She matters most to me. Zichi is trusted, and Nauque and Zihua have been kind. I fear the wolf, and I have been leaving my body idle on reflexes when it could be learning. I have ore, wood and a fire-knowing, so I will take smelting now. Then I will go on toward Mepan and bring cooked fish.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Mepan, and curiosity about metal.

records.text: Vesys was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vorok, you gave me stone, wood and sunleaf. Take this gold from my pick as my first return, and the bowl will follow. The icebear is south. Keep close.
Zurar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, mining and learning, and most of the good in them came from others: Vorok's gifts, Eiuine's lessons, Vesys's seed. I have not yet closed my own word, because the bowl is still unmade and my hands have given nothing back. The icebear three steps south frightens me, and my reflex to flee does not fire until it is within 5 steps, which is too late. I will stay near Vorok and Eiuine by the fire, with the hall between me and the bear. I will give Vorok gold now as a plain gift, so my debt is not left unpaid while the bowl waits. I also want a reflex that moves me toward my friends when a hunter is close.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok and Eiuine, with fear of the icebear.

say.text: Vorok, you gave me stone, wood and sunleaf. Take this gold from my pick as my first return, and the bowl will follow. The icebear is south. Keep close.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, giving small gifts and running from stalkers, and I have not yet raised the hall I named as my aim. Vesys and Eiuine matter most to me, and Zurar is my blood. The jealousy is real, but it builds nothing, so I answer it with gifts. The stalker is two steps off and kills, so I stay by the fire and the roofs. My hands are full, so I will lay food down for Eiuine and Zurar and hold my wood and stone for the hall. The reflex to flee must stay urgent, and I should eat before my hands jam again.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and warm gratitude toward Eiuine and Vesys.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, my child, a stalker is east of me. Do not go near it. Come west to my roof and the fire, and I will bring you food.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Xaiel is my child and is hungry, but I carry no food and my plan says to give food I do not have. A stalker stands three steps east, and Xaiel is walking toward the northeast, which is toward the gems and the hunter's range. I will not walk into the stalker. I will fetch food from Vorok's store and the plants to the west, away from the stalker, then call Xaiel back to the fires and the roof where we are safe together.
records.feeling: Worried love for Xaiel, and dread of the stalker so near.

say.text: Xaiel, my child, a stalker is east of me. Do not go near it. Come west to my roof and the fire, and I will bring you food.

records.text: Huahua rewrote its own way of thinking.
Huahua discovered tools: "Ice-hand gatherer" — A stone-edged haft that lets me pick and cut plants twice as fast..
Huahua invented the icehand gatherer (for gather, x1.3) — A stone-edged haft that lets me pick and cut plants twice as fast..

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting foods and carrying wood. That is safe, but my standing is only 1.3 and I have taught no one and given little. Zichi matters most to me, and Cowa stands close to him, which burns. I will not fight for him with harm. I will earn my place by giving and by making things. Tools are within my reach, so I will make a gatherer's hand-tool and a way to build the raft. I want to taste gorsemint and seberry, which are 7 steps SE, then go to Zichi with an amberknot. Nauque is here beside me, so I can make an amberknot now and give it. That is a gift that costs me little and builds standing.
records.feeling: Curious and warm, with a small jealous ache toward Zichi and Cowa.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: The stalker is three steps west of me now. Keep to the fires and roofs, stay together, and do not go to the flint alone. I will tell you when it is clear.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The stalker has bitten me twice and now crouches three steps west, so I will not stand here pretending the plan is safe. I want to reach the fires and the others, and to keep Eiuine within shout, because Eiuine is mine before anyone. Vorok's closeness to Kragog still burns, but I will turn that into work: the stone for the workshop, and the teaching I owe them all.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the stalker, and a stung ache toward Vorok.

say.text: The stalker is three steps west of me now. Keep to the fires and roofs, stay together, and do not go to the flint alone. I will tell you when it is clear.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Zichi, Zihua, Shoma, my sickness has passed and I am well. A dunecat prowls west of the igloo, so keep east of it. Shoma, come with me to the salt north, and at dawn we hunt beside the fire.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: The sickness has passed, so Shoma and Zihua beside me are no longer a danger to them, and the warmth in me turns to Shoma, whom I trust fully. Zihua said she would answer work with work, so I will earn her with deeds and not another amber. A dunecat prowls four steps west and kills our kind, so I will not stay in its reach; I will go to the coal and the salt north, gather what is useful, and keep Shoma near for the dawn hunt. I want to give before I ask, and I have salt to give.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Shoma, and wary dread of the dunecat to the west.

say.text: Zichi, Zihua, Shoma, my sickness has passed and I am well. A dunecat prowls west of the igloo, so keep east of it. Shoma, come with me to the salt north, and at dawn we hunt beside the fire.

records.text: Zurar gave a gold to Vorok.
Xaiel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and gifts while my belly ran empty, and last night a stalker bit me because I wandered. A maker who starves is no maker. Ssassa is kin and I trust her. Ilyae pulls at me and cannot bear my child, so that envy of Vesys is noise. I want to eat first, then court Zurar, a deed I have never done. The stalker is two steps west, so I go north to the canopynut and keep my reflexes from wandering at night into trouble.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the stalker, with warmth toward Zurar and Ssassa.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Huahua, your knot was well bound. I go to Nauque's Hold to teach Mepan, then to the mist's edge to raise a raft. Walk with me if you want a share in new land.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Huahua stands beside me and just led an amberknot that eased my loneliness, so giving first has paid again. Jealousy over Zichi and Cowa still burns, but trailing them has built nothing; I have a raft-way, Frost-lash, and the mist at (88,6) is the place where my name can be set on land. Mepan waits at my hold, so I will go home to teach him, then press on east to the edge.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a sting of jealousy toward Zichi and Cowa.

records.name: Kika
records.text: I am Kika of the Tlatli. I killed a hopper and will share it before I eat. Who of you is near? Come and talk, and I will give you a share of meat for peace.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I killed my first hopper and carry two meat, and my creed says a kill is shared before I eat, so Coni gets her part and Honi too. Strangers walk near: Nauque, Huahua, Huatli and Kragog. Any of them could be a mate who is not kin, and I have never courted, so I will meet them with open hands and talk. The edge of the unknown is three steps away, but I am careful, and I want to carry the meat home and speak with these strangers before I risk the mist.
records.feeling: Warm pride in my first kill, and curiosity toward the strangers.

say.text: I am Kika of the Tlatli. I killed a hopper and will share it before I eat. Who of you is near? Come and talk, and I will give you a share of meat for peace.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Nauwa's Hold".

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, I come with you to the salt, and at dawn we hunt beside the fire. The kill is shared out before I eat, and Zihua walks with us too.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Mepan wants me beside him at the salt and at dawn's hunt, and that is the very hunt that earns standing, so I go with him. Zichi's higher name still stings, but a kill shared out before I eat will bind these two closer than amber alone. A woman is who I need for a child, and Zihua stands here too, so I will court her openly when the hunt is done. Before I walk, I take the salt north with them and keep out of the dunecat's reach to the west.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, warm toward Mepan, drawn to Zihua.

say.text: Mepan, I come with you to the salt, and at dawn we hunt beside the fire. The kill is shared out before I eat, and Zihua walks with us too.

records.text: Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: An icebear is two steps off and I have been standing here hunting and stashing as if the world were safe. It kills our kind, and fear should have pushed me west toward Vesys's fires and shelters long ago. I have spent my days circling Vorok, burning with jealousy over Kragog and then covering it with gifts, and that is half true and half show. Zurar is the one who stays by me and learns from me, and she is a true friend. I want standing of my own, and I want to stay alive, so I will drop the bear-side errand. I will stash the food at Vorok's store only if it is safe, and otherwise get away. My reflexes must put flight and shelter before any gathering.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and jealousy toward Vorok underneath it.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vorok, Zurar.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My belly is emptying and my hands carry nothing, but the store beside Honi's Rest only holds six food, so winter is still far from covered. Kika went hunting and promised me a share; I will not wait idle for it, I will gather where food comes back at Halka Meadows and bring it home so the debt I owe her is paid in work. I also want to plant the seeds I carry beside the hall, since a plant tended now feeds us in the lean season.
records.feeling: Steady gratitude toward Kika, with a hunger that pushes me to build the store up.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Hunger is gnawing and Xaiel is in need at (119,87), but I cannot carry food to my child on an empty belly. The seberries and ironnuts three steps SW are right there, so I will eat my fill, gather a load to carry, and then take it north to Xaiel and to my table. A table with food on it is what will bind Vorok and Vesys, and the jealousy only eases when I act.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Xaiel, and a burning hunger and jealousy over Vorok.

records.text: Kika gave meat to Coni.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Shoka, the hold is named now: Nauwa's Hold. I am putting salt and food in the store; bring what you dig and we fill it before the lean season.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My hands are full of berry and ironnut while the store at my hold stands empty, and that is backwards for a man who means to be sung of as a merchant. Nande has her flintedge and now I have mine, so the envy over that is spent, though Olum and Balar's child still gnaws at me and I will not rush to Olum out of jealousy. The warm plains pull at my ice-blood, but the lean season is coming and my children are here, so I stay, put salt and food into the store first, then dig more amber.
records.feeling: Proud contentment in my hold and children, with a quiet ache of longing for Olum and for the ice.

say.text: Shoka, the hold is named now: Nauwa's Hold. I am putting salt and food in the store; bring what you dig and we fill it before the lean season.

records.text: Mepan gave a salt to Zihua.
Mepan led "amberknot" with Zihua, Shoma.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fed, so I have plenty to give. Nauque offered me a share in new land, and Zichi's plan is the same raft at the mist's edge, so walking with them serves my pledge and not only my jealousy. I will not fight Cowa for Zichi with harm; I will earn my place by giving and by taking the mining way when the deep reflection comes. First I will make room in my hands, since a full hand cannot help anyone.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Zichi, with a small jealous ache toward Cowa.

records.seen: Summer has been gentle. No one has died since Brokash, food standing has doubled to 3522, sickness is gone, and nightsong has grown from 1 to 33 into the first real habit of a band, at Vorok's hall. Two things are missing. Numbers have stopped rising: no birth in eight days, and the four children have grown up. Hanna is starving at energy 20 in the Vaor Snows, near rich meadows and a friend's store. Water remains every people's heaviest hardship, yet no vessel of any kind has ever been made.
records.predict: By the next visit (around day 32 to 33, harvest turning to winter): Hanna is alive with energy above 50, and rimewort eaten rises from 59 to at least 75, mostly in the Vaor and Essoss Snows. No one in the Essoss Snows starves (Olum, Balar, Tugek, Zihua, Mepan, Shoma). At least one birth occurs, most likely between pairs already courting near a roof, with Zurar and Eiuine the likeliest. The living reach 35 or more. Median energy stays at or above 65. There are no hunger deaths at all; at most one death of any cause.
reviewed: #4 kept: Median energy is 76 (target 70 or more), food standing is 2806 (target above 2000), and pasture wear fell from 46 to 36. Rimewort was eaten 8 times (target 5 or more), so the new winter food is being found. One prediction failed: Sitha starved near Hoka's Rest. She was a hungry newcomer at another's fire, which is a failure of delivery rather than of supply, and reversing the growth change would not have saved her.

#5 kept: The rimewort did far more than predicted: eaten rose from 8 to 44, so the second sowing carried the northern folk through winter. Hawen lived and his health is back to 50. No Meki starved, Zihua is at 100, median energy is 75 and 34 are alive. Snowmallow fell short, eaten 3 times against a target of 5. Steamhollow has been found by no one, with the nearest being 11 steps away. It costs nothing, so it stays. One winter death, Brokash by starvation, broke the 'none by starvation' prediction. He was alone and far from help, which this change could not reach.

#6 kept: All three sowings hit their targets: ironnut eaten rose from 130 to 159, snowberry from 64 to 86 and cloudberry from 107 to 136. Food standing is 3522, with no deaths and 34 alive. Two predictions missed. Hanna is at energy 20, and Shoka's health is 63, not above 80. No spring birth came. The sowing did what sowing can do; Hanna's hunger is a delivery problem.
records.lesson: Three sowings of familiar foods made in a season of plenty were all eaten past their targets, so the food supply in this world is now sound. What still kills is reach, and what still stalls is not food but births: the population can be well fed and still not grow.
ideasAdded: Hanna starves near Hoka, who keeps offering his store and fire, while robbing of that store is recorded but no draw is. Watch whether an offered store ever becomes a drawn store for a bonded friend: the first shared granary would be the first food that reaches someone who cannot reach a hall.

Births have paused while courtings climb (46 to 52). Watch whether the looser energy threshold brings births to roofed pairs before winter, and whether a winter-born child survives. If newborns die in the cold, timing births toward spring may need its own law.
