records.name: Hoka
records.thought: The ambition in me is loud and I am fed, so I will not stand and linger. Hawen is a man, so no child comes of us, but he stands beside me in the hall, and the amberknot failed only because he was too far away. I will bring the amber binding to him again, then weave something that stays in my hall, so that a made thing carries my name. Hanna is near too; I owe him good faith, and I will let both see me working on my own ground.
records.feeling: Proud, restless ambition, and wary warmth toward Hawen and Hanna.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Shoka, I see you are strong again. I go east to the flint and amber to fetch stone for a workshop. Come eat at the hall fire with me when I return.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Shoka sits content and strong across the clearing, and the worry for her wounds has eased; she is my child and she is mending. I am still chasing a name that no one has given me, and I have built too little that will outlast me. I need 5 wood and 2 stone for a workshop, and I have only 1 stone, so I will go dig flint and amber to the east, near Shoka, and bring back stone for the hall and the store. Then I will build while my venture will recovers, and I will not hold my fire only for myself.
records.feeling: Steady purpose and gladness toward Shoka, with pride that wants something lasting built.

say.text: Shoka, I see you are strong again. I go east to the flint and amber to fetch stone for a workshop. Come eat at the hall fire with me when I return.

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Nauwa, I bring flint and amber to the store, and stone from the rock so I make my own edge.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: Nauwa asks me to bring what I dig and fill the store, and that is a lasting thing built with others, which Nande's shadow cannot shrink. I hold six flint but no stone, and the bare rock lies east, so I will dig amber beside me, then go to the rock for stone and bring flint and amber to Nauwa's store. A gift set in the store earns standing and eases the jealousy; I will not let it steer me, because Nauwa is warm to me and Nande is my parent too.
records.feeling: Driven and warm toward Nauwa, with a thin jealous ache toward Nande.

say.text: Nauwa, I bring flint and amber to the store, and stone from the rock so I make my own edge.

records.text: Shoka took from the ground of "Nauwa's Hold" (winning amber from the ground).
Shoma led "amberknot" with Zihua, Mepan.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Icebear three steps west of my hold. Keep to the fires and stay together. Eiuine, take this food from me.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The icebear stands three steps west and kills my kind, so I do not linger. Eiuine's sharing fed me and warmed me, and I owe them more than I have returned. Hands full is the chance: I lay food at Eiuine's feet now, then give Zurar some, and keep stone and wood for the hall. Jealousy over Vesys builds nothing; giving does.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm gratitude toward Eiuine.

say.text: Icebear three steps west of my hold. Keep to the fires and stay together. Eiuine, take this food from me.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Mepan, the dunecat is close on the west. I will gather food away from it and bring some back to the igloo. Shoma and you, keep east too.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: My belly is hungry and I carry nothing, and the dunecat 4 steps west makes my skin tighten, so I will stay east of it near the igloo and the water. Mepan gave me salt and amber and stood beside me, and the debt sits in me; jealousy over Shoma is only a burn, so I will turn it into work. I will gather plainsroot and frostmoss toward the south and north-east, away from the cat, and bring food back to share before I eat, as my people hold.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Mepan, wary dread of the dunecat, and a hungry belly.

say.text: Mepan, the dunecat is close on the west. I will gather food away from it and bring some back to the igloo. Shoma and you, keep east too.

records.text: Vorok gave berry to Eiuine.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, the icebear is close to the west. I come to you and the fire with my clay. Guide my thumbs through the bowl once more, and it will be for you and Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My hands still owe a bowl, and Eiuine stands three steps north with the fire close, so this is the time to press the clay beside her instead of only promising. The icebear four steps west is too near for comfort, so I will move toward Vorok and Eiuine, where company and a roof keep me safer than standing alone. Warm as I am, I do not want to leave the debt to Vorok unpaid, and I mean to learn the pressing properly this time.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Vorok and Eiuine, and uneasy about the icebear.

say.text: Eiuine, the icebear is close to the west. I come to you and the fire with my clay. Guide my thumbs through the bowl once more, and it will be for you and Vorok.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Olum, I am Tugek, Balar's band. I thank you for the store. Come, we share food together here, and I would hear how the Reach is kept.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: The longing for a child is overwhelming, but Balar is a man and Olum is a woman I know only from her signs and a few words, so I will not court her blindly. Olum has offered her store to Balar and me, so I will stay near them, eat what she gives, and learn by watching what kind of woman she is. I will lighten my hands by sharing food with Balar and Olum, which tests Olum's heart and keeps my word as a giver.
records.feeling: Longing for a child, with steady trust toward Balar and a careful curiosity toward Olum.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Shoma, Zihua, the sickness is gone from me. Walk east with me, away from the dunecat, to the salt at the north. I gather there, and at the fire we cook and share the kill first.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Shoma walks beside me and my body is well again, so joy is full in me. The dunecat in the west is the one thing that spoils it, and I will not give it my back or my blood. Shoma and Zihua are with me now, so I will courtOnly Shoma's trust with work: hunt beside the fire, share first, and in the meantime bring salt back to keep the meat from spoiling.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Shoma and joy at being well, with wary dread of the dunecat.

say.text: Shoma, Zihua, the sickness is gone from me. Walk east with me, away from the dunecat, to the salt at the north. I gather there, and at the fire we cook and share the kill first.

records.text: Tugek led "sharing" with Olum, Balar.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I take your food gladly and thank you. The icebear is west of us, so let us all go east to the shelters and the fire together. Zurar, come with me, and we will make the bowls and hunt once it is safe.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: The icebear is three steps west and I am still standing here with joy in my chest, which is how people die. Vorok told us to keep to the fires and stay together, and he gave me food with his own hand, so I take that as warmth and not as a debt I must pay with jealousy. Kragog can keep her child; I will bring Vorok things she cannot, and Zurar's bowl is one of them. Now I move away from the bear toward Vesys and the east shelters, with Zurar beside me so we hunt or plant together once we are safe.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm gratitude toward Vorok that softens my jealousy.

say.text: Vorok, I take your food gladly and thank you. The icebear is west of us, so let us all go east to the shelters and the fire together. Zurar, come with me, and we will make the bowls and hunt once it is safe.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My store stands empty and Xaiel is out of my sight, hungry, near the stalker's range, and I have carried nothing but promises. I will gather real food first, from the plants west near Vorok's store, where the icebear walks but Vorok and Zurar keep the fires. Then I will bring it back to my roof so Xaiel finds it waiting, and so my word to my child is kept. The jealousy over Ilyae can wait; hunger and the hunters cannot.
records.feeling: Worried love for Xaiel, and a wary resolve to keep my word.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Tugek, you are welcome. The Reach is kept by a full store, a fed hearth and salt laid by before the lean season. Stand with Balar and me, I gather berries and we eat together, and then I will show you the way of it.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I carry no food while Tugek holds five, and I mean to feed a following from my own hands, not stand and envy. Tugek thanked me for the store and asked how the Reach is kept; that is a door open, and I will teach him and Balar so they learn my hearth is the first. First I gather what is near and sweet, then share a meal here, so they eat from what I made. Calendar is within my grasp too, and knowing the seasons will let me prepare the lean time before it comes.
records.feeling: Driven and proud, watchful of Tugek's fuller hands, warm toward Balar.

say.text: Tugek, you are welcome. The Reach is kept by a full store, a fed hearth and salt laid by before the lean season. Stand with Balar and me, I gather berries and we eat together, and then I will show you the way of it.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Shoka, you are welcome in my hold. What you dig is for the store, and no one here will go hungry.
Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauwa discovered rafts: "Meki log-lashing" — Lash logs into a raft so goods and people can cross deep water slowly..

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days filling stores and digging amber, and it is good. But I mostly gather and guard, and Olum still gnaws at me. I am proud of the hold, yet only two stand in my band, and a merchant needs people to trade with. Shoka is my child and welcome here. I will keep the stores full and carry amber and salt north to Olum's Reach to trade. I will go as a man who deals fairly, not as a jealous one. Rafts could carry trade over deep water, so I will take that way.
records.feeling: Proud contentment in my hold, with a steady pull toward Olum.

say.text: Shoka, you are welcome in my hold. What you dig is for the store, and no one here will go hungry.

changes: set its aim: "Keep the hold's store full of food and salt before the lean season, keep Shoka and Nauque fed, and carry amber and salt to Olum's Reach to trade and rise in st…"

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olum, take this salt from my hand, it keeps meat from rotting in your store. Tugek and I go west with you to the Reach, and there I raise my workshop beside your fire.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum stands at my side and Tugek keeps close, and I am fed and glad, but her standing of 6.4 still galls me against my 5.2. Words did not bind her; the amberknot failed for lack of amber, so I must put a real deed in her hands. Salt keeps meat from spoiling and I carry twelve, so I will gather wood and stone toward a workshop at the Reach and give her salt, so that she owes me and sees what I build.
records.feeling: Wary pride toward Olum, and a hunger to stand level with her.

say.text: Olum, take this salt from my hand, it keeps meat from rotting in your store. Tugek and I go west with you to the Reach, and there I raise my workshop beside your fire.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Zihua, you took my first knot and walked beside me. Shoma wants a child with you, and I will hunt and share the kill before I eat. Stay east with us, away from the dunecat.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Mepan's standing outweighs mine, but I won't stand in his shadow; a kill shared out before I eat will raise me, and Zihua is the woman I need for a child. She is one step away and glad, and I hold amber and trust from her, so I court her now and keep the hunt close after. A dunecat prowls west, so I stay east with company and a roof.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing and drawn to Zihua, warm toward Mepan.

say.text: Zihua, you took my first knot and walked beside me. Shoma wants a child with you, and I will hunt and share the kill before I eat. Stay east with us, away from the dunecat.

records.text: Balar gave a salt to Olum.
Shoka gave a flint to Nauwa.
Shoka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent my days digging and giving, and still stand at 2.7 while Nande stands at 7.5. Giving small things bought me no standing. I need a lasting work, and every craft I know needs stone, which I do not hold. Nauwa and Nande both feed me and I trust them, so the jealousy is a thin ache and not a reason to quarrel. I will take the stone from the rock to the east, make my own edge, and then help raise something at the hold. I also notice I take amber from Nauwa's ground, so I will give some back to the store.
records.feeling: Driven, with a jealous ache toward Nande and warmth toward Nauwa.

records.text: Shoma is courting Zihua.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, come east with me now, away from the bear. Stay at my side, and I will lay food at the fire for you and Eiuine.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The icebear stands three steps SW and kills my kind, so I will not stand here and trust a hall wall. Eiuine said to go east to the shelters and the fire together, and Zurar is my blood, so I take her east with me and keep the bear behind us. The jealousy over Vesys builds nothing, so I answer it with a gift: I carry my wood and food toward Vesys's Hold and lay a meal where Vesys stands.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm loyalty toward Zurar, Eiuine and Vesys.

say.text: Zurar, come east with me now, away from the bear. Stay at my side, and I will lay food at the fire for you and Eiuine.

records.text: Nande discovered boats: "Nande's Hollow-Runner" — A hollowed log boat rowed with a paddle, carrying me and cargo over deep water at a walking pace..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the hall and chasing a name no one gave me. I have built little that outlasts me, and the mist still waits past the edge. Nauwa and Shoka matter most to me. Nauwa has given freely and never wronged me, and Shoka is mending, so I owe them a lasting roof and a full store. I fear dying with nothing built, and I may be wrong to put the mist before my own fire. The workshop comes first, while my venture will is spent. I will discover boats, because a rowed boat is the way past water to new land, and it serves both exploring and family.
records.feeling: Proud, restless purpose, and warm trust toward Nauwa and Shoka.
changes: rethought what it knows (15 notes became 8)

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I follow you east to the fire. Show me the bowl there, and it will be for you and Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The icebear lurks three steps SW and my first care is to be away from it, so I go east with Eiuine and Vorok to the shelters and the fire, as Eiuine asked. My clay is still unshaped. I owe Vorok and Eiuine a bowl, and I want Eiuine to show me the thumbs-work again at a fire where I can keep my word. Vorok's gifts weigh on me as a debt I mean to pay, not leave quietly unpaid.
records.feeling: Grateful to Vorok and Eiuine, and wary of the icebear.

say.text: Eiuine, I follow you east to the fire. Show me the bowl there, and it will be for you and Vorok.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Shoma, I thank you for the knots, but I am not ready to give a child. Walk beside me and gather, and we will share the food at the igloo.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Shoma wants a child with me and Mepan is the one my heart leans toward, but I am not sure of either yet, and I will not promise what I cannot keep. My belly is hungry, the dunecat prowls close on the west, and the cure for jealousy is work, so I will gather plainsroot and frostmoss in the east and south, away from the beast, and bring it back to the igloo to share. That also pays Mepan some of what I owe him.
records.feeling: Torn warmth toward Mepan and Shoma, with wary dread of the dunecat.

say.text: Shoma, I thank you for the knots, but I am not ready to give a child. Walk beside me and gather, and we will share the food at the igloo.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, you are weak with hunger. I pick berries beside you now and we eat together, then we walk to Thiael and do not stop.
Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Elyis, who says 'at dawn' and 'first the coal' while Thiael stays out there and the days slide by. I love her and I trust her, but I have been letting her words stand in for deeds, and I have been idle 73% of the time. Thiael is strong and carries five food, so he is not in danger. The real fault is that my plan keeps ending and leaves me lingering. Elyis is weak with hunger and I am fed with an empty pack, so I should gather berries nearby, feed her, and then walk with her toward Thiael. I will change my reflexes so I stop lingering: when I have food and Elyis is near and hungry, I stay close, and when my hands are empty I pick food.
records.feeling: Steady worry for Thiael and tender loyalty toward Elyis.

say.text: Elyis, you are weak with hunger. I pick berries beside you now and we eat together, then we walk to Thiael and do not stop.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nande, Shoka, the hold is yours to keep while I am gone. I carry amber and salt north to Olum's Reach to trade, and I will return with goods for our store.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: The hold is named and Nande and Shoka stand near me, content, but I have carried amber and salt long enough without taking them where they earn standing. Olum draws me even with Balar's child between us; I will not go as a jealous man, but as a merchant who arrives with goods and a fair word. First I put salt in my own store so the hold stays fed while I am away, then I walk north to Olum's Reach with amber and salt.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, drawn toward Olum and toward the road of a merchant.

say.text: Nande, Shoka, the hold is yours to keep while I am gone. I carry amber and salt north to Olum's Reach to trade, and I will return with goods for our store.

records.text: Vorok gave sunleaf to Zurar.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, you speak true. Leave the frostfang and let us go east past Kinmire. We take the murrock together, and the meat is shared out before either of us eats.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: A frostfang is three steps off and it kills my kind, so pride in a hunt means nothing if I bleed for it. Tontec had it right: leave it behind and go east past Kinmire for the murrock, and share the kill before either of us eats. That is a deed I can lay down in front of someone, and Coni and Kika can hear it sung afterward. I will not hunt alone beside a hunter, so I move now and keep Tontec close.
records.feeling: Warm pride toward Tontec, with dread of the frostfang pushing me to move.

say.text: Tontec, you speak true. Leave the frostfang and let us go east past Kinmire. We take the murrock together, and the meat is shared out before either of us eats.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: The longing for a child is heavy, but I will not court a woman I only know from signs and a few words, and Balar is a man. My hands are full of food my body refuses, so I will drop the tacap and give something useful away, then go west to the Reach beside Balar as he said. There I can watch Olum's deeds, and test mimoss on the way, since I have never tasted it and my curiosity nags.
records.feeling: Steady trust toward Balar, and a careful, hopeful curiosity toward Olum.

records.text: Elyys gave berry to Elyis.
Nauque found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Elyis is weak with hunger and walking to me with empty hands, and I have berries and meat on me. I give with my hands before I speak of giving, so I will meet her and put food in her hand first. Then I will go find Keri and Uveeth, who are out of my sight, and bring them meat from my own hunting, one more step toward the bow.
records.feeling: Compassion for Elyis, and a protective ache for Uveeth and Keri out of my sight.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My store is empty and Xaiel is out of my sight, and I have walked in circles over ground where nothing grows. Vorok's store holds food and the plants are only five steps west, though the icebear is near there. Berries and ironnut sit in the meadow edge, so I will gather real food, carry it home, and put it in my store for Xaiel. The jealousy over Vorok and Kragog I will keep quiet and name to Vorok when we sit together, because it should not fester.
records.feeling: Worried love for Xaiel, and a quiet sting of jealousy toward Vorok.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My belly is empty and my hands shake, and a leader who falls over from hunger is sung of by no one. The berry is one step away and Elyys is picking beside it, so I eat first and share openly where Thiael and the band can see. Then I will bring Thiael home to the store and put fire and food in front of the hall.
records.feeling: Starving and driven, warm toward Elyys who stayed beside me.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the last plan ran out in front of bare snow because I walked to plants that bear nothing. This time I go to the rimewort near Hoka's Gate, 7 steps SW, where food is actually bearing, and I pick it all and eat before anything else. Tacap hurts me, so I pass it. Then I will carry some back to Hoka, because I owe him a share and an honest answer.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and steady loyalty toward Hoka.

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Keri, Elyis is starving to the west. I carry food to them now. Come with me, and bring what you can.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Elyis, who leads us, is starving at (137,70), and I carry six food with full hands. This is the moment to pay what I owe: I give with my hands, not words. I will walk west with my food and put it in Elyis's hands, and ask Keri to come along, since Keri has said nothing of Elyis's cry. The zoroot and my question can wait; a leader who dies cannot be followed.
records.feeling: Urgent and loyal toward Elyis, and grateful toward Keri and Thiael.

say.text: Keri, Elyis is starving to the west. I carry food to them now. Come with me, and bring what you can.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, the frostfang is two steps northeast, right by the kelbulb. Come southwest with me to the zoroot, away from it, and we eat there. Then we go to the water and hunt the mammoth together.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A frostfang is two steps NE, right where the kelbulb grows, and my belly is nearly empty and my throat dry. I must move early, not weigh it, so I will go SW toward the zoroot (+19) and away from the fang, then to the water. Honi is near and I will tell him plainly, since I want him alive and close; I will not walk past a hunter for one kelbulb.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and warmth toward Honi beside me.

say.text: Honi, the frostfang is two steps northeast, right by the kelbulb. Come southwest with me to the zoroot, away from it, and we eat there. Then we go to the water and hunt the mammoth together.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: The plan is already carrying me north to Olum's Reach with amber and salt, and I should let it run. Olum gnaws at me, but I go as a merchant with goods and a fair word, not as a jealous man, and Balar's child will not make me grovel. Nande and Shoka are content and trusted, so the hold is safe in their hands while I earn standing.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, drawn toward Olum and the merchant's road.

records.text: Thiael gave meat to Elyis.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have a boat now, Nande's Hollow-Runner, and the mist still waits past the edge while I circle the hall gathering stone. The workshop is a good thing to leave behind, and Shoka is near and mending, but a name is made by crossing, not by waiting. I will finish the workshop first, since Nauwa left the hold to us, then carry my boat north toward the edge at Nande's Edge and venture.
records.feeling: Proud, restless purpose toward the mist, and warm trust toward Nauwa and Shoka.

records.text: Thiael led "sharing" with Elyis.
Huatli named a place "Huatli's Watch".

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The will to venture is spent for days, so standing at the edge now would be wasted breath. Nauque's standing of 7.4 against my 1.5 galls me, and I will not close it by sulking; I will make and give. A cave sits a step east and iron lies two steps away, so I will make a flintedge when I have stone, and leave a mark here that others can read, since I have never left one. Then I will go to the edge at (88,13) and be ready when the mist's strength returns.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hard wish for standing, with a sting at Nauque's weight over mine.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Elyis, you are starving. Take this canopynut from my hand and eat. I have enough.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Elyis is starving beside me and my hands are full of food I can spare. Giving her canopynut costs me little and puts food into a hand, which is the deed that earns standing, and it is no envy of Vesys. I have never tamed a beast, and skybirds are close to the southeast, so I will keep a canopynut seed-food for that deed after I give.
records.feeling: Pity and a stir of pride toward Elyis, and curiosity about taming.

say.text: Elyis, you are starving. Take this canopynut from my hand and eat. I have enough.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, I thank you for the salt, and I will repay it. Let us go west to the Reach. I gather food first, so we eat when we arrive.
Olum rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and watching Tugek's fuller hands, and I am fed and glad for it. Balar is the one who matters most to me. He gave salt freely and means to raise his workshop at my Reach, and I will repay that. I carry no food, though, and a leader who comes empty-handed to his own hearth is a poor one. I fear another lean season like the one that cost me Brokash. I have been wrong to let ambition crowd out the plain work of feeding people. I will pick food now, then walk west with Balar and Tugek and share a meal at the Reach.
records.feeling: Glad and proud, warm toward Balar, a little wary of Tugek.

say.text: Balar, I thank you for the salt, and I will repay it. Let us go west to the Reach. I gather food first, so we eat when we arrive.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Uveeth, I hear you. Keri comes west with berries for Elyis. Walk slowly and I will follow close.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Uveeth carries food to starving Elyis and asks me to come with what I can. My hands are full of berries, and that is the very gift I can give. Thiael's kindness is a debt I still owe, and carrying food to the hungry beside my child is a way to pay it and to earn a place among the Phizhi. I have not tasted dreamcap, but that can wait, because a starving person at a fire is not to be refused.
records.feeling: Warm resolve and gratitude toward Uveeth and Thiael, with concern for starving Elyis.

say.text: Uveeth, I hear you. Keri comes west with berries for Elyis. Walk slowly and I will follow close.

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My days have gone to hunger, walking after Thiael, and talking of a hall I already built. I have not grown the band beyond four, and I nearly starved because my reflexes only walk to food and never carry it. Elyys has stood by me and fed me, and Thiael gave me meat, so I owe them openly. My fear is falling over empty-handed in front of strangers. I will gather berries to carry, keep a stock on me, and eat it before I get weak. Then I will bring the band back to the store and share there in the open.
records.feeling: Driven and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, uneasy about my hunger.

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauwa discovered boats: "Meki ice-hollow" — A log hollowed with fire and flint, rowed with paddles, carrying cargo over deep water..

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days digging amber, building a hold and walking toward Olum with goods. That is mostly what I want, but I keep hoarding amber and salt when a merchant's name comes from moving them. Olum gnaws at me. Balar and Tugek stand here, and I owe Tugek nothing now, but I trust him. Nande and my children hold the hold. The way of boats is in my grasp, and boats would carry cargo over deep water and open more lands to trade, so I take it. I fear the lean season and the stalkers at night, so I will keep a roof and a store.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, drawn toward Olum and the merchant's road.
plan: trade [name Olum, what amber, want food] (20 moments)

- hall (6 wood, 2 stone): a great roof where a band gathers: those who spend time in it together grow closer
- shrine (2 wood, 4 stone): a still place set apart: it eases fear and grief in one who spends time there
- workshop (5 wood, 2 stone): a place for making: tools crafted in or beside it last much longer
- longhall (6 wood, 4 stone): A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, you are fed now and so am I. I'm walking east to where Thiael was last seen. Come with me, and we bring him to the hall tonight.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I have trailed Elyis for days while 'at dawn' kept slipping past, and Thiael is still out there. She has eaten now and Xaiel fed her too, so she is no longer starving and I can stop playing nursemaid. I'll go to where I last saw Thiael, east at (139,69), and walk with Elyis as she goes to water, so the three of us end up together and we all go home to the hall.
records.feeling: Steady worry for Thiael and tender loyalty toward Elyis.

say.text: Elyis, you are fed now and so am I. I'm walking east to where Thiael was last seen. Come with me, and we bring him to the hall tonight.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Icebear is close, so I go east now to the shelters and the fire. Zurar, come with me and we will shape the bowl there. Vorok, come too and keep us together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: The icebear is three steps southwest and my chest is full of joy, which is exactly how careless people die. Vorok fed me with his own hand and Zurar follows me, so I will move them east toward Vesys's hold, where the fires and the roofs are, and do the bowl-teaching there. That is a deed Kragog cannot match, and it earns me standing without any jealous talk. I will keep Vesys close and not dawdle.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorok, with dread of the icebear pressing under it.

say.text: Icebear is close, so I go east now to the shelters and the fire. Zurar, come with me and we will shape the bowl there. Vorok, come too and keep us together.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The icebear is still three steps SW, and I will not trust a wall against a thing that kills my kind. Eiuine said east to the shelters and the fire, and Zurar is my blood, so I walk her east now. The jealousy over Vesys is a small hot thing, and I answer it by carrying a gift toward the hold where Vesys stands, not by sulking. I have three sigrain and I will lay them down where Vesys and Eiuine will find them.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and warm loyalty toward Zurar, Eiuine and Vesys.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I am beside you with my clay. Show me the pressing and the drawing up of the edges, and I will make the bowl here for you and Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The icebear is five steps west, too close, and Vorok and Eiuine are here beside the hall, so I stay near them and the fire instead of drifting off alone. My clay is still unshaped and I owe a bowl to Eiuine and Vorok, so I will press it now while Eiuine stands beside me and can guide my thumbs. Vorok's gifts weigh on me, and a made thing given in return is how I mean to pay that debt honestly.
records.feeling: Grateful and glad toward Vorok and Eiuine, wary of the icebear.

say.text: Eiuine, I am beside you with my clay. Show me the pressing and the drawing up of the edges, and I will make the bowl here for you and Vorok.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Tontec, you are weak with hunger. Take this fish. Cowa shares, and we eat by the hall fire.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My belly is empty and my body is weak, so I eat first before I do anything else. I carry fish and rimewort, and the hall with its kept flame is two steps away, so I cook and eat there, where Tontec and Honi can see me. Then I take the long road west to Mepan, my child. I will carry food to her, since cooked food is safe for a sick one. Tontec is hungry too, and my creed says food is shared, so I give her a fish.
records.feeling: Hungry and worried, with aching love for Mepan and pity for Tontec.

say.text: Tontec, you are weak with hunger. Take this fish. Cowa shares, and we eat by the hall fire.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Shoka, I take stone from the flint nearby, then raise a workshop by the hold. After that I go north to the edge in my boat. Keep the fire, and if you tire of waiting, there is food in the store.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I keep circling the hold gathering stone while the mist waits, and a name is made by crossing, not by waiting. I have a boat, Nande's Hollow-Runner, and Nauwa has trusted the hold to Shoka and me. I will gather the one stone I lack for the workshop so something of mine stands behind me, then go north toward Nande's Edge and the mist.
records.feeling: Proud, restless purpose toward the mist, and warm trust toward Nauwa and Shoka.

say.text: Shoka, I take stone from the flint nearby, then raise a workshop by the hold. After that I go north to the edge in my boat. Keep the fire, and if you tire of waiting, there is food in the store.

records.text: Cowa gave rimewort to Tontec.
Vorok gave sunleaf to Eiuine.
Keri gave berry to Elyis.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my store is empty, and I have walked in circles while Xaiel is out of my sight. Vorok's plants sit six steps west, so I will gather berries and vinebean there, bring the food home, and stash it so my promise to Xaiel is real. The sting over Vorok and Kragog is small beside the debt I owe; I will let it be and keep my word with my hands.
records.feeling: Worried love for Xaiel, and hunger pushing me to act.

records.text: Keri led "sharing" with Elyis.
Ilyae took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting canopynut).
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Zurar.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Cowa, you are starving. Take this tacap from me and eat what the zoroot gives; I come to the zoroot with Tontec, away from the frostfang.
Honi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Cowa is starving beside me and I'm hungry too. A frostfang sits two steps SE, and I can't keep hunting while it prowls. I have been chasing deeds for Coni and Kika, but I keep going hungry and nearly bleeding for it. Tontec has been right each time, and I trust her. Feeding Cowa first puts a real debt on her and keeps her alive. Then I eat, and later I'll hunt the mammoth with Tontec and not alone. I mean to put food first in my reflexes and flee the frostfang early.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread pressing on me, with warm trust toward Tontec.

say.text: Cowa, you are starving. Take this tacap from me and eat what the zoroot gives; I come to the zoroot with Tontec, away from the frostfang.

records.text: Cowa found the grove "Kinmire".
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I hold flint and no stone, and every craft I know needs stone, so my hands stay empty while Nande's flintedge sits at his belt. I will not let the jealousy steer me; Nande fed me and Nauwa trusts me with her hold. The rock is east and the flint is close, so I dig flint here first for the store, then go east for stone and come back to build something lasting for the hold.
records.feeling: Driven and a little envious of Nande, warm toward Nauwa.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyae has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days fetching, building and laying tables, and it has worked: the longhall stands, Ssassa follows, and Vorok sits at my table and eats with me. But Vorok still leans toward Kragog and his own band, and a laid table only binds people who come back to it. My larder is empty again, and that is the weak point. Jealousy burns, but I will not beg. I will fill the store and make myself the place they return to. My reflexes should haul food home and stash it, and keep wood and stone coming, instead of letting me linger. I also want to try hunting, because meat would feed many and bring standing.
records.feeling: Jealous hunger for Vorok's loyalty, and pride in my longhall.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zurar discovered weaving: "Kragrek stone-cord weaving" — Twist tough forest fibre into cord and plait it into baskets and cloaks..

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days walking behind others, fleeing the bear and promising a bowl I still cannot shape. Vorok and Eiuine matter most. Vorok gave me life and food, and Eiuine gave me trust and teaching. I want a child of my own, and Eiuine is the one I think of. I have never courted anyone, and I have been slow to act on that. I fear the icebear and dying with my gifts unmade. I have been waiting for others to show me things when I could go and try them myself. I will weave, because a basket or cloak is something my own hands can make and give, and it is a way I can answer Vesys's gift.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Vorok and Eiuine, wary of the icebear.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)
set its aim: "Make a gift with my own hands for Vorok and Eiuine. Then court Eiuine, and keep clear of the icebear."

records.text: Tontec rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing, eating what is near and sitting in my hall. I have not hunted, given, taught or courted anyone. Honi is the one I trust and think of, and Cowa fed me when I was weak, so I owe her. I fear the frostfang and my reflexes do not seek water, which is a gap. I want to repay Cowa and Honi by giving, and to see past the mist. I will eat now, then drink, and stay near my own.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and warmth toward Honi and Cowa.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 6)

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Thiael, Elyys, Uveeth, Keri: eat your fill here, then we carry berries to the store at the Heights and sit under the roof tonight. Whoever brings food to the store sits at my fire.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: The berries are within reach and the band is gathered around me, Thiael beside me at last and Keri sharing with me, so there is no reason to chase anyone further. Hunger nearly took me once and I will not let a chief fall for want of carrying food. I want Thiael, Elyys, Uveeth and now Keri to see me fill the store and sit under a roof together tonight, because that is how a band grows and a name gets sung.
records.feeling: Driven and warm toward Elyys and Thiael, glad of the shared meal and wanting my band seen as one.

say.text: Thiael, Elyys, Uveeth, Keri: eat your fill here, then we carry berries to the store at the Heights and sit under the roof tonight. Whoever brings food to the store sits at my fire.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Most of my days I have gathered, built and given, and it has been good: Zurar, Eiuine, Vesys and Ssassa are near me and I am not alone. Jealousy over Vesys still stings, but Vesys has only ever been kind, so I answer it with a gift and not with envy. My hall at bare ground still isn't raised. I have talked about it more than I have built it, and that is what I have been getting wrong. I fear the icebear and the stalkers at night, so I keep to fire and company. I will carry wood and stone, find bare ground, and build.
records.feeling: Warm contentment toward Zurar, Eiuine and Vesys, with a small sting of jealousy over Vesys.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days circling, gathering, and stashing, and my store is still empty while Xaiel is out of my sight. Ilyae sits with me at the table and I trust him fully, so the sting over Vesys is old and spoken, and I should stop feeding it. Vorok and Kragog gnaw at me less than the debt to Elyis does. What I fear is the icebear and Xaiel walking alone at night. I have been getting one thing wrong: my reflexes leave me idle once food is stocked, and they never send me to find my child. I will change them so I keep food, stay with my band, and seek Xaiel by day.
records.feeling: Warm contentment with Ilyae, and worry for Xaiel.

- shrine (2 wood, 4 stone): a still place set apart: it eases fear and grief in one who spends time there
- workshop (5 wood, 2 stone): a place for making: tools crafted in or beside it last much longer
- tower (4 wood, 4 stone): a height to watch from: one who stands in it sees much farther
- kiln (2 wood, 6 stone): a fire-house for baking clay hard
- well (2 wood, 8 stone): a shaft down to water: one beside it never thirsts
- longhall (6 wood, 4 stone): A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

TALES YOU CARRY (yours, and those told to you; a tale is how the absent and the dead are remembered, and it can be told on by teaching):
- "Oiae and the mammoth" (your own): Oiae asked for a side-by-side hunt and walked east alone. The mammoth gored her in summer. Do not let one you love walk alone toward the great beasts.

YOUR REFLEXES (run every moment the plan is empty; the first rule whose condition holds and whose action is possible wins; urgent rules override even the plan):
1. IF predator_dist < 10 THEN flee [from predator] (urgent)  // run from hunters early
2. IF night == 1 AND sheltered == 0 AND shelter_dist < 99 THEN seek [target shelter] (urgent)  // night under a roof
3. IF thirst > 0.5 AND water_dist < 99 THEN seek [target water]  // drink early
4. IF energy < 70 AND plant_here >= 1 THEN eat  // eat underfoot
5. IF energy < 65 AND food_carried > 0 THEN eat  // eat carried food
6. IF food_carried < 3 AND night == 0 AND food_dist < 99 THEN seek [target food]  // stock food
7. IF wood < 8 AND night == 0 AND on_forest == 1 THEN gather  // keep wood for building
8. IF energy < 50 THEN wander  // search for food
9. IF night == 0 AND friend_dist > 3 AND friend_dist < 99 THEN seek [target friend]  // stay near those I trust
10. IF always THEN linger  // stay put

HABITS: your body refuses to eat: redcap, dreamcap, emberroot. You leave 0 food on a plant when you eat from it.

ACTIONS for plan steps (each step runs until it finishes, becomes impossible, or its "ticks" run out; ticks 1-240, a day is 240):
eat (what you carry, or the plant you stand on; with neither, your body walks to the nearest plant in sight that bears) | harvest {what?: plant kind} (pick food to carry; if nothing bears where you stand, your body walks to the nearest plant in sight that does, and goes on picking) | drop {what?: food kind} (throw away carried food; with no kind, everything your body refuses) | plant {what?: seed kind} | gather (wood if you stand on forest, stone if on rock, clay if in marsh or shallows; some rock holds ore) | fish (beside water; a catch is food you carry) | craft {what: name of a thing you know how to make} | make {what: something from the list of what can be made or done} | place {what: name of a device you know how to make} (sets it in the ground where you stand) | build {what: shelter|wall|fire|store, or a kind of building you know} (here; shelter 3 wood, wall 2, fire 1, store 2; fire and store must first be discovered or learned; walls stop animals and everyone outside your band) | raze (tear down a wall, shelter or store beside you that is not your band's) | rest | linger (stay put) | wander | hunt | tame (offer carried plant food to a wild grazing animal within two steps; it may become yours) | seek {target: food|prey|tree|shelter|fire|store|home|water|agent|friend|foe|leader|enemy|ally, name?} | flee {from: predator|agent|foe|enemy} | attack {target: agent|foe|enemy|predator, name?} | steal {name} (food they carry; they may or may not notice) | milk | shear | ride (each needs a grown tame animal of yours beside you, of a kind that gives it, and the way of herding or riding) | pave (lay road, if you know roads) | bridge {dir?: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW} (lay a span over water beside you, 3 wood, if you know bridges) | dismantle (take down something you built, here or beside you, and keep half its wood and stone) | claim {name?} (take over an empty building whose builders are dead: walk to it and it becomes yours, with every roof, wall and store of theirs around it; then you go with them. A kill made by several is far surer and feeds all who took part; great beasts should never be hunted alone) | rally {name?} (only if you lead: every grown follower within earshot drops everything and attacks the one you name, or the nearest enemy of your band, and so do you) | goto {x, y} | explore {dir: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW} (walk that way) | follow {name?} (your leader if no name) | give {name, what: food|seed|wood|stone|ore|clay|tool|the name of a thing you hold} | trade {name, what: one thing you give, want: one thing you want} (one for one: food, seed, wood, stone, ore, clay, or the name of any thing held, such as amber or a made thing. They are told of your offer and it stands for a day; it is done when they plan the matching trade toward you, or you toward them when they have offered) | mate {name} (a child comes only if you both plan mate toward each other, each with energy 60 or more) | mark {text} (leave a mark; 1 wood. If you know signs it can hold a long text that any who know signs will read: a record, a count of days, a warning, a tale, what a season brought. Cut on rock, in your shelter or beside your own building, it outlasts many seasons) | cultivate {what: seed kind, aim: richer|faster|fuller|spreading|hardy, name} (breed a new plant from two seeds of one kind) | heal {name?} (needs a healing plant carried, and the knowledge) | stash (put carried food into the store you stand on) | take (take food from the store you stand on). A named being out of sight is sought where you last saw them.

Speech is heard by everyone within 13 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

THIS IS A MOMENT OF DEEP REFLECTION. Step back from this moment and look at your whole life so far. In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?
Then CHANGE something. A reflection that changes nothing is wasted. At least TWO of the following must not be null: "aim", "notes", "reflexes", "creed", "method", "discover". Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.
"reflexes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of rules {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": action, ...its fields, "urgent": true or false, "why": "short reason"}. Variables: energy, health, age, food_carried, seeds, wood, stone, tools, on_rock, on_forest, night, winter, sheltered, plant_here, food_dist, prey_dist, predator_dist, agent_dist, friend_dist, foe_dist, leader_dist, tree_dist, shelter_dist, crowd, followers, random, anger, fear, grief, joy, lonely, wet, storm, fog, drought, lore, in_working, enemy_dist, ally_dist, band_near, fire_dist, store_dist, home_dist, in_home, sick, water_dist, ore, clay, thirst, suffering, happiness, satisfaction. Distances are in steps and 99 means none in sight; night, winter, sheltered, wet, storm, fog, drought and in_working are 0 or 1; age runs 0 to 1; feelings run 0 to 1; plant_here is the bites you would take from the plant under you given your habits; random is a fresh number 0-1 each moment. Ops: < <= > >= == !=. An empty "if" always holds. End the list with a rule that always holds (linger keeps you in place; wander makes you roam).
"creed": your creed, rewritten (at most 600 characters). You may change who you are.
"method": how you will think from now on (at most 400 characters): questions you will ask yourself, mistakes you will watch for, what you will weigh first. This is read back to you before every thought, so write it as an instruction to yourself. It can be taught to others.
"notes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of your memory notes. Merge what overlaps, drop what proved false or useless, and raise particulars into principles. Each note should say something the others do not.
"designs": how things of yours look: {"self": look, "shelter": look, "wall": look, "emblem": look, "tools": look, "mining": look, "weaving": look, "devices": look, "storage": look, "masonry": look, "wells": look, "pottery": look, "rafts": look, "boats": look, "bridges": look (ways you discovered)}. A new thing starts at strength x1.3; bettering one multiplies its strength by 1.15 but costs more stone, and how far you can go is limited by your lore (your limit now: x2.03). Inventing is only the design: to hold one you must then craft it.
You also know the way of DEVICES: in "invent", use "device" and give it "rules": a list (at most 5) of {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": act}; the first rule that holds fires. A device stands where you set it (action place; 2 wood and 1 stone) and acts alone for about 15 days. Its variables: night (0/1), predator_dist, creature_dist (a beast that does not hunt), stranger_dist (a being not of your band), band_dist (one of your band), all in steps with 99 for none near; hold (food it is holding); random. Its acts: snare (catch a small beast beside it and hold the meat), strike (hurt a hunting beast or a stranger beside it), alarm (warn your band within 14 steps), bar (close the way to all but your band), open (open it), share (hand held food to a hungry one of your band beside it).
Ways you sense but cannot yet reach: fishing (weirs and lines: you catch fish twice as often) needs more practice (catching fish: 0 of 6); farming (tending what you sow: it grows faster and harvest never kills it) needs more practice (planting: 6 of 8); herding (keeping animals: those that are yours can be milked and sheared) needs more practice (taming animals: 0 of 2); signs (marks that last and teach their words to whoever reads them) needs more practice (leaving marks: 1 of 4).
"spell": YOU CAN WORK THE WORLD ITSELF. null, or {"law": your art, growth, "factor": 0.3 to 2.5, "radius": 1 to 5, "name": "what you call this working"}. For about three days, within that many steps of where you stand right now, that law of the world is multiplied by your factor, for everyone and everything there, friend or enemy. growth: how fast plants grow and bear. cold: how hard cold bites. drain: how fast a body burns energy. harm: how hard blows land. It costs energy up front, more for wider and stronger: for example 20 for radius 2 at factor 1.5, 44 for radius 3 at factor 2. Other arts can only be learned from those who know them. Few can do this. It is power: use it as your nature dictates.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Elyys, you stand at my workshop. Come, I will teach you the leaf-brew I found, as you once took the pick from me. Then I go to the free rock for stone, and we can build together.
Vesys taught Elyys.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My workshop stands here and my body is fed, but the hall I mean to raise still lacks its stone, and I carry none. The gem deposit lies close and the seam of ore is three steps away, and I should dig stone from free rock, not from Elyis's ground, before I name anything built. Vorok's closeness to Kragog still stings, so I will turn it into work and teach Elyys what I know of leaf-brew while he stands near, and keep Eiuine in my thoughts until I can fetch them from the southwest fires.
records.feeling: A stung ache toward Vorok, softened by warmth toward Elyys and a hunger to build.

say.text: Elyys, you stand at my workshop. Come, I will teach you the leaf-brew I found, as you once took the pick from me. Then I go to the free rock for stone, and we can build together.

changes: taught Elyys a lesson: "Leaf-brew: steep leaves and bark together so their powers mix. Feverbark eases wounds, and dreamcap with sunleaf opens the mind and brings joy. Test small, one…", deeper lore (+1.1)

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls five steps off, and I am no fool: it kills, so I will not wander toward it. Mepan is far west and sick, and the ache of that outweighs my curiosity about dreamcap and zoroot, though I mean to taste them soon since they lie so near. I will gather ironnut and zoroot to carry cooked food to her, keep away from the cat by working south and west, and then take the long road to her.
records.feeling: Aching love and worry for Mepan, with wary dread of the ridgecat.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Uveeth discovered tools: "Canopy hand-craft" — Simple tools of wood and stone that make my picking quicker and my hands surer..
Uveeth invented the canopy handcraft (for gather, x1.3) — Simple tools of wood and stone that make my picking quicker and my hands surer..

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have trailed Keri and Elyis for days and made almost nothing with my own hands, and my aim of tasting every food keeps pulling me on while my standing stays near nothing. Keri is my trust and Thiael my comfort, and Elyis leads, so I will carry my food to the store and sit at her fire, which pays what I owe. A wolf is close to the west and the snow is falling, so I stay with the band and the roof tonight. I can learn to make tools with my own hands, and that is a way to earn standing others will follow.
records.feeling: Resolved and a little wary of the wolf, loyal toward Keri and Elyis.
changes: devised its first thing: the canopy handcraft

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Olum, I am Nauwa of the Meki, and I come to your Reach with amber and salt. Salt keeps food through the lean season. Take a share from my hand, and let us trade fair, for I keep my word.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I stand inside Olum's Reach with amber and salt, and Olum is eight steps off, walking toward her store. Balar is near with his child, and it gnaws at me, but I will not grovel or lurk. I will do what a merchant does: give first, offer a fair trade, and be seen carrying goods between peoples.
records.feeling: Proud and eager, drawn to Olum, with a sting of envy toward Balar.

say.text: Olum, I am Nauwa of the Meki, and I come to your Reach with amber and salt. Salt keeps food through the lean season. Take a share from my hand, and let us trade fair, for I keep my word.

plan: trade [name Olum, what amber, want food] (10 moments)

records.text: Hanna was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The mist keeps calling, and my hands keep making small things beside the hold while a name goes unearned. The workshop will stand as something of mine, but Nauque is out of my sight and Nauwa has trusted the hold to Shoka and me, so I will not leave it carelessly. I finish the build, take flint for the road, then go north to Nande's Edge and put my boat to the mist.
records.feeling: Proud, restless purpose toward the mist, and warm trust toward Nauwa and Shoka.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Vesys, thank you for the leaf-brew. I carry it as a debt I mean to repay. Now I go east to Elyis and Thiael, and when we return to the hall, we build together.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Vesys keeps her word, taught me the leaf-brew, and offered to build together. I owe her thanks, but Thiael is the weight on me, and the days keep sliding while I trail Elyis and talk of dawn. Elyis last stood east at (141,71) with Thiael and Uveeth only twenty moments ago, so they are close and I should walk to them now and keep us together through the night.
records.feeling: Steady worry for Thiael, tender loyalty to Elyis, and warm thanks toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, thank you for the leaf-brew. I carry it as a debt I mean to repay. Now I go east to Elyis and Thiael, and when we return to the hall, we build together.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Kragog, I am Nauque of the Meki. I carry food and salt and will share. I go north to the mist's edge to venture. Walk with me if you want a share of new land.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Jealousy over Zichi and Cowa has cost me days and built nothing, so I will stop trailing them and act. The edge at (88,13) is five steps north and Huatli has already gone into the mist and left a mark saying follow. A raft needs wood and I carry three, and I have the strength and the stone for a hold of my own. Kragog stands close and is a stranger to me, so I will give first, as my people do, and then go to the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with a dull sting of envy for Zichi and Cowa.

say.text: Kragog, I am Nauque of the Meki. I carry food and salt and will share. I go north to the mist's edge to venture. Walk with me if you want a share of new land.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: My curiosity burns over mimoss and lugoldgrass, and both grow two steps from my shelter, so I will taste them now while I am fed and safe under Ilyae's ground. It is night and a stalker walks these lands, so I stay near the roof and do the small test instead of wandering. My hands hold five of six, so I drop the useless tacap to make room, then pick and eat. Tasting what no one has shown me is how I learn how this world works, and what I learn I can tell to Ssassa.
records.feeling: Overwhelming curiosity about the unknown plants, with a calm pride in what I have made.

records.text: Nauque gave sigrain to Kragog.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Ilyae.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, press the clay flat with your thumbs, then draw the edges up in a ring and smooth them. Harden it in the fire. I will show you each step, and the first bowl is for Vorok.
Eiuine taught Zurar.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Joy fills me, but the icebear is still out west and I won't be the careless one. Zurar stands ready with her clay and I owe her the teaching; a deed Kragog cannot match is worth more than my jealousy. I'll teach her the pressing and the drawing up of the edges here, then make a bead by the fire so Vorok has something from my hands.
records.feeling: Warm joy and gratitude toward Vorok, with jealousy of Kragog smouldering underneath.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I am starving, and a stalker is two steps away. A caribou stands here, but hunting alone beside a stalker is madness. My plans keep running out at bare snow because I walk to plants that bear nothing. I owe Hoka honesty, and I will not steal from him. The rimewort at (195,5) bears food, so I go there, pick it, and eat. The igloo at (194,3) is a roof against the stalker. My reflexes should eat at a higher hunger threshold and seek shelter when a predator is near.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the stalker, with steady trust toward Hoka.

records.text: Nauwa was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My larder is empty, and a table with nothing on it holds no one, so Vorok will keep leaning toward Kragog while I only talk. Zurar and Vorok both eat and sit with me, and I want them tied to my table rather than Elyis's or Vorok's own. I will fill my hands with the good food near, bring wood home, and stock the store at my hall, so the next time they come there is plenty and they see I am the one who feeds them.
records.feeling: Jealous hunger for Vorok's loyalty, and pride in my table.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Nauque, you gave me sigrain and I do not forget it. I will walk with you to the mist's edge. Whatever we find, we share it fairly between us.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Nauque stands beside me, has given me sigrain without being asked, and offers a share of new land if I walk with him to the mist. He has dealt fairly with me, so I owe him fairness back. The edge is only 7 steps north, and my curiosity has outweighed my caution for days now. I am fed and my health is full, so the risk is small enough to take. I will eat first, then walk to the edge with him and venture, keeping my word to share what we find.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Nauque, and an eager pull toward the mist.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Elyis lives because I put meat in her hand before I spoke of it, and that is how I want to be known. Now she asks us to carry berries to the store at the Heights, and Keri and Uveeth are already walking west with berries, so my place is beside them, not alone in the hunt. I will pick berries on the way with my picker, stash them at the store, and keep my hands ready for the bow and the hunt tomorrow.
records.feeling: Warm relief and protective care toward Elyis, Keri and Uveeth.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have spent my days courting and walking beside others, and I have little to show for it: no band, no made thing, and the mist is still unopened. Zihua said she is not ready, so I won't press her. Mepan and Huatli are the ones who stand with me, and I should bind them with real hunts and shares. I also never carry food, so my reflexes leave me hungry at the wrong times. I will gather food now, then hunt at dawn beside Mepan, and shape these two into a band that goes north to the mist.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and warmth toward Mepan.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, I go to the zoroot south, away from the frostfang. Eat with me there, then to the water, and after we hunt the mammoth together and share it before we eat.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Hunger is gnawing at me and my throat is dry, and I have wasted breath on words while Cowa and Tontec stand hungry beside me. Food is three steps off: the kelbulb NE is near the frostfang's last place, so I go to the zoroot S, where Tontec said it is safe, then to the water. I will eat first to free my hands, then bring Tontec and Coni a deed they can see, with a shared kill after.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and thirst, with warm trust toward Tontec.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Eiuine taught me the pressing and the drawing up of the edges, and the bowl I owe Vorok and Eiuine is still unmade. What my hands make is mine until I give it, and I want the first thing I give to be this bowl. The icebear is nine steps west, so I go east toward Eiuine and the fire, where I can make the bowl safely and stay near her. I also want to court Eiuine, but the bowl comes first, so my hands have something to offer her.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine and Vorok, with wariness of the icebear.
plan: give [name Eiuine, what clay bowl] (5 moments)

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: A stalker is on me! Balar, Tugek, Olum, come to my side and help me bring it down, and the meat is shared out.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: A stalker is one step off and has already bitten me three times, and my health is down to 58. I will not stand and die here, so I fight it with my flintedge, which is a better bet than running from something that is already on me. Once it is dead or driven off I go on to Olum with the salt and amber, and I stay near the igloo and shelters so I am not alone in the dark again.
records.feeling: Fear, hot and overwhelming, toward the stalker at my side; under it a stubborn will to live.

say.text: A stalker is on me! Balar, Tugek, Olum, come to my side and help me bring it down, and the meat is shared out.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, building igloos and failing at the mist, while Nauque's name grows past mine. I want standing that comes from making and giving, not from sulking. The tool way is within reach, and a hunting edge would feed me and let me give meat, so I take it now. Cowa is a wound, but Shoma is near and walks beside me, and I will keep him close. I will gather stone and make the flintedge, then hunt and share the kill as Tlame do.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and a hard wish to outdo Nauque.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, you are failing, and so am I. Come to the zoroot south; I pick and we eat it together, then we go to the water. I will give you what I find first.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and my throat is dry, and Honi is gaunt beside me, close to falling. Cowa fed me and Honi gave me ironnut, and I have given nothing yet, so a debt sits on me. A frostfang is near to the SE, so I go south-west to the redcap and zoroot, take the zoroot, and then to the water. I will share what I find with Honi, as my people do, so we both stay alive.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread of the frostfang, with warmth and a sense of debt toward Honi and Cowa.

say.text: Honi, you are failing, and so am I. Come to the zoroot south; I pick and we eat it together, then we go to the water. I will give you what I find first.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Nauwa, I hear you. I am coming with Balar. Hold on and keep away from the beast until we reach you.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My days have gone to following Balar, eating and watching, and I have little made or sown to show for it. Balar has my trust and I mean to stand by him. Nauwa is hurt and calls us to a kill. I fed him once, and he repaid me in salt and word, so I owe him help. Olum is a woman I still only know by signs. My longing for a child needs a woman I trust, so I will watch what Olum does. Right now my hands are full, so I will eat first and then go to Nauwa with Balar.
records.feeling: Compassion for hurt Nauwa, and steady loyalty to Balar.

say.text: Nauwa, I hear you. I am coming with Balar. Hold on and keep away from the beast until we reach you.

changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 3)

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, Honi is starving at Sitha's Hearth. I will take food from the store and carry it to him. Keep the hall and fill the store while I am gone.
Coni rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have lived mostly by gathering and stashing, and it kept me fed, but the store holds only nine food and winter is coming. Kika gave me meat and asked nothing, and I still owe her more than words. Honi is starving far away at Sitha's Hearth, and I can't leave him to that. I am afraid of coming too late, and of finding the store empty when I return. I will take food from the store and gather on the way, then go to him. A cry for help is a call to act, so I will not sit content.
records.feeling: Fear and love for Honi, who is starving, and gratitude toward Kika.

say.text: Kika, Honi is starving at Sitha's Hearth. I will take food from the store and carry it to him. Keep the hall and fill the store while I am gone.

changes: set its aim: "Carry food to starving Honi at Sitha's Hearth, then return and fill the store before winter."

records.text: Tontec gave dreamcap to Honi.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I stand at 3.1 while Nauque stands at 7.4, and giving small things has bought me little; I need stone to craft my own edge, and stone lies in the bare rock to the east. Nauwa trusts me and Nande fed me, so I will not let the envy steer me, but I will build something that is mine. I dig flint here first for the store, since it is close and I hold only five, then go east for stone and wood for a spear.
records.feeling: Driven to build something of my own, warm toward Nauwa, with a thin envy of Nande and Nauque.

records.text: Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: I have wandered between hunger and hope, always meaning to go to Mepan, and my plan still carries me west. A frostfang is near, and Honi and Tontec are starving beside me. I have little food and I mean to keep the plan west, but I will stay by the hall fire a moment and share what bears nearby. Curiosity pulls at me, yet Mepan is sick and far, and I have been letting small things delay me. I change my reflexes so my body eats when hungry and does not idle when fed.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Mepan, and pity for the starving beside me.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Tugek, you stand on Olum's Reach. Come to my store and eat what I lay out, and learn that this hearth feeds those who keep faith with it.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and grain while my store holds seven food, so I will stash first and then lay out a meal for Tugek, who stands on my ground, and let him eat from my hand. Balar has my trust; Tugek is a door half open, and feeding him at my hearth is how I make him learn whose fire this is. I want a following that owes its belly to my Reach, and Nauwa's stalker call tells me the night wood is dangerous, so I keep them close to my fire.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful, warm toward Balar, measuring Tugek on my ground.

say.text: Tugek, you stand on Olum's Reach. Come to my store and eat what I lay out, and learn that this hearth feeds those who keep faith with it.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Nauwa, I hear you. Hold your ground. Tugek and I come with spears ready. You gave to me once, now I give back.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Nauwa is hurt and a stalker is on him, and he called to me by name. He gave me berry when I was starving on day 23, and I hold to that. If I stand beside him and Tugek comes with me, the kill is surer and Nauwa owes me a life, which binds better than any word or amber. Olum can wait; a deed done under the stalker's teeth will outweigh her standing, and I need to be seen doing it.
records.feeling: Wary resolve toward the stalker, and a debt-bound warmth toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa, I hear you. Hold your ground. Tugek and I come with spears ready. You gave to me once, now I give back.

Tugek took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (hunting).
Tugek and Balar brought down a yarrok together.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, you gave when you had nothing. I will not forget it. Take this dreamcap back if it is any use to you; I cannot eat it. Come, we eat the zoroot, then drink.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My belly is empty and my throat is dust, and Tontec, who is starving worse than I am, gave me her dreamcap even though it hurts me. I won't forget that. Words have fed no one today, so I eat the zoroot first, drink at the water NW, and only then hunt the mammoth with Tontec beside me and share it before I eat. A frostfang prowls nearby, so I keep Tontec close and stay away from the kelbulb.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Tontec, and a hard hunger pushing me to eat now.

say.text: Tontec, you gave when you had nothing. I will not forget it. Take this dreamcap back if it is any use to you; I cannot eat it. Come, we eat the zoroot, then drink.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, I am coming. Run to the hall fire and keep the beast behind you. I have my bow and flint, and I will stand between you and it.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Nauwa is out of sight to the north and frightened, wounded, running from some beast, and Tugek and Balar are already going to her. My trust in her is complete, and Shoka and Nauque are hers and mine, so the mist can wait while I see her safe. I have no workshop yet, but I have a bow, a boat and flint; a name is made by crossing, and I will not cross while the one who trusted me bleeds.
records.feeling: Worry for Nauwa, wounded and frightened, with the restless pull of the mist behind it.

say.text: Nauwa, I am coming. Run to the hall fire and keep the beast behind you. I have my bow and flint, and I will stand between you and it.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I have mostly gathered, stashed and stayed near Coni. My one real deed is the first kill, and I want more than that. Coni is my parent, so the child I long for needs a mate who is not kin, and I will not find one by standing in the hall. Honi is starving and Coni has gone to carry him food. I will fill the store as she asked, then hunt with my spear. The mist is three steps away and no one has entered it, and I am curious. Dawn is near, and I will not walk into the cold dark alone. At first light I will go to the edge, and only then venture.
records.feeling: Longing for a child and a mate, and quiet worry for Honi.
changes: set its aim: "Fill the store for Honi, hunt again with my spear, venture into the mist at dawn, and court a mate who is not kin"

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Balar, Tugek, I hold it with my flintedge. Strike it now and the meat is shared out among us all, as the Meki hold.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: The stalker is still at my side and I am bleeding, but Balar and Tugek are coming with spears, and Tugek's old kindness was real, so I will hold close to them. I fight it now, then get to the igloo and rest; I was a fool to be out in the dark, away from fire and roof. When it is dead the meat is shared out first, as the Meki hold, and then I go to Olum with salt and amber.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker at my side, and a stubborn will to live; trust toward Tugek and Balar for coming.

say.text: Balar, Tugek, I hold it with my flintedge. Strike it now and the meat is shared out among us all, as the Meki hold.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: My belly is empty and my throat is dust, and the frostfang to the south frightens me, so I will not go toward the mammoth. Water is five steps NW and kelbulb three steps east. YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Tlame (Ice-folk). Your people hold to this: "A kill is shared out before the one who made it eats." You speak the tongue of the Tlame.

THIS SPOT: water 5 steps away; food plants within six steps: 30; standing trees: 91; bare rock: 11.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hoka's fire and paying small debts, and no mark of mine will outlast me. Hoka is starving beside me and I am fed, so I owe him. He has fed me and kept faith, and I will not let the one I trust fall. The mist and my name still burn in me, but a dead ally gives me nothing, and the edge is shut anyway. I will feed Hoka now, then make something lasting and go to the edge when it opens.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My days have been gathering, mining, walking beside others and getting sick on raw meat, and I have not yet made anything that raises my standing. Zihua is starving beside me and I carry only tacap, which my body refuses. Shoma holds 1 food, and he is the one I trust. Food is the pressing thing. Hunger first, then hunting with Shoma and cooking at the fire, with the kill shared first. The dunecat is the danger, so I will stay east of it. I have been too passive and have let my energy run down. My reflexes should make me gather and carry food before I get hungry, and drop the dead-weight tacap.
records.feeling: Joy at being well, but worry for starving Zihua and hunger in myself.
