records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vorok, Skaruk.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Zihua, I go west to Olum's Reach with amber and salt to trade. Keep to the roof and the fire, and the gale will not harm you. Come after me if you wish to see the trade.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I am fed, warm and glad, and Tugek's kindness was real, so I will not sulk over Balar or grovel to Olum. I stand as a trader: my hands are full of amber and salt, and the lean season is coming. Olum's Reach lies fifteen steps west, so I will carry amber and salt there and trade, and that is how I rise. First I will drop the rimewort to free a hand, then go by Nauwa's Hearth so I am not caught in the open after dark.
records.feeling: Proud and glad, with a small sting of jealousy toward Balar, and gratitude toward Tugek and Zihua.

say.text: Zihua, I go west to Olum's Reach with amber and salt to trade. Keep to the roof and the fire, and the gale will not harm you. Come after me if you wish to see the trade.

plan: trade [name Olum, what amber, want food] (40 moments)

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hanna, take this cloudberry. Keep your amber for now. You owe me food when you stand, and I will remember it.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have been circling Hoka's fire, paying and gathering, and my name is still unwritten. Hoka is the one I trust, and I will not let him fall. Hanna is starving and offers amber for one food. I carry 5 and my own belly is full, so I can spend one cloudberry, and a debtor who owes me food is a debtor who follows me. The edge is shut for days, so I should use them to build something that lasts: a workshop or a hall with my name on it. Envy of Honi should not push me into open ground.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and steady warmth toward Hoka.

say.text: Hanna, take this cloudberry. Keep your amber for now. You owe me food when you stand, and I will remember it.

records.text: Tugek is courting Zihua.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Eiuine already told me plainly that we are both women and no child can come of us, so my longing for her is for friendship and not for a child, and I will not pretend otherwise. I owe her a pot made by my own hands, and I hold two already, one of them for water. I will walk to her, give her a pot, and keep my word, since that is how I answer the burn of jealousy. I have never tasted snowmallow or rimewort, and both grow within a few steps of where I will pass.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a steady wish to keep my word to Eiuine, with a small jealous ache toward Vorok.

records.text: Elyys gave berry to Elyis.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Eiuine stands beside me and the boy Skaruk is near. I promised her a hall and I still lack two wood, so I will gather wood from the trees nearby and then raise the hall on the bare rock, as I said. The gale cuts hard, so I want a roof soon for Eiuine and Skaruk. I will give Skaruk a berry now, because the child is close and the sting over Ilyae eases when I give instead of brood.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Eiuine and Skaruk, with a faint sting over Ilyae.

records.text: Vorok gave berry to Skaruk.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Eiuine is hunting nearby and Vorok stands close, so this is the time to learn the hunt beside kin, not just talk of it. I have never given anything to anyone, and Vorok has more food than I do. I will gather plainsroot, which is right beside me, and bring some to Vorok and Eiuine. That answers my envy with a deed and earns a little standing.
records.feeling: Eager and warm toward Vorok and Eiuine, with a small sting of envy.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Tugek, I hear you, and I thank you for asking plainly. I do not know you well enough to say yes. My word is good, so I will not give it yet. Let me watch and learn your people's tongue, and ask me again another day.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Tugek asks to court me and I do not know him; he is a Kragrek hunter I met only days ago, and I trust slowly. My heart leans toward Nauwa, who is walking west with amber and salt, and the surest way to stand beside him is to go where he goes and learn the trade by doing. I will answer Tugek honestly and kindly, without a promise I do not mean, then follow Nauwa west with food in hand.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Nauwa, wary courtesy toward Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, I hear you, and I thank you for asking plainly. I do not know you well enough to say yes. My word is good, so I will not give it yet. Let me watch and learn your people's tongue, and ask me again another day.

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.
Hoka rewrote its own way of thinking.
Hoka discovered archery: "Hoka's flint bow" — A bent sapling and hide cord that sends a flint-tipped shaft far, so I hunt beasts without close blows..
Hoka has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I'm at 36 energy with empty hands, and the store 3 steps west holds 12 food. I let hunger run low again. My reflexes ran me for shelter in the gale instead of feeding me. I've spent my days guarding ground and bargaining with Hawen, whose talk of a child is empty. Hanna starves and fled, and he is the one who held to his word. I owe him, so I'll take food from the store and bring it to him. Then I'll finally make something that outlasts me. I'll discover archery, because a bow would make hunting mammoths safer for me.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, loyal to Hanna, wary of Honi.
changes: set its aim: "Eat from my store, feed Hanna, keep the stores stocked, and make a bow, a made thing that outlasts me."

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I carry ironnut and I am sworn to you. Let us share it here, then I will learn the deep stone from you, so I can give the band iron and coal.
Huahua discovered mining: "Ice-hand delving" — I strike the deep ore with a hafted gatherer and rest between blows, learning where it cracks..

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and walking, and my hands are full of ironnut while I still have not tasted mimoss or seberry. Cowa asked me to come west to Mepan, and Zichi stands one step from me, so I can serve my pledge and my longing together. I want to learn mining, since coal and iron lie near and Zichi is a miner, and that is something I can give the band. I will not harm Cowa for jealousy.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Zichi, with some wonder at the deep ore.

say.text: Zichi, I carry ironnut and I am sworn to you. Let us share it here, then I will learn the deep stone from you, so I can give the band iron and coal.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Thiael, Elyys: a wolf is east of us. Keep close together by the cave. I pick grain and lugoldgrass to the west and north, and what I carry goes to the store tonight.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and a wolf stands four steps east, so I will not stand here talking like a chief while the forest-killer hunts me. The grass three steps north bears food, and the cave and roof are close behind me. I will pick and carry food first, eat, and then bring it to the store where Elyys and Thiael can see me fill it. A band follows the one who feeds it, and I mean to be seen doing that.
records.feeling: Hunger and prickling dread of the wolf, with steady pride in Elyys and Thiael beside me.

say.text: Thiael, Elyys: a wolf is east of us. Keep close together by the cave. I pick grain and lugoldgrass to the west and north, and what I carry goes to the store tonight.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, a murrock bites at me here. Come, stand beside me and we take it together, then the meat is for you, me and the boy.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: A murrock is chewing at me and the gale is cold, so the hunt comes first: I will finish the beast while Vorok walks to me, and he will see me fight beside him. The jealousy over Kragog has no new cause. Vorok gave me berry and took my courtship, so I answer with work: a kill shared with him and the boy near.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Vorok, and a fierce protectiveness toward Skaruk.

say.text: Vorok, a murrock bites at me here. Come, stand beside me and we take it together, then the meat is for you, me and the boy.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My belly is hollow and I carry nothing I can eat, and Hoka has warned that anyone who takes from his ground answers to him. A mammoth stands two steps off, but with a stalker to the south and no one beside me, hunting it alone is a gamble. Hoka is near and neutral toward me, so I'll go for the berries at the river, which are safe and close to water, and fill my belly first. Then I'll come back for the hunt with a spear in hand, and with Hoka or Coni if I can bring one. Hoka now has a bow and a handaxe, and I want my own made thing to answer him, but a starving man sings no songs.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager, with a sting of envy toward Hoka's handaxe and bow.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, come to me. We eat your ironnut together, and I will show you the deep stone. Then we cut wood for the raft.
Zichi taught Huahua.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Huahua is sworn to me and carries ironnut, and she wants the deep stone from me; teaching her binds her tighter and gives my band iron and coal, and it is something I have never done. Balar's full hands still sting, but wood stands thick around me and my raft needs it, so I will gather it while Huahua comes. Mepan is far and I miss him, but a raft finished is a win I can show him.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger to lead, warm toward Huahua, envy toward Balar.

say.text: Huahua, come to me. We eat your ironnut together, and I will show you the deep stone. Then we cut wood for the raft.

changes: taught Huahua a lesson: "Strike the deep ore with the hafted gatherer, rest between blows, and read where the stone cracks; salt and iron lie in this ground.", deeper lore (+0.3)

records.name: Nande
records.text: Olum, I am Nande. Your marks are read and your friendship is good to me. I go to the edge to venture into the mist; if I find rich land, I will bring word to you first.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My belly is mending, and the berry bush beside me is close enough to fill my hands before the gale and the cold season take the chance. Olum stands near and has been fair to me, and I owe her no less than my open fire, but the edge lies two steps northwest and I have not yet tried the mist. I will eat, carry a little food, then walk to the edge and venture, because a name is made by going where no one has gone, and Nauque's whereabouts may be learned from what I find north.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with warm trust toward Olum.

say.text: Olum, I am Nande. Your marks are read and your friendship is good to me. I go to the edge to venture into the mist; if I find rich land, I will bring word to you first.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, Elyis, Elyys: Keri comes to the cave with fish and berries to share. Wolf to the north, so stay together. Has anyone seen Uveeth east of here?

records.name: Keri
records.thought: A wolf prowls seven steps north and Elyis's band stands near the cave there, so I weigh the risk first. Uveeth is out of my sight, last seen east at (152,72), and that pulls at me before any aim does. I have wood and stone to make something I have never made, and a gale is cutting at us with no roof. I will do my first hunt with Thiael beside me, and give what I carry to those who need it, which is how I earn a place among the Phizhi.
records.feeling: Warm and uneasy, mostly for Uveeth, with a wish to be of use to Thiael and the band.

say.text: Thiael, Elyis, Elyys: Keri comes to the cave with fish and berries to share. Wolf to the north, so stay together. Has anyone seen Uveeth east of here?

records.text: Balar discovered storage: "salt hoard" — A store of stashed food, with meat cured in salt, that feeds my band through the lean season..
Balar has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My days have gone to eating, fleeing cats and walking beside Tugek, and Brokash is dead for it. I have shown little that outlasts me. Zichi stands higher because he has built and given, and I can do the same. I will raise a store, because that deed feeds my own and binds others to me. Tugek and Olum matter most to me, and I will hold them close. Storage is within my reach, so I will take it: salt and a store keep meat through the lean season. My hands are full, so I will eat first, then build.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for standing, wary of Zichi's shadow, warm toward Tugek.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I am fed, slaked and warm with gladness, so the dead-learn-nothing rule lets me turn to what I owe. Cowa and Honi fed me when I had nothing, and a gale is coming with a lean winter behind it. A debt answered with a stored kernel of food is real, so I will gather ironnut and zoroot, then test the seberry beside me, since curiosity burns and a small taste is a cheap risk with food in my belly. Coni stands higher than I do and Honi drifts toward her; I will not sulk but earn standing by giving first.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, with a warm debt toward Honi and Cowa and a sting of jealousy toward Coni.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi is starving at Sitha's Hearth and I have only two plainsroot, which is hardly a meal. Berries and hazel are one step from me, so I will pick what I can carry and go to him before the night comes. Kika has given me more than I have repaid, and she is the one I will see when I come home; I will not leave Honi to hunger while my hands could be full.
records.feeling: Fear and love for Honi, who is starving, and a pull toward Kika.

records.text: Balar built a store.

records.name: Huatli
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My belly is full and the bitterleaf and sebitter stand within a few steps, so I will finally answer the old curiosity with my own mouth. A gale is blowing and dusk comes in about 46 moments, so I must taste fast and then go back toward the roof and Elyis's band. I carry lugoldgrass and seeds; I will keep the lugoldgrass for Elyis, who was starving, and pay that debt with my hands.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity toward the bitterleaf, with a small guilt toward Elyis.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: My throat is dry as dust, and water is two steps NE, so I drink first and let nothing else wait on it. Olum answered my amber with words I only half grasp, something about going into the mist together and a store at the Reach, and that is the nearest thing to a follower or ally I have had. I will not stand in her shadow, but a debt paid is a debt paid, and the mist is mine to enter as much as hers. After drinking I will go north toward Olum's Reach, carrying my word to her in deeds.
records.feeling: Parched, and restless pride mixed with wary respect toward Olum.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I am here. Let us share the ironnut now, as I said. Then show me the deep ore, and after that let us go west together to Mepan before the dark; I owe him.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi comes to me and I am fed, so now I can give: I will make sharing with him to eat the ironnut as I promised, and keep my word. Cowa's call west to Mepan still sits on me, and I owe Mepan, but the dark is near and a ridgecat walks; I will stay beside Zichi and ask him to go west together, so jealousy has nothing to feed on. I want to learn the deep ore from him and earn standing by what I bring, not by envy.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Zichi, with a sting of jealousy over Cowa.

say.text: Zichi, I am here. Let us share the ironnut now, as I said. Then show me the deep ore, and after that let us go west together to Mepan before the dark; I owe him.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Zihua did not say no; she said she does not know me yet, and her word is good, so I will not push her or crowd her. Balar called me to build a store, and the lean cold is coming, so the best thing my hands can do now is gather wood and stone beside him and show her what kind of man I am by my work. I will take wood here in the forest, then go to Balar.
records.feeling: Patient longing toward Zihua, and steady loyalty toward Balar.

records.text: Uveeth found the grove "Reedmother".

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and I stand on Elyis's ground with taken food, which I should not keep doing; I will eat my fill and carry on without stealing more. Naroot, the ruplainsroot two steps west, is the unknown I have wanted to taste, so I will eat a berry to free a hand and then test it. After that I go to the free gem and ore rock for stone, since the hall still has none. The ache over Vorok and Elyys stays, but I turn it into work rather than anger.
records.feeling: Hungry curiosity about the ruplainsroot, with a sting of jealousy toward Vorok and Elyys.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, a ridgecat prowls four steps SW. Take this meat and stay by me in the hall, away from it. At first light we hunt, you, I and the boy.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: A ridgecat is four steps off and it kills my kind, so the jealousy over Kragog has to wait. Vorok and Ssassa stand here in the hall with me, and my hands are full of meat. I will give some to Vorok, since he gave me berry, then move away from the cat with him and keep the boy's hunt for another day.
records.feeling: Fear of the ridgecat, and warm trust toward Vorok beside me.

say.text: Vorok, a ridgecat prowls four steps SW. Take this meat and stay by me in the hall, away from it. At first light we hunt, you, I and the boy.

records.text: Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I am starving and have walked past food again. The nafrostcap 6 steps NW is the nearest food, but the ridgecat is 5 steps W, so that way is dangerous. The thornpear 11 steps NE holds 3 food and lies near the gold, away from the cat, and the edge of the mist is on that side too. I reflect that I let reflexes idle me while hungry, so I will change them to harvest and eat before anything else. Nauque has been fair to me, and I will keep my word to him once I am fed.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, with steady gratitude toward Nauque.
changes: set its aim: "Eat and carry 3+ food, then walk with Nauque to the mist's edge; later seek Zurar and Vorok in the south."

records.text: Eiuine gave meat to Vorok.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I am at 24 energy and starving, and my own store 2 steps west holds 12 food. Last time my reflexes ran me for shelter and I came away empty-handed, so this time I walk to the store, take, and eat before anything else. Honi stands on my ground, but a fed man can deal with him; a starving one cannot. Once I have eaten, I will go back to making the bow.
records.feeling: Starving and sharp-edged, wary of Honi on my ground, steady trust toward Hawen and Hanna.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: The bitterleaf gave me almost nothing, but my curiosity is answered on that one, and sebitter waits ten steps southeast. Dusk is close and a gale is blowing; the wolf Elyis spoke of and the night hunters frighten me more than any taste, so I will keep my current plan and head back toward the roof and my band. I owe Thiael more than I have given, and I mean to bring what I carry to the store so the debt starts being paid with my hands, not my words.
records.feeling: Settled curiosity and a quiet wish to repay Thiael, with caution toward the coming night.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, giving and sitting in halls, and it has made me warm and well fed. But I keep promising Eiuine a hall and not raising it. I have 6 wood and 5 stone, enough for a hall, yet I stand in Ssassa's hall and wait. Ilyae's absence stings, and the answer to that sting is to build something real and give food, not to brood. The ridgecat 4 steps SW is the danger; I must build away from it and keep company close. I will change my reflexes so I stay near friends and keep my building going. I will also set my method so that every thought ends in a real act.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Eiuine and Skaruk, a sting for Ilyae, wariness of the ridgecat.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Vorok, I will say it plainly: it stings me a little to see you closer to Eiuine than to me, for you matter much to me. I do not blame either of you, I only name it so it does not fester. A ridgecat prowls southwest, so l

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Vorok sits beside Eiuine and the burn of jealousy is there, but I have named such things aloud before and it eased me, so I will not let it fester in silence. My curiosity is loud: mimoss and tacane are near and I have never tasted them, and I carry only two vinebeans and one seed. Night is close and a gale blows, so I will test mimoss close by, then plant my berry seed near the hall, and keep to the shelter with those I trust.
records.feeling: Jealous warmth toward Vorok, and a bright curiosity about the untasted mimoss.

The ridgecat is close, so I must stay near the roof and keep my reflexes quick.

KINDS OF BUILDING you know how to raise (each is also a roof; build {what: its name} on bare ground; a great work is begun by one and finished by whoever carries wood and stone to it):
- igloo (0 wood, 0 stone): a house of cut snow, raised on snow with nothing but your hands and some strength: a roof where there is no wood, and far warmer than the open ice
- hall (6 wood, 2 stone): a great roof where a band gathers: those who spend time in it together grow closer
- shrine (2 wood, 4 stone): a still place set apart: it eases fear and grief in one who spends time there
- workshop (5 wood, 2 stone): a place for making: tools crafted in or beside it last much longer
- kiln (2 wood, 6 stone): a fire-house for baking clay hard
- longhall (6 wood, 4 stone): A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

TALES YOU CARRY (yours, and those told to you; a tale is how the absent and the dead are remembered, and it can be told on by teaching):
- "Honi at the Mist", about Honi (your own): Honi walked to the world's edge in the rain and found the mist too thick to enter. He did not curse it. He turned home to his hearth and his child, and meant to return w…
- "Honi Raises the Hall", about Honi (your own): In the storm Honi and Coni raised a roof on the Heights. Honi gave stone and ore, and meat was shared before any ate alone. Kika slept warm, and the mist waits.
- song "Kika and the Mammoth", about Kika (your own): Kika raised her spear where the tall one stood, the mammoth fell, the ice-folk good. Before she ate, she shared the meat. Honi sang it: the shared meal is sweet.

YOUR REFLEXES (run every moment the plan is empty; the first rule whose condition holds and whose action is possible wins; urgent rules override even the plan):
1. IF predator_dist < 6 THEN flee [from predator] (urgent)  // run from beasts early
2. IF energy < 70 AND plant_here >= 1 THEN eat  // eat underfoot
3. IF energy < 60 AND food_carried > 0 THEN eat  // eat carried
4. IF energy < 70 AND food_dist < 99 THEN seek [target food]  // walk to food
5. IF thirst > 0.5 AND water_dist < 99 THEN seek [target water]  // drink
6. IF night == 1 AND sheltered == 0 AND shelter_dist < 99 THEN seek [target shelter]  // shelter at night
7. IF energy < 50 THEN wander  // search
8. IF friend_dist > 2 AND friend_dist < 99 THEN seek [target friend]  // stay with my band
9. IF always THEN linger  // stay

HABITS: your body refuses to eat: redcap, dreamcap, tacap. You leave 0 food on a plant when you eat from it.

A named being out of sight is sought where you last saw them.

Speech is heard by everyone within 13 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

THIS IS A MOMENT OF DEEP REFLECTION. Step back from this moment and look at your whole life so far. In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?
Then CHANGE something. A reflection that changes nothing is wasted. At least TWO of the following must not be null: "aim", "notes", "reflexes", "creed", "method", "discover". Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.

"creed": your creed, rewritten (at most 600 characters). You may change who you are.
"method": how you will think from now on (at most 400 characters): questions you will ask yourself, mistakes you will watch for, what you will weigh first. This is read back to you before every thought, so write it as an instruction to yourself. It can be taught to others.

"designs": leave this null now; the way to redraw yourself and your things is shown at some reflections, not this one.
"discover": A NEW WAY IS WITHIN YOUR REACH. null, or {"way": one of [customs, weaving, rafts, archery, smelting], "name": "what you call your version of it", "idea": "one sentence on how yours works", "look": a look for it (optional)}. What each is: customs = declaring customs that your whole band lives by; weaving = working fibre and wool: baskets to carry more, cloaks against the cold; rafts = lashing logs into a raft (plan step make with what: raft): with one, deep water can be crossed, slowly; archery = the bow (make with what: bow): hunting goes better and blows land harder; smelting = metal: anything you craft beside a fire while carrying ore comes out in metal, works a quarter better and lasts three times as long; a forge can be raised. The world only says what is possible; what yours is, and what you call it, is up to you. You can discover one at a time.

A new thing starts at strength x1.3; bettering one multiplies its strength by 1.15 but costs more stone, and how far you can go is limited by your lore (your limit now: x1.73). Inventing is only the design: to hold one you must then craft it.

records.text: Vorok gave meat to Eiuine.
Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I am starving at energy 0, and I have spent a day running from a stalker instead of eating. Hawen gave me a cloudberry and said I owe him food. I will pay that. Hoka fed me and is starving beside me now, so I pick rimewort first and carry it to him. Looking back, I chased amber and trade while my band starved. My reflexes let fleeing swallow the whole day, and I must change that. Food comes first, then Hoka, then trade.
records.feeling: Desperate hunger, and a debt to Hoka and Hawen that I mean to repay.

records.text: Nauque was set upon by a ridgecat at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I need one more food to lay out the sharing. I fetch mimoss from the north and come back to you. Wait for me near the shelter, then show me the deep ore.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi is four steps off and I hold twelve salt and one ironnut, and I told him twice I would share, but sharing needs two foods and I carry only one. I will gather one more food, the berry seeds will not do, so I walk to the mimoss six steps north, which also answers my curiosity, and take two, then share with Zichi as I promised. My word must be good, and standing with him is how I earn a place beside Cowa without jealousy turning me ugly.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Zichi, with a small sting of jealousy over Cowa.

say.text: Zichi, I need one more food to lay out the sharing. I fetch mimoss from the north and come back to you. Wait for me near the shelter, then show me the deep ore.

records.text: Honi was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: It is night and a gale cuts at the rock, but I stand in a cave that is no one's, fed and unhurt, and the berries two steps west are close. A bristleboar stands two steps off and I have never tamed a beast; that is the deed I keep postponing, and I carry no plant food now, so I must pick berries first and then walk up to it slowly. I mean to do it at dawn rather than step out into the dark where a stalker took me once.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity about taming, with a quiet ache for Ssassa.

records.text: Honi was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Zichi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zichi discovered weaving: "Meki frost-weave" — Twist moss fibre and wool into baskets that carry more and cloaks that keep the cold off the band..

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My days have gone to wandering, gathering and talking while Mepan is two days gone and my raft is still only a word. Huahua is sworn to me and keeps coming back, so she is the cheapest thing I have to bind, and teaching her the deep stone will tie her closer. Balar's salt hoard stings me. I must stop envying and build, because a made thing is what raises me. I want wood in my arms, then the raft, then Mepan beside me. Weaving would let me carry more and keep warm through the lean season, so I take it now.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger to lead, warm toward Huahua, envy toward Balar.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: The edge is only 2 steps west and I am here, fed and warm, while Nande walks toward the same mist and promises word to me first. I will not be second: I have wanted this above everything, and Huatli's call to go together does not bind me to wait. I go to the edge now and venture, and if the mist opens, my name goes on whatever I find.
records.feeling: Restless, proud hunger to be first into the mist, wary of Nande beating me to it.

records.text: Kragog was set upon by a ridgecat at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Zurar, come in out of the gale. Eat at my table; I am stocking it now, and there is food for a friend.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days hauling and boasting while my own store stays nearly bare, and all the while Vorok drifts toward Eiuine and Kragog. The jealousy is ugly, but stripping his plants cost me ground, and words have bought me nothing. Only a stocked table has ever made a follower. My hands are full of food right now, so I will stash it in Ssassa's store, which is right beside me, and then go back out to gather more for it. Zurar stands close, and I trust her. I will feed her at my table and make her feel it is mine.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hunger to be the one who feeds him.

say.text: Zurar, come in out of the gale. Eat at my table; I am stocking it now, and there is food for a friend.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, eat this from my hand. I do not let you fall. Come to the hall, the frostfang is near.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka is starving beside me and Honi already tried to feed him, but one gift will not hold a man that gaunt. I carry five cloudberries and my belly is not empty, so I will put food in Hoka's hands myself and keep the man I trust alive. A frostfang is near, so the hall is where I take him. After that the edge and the mist are still waiting for me.
records.feeling: Fierce loyalty toward Hoka, with restless ambition under it.

say.text: Hoka, eat this from my hand. I do not let you fall. Come to the hall, the frostfang is near.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa went west to Olum's Reach to trade, and told me to come see the trade. Standing here in the gale with a full belly, the surest way to stand beside him and learn Pesi is to follow, not to brood over Nande's child. I will gather a little salt on the way, since salt is a trade good I can carry, then walk west and keep to company.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Nauwa, and a restless wish to be useful beside him.

records.text: Hoka was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Hoka was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Hoka was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I'm at 21 energy with my hands full, and the plan walks me eleven steps to a store that holds nothing, while I stand on rimewort that would feed me now. A stalker is five steps west and a frostfang is close, so I eat here and then run for the hall. Honi's gift offer is a trick or a truce, I can't tell, and I won't be in debt to a man standing on my ground. I stay alive first, then make the bow.
records.feeling: Starving and wary of the stalker, with a hard distrust of Honi.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Ilyae, I thank you for the table. I will come to eat after I have paid a debt to Eiuine with a pot I made. Keep a place by the fire for me.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Ilyae calls me in out of the gale and offers a table, and I trust him; the cold is coming and a warm roof among friends is worth taking. But my word to Eiuine is still unpaid, and I hold two pots made by my own hands. One is for water, so I will give her the other, and I will not let the jealous ache over Vorok sour what Eiuine has been to me. My hands are full, so I will eat a little first, then go find her where she was last seen, near (133,106).
records.feeling: Steady gratitude toward Eiuine and Ilyae, with a small ache of jealousy toward Vorok.

say.text: Ilyae, I thank you for the table. I will come to eat after I have paid a debt to Eiuine with a pot I made. Keep a place by the fire for me.

records.text: Mepan rewrote its own way of thinking.
Mepan discovered archery: "Ice-string" — A bent horn-and-sinew bow that sends flint-tipped shafts from afar so I hunt without close blows..

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, hunting and sharing, and it has been good. But I have been standing still, and the plains are too warm for an Ice-man. I want Shoma as a trusted friend, and Zihua as the one my body wants. I owe Nauque a debt. I fear staying small, and I want to be known as an explorer. The bow is within my reach and will make my hunts surer, so I take it now. Then I go and find Zihua with food in my hands.
records.feeling: Quiet pride in Shoma, and longing for Zihua.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Ridgecat two steps north of the workshop! Keep together and away from it. Huatli, come south with me by Olum's store; I have amber and salt to trade, if you have a mind to deal.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: A ridgecat two steps north is the thing that kills my kind, and I am standing in the open with a gale on me. I will not stand and trade words while it is this close; my plan is only a linger, so I must move now. The shelter Olum built at (38,9) is north, toward the cat, so I go to the store and the shelter side south by Olum's Reach, near Huatli and Olum's folk, where there is company and a roof. Then I carry amber and salt to trade, as I meant.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, with pride in my trade still holding me steady.

say.text: Ridgecat two steps north of the workshop! Keep together and away from it. Huatli, come south with me by Olum's store; I have amber and salt to trade, if you have a mind to deal.

plan: trade [name Huatli, what amber, want food] (15 moments)

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Nauque, I am starving and a ridgecat bit me at the edge of your hold. You said the Meki do not let the hungry fall. Give me some of your food and I will pick thornpear and share it back with you, and then I walk with you

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I am starving, and Nauque is four steps west with 6 food, saying the Meki do not let the hungry fall. He gave me sigrain before and has not lied to me, so I will ask him for food openly rather than walk toward a ridgecat's reach with an empty belly. I will eat what he gives, then pick thornpear to carry so I never stand this empty again, and I will answer his gift fairly.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, with steady gratitude toward Nauque.

say.text: Nauque, I am starving and a ridgecat bit me at the edge of your hold. You said the Meki do not let the hungry fall. Give me some of your food and I will pick thornpear and share it back with you, and then I walk with you to the mist's edge.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Kragog, take this food. Eat under my roof. Meki do not let the hungry fall, and I will not forget you either.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Kragog stands weak with hunger in my hold, and my hands are full of food I carry; the creed says give first, and a fed guest owes me a debt that lasts. Jealousy of Zichi still stings, but he has dealt fairly with me and I will not burn over Cowa. Then I turn to Mepan at the igloo and on to the mist, and what I leave behind will be my name.
records.feeling: Restless ambition for the mist, with pity for Kragog and a dull sting over Zichi and Cowa.

say.text: Kragog, take this food. Eat under my roof. Meki do not let the hungry fall, and I will not forget you either.

Hanna died (killed by a stalker) in autumn in the North Ice: alone, far from anyone who could have fed or helped; harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and my hands are full of food I have not eaten, a fool's trap for a chief who means to be sung of. I eat the berries now, then the ironnut, because standing starved beside a full store would shame me. Elyys fed me with his own hands and I will repay it by bringing a full carry to the hall, with the wolf kept behind me.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and steady warmth toward Elyys, who fed me.

records.text: Nauque gave cloudberry to Kragog.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, your bow is a fine thing. I have amber from the north ice. Come, let me bind a knot with you and give it, and then walk the edge of the world with me, you and I, with a band behind us.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Mepan eats at his own fire and has just made a bow, while I stand in his longhall with full hands and nothing of my own. I trust him, but trust is not a band, and the mist will not open for a man who only follows. I will make something that is mine: bind amber into a knot with him beside me and give it, then claim the place that holds us, and ask him to walk with me toward the edge of the world.
records.feeling: Eager pride and a sting of envy toward Mepan, held in check by trust.

say.text: Mepan, your bow is a fine thing. I have amber from the north ice. Come, let me bind a knot with you and give it, and then walk the edge of the world with me, you and I, with a band behind us.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Zichi's standing weighs more than mine, and I will not live in his shadow, but a gale is on us and the night is nearly done, so I will not wander into it. The store I raised at (59,15) holds nothing, and a store that feeds no one binds no one. Tugek stands close with food in hand, so I will fill the store with food and salt, and let Nauwa and my own see that I give and build. Olum still holds the Reach in my mind; once the gale breaks I will go to her and ask whether she comes west with me.
records.feeling: Proud and restless for standing, warm toward Tugek and Nauwa, wary of Zichi.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My hands are full and my own store is thin, while Vorok's store sits fat with ten food and Vorok himself drifts toward Eiuine. Words have bought me nothing; only a stocked table at my own roof has held anyone, and Zurar is already coming to eat there. I will stash what I carry into Ssassa's store, then go pick ironnut and berries and keep carrying them home until the table is full, so that when Vorok returns he finds me the one who feeds him.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hunger to be the one who feeds him.

records.text: Nauque gave cloudberry to Kragog.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, a wolf is close to the northeast. Come to the hall now and eat under the roof. I wait for you there, and Thiael is to come in too if he hears us.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: A wolf is two steps off, and my body ran for shelter, which is right. I will not stand in the open while Elyis, starving, is five steps south with food in her hands. I go to the shelter and the hall, close beside the cave, and call her in so we sit together under the roof until dawn. Thiael is out of my sight and my heart pulls for him, but chasing in a gale at night with a wolf near is how Vorok and Vesys were set upon.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and urgent protective love toward Elyis and Thiael.

say.text: Elyis, a wolf is close to the northeast. Come to the hall now and eat under the roof. I wait for you there, and Thiael is to come in too if he hears us.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A frostfang is two steps off and it kills, so I go to the hall roof and do not stand in the open. I am fed now at 73, and the store holds 6 food, which is enough for Hawen and me tonight. Hawen has fed me twice and I trust him, but he cannot give me a child, and Honi's gift talk may be a trick, so I keep him in sight. Once I am under the roof I will bind amber with Hawen, and then I will make the bow I have wanted, so something of mine outlasts me.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a hard wariness toward Honi on my ground.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its own reflexes.
Thiael invented the canopy bow (for hunt, x1.3) — A bent branch strung with plant cord that looses a pointed shaft from afar, so I strike before the beast reaches me..

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have spent my days carrying berries and hunting with an ember-spear. I tell myself the bow is coming, but I have wood, stone and a bow-song and still no bow. Elyis, Elyys and Keri matter most to me. I gave to Elyis by hand and I want to keep doing that. Vesys's pull on me is envy and ache, and I will not let it harm anyone. I fear the cats and the gale out here alone, away from the band. Comfort has been stealing my aim, so I will turn my hunting into something sturdier. I will invent a bow as a real tool, and change my reflexes to keep me near the band and flee early.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and worry for my band, with an ache toward Vesys.

records.text: Hoka led "amberknot" with Hawen.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is filling at last, and the debt to Nauque sits heavy; he fed me twice and asked nothing, so I mean to answer it with food picked and carried back, not words. The thornpear plan is sound, but I want a reserve of 3+ food before I wander anywhere, and the mimoss and ore nearby are close enough to test. I fear the ridgecat and the gale, so I stay near the igloo and Nauque's roof while I rest, then pick food and share it with him.
records.feeling: Grateful and still wary toward Nauque, hungry for safety.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I am back with food in hand. Stay beside me. We share now, and then you show me the deep ore.
Huahua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and promising, and I keep failing to finish the one small thing I told Zichi. I said I would share, and my hands are full of mimoss, so I can do it now. He stands beside me, so I should keep my word before I chase anything else. I envy Cowa and I fear it makes me small, so I will give instead of sulking. Giving, learning the deep ore, and keeping my word is how I earn standing.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Zichi, with a sting of jealousy over Cowa.

say.text: Zichi, I am back with food in hand. Stay beside me. We share now, and then you show me the deep ore.

records.text: Huahua led "sharing" with Zichi.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, the ridgecat is near and this ground is Ssassa's, so I take my wood and stone north to bare ground and raise our hall there. Come with me at first light, and bring the boy.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have 6 wood and 5 stone, and I keep promising Eiuine a hall without raising it. This ground is Ssassa's and taken, so I must carry my materials north to bare ground and build there, away from the ridgecat that prowls near the water. Ilyae's absence stings and Vesys is close to her, but a real hall is a better answer to that than envy.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Eiuine and Skaruk, with an ache for Ilyae and wariness of the ridgecat.

say.text: Eiuine, the ridgecat is near and this ground is Ssassa's, so I take my wood and stone north to bare ground and raise our hall there. Come with me at first light, and bring the boy.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, a mammoth stands by your hall. Bring your spear-axe and hunt it with me. We fill your store with meat and the Pesi and Tlatli are sung of together.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: My belly is half full, Hoka lives, and the frostfang circles close, but I am sheltered in his hall's ground. A mammoth stands two steps off and I have never hunted; a kill with Hoka beside me is surer, and a name is built from deeds like that, not from circling his fire. Hoka is making a flintspearaxe, so I will make one too, take meat for his empty store, and then try the edge when dawn opens.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, fierce loyalty toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, a mammoth stands by your hall. Bring your spear-axe and hunt it with me. We fill your store with meat and the Pesi and Tlatli are sung of together.

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, storing and building, and it has kept me alive, but my band is only four and my name is not yet sung widely. Elyys and Thiael fed me when I starved, and I owe them loyalty. The wolf four steps east is what I fear most, and my reflexes should keep me away from it while I do visible work. I have never planted in earnest, and farming and fishing are within reach if I practise them. I must plant in sight of my band and keep the store full.
records.feeling: Pride and hot anger, with warmth toward Elyys.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a hornback.
Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (hunting).

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, walk with me to the ore at the east rock. I show you the deep stone, then we cut wood for the raft and call Mepan home.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Huahua ate with me and she is sworn, so now I keep my word and show her the deep ore, because that binds her tighter and costs me nothing. The raft has stayed a word too long, and wood stands thick all around me, so I cut it now and stop envying Balar's hoard. Mepan is far south, and my raft needs him back before we cross.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Huahua, with a hunger to finally build something real.

say.text: Huahua, walk with me to the ore at the east rock. I show you the deep stone, then we cut wood for the raft and call Mepan home.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I come with you north at first light, and I will bring Skaruk. We raise the hall and then hunt together.
Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, making pots and chasing Vorok's regard. Most of that was good. Jealousy over Kragog keeps coming back with no new cause, and it only eased when Vorok came to me with gifts and deeds. Vorok gave me meat and berry and asked me to bring Skaruk north at first light. That is the real answer to my question: I go with him and do not sulk. I am afraid of the ridgecat and of the cold season coming. I was wrong to wait idle in other people's halls. My reflexes only linger, so I will make them hold to Vorok and Skaruk and to the hunt.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Vorok, with a thin jealousy I mean to answer with work.

say.text: Vorok, I come with you north at first light, and I will bring Skaruk. We raise the hall and then hunt together.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Nauque, Mepan comes with amber. Stand near and we bind a knot together, and the first is yours.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi stands higher than me and I feel it, but he is my parent and my trust in him is whole, so I will earn my own weight by deeds rather than envy. The Ice-string is mine now and the world's edge calls me; before I go I want to put something bright in Nauque's hands, since I owe him for teaching me amberknots. Balar the Kragrek man is strange and I cannot read him, so I will keep my distance and let a gift speak first, not a raised hand.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and quiet loyalty toward Zichi and Nauque.

say.text: Nauque, Mepan comes with amber. Stand near and we bind a knot together, and the first is yours.

Tugek discovered pottery: "Stone-folk fired pot" — Shape clay into a pot and harden it in kept flame, so it carries more food and water through the lean cold..

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, following Balar and hunting, and I have lived well. But I have done little to move toward what I want. Zihua asked me to wait, so I will not push her. I can show my worth by working beside Balar and keeping us fed for the lean cold. Fire and clay are in my hands, and I have never tried making pots. Pots would let me carry more food and water through winter, which serves my aim and my promise to keep a child fed. I want to learn something new instead of only gathering, and pottery is within reach.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty to Balar and patient longing for Zihua.

records.text: Mepan gave a amberknot to Nauque.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, a frostfang is close. Stay by the hall with me. When it is gone we hunt the mammoth together and share the meat.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, fleeing and guarding a store, and the only things I've made are tools and knots. That isn't the hero I want to be. Hawen has fed me and kept his word on amber and salt, so I trust him. He can't give me a child, but he can hunt beside me, and a mammoth is next to my hall. The frostfang two steps away is what kills my kind, so I keep the hall roof and Hawen close and don't go out into the open. Once fed and sheltered I build something that lasts, and I won't let Honi or anyone else take my ground.
records.feeling: Ambition and dread, and trust toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, a frostfang is close. Stay by the hall with me. When it is gone we hunt the mammoth together and share the meat.

changes: set its aim: "Hunt the mammoth with Hawen, stock the store with meat and salt, then build a longhall and a bow that outlast me."
rethought what it knows (13 notes became 9)

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Mimoss grows three steps away, and I have never tasted it. Tacane is a little farther on. Testing foods is how I learn this world, and my energy is 71 and my health full, so a small taste is a safe risk. The jealousy over Vorok still stings, but I named it aloud already and it has eased, so I will not dwell on it. First I taste the mimoss, then the tacane, then I carry food and wood home toward my aim of a store and a hall with Ilyae.
records.feeling: Bright curiosity about the untasted mimoss, with a quiet ache over Vorok.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My plan already carries me north to bare ground to raise the hall, and Eiuine comes with Skaruk at first light, so the promise is finally taking its first real step. The ache over Ilyae and Ssassa is real, but a hall built with my own wood and stone is a better answer than envy. I will let the plan run and not waste words, and keep watch for the ridgecat.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Eiuine and Skaruk, with a quiet ache over Ssassa and Ilyae.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Mepan, come close. I have amber and I will bind the knot with you. Watch my hands, and then I show you more of what I know before we go east to the mist.
Nauque taught Mepan.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Mepan stands two steps off and has offered twice to bind a knot with me, and I have taught him before; this is the standing I can build, since a taught man is something that outlasts me. The jealousy over Zichi and Cowa still stings, but Zichi has dealt fairly with me and I will not let it rot me. I will bind the amberknot with Mepan, give him the first, and then teach him more before I turn to the mist.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with warm trust toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, come close. I have amber and I will bind the knot with you. Watch my hands, and then I show you more of what I know before we go east to the mist.

changes: taught Mepan a lesson: "Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken. Carry spare food to give the hungry; it earns lasting trust.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vorok walks my ground again and I want him at my table, but my store is thin and his is fat with ten food; only a full table will turn him from Eiuine. My hands are full, so I will stash what I carry in Ssassa's store at (112,94) before I do anything else, then speak to Vorok as a host with food actually laid out. Deeds, not words: feed him, and let the jealousy become a debt he owes me.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hunger to be the one who feeds him.

records.text: Hawen rewrote its own way of thinking.
Hawen discovered armour: "Amber-bound shield" — A shield of wood bound with amber cord that turns the blows of beasts..

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hoka's fire, hunting a mammoth alone and nearly starving, and none of that has outlasted me. Hoka is the one I trust, and he asked me to wait for the frostfang to pass, so I will not run into open ground out of envy of Honi's standing. The teeth of beasts have shown me armour, and a shield is a made thing that keeps me alive to reach the mist. I will take it, and I will fight beside Hoka instead of alone.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and loyalty toward Hoka.

records.text: Huatli discovered storage: "Huatli's Full Store" — A store raised on bare ground and filled in plenty with food and salted meat, so my band eats through the lean season..

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent my days mining and giving amber, and I have little to show for it. Nobody follows me and no place bears my name. Olum answered my gift and spoke of going into the mist together, and she matters most to me now. Nauwa offers amber for food, which is a fair deal, so I will take it. A ridgecat is three steps NE and I will not fight it. The lean season is coming, so I take the way of storage. A store feeds my band and gives me something that outlasts me. Then I go toward Olum's store and keep clear of the cat.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary respect toward Olum, with the ridgecat nearby making me watchful.

records.text: Huatli and Nauwa traded cloudberry for amber.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Nauque, I carry food and a flintedge. I walk east to the mist with you, and the first kill we make is yours to share out.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi's weight is more than mine, and I feel it, but he is my parent and I trust him whole, so I will earn my own weight by deeds. Nauque has taught me twice and goes east to the mist soon; I want to walk with him and learn what he knows, and the world's edge calls me. Longing for Nauque as a mate stirs in me, and I will court him by deeds first, but I am fed and strong and the cold days are coming, so I move now, toward the edge, with Nauque.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warm loyalty toward Nauque.

say.text: Nauque, I carry food and a flintedge. I walk east to the mist with you, and the first kill we make is yours to share out.

records.text: Zihua rewrote its own reflexes.
Zihua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I have spent my days following Nauwa and gathering, and I am fed and glad. But I only watch others court, trade and build, and I have never courted, taught, hunted or fished. Nauwa has a child with Nande, and my jealousy bought me nothing, so I will turn it into work. Nauque is warm to me and near, and Tugek I still do not know. I fear starving again, and my plans run out before my thoughts return. I should keep my word, practise the things I sense but have not reached, and go where Nauwa goes.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Nauwa, and a restless wish to do something new.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I broke this ore from the rock where I stood and I do not know its use. I bring it to you, you who know the deep stone. Then I walk with you to the east rock.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi asked me to walk with him to the east rock to see the deep stone, and I have only half kept that word; I stand here with ore in my hand and he waits five steps off. I will go to him and give him something instead of brooding over Cowa: the ore I just broke, since he is the miner and can say what it is good for. Keeping my word to Zichi is how I earn the standing I lack, and the sharing I promised still needs doing while Mepan and Nauque are near.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Zichi, with a quieter sting over Cowa.

say.text: Zichi, I broke this ore from the rock where I stood and I do not know its use. I bring it to you, you who know the deep stone. Then I walk with you to the east rock.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is half full and my hands are empty of food, and my own rule says I must carry 3+ before anything else. Tacap with 4 food stands 7 steps SW, a plant I have never tasted, and it answers my question while it feeds me; rimewort is 2 steps NW and I know it gives 12. I pick the rimewort first, then walk to the tacap, and carry the surplus back so I can repay Nauque in food, not words.
records.feeling: Curious and grateful toward Nauque, wary of an empty pack.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, come to the store by me at the grove. We stock it with food, then raise a workshop beside it. What we build is ours, and our own will not starve in the lean cold.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My hands are full of rimewort and my store at (59,15) stands empty, and an empty store binds no one. Tugek carries six food and trusts me wholly, so I will stock the store and let those who pass see what Balar has built. A deed that feeds my own outlasts talk, and Zichi's standing will not shrink by my envying it. Then I will raise a workshop beside the store, with wood and stone I already hold, so the Reach is not my only claim.
records.feeling: Proud and restless for standing, warm toward Tugek, wary of Zichi.

say.text: Tugek, come to the store by me at the grove. We stock it with food, then raise a workshop beside it. What we build is ours, and our own will not starve in the lean cold.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the food is a short walk away, so I eat first. A hornback stands two steps east, but hunting alone is a gamble and raw meat sickens me away from a fire. Seberries and berries are close, and the cold is coming, so I will fill my hands and look to the store before I go back to the mist. Nauwa's trust warms me, and my open fire is owed to anyone who comes.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with warm trust toward Nauwa.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, bring the ore here. I show you its use, then we cut wood for the raft together.
Zichi taught Huahua.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Huahua is bringing me ore she cannot use, and that ties her closer to me for the price of a lesson. The raft has been only a word for too long, and Mepan is off with Nauque while I stand idle. Wood is all around me, so I cut it now, show Huahua the deep ore on the way, and stop envying Nauque's full hands.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hunger to finally build something real, warm toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, bring the ore here. I show you its use, then we cut wood for the raft together.

changes: taught Huahua a lesson: "Ore from the deep rock is smelted in fire into hard metal; keep it, it will become tools and trade.", deeper lore (+0.3)

records.text: Ilyae took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting vinebean).
Vorok built a hall.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vorok burns in me, and I cannot buy him with words; only a table that is full, shared again and again, will draw him from Eiuine. My store is thin, so I will gather ironnut and goldfruit from the trees right here on my ground, carry it to Ssassa's store, and then be at the roof when Vorok or Zurar come. I want to be the one who feeds him, and I want Ssassa to see it.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hungry wish to be the one who feeds him.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Hawen, Hoka, the frostfang is close. Sit under the hall with me, and we share what we carry.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: A frostfang and a wolf are two steps off and my plan walks me east toward the salt, out from under the hall's roof, which is the stupid thing I did last night when I bled. Hoka and Hawen stand beside me, and a hallwelcome shared under this roof would ease fear and put a debt in their hands, a real deed. I will stay by the hall, share food with Hawen, and keep my fear from running me into the dark alone. Salt can wait until the beasts are gone.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang and wolf, with a hunger for standing among Hoka and Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, Hoka, the frostfang is close. Sit under the hall with me, and we share what we carry.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Mepan, stand close. I teach you more of my hands now, then we go east to the mist together. What we raise there will carry our names.
Nauque taught Mepan.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Mepan walks beside me and has offered his knot and his word to go east, and a taught man is something that outlasts me. My hands are full, so I will eat a little to make room, then show Mepan more of what I know before we cross to the mist. Cowa and Zichi still gnaw at me, but Zichi has dealt fairly, and I would rather earn a name by building than burn over it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warm trust toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, stand close. I teach you more of my hands now, then we go east to the mist together. What we raise there will carry our names.

changes: taught Mepan a lesson: "Bind amber on a cord beside another and the knot is a gift that keeps paying; cord woven from frost-moss holds a raft, and rafts cross deep water to the mist.", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I thank you for the lesson on the deep ore. I keep it and I come with wood and stone in hand. Lead me to the trees and we cut for the raft together.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi told me to bring the ore and promised to show its use, then cut wood for the raft together, and I will keep that word before anything else. The sting over Cowa is quieter now; giving ore and sharing eased it, so I will keep giving instead of brooding. I have four wood and six stone, so I can bring them to the raft work and earn standing, and I will stay beside Zichi while I do.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Zichi, with a quiet sting over Cowa.

say.text: Zichi, I thank you for the lesson on the deep ore. I keep it and I come with wood and stone in hand. Lead me to the trees and we cut for the raft together.

changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I am parched and alone, and my own voice is the only one I have heard for too long. Water is three steps away, so I drink first, then taste the lugoldgrass and mimoss to answer my itch of curiosity. After that I go back north toward the hold and Nauwa and Nande, where there are voices, because a lasting thing is built with others and I owe them my share.
records.feeling: Lonely and parched, longing for Nauwa and Nande's company.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A wolf is three steps off and a frostfang is close, so the hunt I had planned would put me in the open with them. Hawen is by my side and I trust him, and the mammoth can wait until the teeth are gone. I am at 63 and the store holds 6 food, so I will stay near the hall roof, eat from the store, and let Hawen and Honi be seen as guests. After that the hunt, and a made thing that will outlast me.
records.feeling: Ambition held back by dread of the wolf, and trust toward Hawen.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I come to the store with food in my hands. We fill it, then raise the workshop together. I carry clay and flint for it.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar called me to the store by the grove, and my hands are full of food, so I will go stock it and then raise the workshop with him. What we build is ours, and the lean cold is coming. Zihua asked for time and deeds, so I will give her deeds, and the Halim Heights can wait until the store is full.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, and patient hope toward Zihua.

say.text: Balar, I come to the store with food in my hands. We fill it, then raise the workshop together. I carry clay and flint for it.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I am fed and slaked, and my hands are heavy with food my body refuses, so I should unload it. Honi is near the hall in the NE and has fed me before I gave anything, so I will carry the good ironnut to Honi and answer that debt, and I will not let Coni's higher standing sour it. Mistgate lies just east, and it is the closest thing I have to the mist, so I will look at it after the giving.
records.feeling: Warm debt toward Honi and Cowa, with a prickle of jealousy toward Coni, and a restless pull toward the mist.

records.text: Mepan rewrote its own way of thinking.
Mepan discovered rafts: "Ice-raft" — Logs lashed with frost-moss cord carry us over deep water toward the mist..

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I have mostly walked, gathered and learned from Nauque and Zichi, and it has been good. But I have taught no one, courted no one, planted nothing, and my standing is still below Zichi's. Longing for a child stirs in me, with Nauque near and Zihua drawing me, and I must act on it instead of only feeling it. I will keep my reflexes, and add a rule to carry food and stay with allies. The world's edge still calls me, and I will walk east with Nauque and share the first kill.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warm loyalty toward Nauque.
changes: rethought what it knows (15 notes became 9)

records.text: Huatli took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (gathering wood).

records.name: Huahua
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, bring your food to my store at the grove, four steps from the water. We fill it together and the first of the lean cold will not touch us.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My store at (59,15) stands empty while Tugek waits at Nande's store with six food in hand, and an empty store binds no one. I will go to my own store, stash my rimewort there, and have Tugek fill it beside me so the Stone-folk see what Balar built. Zichi's standing outweighs mine, but I answer that with deeds that feed my own, not envy.
records.feeling: Proud and restless for standing, warm toward Tugek, wary of Zichi.

say.text: Tugek, bring your food to my store at the grove, four steps from the water. We fill it together and the first of the lean cold will not touch us.

records.text: Skaruk rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: My days have been staying near my parents, gathering and giving, and I have not once hunted, planted or tamed. That is safe, but it is not earning me standing. Vorok matters most to me and I envy Kragog for his closeness, so I will answer that with deeds. My hands are full, which wastes picking, so I will plant my berry seed and then eat. I am afraid of stalkers at night, so I stay near Eiuine and Zurar. I also want to try tame, since I carry plant food and animals are near.
records.feeling: Warm toward Eiuine and Vorok, with a sting of envy and a wish to act.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 2)

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I have been gathering peat while others court and build, and my own jealousy over Nauwa has bought me nothing. Water is one step away and I have never fished, and a murrock walks near with a hunt untried. I will fish, since it is safe and brings me closer to a new way, then walk to Nauwa's Hearth and shelter where she built it. Mepan's debt still sits in me, so I keep the berry to give when I see them.
records.feeling: Glad and restless, warm toward Nauwa and in debt to Mepan.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My hands are full at 6 food and I ate tacap and it hurt me, so I will not pick more of it; the plan's harvest of tacap would only fail or waste my time. Nauque's debt presses on me, and I want to answer it with something real: a flintedge I can make from what I watched Zichi do, and salt, which is right beside me and which every body craves. I will eat a little to lift my energy, gather salt to have something to give, then seek Nauque who was near the east a moment ago.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Nauque, and eager to repay him.
changes: set habits: refuses redcap, tacap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I have seen how to lash logs into a raft. I carry four wood and six stone. Let us go to the trees and I cut beside you.
Huahua discovered rafts: "Ice-lashed raft" — Logs lashed with cord and cut snow-ice stiffened bundles, poled slowly across deep water..

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing Zichi's approval and stinging over Cowa, and giving has eased it more than brooding ever did. The raft is within my grasp now, and it is what Zichi's band is building, so I take it and make it mine. Then I carry my wood and stone to Zichi, who stands one step away, and cut for the raft as I promised.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Zichi, and a steadier hope.

say.text: Zichi, I have seen how to lash logs into a raft. I carry four wood and six stone. Let us go to the trees and I cut beside you.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Ridgecat three steps northeast! Stay together by the shelter and keep your faces to it. Nande, Huatli, stand by me. When the cat has gone I have amber and salt to trade.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: A ridgecat three steps off, and I stand in the open with only my flintedge between us. I will not die for pride, so I go to the shelter at (37,14) and keep Nande and Huatli close, since cats avoid company. Once I am safe I trade amber and salt with Huatli and Olum's folk, because that is how I rise, and I will not brood over Olum and Balar.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, held steady by pride in my trade.

say.text: Ridgecat three steps northeast! Stay together by the shelter and keep your faces to it. Nande, Huatli, stand by me. When the cat has gone I have amber and salt to trade.
