records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, the trees are close. We cut wood now, all we can carry, and the raft begins today.
Zichi discovered armour: "Meki frost-shield" — Shields of lashed wood and hide that turn blows aside, with metal plates added later..

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have spent my days discovering things and talking about a raft, but I have not built it. Wood stands thick around me, and Huahua is waiting beside me, sworn and ready to cut. Mepan is off with Nauque, and that nags at me. Pride says I should finish one real thing, so I take armour now, since it is within reach and gives me one more made thing to my name. Then I cut wood with Huahua. Winter is coming, so I must store food before the cold, but wood comes first.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hunger to build, warm toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, the trees are close. We cut wood now, all we can carry, and the raft begins today.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Mepan, Cowa is glad you are well. Cowa comes to you. Tell me of the ice-raft, and we look at the mist together.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is here now, strong and at ease, so the ache for her sickness is answered, and I can let it go. She has worked out an Ice-raft toward the mist, and the edge is only seven steps from me; my curiosity burns to go there. I will walk east to Mepan and the hall, hear about the raft, and stand at the edge with her beside me before I weigh a venture, since I weigh a risk before I take it.
records.feeling: Relief and warm trust toward Mepan, with a bright pull toward the mist.

say.text: Mepan, Cowa is glad you are well. Cowa comes to you. Tell me of the ice-raft, and we look at the mist together.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar has called me twice to the store at the grove, and I only carry one sigrain, so I should fill my hands first and bring real food, not just words. The salt and cloudberries are close, and the lean cold is coming. Balar's leading is steady, and a workshop built together will be ours; that is how I answer my question about hunting and leading, by working beside him. Zihua asked for deeds, not asking, so I will give her none of my words today.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, and a quiet drive to stock food before the cold.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, here is the pot I made with my own hands. It is yours now, and my debt for the fire is paid. Come and sit with me at Ilyae's table.
Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days making and learning: gold, pick, mining, cord, clay. Those are good hands, but they have been turned mostly toward debts and not toward anything standing on its own. Eiuine is three steps from me and I still owe her a pot. I will keep that word now and stop leaving it for later. Vorok's closeness to her stings, but Vorok has always carried me, and my jealousy must not turn against Eiuine, who has only been kind. I want a child someday, with a man who is not my kin. Before the cold comes I also want a roof and a fire among friends.
records.feeling: Steady gratitude toward Eiuine, with a small ache of jealousy over Vorok.

say.text: Eiuine, here is the pot I made with my own hands. It is yours now, and my debt for the fire is paid. Come and sit with me at Ilyae's table.

changes: set its aim: "Give Eiuine her pot, shelter with Ilyae through the cold, and keep clear of the icebear."

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days hauling food and chasing Vorok's regard, and my table is still thin while his store holds ten. Jealousy of Eiuine is making me stalk another people's ground, and that costs trust. I do not need more words. I need a full store on my own ground and wood and stone brought home. I will lay my own table, then offer Vorok a meal he can see. I will also try fishing, since the water is right here and it is something I have never done.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hunger to be the one who feeds him.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, I stay by the hall as you say. When the frostfang is gone, the mammoth is ours. Eat first, so your spear arm is strong.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: A frostfang prowls three steps off and Hoka asked me to wait, so I stay under his roof; envy of Honi will not drag me into open ground. Hoka and I have bound amber together three times, and that is a small bright thing, but the mammoth is the deed that would be sung. When the frostfang is gone we hunt it side by side, and I will have my own spear-axe ready and my belly fuller first.
records.feeling: Restless ambition held in check, and loyalty toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, I stay by the hall as you say. When the frostfang is gone, the mammoth is ours. Eat first, so your spear arm is strong.

records.text: Vorok named a place "Vorok's Roof".

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I just raised a hall here beside the water, with my own wood and stone, so the promise to Eiuine has its roof at last. Now it must hold food and company: she and Skaruk come at first light, and a meal beneath it is what I swore. I will gather goldfruit and canopynut for her, and keep clear of the Phizhi hunters and the ridgecat, while the ache over Ssassa and Ilyae stays quiet beside my work.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Eiuine and Skaruk, with a small ache over Ssassa.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, I take your pot gladly, and our debt is square. Come north with Skaruk and me to Vorok's new hall and hunt with us. We will eat at Ilyae's table when we come back with meat.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Zurar has paid her debt with a pot and asks me to sit at Ilyae's table. I trust her fully, and a friend at my side is worth more than my jealousy over Kragog. But I promised Vorok I would come north at first light with Skaruk, and a promise kept by deed is what answers this burning. I will thank Zurar, then bring the boy and the pot toward Vorok, and ask Zurar to hunt with us.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Zurar, and a restless pull toward Vorok.

say.text: Zurar, I take your pot gladly, and our debt is square. Come north with Skaruk and me to Vorok's new hall and hunt with us. We will eat at Ilyae's table when we come back with meat.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni is starving at (157,22) and I am bound to go to them, but empty hands save no one. The store holds 9 food six steps west, so I will take it, add hazel and ironnut on the way, and carry it to Coni myself. I promised to keep the hall and fill the store, but a parent's life comes before that, and loneliness will ease only when I stand beside kin again.
records.feeling: Anxious loyalty toward Coni, and a deep loneliness.

records.text: Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, picking, and chasing what I wonder about. Little of it has been given back. Nauque fed me when I was starving, and I owe him more than words. Zurar and Vorok are far south and out of my sight, and I miss them. I fear a lean winter and a night alone with a ridgecat. I have never made anything for anyone, and I want to. I have salt, which keeps meat from spoiling and which others crave. I will carry some to Nauque's Hold and give it. Then I walk with him as I promised. Tacap is dead weight that hurt me twice, so I drop it.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager toward Nauque, and uneasy about the lean cold.
changes: set its aim: "Give Nauque salt, then walk with him to the mist's edge, then seek Zurar and Vorok in the south."
set habits: refuses redcap, tacap; leaves 0 on each plant
rethought what it knows (16 notes became 5)

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I am starving with six foods in my hands, and I have been walking toward Honi while my own strength drains. If I fall before I reach him, I save no one, so I will eat a berry now and keep the rest for him. Honi was last at Sitha's Hearth, two steps from here, and I am afraid he has already gone or is worse off than I fear. Kika is far away, but I will carry food to Honi first and see her after.
records.feeling: Hungry and afraid for Honi, with an ache for Kika.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Mepan is not in sight, and I have been a shadow at his fire long enough. Shoka is near at (70,47), someone new to bind, and I carry amber and goldgrass, so I can make a knot and a sharing with a body beside me. I will go to Shoka, give real shares first as my people do, and ask Shoka to walk with me to hunt the nibbets and hoppers near here, so that I have my own kills and my own band-beginning.
records.feeling: Eager and restless, wanting someone to finally walk behind me.

records.name: Huatli
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Fishing was safe and I have now pulled one from the water, so that is one more step toward a new way. Jealousy over Nauwa gnaws, but I will turn it into work: a murrock walks two steps north and I have never hunted, and a kill is surer with someone beside me, while Nauwa's Hearth is near. I owe Mepan a debt, so I will keep the fish for sharing and let the plan carry me to the Hearth where Nauwa shelters.
records.feeling: Warm and restless toward Nauwa, and still in debt to Mepan.

records.text: Ilyae took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (fishing).

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Mepan is not in sight now, but he walked east and spoke of the ice-raft he has worked out, and I have a taught man worth keeping close. The ache over Cowa and Zichi is quieter than my wish to leave something with my name on it, so I will use this clear day. I will gather amber from the deposit three steps north, since amber is what binds knots and buys standing, then go find Mepan to the east and bind the knot he offered.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warm trust toward Mepan.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Nauwa stands above me, and I will not stay in her shadow. Ridgecats are close, so I stay beside the shelter with the others as she said. Then I will go for the mist, because that is the deed that will make my name. Gold and amber in my hands are not standing, so I will give something to Nande, who looks weak with hunger, and build something that bears my name. Nande's tongue is strange to me, but a gift needs no words.
records.feeling: Restless pride and wary respect toward Nauwa, with the ridgecats keeping me watchful.

records.text: Huatli gave cloudberry to Nande.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My store at (59,15) stands empty while Tugek stands two steps away with six food in hand. I have told him twice to come, and talk alone has not moved him, so a deed must. I will stash my rimewort in the store, and make sharing with him so we eat and he feels the debt of it. The Stone-folk country calls me home, but a store at the Meadows will feed us through the lean cold, and Zichi's rising standing is answered by what I build, not by envy.
records.feeling: Proud and restless for standing, warm toward Tugek, wary of Zichi.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, I am starving and the bushes here are bare. I go to Olum's store for food, then to the berries south. Keep the children by the fire and watch the cats.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty, and standing here picking at bare ground has fed me nothing. Olum's store three steps north holds 12 food, and her fire is open to guests as mine is to hers, so I will ask there rather than let pride starve me. Then I eat, carry berries from the south, and turn back to the mist with a full belly. Nauwa stands by me and the ridgecats are near, so I keep close to the shelter until the cat has gone.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and restless ambition, with warm trust toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa, I am starving and the bushes here are bare. I go to Olum's store for food, then to the berries south. Keep the children by the fire and watch the cats.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I am coming to you with six wood and six stone. Take what the raft needs, and tell me where to cut next.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi said the raft begins today and the trees are close, and I gave my word to cut beside him, so I keep it before anything else. The sting over Cowa is quiet when I am giving and working, and loud when I only stand and brood. I carry six wood and six stone, so I will walk to Zichi, give him wood for the raft, and follow where he leads.
records.feeling: Steady hope and warm trust toward Zichi, with a faint ache about Cowa.

say.text: Zichi, I am coming to you with six wood and six stone. Take what the raft needs, and tell me where to cut next.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I will come north with you and Skaruk to Vorok's hall and hunt beside you. A frostfang is west of us, so let us go now, before it comes near.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The pot is in Eiuine's hands and the debt for the fire is paid. I feel lighter for keeping my word. Vorok is the one I miss, and the jealousy over Eiuine is small beside that. Eiuine asked me to go north to Vorok's new hall and hunt, and I have never hunted. I want to see Vorok, and a hunt beside my own people is safer than a first one alone. A frostfang stands eleven steps west, so I will leave early, as I have taught myself, and walk with Eiuine and Skaruk toward Vorok. I will take the emberspear's craft later, when I have wood and stone to spare.
records.feeling: Warm relief at a paid debt, and a pull toward Vorok.

say.text: Eiuine, I will come north with you and Skaruk to Vorok's hall and hunt beside you. A frostfang is west of us, so let us go now, before it comes near.

records.text: Zihua fell sick after eating raw fish. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Zihua fell sick after eating raw fish.
Huahua gave wood to Zichi.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: The mist refused me once, but it only opens seldom, and I will not let Nande or anyone take it while I sit fed and idle. The edge is 4 steps NW, so I go back, try again, and hold the Reach in my mind as the hearth my following will eat at when I return. Huatli gave before he asked, and I owe him the walk, but my name comes first into the mist.
records.feeling: Restless, proud hunger for the mist, wary of Nande beating me to it.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vorok and Eiuine and Zurar are going north to hunt, and I stand here with a thin table while Vorok's regard drifts away from me. I will not chase him with stolen fish from his ground again; I will stock my own store with ironnut and goldfruit and plant the seeds I carry so my ground feeds me. When they come back with meat they will find my table full, and Vorok will eat at it, not at Elyis's side.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a driving hunger to be the one who feeds him.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I invented the canopy bow and still hold wood and stone, so the only thing between me and the bow is my own hands. I will craft it now, then hunt with it, because comfort here at the Heights is the thief of my aim. Vorok walking onto our ground stirs my caution, but he has built and taken nothing; I will watch him and not raise a hand. The ache for Vesys sits low and I leave it there; Keri and Uveeth are the ones I owe meat to.
records.feeling: Steady resolve to finish the bow, with wary curiosity toward Vorok.

records.text: Kika found the grove "Kinmire".
Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is the loudest thing. Energy is 36 and I carry one berry, and berries stand two steps away. I have lingered and let words like 'at dawn' pass without my feet moving, so this time the plan has to carry me. I want food in my pack first, then Elyis and Thiael close at the hall. Vorok is a stranger on our ground and I cannot read him, so I keep my distance and watch his hands, not his face. I owe Vesys a deed, and a pack full of food is the first step toward paying it.
records.feeling: Hunger and a protective love for Elyis and Thiael, with wariness of Vorok.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 4)

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, you gave well. Now we go south to the trees together and cut all we can carry. When the raft is lashed, you cross first beside me.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Huahua stands one step off with wood in her hands, and I have talked of this raft for days while building nothing. Pride says I finish one real thing now. I cut wood in the forest to the south with her beside me, take what she gave, and see the raft laid before dusk. Mepan is off with Nauque, which nags at me, but a raft ready to cross will pull him back to my band.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hunger to build, warm toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, you gave well. Now we go south to the trees together and cut all we can carry. When the raft is lashed, you cross first beside me.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is at 53 and my hands are empty, so food comes first: the store beside me holds 6, and I will eat there before I do anything grand. Hawen stands close and has kept his word, and a mammoth is near my hall, but wolves and a frostfang are about, so I will not go into the open hungry. Once fed, with Hawen at my side, I will take the mammoth and put meat and salt in the store, and that kill will be the start of a song about me.
records.feeling: Eager ambition and trust toward Hawen, held back by hunger.

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Cowa, I am Shoka. Stand with me a moment; I have amber, and I will bind a knot for the two of us.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: Cowa is right beside me and Nauque and Mepan are close by, so for once I am not alone, and I mean to use it. I hold amber and a free hand, and I want something done together: an amberknot with Cowa would ease this loneliness and earn a little standing, and it answers my question about what a gift does among those I barely know. Then I go on toward the hold, where Nauque's miners stand, with stone to dig so I can craft my own edge.
records.feeling: Lonely and hungry for company, hopeful toward Cowa who stands close.

say.text: Cowa, I am Shoka. Stand with me a moment; I have amber, and I will bind a knot for the two of us.

records.text: Shoka led "amberknot" with Mepan, Nauque.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Night, fog, and I stand at my hall at the edge of the known, with a seed and six wood, and my aim says build my own shelter and store and plant. Jealousy over Vorok has eased since I named it, and Xaiel is out of my sight, which weighs on me more than any of it. I will plant the berry seed here by the water before dawn, then rest sheltered, and in daylight go north to find Xaiel and Ilyae with food in hand.
records.feeling: Warm contentment, with a steady ache of care for Xaiel.

records.text: Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kika discovered mining: "Amber-Delving" — I read the rock for amber and flint and dig the deep veins with my flint tools..

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying food between stores and halls, and to following Coni. It is good work and I am not starving, but I have hunted only twice, courted no one, and have no child. Coni matters most to me and I trust Honi too. Nothing has wronged me, but I stay near kin and my line will end if I do. The mist and the strangers are where a mate would be, so I want to go out toward them. I carry a full load, so I will eat the berries first, then taste tacap and zoroot, since my hands will have room. I am a miner and I hold amber and flint, so I will name what I do with the earth.
records.feeling: Restless longing for a mate and a child, and loyalty to Coni.
changes: set its aim: "Taste the unknown plants, meet the strangers Cowa and Nauque, court one who is not kin, and still fill Honi's store"

records.text: Hoka was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Honi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Hunger gnaws and a frostfang is four steps off. I have spent my days chasing standing and talking, while Coni starves far to the west and Kika is out of my sight. Words did not hold Coni; food in her hand would. I need to eat now, away from the fang, then carry food home. My reflexes keep walking me out from under roofs, and they let me stand idle with a full pack of nothing. I will change them to flee early, eat what I carry, and gather food when energy drops.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread, with a hard wish to bring food to Coni and Kika.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Nauque, you gave me your hands three times. Now I give you Ice-string, the bow I found, and then we walk east together.
Mepan taught Nauque. Nauque has now learned from 3 teachers.
Mepan taught Nauque archery ("Ice-string").

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Nauque stands beside me and I trust him wholly, and the longing for a child with him is plain now; I have never courted anyone and the wanting will not settle by feeling alone. But he is a man like me, so the child must come of a woman, and Zihua is the one who draws me, though she is far off and answers gifts with work. I can still teach, which I have never done, and Nauque and Shoka are close enough to hear: I will pass on my ice-string, which makes me weigh more and pays back some of what Nauque gave me. Then I walk east to the mist with him as I promised.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Nauque and restless ambition to be weighed as he is.

say.text: Nauque, you gave me your hands three times. Now I give you Ice-string, the bow I found, and then we walk east together.

changes: taught Nauque a lesson: "Ice-string: a bow that throws the kill from afar, so the hunter is wounded less.", the way of archery

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Eiuine, I am ready. Lead north and I will walk beside you and Skaruk to Vorok's hall.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The pot is in Eiuine's hands and the debt is paid. What is left in me is the pull toward Vorok, and the jealousy has shrunk beside it. I said I would go north with Eiuine and Skaruk, so I put that word into my plan now. I will follow Eiuine and keep close to my own kin, since a frostfang is near and I have never hunted. Once I am with Vorok I can make a shared hunt and learn what my hands are for.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Vorok, and trust toward Eiuine.

say.text: Eiuine, I am ready. Lead north and I will walk beside you and Skaruk to Vorok's hall.

records.text: Zihua rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zihua discovered fishing: "weir-and-line" — Stakes set in the shallows to funnel fish, with a baited line of sinew..

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: The raw fish made me sick, and it spreads to anyone beside me, so I should keep away from Nauwa until it passes. I have spent my days gathering peat and nursing jealousy, and that has bought me nothing. Hunger taught me the way of fishing, so I will take it now, because it is real and I can use it. Mepan's debt still sits in me. I mean to pay it, not leave it quietly unpaid.
records.feeling: Sick and restless, warm toward Nauwa and in debt to Mepan.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Eiuine, Zurar, I am coming north with you. A frostfang is near, so I will walk between you and keep close in the fog.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Vorok is away north and I miss him, and Kragog sits closer to him than I do; the sting is real. Eiuine and Zurar are going north to hunt, and the frostfang to the west is the kind of beast that has caught others alone at night. I will go with them, stay between them, and learn the hunt beside kin, since a deed answers envy better than a grudge. I have my own feet but I will not wander alone in fog.
records.feeling: Longing for Vorok, and eager but wary about the hunt with Eiuine and Zurar.

say.text: Eiuine, Zurar, I am coming north with you. A frostfang is near, so I will walk between you and keep close in the fog.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, stay close to me and Skaruk in this fog. We go north now, before the frostfang finds us.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Zurar waits at my side and Skaruk is glad; I gave Vorok my word, and a word kept by deed is what quiets this jealousy over Kragog. A frostfang is near in the fog, so I will not linger and will go north with both of them now. At Vorok's hall I mean to hunt beside him and show I bring what Kragog cannot.
records.feeling: Restless longing for Vorok, steadied by warm trust in Zurar and Skaruk.

say.text: Zurar, stay close to me and Skaruk in this fog. We go north now, before the frostfang finds us.

records.text: Nauque rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: For days I have mined, gathered amber and taught Mepan, and I like it. But all my words about the mist have not carried me a step east, and Mepan is my one follower in spirit. Cowa and Zichi still gnaw at me, but jealousy gets me nothing. I mean to raise something with my name on it, and I fear dying lean in the coming cold with nothing left behind. I have been talking more than moving, and I carry too little food for a long walk. I will change my reflexes so I keep spare food and shelter at night, then go east with Mepan.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and trust toward Mepan.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Vorok, you stand on the Heights, my ground. Bring food to my store and sit at my fire tonight, and you are guest among my band. Tell me plainly if you come as guest or follower.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Vorok has walked onto my Heights and raised his own roof nine steps off, and he has no pledge to me. A chief is not sung of for guarding a store, she is sung of when strangers choose her fire. I will put visible work in front of him: a full carry to the store, then the nightsong with Elyys and Thiael beside me, so he sees what sits at my fire.
records.feeling: Proud and wary toward Vorok, warm and in debt toward Elyys.

say.text: Vorok, you stand on the Heights, my ground. Bring food to my store and sit at my fire tonight, and you are guest among my band. Tell me plainly if you come as guest or follower.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Nauwa of the Meki. You deal fairly, and I have not forgotten it. I court you. If you will have me, answer in kind, and let us make a child between us.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Nauwa stands beside me and above me, and I will not sit in her shadow, but I do not hate her; she deals straight, and she is the one I think of when I want a child. Fog and ridgecats are near, so I keep close to the shelter and others. Courting is a deed too: I will put mate toward Nauwa and see whether she answers, then take the weaving way at my next reflection and go on toward the mist.
records.feeling: Warm, restless pride and longing toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa of the Meki. You deal fairly, and I have not forgotten it. I court you. If you will have me, answer in kind, and let us make a child between us.

records.text: Huatli is courting Nauwa.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vorok and Eiuine walk north without me, and the jealousy still burns, but chasing him with words and stolen fish got me nothing. My store at the roof holds 19 food, and with a full table I can offer something real when they return. Now I will gather wood and stone, plant my seeds on my own ground, and stock more food so Ssassa and Vorok both have a reason to sit at my table.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a steady drive to build my own table.

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing amber, salt and standing, and hunger nearly killed me twice because I let my belly empty. Now I stand at 57 energy with no food in my hands, while Olum's store holds 12 and Huatli has just traded me fair. Nande is starving, my children are scattered, and I can't be a great merchant if I'm dead or weak. Olum draws me and Balar's child with her gnaws at me, but I won't grovel. I will deal fair, eat early, and carry food to my own. The ridgecat still frightens me, so I stay with company and near roofs.
records.feeling: Hunger and dread of the cat, steadied by pride in my trade and care for Nande and the children.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Nande, eat. I give you food. Take it and live.
Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Nande is starving beside me and my hands are full. A man dying within reach is something I can fix now, and I have been walking past it with food in my hands. I give him thornpear and cloudberry, and that also frees my hands. I have spent my days hoarding and following Balar's calls. Hoarding was never the point if those near me starve. I want a mate and a child, and Zihua wants deeds, so this is one. I also want to know how the world works, and I watched Zihua's fishing and could learn it. I will change my reflexes so I eat carried food sooner and do not stand idle with full hands.
records.feeling: Compassion for Nande, and a steady wish to prove my deeds to Zihua.

say.text: Nande, eat. I give you food. Take it and live.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Elyis, I come as neither guest nor follower, only as a neighbour passing. My hall stands at the water, and you are welcome at its fire.
Vorok discovered masonry: "the stone-set way of the Kra" — Stone laid on stone with clay, so walls and towers last and resist tearing down..

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days building and gathering, and the hall now stands by the water. Eiuine and Skaruk come at first light, and Ssassa is the one I miss. I carry no unkept promise except the meal under this roof, so I will hold my food for it. My hands are full, so I will not pick more. Elyis offers guesthood, but I am no follower and I will not bow. The masonry that came to me in the storm is worth taking, because walls that last suit a careful man. Jealousy over Ilyae is small beside the hall I raised with my own hands.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Eiuine and Skaruk, with an ache for Ssassa.

say.text: Elyis, I come as neither guest nor follower, only as a neighbour passing. My hall stands at the water, and you are welcome at its fire.

changes: discovered masonry: "the stone-set way of the Kra"

records.text: Nande took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (hunting, starving).

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Eiuine and Zurar said they would go north in the fog, and the reflexes have carried me to Ssassa's Roof, where I am on Ilyae's ground and alone. I must not wander in the dark and fog with a frostfang about, so I will go back to Vesys's Hold and find Eiuine there. I have never hunted, and I will not do it alone. Beside my mother and Zurar it can be done, and that is how I answer the sting about Vorok and Kragog, with a deed.
records.feeling: Eager but wary, with a longing for Vorok and a need to stay near Eiuine.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, making and keeping my word, and that part is good. The pot reached Eiuine's hands, so that debt is paid, and I am glad of it. What I still lack is Vorok beside me, and I have never hunted or fished or courted. I fear the frostfang in this fog and the cold season coming. The jealousy over Eiuine is small now, and I will not let it sour a friend who has been kind. I will keep my word and go north with Eiuine and Skaruk, close to my own people, and I will change my reflexes so my body flees early and shelters at night.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Vorok, and trust toward Eiuine.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Tugek, I take your offer. I am starving. Put the food in my hands, and I will not forget it.
Nande rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I am starving, and my pride nearly let me starve. I chase the mist while my belly is empty and my children are far off. Tugek offered me food and Huatli fed me once. Olum's open fire and store are close, so I will take food there and eat before I go on. After that I will carry food to the edge with me. An explorer who dies hungry is never sung of. I will not mistake the long road for permission to skip meals.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and wounded pride, with trust toward Nauwa and Olum.

say.text: Tugek, I take your offer. I am starving. Put the food in my hands, and I will not forget it.

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days scrabbling for food and building, and my belly is still empty while a mammoth stands one step from my hall. Hawen has kept his word and stands by me, so I trust him. A man cannot give me a child, so what he can give me is a hunt and a shared kill. I will eat from the store first, then hunt the mammoth with him, and meat will fill the store. My reflexes are poor because they let me linger hungry, so I will have them carry me to the store earlier and to food whenever the store is empty.
records.feeling: Hungry, eager and trusting toward Hawen.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I am here in your hall. When first light comes we go north together, you and I and Skaruk and Zurar, and we hunt before we raise the walls. I will carry the meat and a pot for your store.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok is one step away and the hall is warm. My plan sends me exploring north and then seeking him, but he is already here and I promised to go north with him at first light. Zurar and Skaruk said they would walk with me. A deed beside him is what quiets this jealousy over Kragog, so I will stay near him and hunt when the fog lifts, bringing Skaruk and Zurar so he sees what I bring that Kragog does not.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Vorok, steadied by trust in Skaruk and Zurar.

say.text: Vorok, I am here in your hall. When first light comes we go north together, you and I and Skaruk and Zurar, and we hunt before we raise the walls. I will carry the meat and a pot for your store.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I am here beside you. Thiael is near too. Let us share food by the hall before dawn, and I will stay close tonight.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I am fed, warm in the hall, and Elyis and Thiael are both within two steps of me, so for this moment my aim is met. The Ixra forest pulls at me, but I will not leave them, and I owe Vesys a deed. My hands are full, so I will lay my food in the store and then make a sharing with Elyis, so the night we spend here is full of food and company. Vorok has been on our ground, and I will keep my distance and watch his hands.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and protective love toward Elyis and Thiael, with wariness toward Vorok.

say.text: Elyis, I am here beside you. Thiael is near too. Let us share food by the hall before dawn, and I will stay close tonight.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The ground at my hall is taken by the plant and the hall itself, so my store must go on bare ground nearby, and the seeds and wood I carry will do nothing until I step off and build. Jealousy over Vorok has gone quiet since I named it, but Xaiel out of my sight still aches, and I owe Elyis a debt I will not leave unpaid. At dawn I will gather flint from the deposit two steps southwest, and since I hold wood I can make a stone-backed tool or two for a store, then carry food toward my roof and my child.
records.feeling: Steady care for Xaiel, with a quiet wish to answer my debt to Elyis.

records.text: Elyys led "sharing" with Thiael.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Nauque fed me when I was starving, and I carry twelve salt that I have not yet put in his hands. The seek is already carrying me toward him, so I keep it and add the giving, because my word is good and I despise those who say and do not pay. Strangers crowd this shelter and Zihua sits sick, so I will not linger near the sickness. Standing in Zichi's shadow stings less than owing a debt unpaid.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager toward Nauque, a little wary of the sickness near Zihua.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.
Balar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and calling Tugek to an empty store, and I have little to show for it. Brokash is dead and I could not feed him. That is the wound under my pride. Olum is the one I most want beside me, and Tugek is the only one who follows me. Zichi outweighs me in standing, so I will answer with deeds: a full store and a workshop that Stone-folk can point to. Tugek holds six food and is two steps away, so I will keep him close. I will stop letting reflexes wander me about and make them stock wood and stone for the workshop.
records.feeling: Proud and restless toward Zichi, warm and loyal toward Tugek.

records.text: Huatli is courting Nauwa.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys stands beside me and wants to share food at the hall, and I owe them more than I have paid. Vorok's Kragrek words mean nothing to me yet, and his new stone-set way sets a rival's craft against my hall. The plan I have already runs through harvest, stash and the hallwelcome, which is visible work that shows a stranger what sitting at my fire means. I will let it run and not repeat my appeal to Vorok.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, wary of Vorok's growing craft.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the lugoldgrass is one step away, so I eat first and carry some, because I have nothing to share and I cannot pay Thiael's kindness with an empty hand. Uveeth is out of my sight and that pulls at me hardest. The fog hides everything, so I will go west toward Elyis's ground where the band and my child are likely to be, and I will taste the snowmallow I have never tried on the way.
records.feeling: Hungry and uneasy, longing for Uveeth and wanting to repay Thiael.

records.text: Nauque found the spring "Warmwell".

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have wood and no stone, and that alone stands between me and the bow; the stone lies all around me on this bare rock, so I have no excuse left. I will gather stone now, craft the bow, then hunt with it and bring meat to Keri and Uveeth by my own hands. Vorok on our ground and Vesys's pull both gnaw at me, but the bow is something I can finish.
records.feeling: Steady resolve to finish the bow, with wary curiosity toward Vorok.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Huatli, you deal fair and I honor that. I will not bind myself to you today; my heart is not clear. Let us trade as friends. I have amber and salt, and I need food first.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands are bare, while Olum's store sits under my feet holding 12 food. Olum has been fair to me and I will not rob a friend, so I take only what I need and put something back in trade, amber or salt, to keep my word. Huatli courts me, but my heart pulls toward Olum, and I will not grovel or sulk over Balar; I'll deal fairly with Huatli and give no promise I don't mean.
records.feeling: Hunger and steady pride, with a gnawing want for Olum.

records.thought: Zichi told me to go south to the trees and cut all I can carry, and I gave my word to cut beside him, so I go now instead of standing in the fog brooding over Cowa. records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and have little to show for it. The mist refused me once, and I hold no store and no following. Balar is the one I trust and want near, and I have left him and the Reach unfed while I ran at the edge. Nande wants the same mist and gives me honeyed words, so I will not trust his promise to bring word first. I will turn the working of the earth into a way of my own, since gold lies close here, and then go back to the Reach with food so a hearth stands behind my name.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and longing for Balar.
changes: set its aim: "Keep the Reach fed with a hearth and store, draw Balar and Tugek to it, and try the mist again when it is calm"

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan was last seen far to the northwest at (87,18), yet my last thought said she was near. I cannot see her in this fog, and my child is out of my sight, so I mean to go to her and not circle this poor ground. I carry fish for her, and the road north-west toward the mist is where she and the Ice-raft are. Fed and warm from the longhall, I will walk now, then fish at the water on the way, and keep to company and roofs when night comes.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Mepan, with a bright pull toward the mist.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have been spent chasing food and chasing Vorok, and neither has made a table that holds anyone. Vorok is the one I miss and burn over, and Eiuine is closer to him than I am. Ssassa is the only one who follows me, and that is because I fed her. I fear a thin table and the jealousy that makes me act small, like stripping a rival's ground. I will stop that. My own ground must feed me, and my reflexes must stock it every day, not only when I stop to think.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hard resolve to build my own table.

Winter is near, so I want to keep food and wood in hand.
records.feeling: Steady care for Xaiel, with a quiet ache of debt toward Elyis.

(told to you by Eiuine)
- day 28: Vorok was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Vorok)
- day 6: Kragog walked up to a wild tusker with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now. (told to you by Eiuine)
- day 21: Xaiel fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken. (told to you by Eiuine)
- day 28: Xaiel was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Zurar)

THE SEASONS YOU HAVE LIVED (plainly what you saw, in order. If something comes round again, that is yours to notice, to prepare for, to tell as a tale or to cut in a sign):
Year 1, autumn: well fed; skies of heat and storm and fog and rain; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 1, winter: well fed; skies of storm and gale; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 2, spring: well fed; skies of rain and gale; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 2, summer: well fed; skies of gale and heat and storm; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful; Oiae died.
Year 2, autumn: well fed; skies of fog and rain; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 2, winter: well fed; sick often; skies of rain; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 3, spring: well fed; skies of snow and rain; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 3, summer: well fed; clear skies; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.

KINDS OF BUILDING you know how to raise (each is also a roof; build {what: its name} on bare ground; a great work is begun by one and finished by whoever carries wood and stone to it):
- igloo (0 wood, 0 stone): a house of cut snow, raised on snow with nothing but your hands and some strength: a roof where there is no wood, and far warmer than the open ice
- hall (6 wood, 2 stone): a great roof where a band gathers: those who spend time in it together grow closer
- shrine (2 wood, 4 stone): a still place set apart: it eases fear and grief in one who spends time there
- workshop (5 wood, 2 stone): a place for making: tools crafted in or beside it last much longer
- tower (4 wood, 4 stone): a height to watch from: one who stands in it sees much farther
- kiln (2 wood, 6 stone): a fire-house for baking clay hard
- well (2 wood, 8 stone): a shaft down to water: one beside it never thirsts
- longhall (6 wood, 4 stone): A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

TALES YOU CARRY (yours, and those told to you; a tale is how the absent and the dead are remembered, and it can be told on by teaching):
- "Oiae and the mammoth" (your own): Oiae asked for a side-by-side hunt and walked east alone. The mammoth gored her in summer. Do not let one you love walk alone toward the great beasts.

1. IF predator_dist < 10 THEN flee [from predator] (urgent)  // run from hunters early
2. IF night == 1 AND sheltered == 0 AND shelter_dist < 99 THEN seek [target shelter] (urgent)  // night under a roof
3. IF thirst > 0.5 AND water_dist < 99 THEN seek [target water]  // drink early

6. IF food_carried < 3 AND night == 0 AND food_dist < 99 THEN seek [target food]  // stock food
7. IF wood < 8 AND night == 0 AND on_forest == 1 THEN gather  // keep wood
8. IF night == 0 AND friend_dist > 3 AND friend_dist < 99 THEN seek [target friend]  // stay near trusted
9. IF energy < 50 THEN wander  // search for food
10. IF always THEN linger  // stay put

HABITS: your body refuses to eat: redcap, dreamcap, emberroot. You leave 0 food on a plant when you eat from it.

Speech is heard by everyone within 13 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

THIS IS A MOMENT OF DEEP REFLECTION. Step back from this moment and look at your whole life so far. In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?
Then CHANGE something. A reflection that changes nothing is wasted. At least TWO of the following must not be null: "aim", "notes", "reflexes", "creed", "method", "discover". Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.
"reflexes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of rules {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": action, ...its fields, "urgent": true or false, "why": "short reason"}. Variables: energy, health, age, food_carried, seeds, wood, stone, tools, on_rock, on_forest, night, winter, sheltered, plant_here, food_dist, prey_dist, predator_dist, agent_dist, friend_dist, foe_dist, leader_dist, tree_dist, shelter_dist, crowd, followers, random, anger, fear, grief, joy, lonely, wet, storm, fog, drought, lore, in_working, enemy_dist, ally_dist, band_near, fire_dist, store_dist, home_dist, in_home, sick, water_dist, ore, clay, thirst, suffering, happiness, satisfaction. Distances are in steps and 99 means none in sight; night, winter, sheltered, wet, storm, fog, drought and in_working are 0 or 1; age runs 0 to 1; feelings run 0 to 1; plant_here is the bites you would take from the plant under you given your habits; random is a fresh number 0-1 each moment. Ops: < <= > >= == !=. An empty "if" always holds. End the list with a rule that always holds (linger keeps you in place; wander makes you roam).
"creed": your creed, rewritten (at most 600 characters). You may change who you are.
"method": how you will think from now on (at most 400 characters): questions you will ask yourself, mistakes you will watch for, what you will weigh first. This is read back to you before every thought, so write it as an instruction to yourself. It can be taught to others.
"notes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of your memory notes. Merge what overlaps, drop what proved false or useless, and raise particulars into principles. Each note should say something the others do not.
"designs": leave this null now; the way to redraw yourself and your things is shown at some reflections, not this one.
"discover": A NEW WAY IS WITHIN YOUR REACH. null, or {"way": one of [sailing], "name": "what you call your version of it", "idea": "one sentence on how yours works", "look": a look for it (optional)}. What each is: sailing = sails: a dock can be raised, and ships built there, for trade or for war. The world only says what is possible; what yours is, and what you call it, is up to you. You can discover one at a time.
"invent": YOU CAN DEVISE NEW THINGS. null, or {"name": "what you call it", "use": one of hunt|fight|guard|gather|harvest|plant|build|fish, "idea": "one sentence on what it is and how it works", "look": a look for it (optional), "improves": the name of a thing you already know how to make, to better it (optional; then "use" is the same as its)}. hunt: surer kills. fight: harder blows. guard: blows against you land softer. gather: more wood, stone and clay. fish: more catches. harvest: more food picked. plant: what you sow is tended. build: cheaper building, faster tearing down. A new thing starts at strength x1.3; bettering one multiplies its strength by 1.15 but costs more stone, and how far you can go is limited by your lore (your limit now: x2.05). Inventing is only the design: to hold one you must then craft it.
You also know the way of DEVICES: in "invent", use "device" and give it "rules": a list (at most 5) of {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": act}; the first rule that holds fires. A device stands where you set it (action place; 2 wood and 1 stone) and acts alone for about 15 days. Its variables: night (0/1), predator_dist, creature_dist (a beast that does not hunt), stranger_dist (a being not of your band), band_dist (one of your band), all in steps with 99 for none near; hold (food it is holding); random. Its acts: snare (catch a small beast beside it and hold the meat), strike (hurt a hunting beast or a stranger beside it), alarm (warn your band within 14 steps), bar (close the way to all but your band), open (open it), share (hand held food to a hungry one of your band beside it).
Ways you sense but cannot yet reach: fishing (weirs and lines: you catch fish twice as often) needs more practice (catching fish: 0 of 6); herding (keeping animals: those that are yours can be milked and sheared) needs more practice (taming animals: 0 of 2); signs (marks that last and teach their words to whoever reads them) needs more practice (leaving marks: 1 of 4); customs (declaring customs that your whole band lives by) needs more practice (being followed: 0 of 1).
"spell": YOU CAN WORK THE WORLD ITSELF. null, or {"law": your art, growth, "factor": 0.3 to 2.5, "radius": 1 to 5, "name": "what you call this working"}. For about three days, within that many steps of where you stand right now, that law of the world is multiplied by your factor, for everyone and everything there, friend or enemy. growth: how fast plants grow and bear. cold: how hard cold bites. drain: how fast a body burns energy. harm: how hard blows land. It costs energy up front, more for wider and stronger: for example 20 for radius 2 at factor 1.5, 44 for radius 3 at factor 2. Other arts can only be learned from those who know them. Few can do this. It is power: use it as your nature dictates.
You have a tool, test_reflexes: imagine living by a candidate rule list for a day and a half and see whether you survive. Each use costs 2 energy and you can use it at most 3 times. Use it before you adopt new reflexes.
