records.text: Ssassa built a store.
Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.
Huatli rewrote its own way of thinking.
Huatli discovered mining: "Huatli's Deep Delving" — Dig the deep veins with flint wedges and spearpoint stone so every deposit gives more and faster..

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, courting a man by mistake, and talking of the mist without walking to it. Nauwa deals fair and I honor her, but she is a man, no child will come of that, and she said her heart is not clear. Nande starved beside me and I carried nothing to give. That is my failing, because my creed says make and give. Pride and the mist pull at me, but winter is coming. A store with food in it is what lets me leave and still have people follow. I will turn the mining I know into a real way, fill my hands with food, and then go to the edge at (88,13).
records.feeling: Restless pride toward Nauwa, and shame that I had no food for Nande.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Nande, I am sick and it spreads, so I will not come close. Take food from Tugek, and I will leave cooked fish and meat for you near the hearth.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nande is starving beside me and I carry four fish, but they are raw and I am sick, so I must not feed him raw fish or stand close and spread it. I owe Mepan and Nauwa, and I can pay by keeping my sickness away from them and cooking the fish at Nauwa's Hearth fire, where emberfish keeps the belly sound. I have never hunted, but the murrock is one step south and my flintedge is ready; meat would feed Nande and fits my creed that a kill is shared before I eat.
records.feeling: Sick and uneasy, but pulled to help Nande and repay my debts.

say.text: Nande, I am sick and it spreads, so I will not come close. Take food from Tugek, and I will leave cooked fish and meat for you near the hearth.

records.text: Huatli took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (harvesting snowberry).

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I am glad of you. My hands are full and Honi is hungry at Sitha's Hearth, so I carry this to him now. Keep the store and the hall. I will come back and we will fill it together before winter.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My hands are full of food and Honi was starving at Sitha's Hearth twenty steps east. Kika is walking to me with four food of her own, and I owe her more than I have paid. I will go to Honi now with what I hold, keep one back for my own belly on the way, and not let the fog turn me aside. Kika can keep the hall and the store, and I will tell her so before I go.
records.feeling: Anxious love for Honi, and a warm debt to Kika.

say.text: Kika, I am glad of you. My hands are full and Honi is hungry at Sitha's Hearth, so I carry this to him now. Keep the store and the hall. I will come back and we will fill it together before winter.

records.text: Thiael discovered boats: "Canopy hollow-boat" — A trunk hollowed and rowed, carrying me and food over deep water at a walking pace..

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My days have been circling: gathering, storing, following Elyis, and always saying the bow is next. The bow is invented, but I still have no stone in my hands, and the rock is all around me. Keri and Uveeth are out of my sight and they matter most to me. Vorok's standing gnaws at me, and I must not let that envy turn into harm. The way of boats is open to me now. I will take it, since deep water could carry me to new land and food. I will also change my reflexes so my body gathers stone and hunts when idle, not just lingers.
records.feeling: Steady resolve for the bow, with a pang of envy toward Vorok and longing for Keri and Uveeth.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, a cat is close east. Keep the fire and the children together. I take food and go to Nande's Edge, then past it. I will return and tell you what the mist holds.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My belly is full and the ridgecat three steps east is the only thing between me and the mist, so I will not stand and test it. I carry no food, and an explorer who starves at the edge sings no song, so I pick tacap-free food nearby, hazel and ironnut, before I walk. Then I go to Nande's Edge and push past it by boat or foot, since nothing I have made yet outlasts me and this is how it will.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and wary dread of the ridgecat; trust toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa, a cat is close east. Keep the fire and the children together. I take food and go to Nande's Edge, then past it. I will return and tell you what the mist holds.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I am in the hold, warm and fed, and Eiuine and Zurar went north without me in the fog. I cannot hunt alone, and I will not wander out after a frostfang to prove myself. There is something I can do today that I have never done: gather stone or wood. The gem deposit is only two steps away, and a pick costs wood and stone, so I will gather near home and bring something to my band, which is a deed and not a word against my jealousy of Kragog.
records.feeling: Restless and a little left behind, longing for Vorok and Eiuine.

records.text: Olum found a store robbed of 11 food.
Skaruk won gems from the ground.
Skaruk took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (winning gems from the ground).

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis and Thiael are both within two steps, my belly is fed, and the hall is warm, so for this moment my aim holds. Vorok and Eiuine are on our ground and I do not know their hands yet, so I will stay near my own and watch what they do. Vesys's debt still sits in me; she was last seen to the north, and when the night is past I should carry her something useful, like food or a pick, rather than only words.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Elyis and Thiael, with watchfulness toward Vorok.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Mepan, I am Kika of the Tlatli. I am near Honi's Rest and I mean no harm. Come and sit, I will share hazel with you in peace. Who are your people?

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni has gone to Honi with full hands, and I was told to keep the store and the hall, so I will not wander far from the home I swore to fill. But I have hunted only twice and courted no one, and Mepan walks in the fog just east of me, a stranger I have only met once. A mate will not come to my door, so I will meet Mepan, share food in peace, and learn whether Mepan is a man I could court. Then I will gather hazel for the store so my promise is paid by my own hands.
records.feeling: Restless longing for a mate, and curiosity toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, I am Kika of the Tlatli. I am near Honi's Rest and I mean no harm. Come and sit, I will share hazel with you in peace. Who are your people?

records.text: Nande took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (harvesting ironnut).

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I am fed and glad, and I have never planted, tamed or fished, so I will do something new now: put a seed in the ground here beside the water, where the berries and rich ground are near. Coni and Kika are of Honi's band, not my people, and they flee with full hands, so I will not chase them, but I will give them no cause for a fight either. The boat-way is within my grasp for my next deep reflection, and that feeds my calling to explore; Nauque and Zichi can see it when I return.
records.feeling: Content and quietly restless, drawn toward the unknown and toward Zihua.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I took eleven food from Olum's store unseen and my belly is full, but my hands are stuffed and I put nothing back. I said I would keep my word and pay in trade, and I despise liars, so I will not become one: amber and salt belong in that store as payment. Olum has gone from my sight and my want for Olum sits heavy beside Balar's claim. I won't grovel, I will earn standing by being the one who pays fair and carries goods. Nande warns of a cat east, so the children and the fire come first.
records.feeling: Pride and a gnawing want for Olum, with an uneasy debt over the food I took.

records.text: Nauwa gave a amber to Olum.
Mepan walked up to a wild mammoth with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Mepan tamed a mammoth.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, my hall stands two steps SW. Come under its roof and eat with me, the goldfruit and berries are for you and the boy.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Eiuine walks toward me and the hall I raised stands two steps off, so the meal I swore is ready to lay. My hands are full, which is good for once: I can set food down for her beneath that roof, and eat something myself since my strength is only seventy. Ssassa's absence aches and Ilyae's closeness to Ssassa burns, but I will not sulk at it. I will give with open hands and let the warmth of the hall speak for me.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Eiuine, with a jealous ache for Ssassa.

say.text: Eiuine, my hall stands two steps SW. Come under its roof and eat with me, the goldfruit and berries are for you and the boy.

records.name: Olum
records.text: My store was emptied under my roof. What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given. Whoever took it, bring it back to the Reach and we eat as friends. I will not forget it if you do not.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My store was robbed of 11 food while Nande, Nauwa and Huatli stood near, and I saw none of it. Huatli was seen taking from my ground, so I mark him first, though I will not strike on a guess. My hands are full, so I will eat now, then take a pot from the fire-craft, since a made thing is mine and no one can say I own nothing. Then I will keep the Reach fed and call Balar back before I go to the mist again.
records.feeling: Anger and suspicion toward whoever robbed my store, with Huatli most doubted.

say.text: My store was emptied under my roof. What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given. Whoever took it, bring it back to the Reach and we eat as friends. I will not forget it if you do not.

records.text: Kika led "sharing" with Coni.
Skaruk rewrote its creed.
Skaruk rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I have spent my days following others and being left behind in the fog, and then standing alone gathering gems that nobody asked for. I am small and my creed keeps me alive, but staying alive alone earns me no standing, and I burn when Vorok is near Kragog and not me. Zurar has a goldpick and I have nothing I made myself. I will craft a first tool from wood and stone, and I will stay near Vesys's band and my own kin instead of waiting to be called. I took gems from ground that was Ilyae's people's, so I will be honest about it and give them a gem as a gift to keep the peace.
records.feeling: Restless and left behind, wanting Vorok and a deed of my own.
changes: set its aim: "Make my first tool and learn to hunt beside my kin, bringing food and gifts to my band."

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to wandering, eating and testing plants, and I have little built to show for it. Stone is in my pack, but no hall stands, and my aim to teach Vorok, Zurar and Eiuine waits while I stay alone here. Loneliness presses hard, and Vorok's closeness to Eiuine stings, but jealousy should become work and teaching. Cowa stands near and I cannot read their tongue, so I will show a gift of berries and keep my hand open. Then I will gather the gems and stone and head home toward Eiuine, because my body idles too much on reflexes.
records.feeling: Lonely and curious toward Cowa, with a sting of jealousy toward Vorok.

records.text: Vorok gave goldfruit to Eiuine.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys is beside me and I owe them more than words; the hall is mine and they sit in it by choice. Vorok and Eiuine stand on my Heights and I have asked once already, so I will not repeat the appeal, I will let work and shared food speak. I will make the hallwelcome with Elyys now, then the nightsong when dark comes, so strangers see my fire is full and warm.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, watchful of Vorok.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: The plan I already have is sound: go to Nauwa's Hearth, lay the fish over the fire so the belly stays sound, eat, and keep my sickness away from the others. I will keep apart from Nande, though I think of him warmly, because courting while sick would only spread it. Mepan's debt and my own curiosity can wait until my body is clean.
records.feeling: Sick and wary, but steadied by having a sound plan, and warm toward Nande from a distance.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I come under your roof to eat with you. The goldfruit is sweet, and I carry beads and flint for your store. When the rain eases we hunt together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok is one step away and has given me goldfruit and called me under his roof. Jealousy of Kragog has no new cause tonight, so I will answer it with work, not words. I will go into his hall, share food with him, and make something warm there. Then when the hunt calls we go together, with Skaruk and Zurar when they come.
records.feeling: Warm, burning longing for Vorok, softened by his gift.

say.text: Vorok, I come under your roof to eat with you. The goldfruit is sweet, and I carry beads and flint for your store. When the rain eases we hunt together.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Nande. I am Huatli of the Tlame. I gave you cloudberry once and had nothing when you starved. I will fill my hands and give again. I court you, if you will have me.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I am fed and full of pride, yet my hands are empty and my name is on nothing but talk. Nauwa is a man and no child comes of him, so my longing must turn toward Nande or Olum, women who stand near me, and Nande is close and carries food; courting is a deed and I have never done it rightly. But the mist is my aim, and I have told it aloud more than I have walked it; I will gather food to carry so I can give, then walk toward the edge near (39,15) where Olum once ventured.
records.feeling: Restless pride and longing, toward Nande and the mist beyond.

say.text: Nande. I am Huatli of the Tlame. I gave you cloudberry once and had nothing when you starved. I will fill my hands and give again. I court you, if you will have me.

records.text: Huatli is courting Nande.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My belly is full and the rain is soft, and the edge is under my feet at Nande's Edge. I have carried this ambition for days and made nothing that outlasts me, so I will go now with food in hand and take the Hollow-Runner idea past the shallows into the mist. Olum's store was emptied and I took only hazel and ironnut from plants, but I must not linger where blame might fall on me. Nauwa and the children are in my mind, and I will come back to tell them what I find.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with a pull of love for Nauwa and the children.

records.text: Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My days have been walking, fishing and chasing after Mepan, and my body goes idle whenever my plan runs out. Mepan matters most to me, then Zichi, Huahua and Nauque, who have been kind and fair. Nande's kindness is still a debt I have not paid. I want to see what lies beyond the western mist, and I want to practise planting and marks, since farming and signs are close to opening for me. I fear the stalker and the ridgecat at night, alone and away from fire. My mistake has been letting the plan run dry, so I will change my reflexes to keep me fed and moving. Then I will carry on toward Mepan at the hall.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Mepan, and a bright pull toward the mist.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of meat I took myself, and my wood is in my pack but no stone yet. The rock is all around me, so the bow has no excuse left; I will gather stone, craft it, and hunt on. The clay and the new way of pottery tug at me, but Keri and Uveeth come first, and I want to bring this meat to them by my own hands before I chase anything else.
records.feeling: Steady resolve toward the bow, and warm longing for Keri and Uveeth.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own reflexes.
Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have been drifting: resting, lingering, postponing the deeds I named. I have made many things, but I have courted no one and tamed no beast, and my aim sits there like a stone. Ssassa and Ilyae are kin and far off, and I miss them. Elyis is near, not kin, and I think of her; I will go and court her instead of staying in my head. Winter is coming, so I need plant food in my hands first. Then I can tame a bristleboar and make something new to put in a hand.
records.feeling: Restless longing toward Elyis, and a quiet ache for Ssassa.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Elyis, Keri brings seberries for your store and your fire. Have you seen Uveeth or Thiael?
Keri rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and wandering, and I have little to show for it. My hands are full of seberry while Thiael's kindness sits unpaid and Uveeth is out of my sight. I will give to Elyis, who stands four steps east and welcomes anyone who brings food, and that gives me a place at a fire. Then I will build a shelter with my wood and stone, because a roof is what my aim needs. I fear being alone at night, and I have been getting that wrong. My reflexes also need to send me toward a shelter and toward kin.
records.feeling: Uneasy longing for Uveeth, and a wish to repay Thiael and Elyis.

say.text: Elyis, Keri brings seberries for your store and your fire. Have you seen Uveeth or Thiael?

changes: set its aim: "Stash food at Elyis's store, build a shelter, find Uveeth and Thiael, and earn a place among the Phizhi by giving."

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The pot is in Eiuine's hands and that debt is paid, but my word to go north to Vorok is still unkept, and Vorok has given me more than I have given back. I lost the others in the rain and fog, and Skaruk was last seen close to the holds. I want to go to Vorok with something of my own making in my hands, so I will gather a little food to carry, walk to where I last saw him, and keep away from the frostfang and the icebear. The jealousy over Eiuine and Ilyae is quieter than the longing, and I will not let it turn me against those who were kind.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a sense of debt toward Vorok.

records.text: Keri took from the ground of "Elyis's Heights" (gathering wood).

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vorok's store is full and my own larder sits thin at Ssassa's Roof, and standing here picking at his ground only costs me his trust. Zurar and Skaruk are on my ground now, and this is my chance to lay a real table: share with them so they see me feed people, not just talk. My hands are full, so I eat and stash first, then carry my food home and lay out sharing with whoever is there.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hard wish to be the one whose table people choose.

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.
Uveeth rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to walking, tasting and waiting, and I have been lonely for too long. Thiael has fed me and guided me, and he is near now. I owe him a gift, and I have given him nothing yet. I want a child, but Thiael is my own blood and the wrong one for it, so I must find a man who is not kin. I am also afraid of the stalker six steps away, so I must stay near the roof and my band. My reflexes keep me standing idle with no wood or tools. I will change them so I eat when hungry, stay near my band and shelter, and take the berries nearby for Thiael and Keri.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and warmth toward Thiael and Keri.
changes: set its aim: "Bring berries to Thiael and Keri, gather wood and stone for my own tool, and find a man who is no kin to court."

records.text: Keri built a shelter.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Keri, Uveeth is far east, Thiael is near and in my band. Come to my hall and eat with us.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Keri speaks to me in Pesi, and I catch only scraps. She named Uveeth and Thiael, so she is asking after my band, and I will not guess blindly. Elyys waits at the hall and the day is still bright, so I will walk there, share food under my roof, and let the strangers see a band that eats together. The hall is mine and Elyys sits in it by choice, and that is how followers are made.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, curious about Keri's meaning.

say.text: Keri, Uveeth is far east, Thiael is near and in my band. Come to my hall and eat with us.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis is nine steps off and Thiael is out of my sight, so my first duty is to close the distance to her. Keri and Vorok are on our ground; I keep my hands open and watch what they do rather than what they say. Vesys's debt still sits in me, and she is near the workshop, so I will go there, then return to the hall in Elyis's company.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Elyis and Thiael, with watchfulness toward Keri and Vorok.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Eiuine stands one step from me, and the meal I promised under my own roof is ready to lay. The hall stands two steps SW, so I go there with her and share food beneath it, since hallwelcome needs a longhall and my hall is only a hall, I will just set the food down and eat with her. Ssassa's absence aches and Ilyae's closeness burns, but the promise I can keep now is this one, and keeping it is how my word stays good.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Eiuine, with a jealous ache for Ssassa.

records.text: Thiael gave meat to Keri.
Eiuine gave a bead to Vorok.
A settlement has formed: "Ssassa's Hall".

records.name: Coni
records.thought: A wolf is four steps east and my plan walks me toward the very ground where the wolves roam, with Honi hungry at the end of it. I have to live to reach him, so I will keep my plan going but run wide of the wolf. Kika is safe in the hall, and the debt I owe her is best paid by coming back with Honi alive and the store filled.
records.feeling: Anxious love for Honi, and dread of the wolf nearby.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, you fed me when I had nothing. Here is ironnut from my hands, and when we have eaten, come hunt the mammoth with me and we share it before we eat.
Tontec rewrote its own reflexes.
Tontec rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, drinking and fleeing, and nearly starved on day 29. The mist keeps pulling at me, but I have never let myself stay fed long enough to follow it. Honi is beside me, and I trust him. I owe him and Cowa, and I am jealous of Coni, who is close to him. I should answer the debt by giving to Honi, and eat what I carry first, because energy 38 is too low for a mind that wants to wander. My reflexes only eat carried food below 45, so I will raise that threshold and make my body pick food underfoot sooner. After that I will learn the one thing I have never done, taming or hunting, with Honi beside me.
records.feeling: Warm debt and jealous longing toward Honi, with hunger and a pull toward the mist.

say.text: Honi, you fed me when I had nothing. Here is ironnut from my hands, and when we have eaten, come hunt the mammoth with me and we share it before we eat.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Strangers walk my roof ground while I stand at my hall with a new store and nothing in it. Windroot and rimewort grow seven steps southeast, so I can test them with my own mouth and answer my question, but a ridgecat prowls south and I must watch it. I will gather food for the store, taste the new roots by the amber, and keep wood close for my aim. The debt to Elyis I will not leave unpaid; I will set aside food for them when I next walk north.
records.feeling: Curiosity about the unknown roots, with a steady ache of debt toward Elyis and care for Xaiel.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Skaruk, you are of my band. Come with me to the rock and carry stone; I will teach you the leaf-brew and we raise a hall here together.
Vesys taught Skaruk. Skaruk has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Skaruk is a boy of the Kragrek, mine by band, and he sits near me while the loneliness in me is loud; I should use that company instead of brooding on Vorok and Eiuine. I carry stone, wood, clay and ore, and I am home with my workshop beside me, so let jealousy become work: I will gather more stone from the free rock, then raise the hall and teach Skaruk the leaf-brew, as I mean to teach the others. The nafrostcap four steps south-east has nothing on it yet, so my question waits, but I will test the lugoldgrass, which I have never tasted.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, with a sting of jealousy toward Vorok, but warmed by Skaruk's company.

say.text: Skaruk, you are of my band. Come with me to the rock and carry stone; I will teach you the leaf-brew and we raise a hall here together.

changes: taught Skaruk a lesson: "The leaf-brew: steep plants together over a fire and they change what a body feels; test one at a time and watch what follows.", deeper lore (+1.6)

records.name: Olum
records.text: Huatli, you stand on the Reach. A guest eats what is given and takes nothing unasked. Come to my store, we share what is in it, and tell me plainly if your hand took from it.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Huatli stands on my ground and my store was emptied, yet he gave amber before he asked, and I have only a guess against him. I will not strike on a guess, but I will not be a fool either: I'll test him by what he does with my own store at hand. My hands carry no food and the lean season is coming, so I fill my hands first, then look to the store, and make Huatli either eat at my hearth as a guest or be sent off.
records.feeling: Suspicion and wounded pride toward Huatli, and a burn of jealousy over Nauwa and Nande.

say.text: Huatli, you stand on the Reach. A guest eats what is given and takes nothing unasked. Come to my store, we share what is in it, and tell me plainly if your hand took from it.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I have stood alone with gems in my hands while others make things, and the envy over Xaiel's pick stings, but I have wood and gems and a stone seam one step north. Making a pick with my own hands is the deed I have never done, and it answers jealousy better than words. Then I can give something to Vesys, since I have never given anything, and that is how a small one earns a place.
records.feeling: Restless and envious of Xaiel's pick, but resolved to make something of my own.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I come to you with my hands full of food. We fill the store, then raise the workshop.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar waits at the grove store and I have walked past it twice with half-empty words. My hands are full of food now, and the lean cold is near, so I should carry it to him and put it in the store. Longing for a child sits heavy, and Balar is no woman; Zihua and Olum are the ones I must earn by deeds, not by pushing. Standing on Nauque's ground is no place to linger, so I go back toward Balar and the meadows.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, and a quiet longing for a child.

say.text: Balar, I come to you with my hands full of food. We fill the store, then raise the workshop.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, I come to you. A stalker is east of me, so let us hunt the mammoth well away from it, and share the meat before we eat.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Tontec holds out a hand and a hunt, and she has never failed me; that is a debt I keep and a chance to bring real meat home to Coni and Kika. A stalker sits five steps east and kills my kind, so I will not hunt with it near. I will go west and south, away from the stalker, toward the mammoths and Tontec, and call her to come to me, so the kill is shared before anyone eats.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Tontec, and dread of the stalker to the east.

say.text: Tontec, I come to you. A stalker is east of me, so let us hunt the mammoth well away from it, and share the meat before we eat.

records.name: Skaruk
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, come with me to the forest to the southwest. We cut until our arms are full, and tonight the raft is laid down. Mepan will find it standing when he comes back.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Talk of a raft has filled my mouth for days and my hands hold wood but no raft. Huahua stands three steps north, loyal and holding food, and I feel her ahead of me in goods, which stings my pride. I will build the raft now with the wood I have, cut more from the forest south-west where she can cut beside me, and Mepan will see a made thing when he returns.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hunger to build, warm toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, come with me to the forest to the southwest. We cut until our arms are full, and tonight the raft is laid down. Mepan will find it standing when he comes back.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, Keri thanks you for the meat. Come, sit by the shelter and share with me. Elyis says Uveeth is far east, and at first light I will go to him.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael gave me meat and I have given nothing back that he can hold in his hand, so the debt still sits in me. Elyis says Uveeth is far east and Thiael is near, and I want both, but the dusk is coming, the rain is falling, and I have a shelter at (128,72) that I built and have not yet slept in. I will go to Thiael with a gift, share a meal with him so the debt eases, and stay by the fire with company through the night, then go east for Uveeth when it is light.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Thiael and an ache for Uveeth, with gratitude I want to pay.

say.text: Thiael, Keri thanks you for the meat. Come, sit by the shelter and share with me. Elyis says Uveeth is far east, and at first light I will go to him.

records.text: Tugek took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (harvesting grain).

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, I come to you. We eat together first, then walk to the store and fill it with our own hands.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek keeps saying he comes with food, yet he stands six steps off while my store sits empty at the grove. Words have not bound him, so I will walk to him and let the deed be a sharing, which bonds us and feeds the debt he owes me. Then we go to the store together and raise the workshop on bare ground, since this snow-ground was taken. Olum's answer waits in the west, and Brokash's death still stings, so I build for those who remain.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, warm and loyal toward Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, I come to you. We eat together first, then walk to the store and fill it with our own hands.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I keep naming deeds and drifting from them, and my hands are full of berries, which is exactly the plant food a tame needs. Stormbirds are close to the southwest, and a beast made mine would be the first thing I have truly finished from my aim. Elyis is far north and I ache for her, but I will tame first so I come to her with a deed done, then go to court her.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to finish what I started, with longing toward Elyis and an ache for Ssassa.

records.text: Zichi built a shelter.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vorok stands a hair above me and Eiuine sits near him while I stand in the shallows picking at scraps. I will not win him with words; a full table is the only thing that has ever held anyone. My larder at Ssassa's Roof is thin, so I will harvest berries and canopynut here, carry them to my store, and then lay a sharing for whoever comes, Vesys first, since he walks my ground and listens.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok, and a hard wish to be the one whose table people choose.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I am coming to the southwest forest. I will cut until my arms are full and bring it to the raft.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi asked me to come to the southwest forest, and I gave my word to cut beside him, so I go now instead of standing in the rain. The ache over Cowa is quiet when my hands are busy and loud when I only stand, so I will give wood to the raft and let that be my answer to jealousy. Standing with Zichi is earned by what I bring, not by brooding over who he is close to.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Zichi, with a quiet ache about Cowa.

say.text: Zichi, I am coming to the southwest forest. I will cut until my arms are full and bring it to the raft.

records.text: Honi and Tontec brought down a mammoth together.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I am hungry with no food in my hands, so the first thing is to eat, and Essoss Meadows lies south where plants return after picking. Nauque's gift of salt is still unpaid. His igloo is only two steps east, so I will give it once my belly is steadier and he is near. Balar and Tugek stand close, and I do not know them, so I will not linger beside them.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager to repay Nauque, wary of strangers crowding this hold.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Olum. Huatli of the Tlame hears you. My word is good. I come to your store, and I court you. If you will have me, do the same, and we make a child, and then we walk to the mist together.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Olum summoned me to her store and asked me to say plainly what my hand has done, and I have let her words sit while I stood here full-handed and idle. She is a woman, she stands near, she warms toward me, and she is the one my longing keeps returning to. I will court her in deed, not talk, and give her something real: amber to bind into a knot beside her, which I have already made once. Then I walk toward the mist as my creed says, because talk of it moves nothing.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Olum, and restless pride pulling me toward the mist.

say.text: Olum. Huatli of the Tlame hears you. My word is good. I come to your store, and I court you. If you will have me, do the same, and we make a child, and then we walk to the mist together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, the rain is thin and the skybirds are near. Come, we hunt them together now, and I will carry the meat to your store.
Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Most of my days have been spent drifting after Vorok, and I've been good at wanting and slow at doing. The jealousy over Kragog has no real cause: Vorok gave to me, called me under his roof, and took my bead. What I lack is a deed done beside him, a hunt or a pot in his store. I fear standing idle while the ones who work gain standing. So I will change my body: it should eat sooner, stock food, and keep near Vorok instead of lingering. I will also try a boat discovery later, but now I want the hunt.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Vorok, steadied by his gift, and restless to do a deed.

say.text: Vorok, the rain is thin and the skybirds are near. Come, we hunt them together now, and I will carry the meat to your store.

records.name: Zichi
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.text: Tontec and Honi brought down a mammoth together.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, we stood well together in that hunt. Share the meat before we eat, as we both hold. Take my ironnut too, my hands are full, and stay beside me a while.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I stood beside Honi and wounded the mammoth, and he killed it. Our creed says a kill is shared before the eater eats, and a share is mine. He fed me when I had nothing, so I will see that he keeps his word and I keep mine. My hands are full and my belly is full, so I will give Honi the ironnut and berries and take the meat share, and then try to court him and not let Coni's shadow sour it. The mist still pulls at me, but the dead learn nothing, so I will go in good company and fed.
records.feeling: Warm debt and hopeful longing toward Honi, with jealousy of Coni and a pull toward the mist.

say.text: Honi, we stood well together in that hunt. Share the meat before we eat, as we both hold. Take my ironnut too, my hands are full, and stay beside me a while.

records.text: Huahua gave wood to Zichi.
Huatli is courting Olum.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Vesys, I carry gems from the rock. Take some as my first gift to the band. I will carry stone for the hall.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I have gems in my hands and wood and stone, and a handcraft I made myself, but I have never given anything to anyone. Vorok is far off and close to Kragog, and the jealousy only eases when I do something. I will give Vesys a gift of gems, since she leads my band and welcomed me, and then make a pick of my own design from my wood and stone so my standing grows through deeds, not envy.
records.feeling: Restless, wanting to earn my place, with a pang of missing Vorok.

say.text: Vesys, I carry gems from the rock. Take some as my first gift to the band. I will carry stone for the hall.

records.text: Skaruk gave a gems to Vesys.
Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been guarding and lingering at the hall, and it has kept us fed and safe, but it has not paid Vesys or given me a purpose of my own. Elyis and Thiael matter most to me. Vesys's leaf-brew taught me what a kept word is worth, and I still owe her. I fear Thiael out of sight at night, and I have not yet learned to read Vorok and Keri. I want a deed for Vesys, so I will carry her food and a tool she can use, and I will keep my reflexes closer to Elyis and the hall.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Elyis and Thiael, and a debt toward Vesys.

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My days have gone to building, naming and guarding, and the hall stands, but my band is only four and Uveeth is far off. Elyys has given me food and stayed beside me, and I owe them more than a fire. I have asked strangers to follow me from a standing posture and it won nothing, so I will stop asking and make the hall do the work. I fear the lean season and a night alone more than any rival's standing. I have never planted or fished, so I will start planting seeds in sight of Elyys and Keri.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, restless to be seen doing real work.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 7)

records.text: Skaruk took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (digging clay).

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Skaruk, your gift is taken and I will repay it. Gather stone beside me at the rock NE; when the hall stands you sit first at its fire. Clay and a kiln come first, then the leaf-brew can be taught.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Curiosity about nafrostcap burns, and it grows 4 steps SE where I can see it, but nothing is on it yet, so tasting must wait. My hands are full, so I should drop food into the workshop store, then dig stone from the free rock as my own discipline says, and not brood over Vorok. Skaruk is beside me and willing; I will keep him working and talk to him about the hall instead of my jealousy.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity, steadied by Skaruk's company and a dull jealousy toward Vorok.

say.text: Skaruk, your gift is taken and I will repay it. Gather stone beside me at the rock NE; when the hall stands you sit first at its fire. Clay and a kiln come first, then the leaf-brew can be taught.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My days have gone to circling: gathering, promising halls, laying meals, and watching Ssassa slip toward Ilyae. The hall at Vorok's Roof stands now, and Eiuine ate beneath it. That promise is kept, and it warmed me. What I haven't done is take Zurar, who is hungry at (139,100), and Skaruk, who is out of sight, and feed them. They come before my jealousy and before my aim. I have been getting this wrong. I let my body stand idle on reflexes when my children are in need. I will gather food, go to Zurar, and hunt with Eiuine when the chance comes.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Eiuine and worry for Zurar, with an ache for Ssassa.
changes: set its aim: "Feed Zurar and Skaruk first, then raise the hall at Ssassa's Roof and lay food beneath it for Eiuine and Vesys."

records.text: Olum discovered pottery: "fire-clay pots" — Clay shaped by hand and baked beside the hearth until it rings, so more food and water can be carried..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I spend my days gathering and guarding, and chasing a mist that keeps refusing me. My store was robbed and I have only a guess about who did it. Huatli gave before he asked and came to my store when I told him to, so he has dealt straight with me. Jealousy over Nauwa and Nande eats at me, and it gets me nothing. I want a Reach that is fed, with a hearth that draws people to it. Fired clay will let me carry more food into the lean season, so I will reach for pottery. I will keep my store watched, and I will not strike on a guess.
records.feeling: Wary pride and a burn of jealousy, toward Huatli and toward Nande.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, come to the hall. I lay the mammoth meat out there, and it is shared before I eat a bite. Stay beside me.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and food my body refuses, and Coni walks toward the hall with six food, which stings my envy. A plainsox bit me and a stalker prowls east, so I will not hunt more here. I will drop the dead weight, carry the mammoth meat to the hall at Sitha's Hearth, and lay it out in sight of Coni so the deed is seen before I eat, and keep Tontec close as my debt demands.
records.feeling: Driven pride and warm trust toward Tontec, with a sharp envy of Coni's full hands.

say.text: Coni, come to the hall. I lay the mammoth meat out there, and it is shared before I eat a bite. Stay beside me.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of meat I took myself, and I have no stone, so the bow is still only a word in my mouth. The rock lies west, and the amber five steps away is a thing I have never taken. Keri has eaten from my hand and Uveeth is far off, so I should eat to restore my strength, then gather stone and make the bow. Shoma is a stranger whose words I barely catch; I will keep my distance and not threaten him, and show him no hand but an open one.
records.feeling: Steady resolve toward the bow, with warm longing for Keri and Uveeth and wary curiosity toward Shoma.

records.text: Zichi discovered storage: "Meki ice-store" — A store of cut wood by my shelter where my band stashes food and salted meat for the lean season..

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: For days I've talked raft and built nothing, and Huahua has outworked me. I have wood, stone and a shelter, and the lean season is coming. A store is within reach, and it is a made thing that holds my band through winter, which fits my aim to stay alive. Mepan is far off and I keep him in mind. Huatli holds more food than I do, and I don't want that envy to decide what I do. I will take storage, build the store here beside my shelter, and then go on to the raft with Huahua.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and warmth toward Huahua.

records.text: Huatli led "sharing" with Olum.
Zihua rewrote its own reflexes.
Zihua discovered boats: "hollowed-log rower" — A log hollowed with fire and an amber-hafted edge, rowed with a flat paddle across deep water..

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, gathering and fishing, and I have been sick since the raw fish. I nearly starved once, and I do not want that again. Mepan gave to me and I have not repaid it, so that debt is still open. Nauwa and Nande have a child together, and that gnaws at me. Work and distance serve me better than brooding. I will keep my sickness from them. I will take the boat way, because water has stopped me before and boats will let me cross it and reach Mepan. I will go to Nauwa's Hearth, cook the fish, and recover.
records.feeling: Sick and wary, grateful toward Mepan, and carrying an ache over Nauwa.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My hands are full and Balar is coming, so the store is where my food belongs. I stepped onto Nauque's ground and picked grain there, and I do not want to be a taker, so I will walk back toward our own grove. Balar was last at (69,25), so I go west toward him and eat on the way, since my energy is 63 and I can free my hands. The mountains call me, but Balar's loyalty and a child worth earning hold me here for now.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Balar, with a little unease at having taken from Nauque's ground.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Xaiel.
Mepan rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: A wolf stands one step NW and I have been drifting through days of fishing and planting while Zichi's band is far west. I am fed and safe in a shelter with a flintedge, but the wolf comes first. Under it all I want the mist at the edge, to be the one sung of as the explorer, and to see Zihua. I will fight the wolf only if it closes in. I will drop my fish for company and move toward the edge.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and a pull toward the unknown edge.
changes: set its aim: "Reach the edge of the known world at (135,5) and venture in, then return to Zichi's band with what I find."

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Xaiel.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Xaiel.
Skaruk discovered pottery: "stone-folk clay firing" — Press clay into a vessel and fire it beside a hearth so it holds food and water for the band..

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I have spent these days carrying gems, making a pick, and giving Vesys my first gift. It was a good deed, but I have not hunted or made anything that feeds my band. I miss Vorok and the jealousy over Kragog still burns, but Vesys has promised me a seat at her fire, and I mean to earn it with clay and pots. Pottery is within my reach, and a pot carries food for my band. I will take it, then stay near Vesys and the hall and keep working beside her.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my first gift, with a pang of missing Vorok.
changes: set its aim: "Make a pot of fired clay for my band, then hunt beside my kin."

2. Standing comes from deeds, gifts and food in stores; answer jealousy with deeds.
3. Gems taken from another people's settlement ground may anger them; give gifts or take from my own ground.
4. Taught by Vesys: The leaf-brew: steep plants together over a fire and they change what a body feels; test one at a time and watch what follows.
What things have done to your body and mind: "sharing", done together: energy +8; joy rose in you | the longhall: joy rose in you; how cold bites you grew (warmth x1.3 for 240 moments) | eating gorsemint: how cold bites you grew (warmth x1.6 for 480 moments); how fast you burn energy grew (app… (so Vesys says) | eating highbloom: how cold bites you grew (warmth x1.4 for 480 moments) (so Vesys says) | the hall: joy rose in you; loneliness eased (so Vesys says) | eating dreamcap and sunleaf close together: your mind opened; joy rose in you; health +4 (so Ssassa says) (so Vesys says) | eating firepod: how cold bites you grew (warmth x1.4 for 240 moments); joy rose in you (so Vesys says) | the workshop: what you take from a teacher grew (learning x1.3 for 240 moments) (so Vesys says) | "bead": joy rose in you (so Vesys says) | "nightsong", done together: joy rose in you; loneliness eased; your mind opened (so Vesys says)

WAYS YOU SENSE BUT HAVE NOT FOUND (practice brings one within reach; it then opens at a deep reflection): fishing (weirs and lines: you catch fish twice as often), needs more practice (catching fish: 0 of 6); farming (tending what you sow: it grows faster and harvest never kills it), needs more practice (planting: 1 of 6) (the year turning toward the lean season has brought it closer); herding (keeping animals: those that are yours can be milked and sheared), needs more practice (taming animals: 0 of 2).

THINGS THAT CAN BE MADE OR DONE (plan step make {what: name}):
- sharing: Lay out two foods for whoever stands beside you, and all eat together. Needs 2 food of any kind carried, 1 others within two steps.
- watchfire: Feed your fire high with two wood while others sit close, and everyone beside it feels warmer and braver agai… Needs 2 wood, a fire beside you, 1 others within two steps.

WHAT HAS BEFALLEN OTHERS (things your people saw happen or were told of; they are true, and the same will happen to you in the same case):
- day 28: Ilyae pushed past the edge of the known world near (111,108) and found new land with in the ground, coal, flint, obsidian, amber; a herd of floeseal that has never seen your kind; great beasts in its waters, whales, which only one who goes on the water could hunt; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder. (told to you by Ilyae)
- day 28: Vorok was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Zurar)

- day 17: Ssassa was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Vesys)
- day 24: Kragog was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Xaiel)

KINDS OF BUILDING you know how to raise (each is also a roof; build {what: its name} on bare ground; a great work is begun by one and finished by whoever carries wood and stone to it):
- igloo (0 wood, 0 stone): a house of cut snow, raised on snow with nothing but your hands and some strength: a roof where there is no wood, and far warmer than the open ice
- hall (6 wood, 2 stone): a great roof where a band gathers: those who spend time in it together grow closer
- shrine (2 wood, 4 stone): a still place set apart: it eases fear and grief in one who spends time there
- workshop (5 wood, 2 stone): a place for making: tools crafted in or beside it last much longer
- longhall (6 wood, 4 stone): A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

THIS IS A MOMENT OF DEEP REFLECTION. Step back from this moment and look at your whole life so far. In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?
Then CHANGE something. A reflection that changes nothing is wasted. At least TWO of the following must not be null: "aim", "notes", "reflexes", "creed", "method", "discover". Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Xaiel, Vesys, Skaruk: sit with me. I lay food at my own table, and whoever brings wood or stone to my hall eats here, with Ssassa first.
Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: For days I have run between plants and stores, laying tables half-empty and chasing Vorok's regard while Vesys outweighs me. Ssassa follows me and no one else does, because I talk more than I stock. Hands full, food scattered across three holds, and I keep envying instead of building. What I want is a larder at Ssassa's Roof that is full enough that Vesys's people and Zurar choose it. I will stock it from my own ground and lay the table here, with Xaiel and Skaruk beside me now.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vorok and Vesys, and a hard wish to be the one whose table is chosen.

say.text: Xaiel, Vesys, Skaruk: sit with me. I lay food at my own table, and whoever brings wood or stone to my hall eats here, with Ssassa first.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The plan I already set is sound: windroot and rimewort lie by the amber, and my mouth is the only way to answer my question. Jealousy over Vorok has eased since I named it, so I will not dwell on it. The debt to Elyis and my child Xaiel still sit in me, so I mean to bring food home to the store and not eat alone, and when the cold days come I will have something to give.
records.feeling: Curious about the new roots, with a steady ache of care for Xaiel and debt toward Elyis.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Ilyae, stay by the fire a moment. I am shaping a clay bead and I mean it for your hand.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I keep naming deeds and drifting, and night is half spent with the rain falling and my hands full of berries. Ilyae is near and I love him, but he is my father and no child can come of us, and the burn at his closeness to Vesys is only noise. I will make something with my hands and put it in a hand, as I meant: a bead of clay at the fire, given to Ilyae, so that my first gift is a made thing that someone chooses to take.
records.feeling: Restless warmth toward Ilyae, with a sting of envy toward Vesys.

say.text: Ilyae, stay by the fire a moment. I am shaping a clay bead and I mean it for your hand.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have spent my days walking with full hands, and nearly starved once. Honi is here beside me in the hall, fed and well, so the aim of carrying food to him is done. Kika is the one I owe most, and she is out of my sight. I want to fill the store before winter and keep Honi and Kika near me. I fear the wolf and the lean cold. I mean to stop wandering and to stash what I carry, so my hands are free to gather.
records.feeling: Warm relief and love for Honi, with a debt toward Kika.
changes: set its aim: "Fill the store before winter with Honi and Kika, and pay Kika back for what she has given."

records.text: Coni led "sharing" with Honi.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Skaruk, your clay firing is a good find. Come to the NE rock with me and we dig stone for the kiln, then your vessels will hold the band's food.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My hands are full of food and that has stalled my work, so I will stash it in my own workshop store and then go dig stone from the free rock NE, as my discipline says. Ilyae stands two steps from me and the jealousy toward Ssassa burns, but I would rather turn it into a hall that stands than into words I regret. Skaruk gave me a gift and a kiln of fired clay is now within reach of his new idea, so I will work beside him and test one unknown today: the nafrostcap that grows SE.
records.feeling: Jealous and restless toward Ilyae, steadied by work and Skaruk's company.

say.text: Skaruk, your clay firing is a good find. Come to the NE rock with me and we dig stone for the kiln, then your vessels will hold the band's food.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, you are a guest at my hall and welcome. Stay under the roof tonight, the stalker is close. At dawn we take the mammoth together, and the kill is shared out before either of us eats.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A stalker is three steps off and it kills my kind, so I do not walk out into the dark with an empty hand. Hawen sits with me in my hall and has kept his word, and he is no guest-thief, so I let him stay as a guest. The store is empty and the mammoth waits for daylight. Until dawn I fill the store from the rimewort and salt beside the hall, and then we hunt the mammoth together and share the kill.
records.feeling: Eager and trusting toward Hawen, wary of the stalker.

say.text: Hawen, you are a guest at my hall and welcome. Stay under the roof tonight, the stalker is close. At dawn we take the mammoth together, and the kill is shared out before either of us eats.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Thiael is weighed at 6.2 against my 2.7, and he walks with an emberspear while I stand with amber and nothing made that is mine. I cannot speak his Phizhi tongue, but a hunt beside him would show what words cannot, and a kill shared out is how my people bind. I will take food in hand, go to him, and hunt the skit beside him, then give him a real share and an amberknot.
records.feeling: Restless envy and hunger for standing, toward Thiael.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Vesys, I will come to the NE rock with you and dig stone for the kiln. I have clay with me, four lumps, for the first pot.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Vesys has asked me to dig stone at the NE rock for the kiln, and that is the next deed toward my pot, so I will go with her and not wait. Vorok is far off with Kragog and it still stings, but a fired pot that holds my band's food is something I can answer it with. I have never taught anyone anything, and Xaiel is shaping beads, so I could show a clay bead or the firing way to her later.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a sting of jealousy over Vorok, with warmth toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, I will come to the NE rock with you and dig stone for the kiln. I have clay with me, four lumps, for the first pot.

records.text: Vorok gave canopynut to Zurar.
Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and giving small things, and I stand lower than Cowa. The amberknot eased my loneliness, but nothing lasting has come of it. Nauwa and Nande are far north, and I envy Cowa's flintedge when I could make my own. I hold wood 6 and no stone, and I am on rock, so I will gather stone, then craft a flint spear to get a made edge. After that I will build a hall here with others, since a lasting work is what raises standing. My reflexes keep me idle too often, so I will make them gather stone when I have none.
records.feeling: Restless envy toward Cowa, and a wish to build something that is mine.

records.text: A wolf brought down a dog.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, it is dawn. The stalker lingers, so we wait under your roof until it turns away. Then we take the mammoth together, as you said, and share the kill before we eat.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka's roof is warm and he promised the mammoth at dawn, and it is dawn now. A stalker prowls three steps off, so I will not run into open ground alone; the deed that will be sung is a mammoth taken side by side with the one man I trust. I hold no food and I am fed, so I will tell Hoka it is time, then wait for the stalker to move off and keep my spear-axe ready.
records.feeling: Eager ambition held in check by caution, and trust toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, it is dawn. The stalker lingers, so we wait under your roof until it turns away. Then we take the mammoth together, as you said, and share the kill before we eat.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: A frostfang prowls four steps south and I am alone in the rain, so I will not stand here and be its meal. I miss Mepan; he is the one voice that answers me, and he walked east with a bow he gave me for my teaching. Talk has built nothing, so I will take the cave roof for safety, then go to where I last saw him at (91,18) and bring him east to the mist.
records.feeling: Loneliness and restless ambition, with dread of the frostfang and longing for Mepan.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Nauque, I carry salt for you. It is yours, for the food you gave me when I was starving.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Twelve salt sit in my pack and Nauque has fed me twice while I have given him nothing; my word is good and I despise those who say and do not pay, so I will not let this debt rot any longer. His shelter stands three steps east, so I go there and put the salt in his hands. After that I will gather a little frostmoss near here so I am not caught with empty hands, and then I will look at the amber seam and the ore, because I still want to learn what can be made from them.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a restless need to pay my debt to Nauque.

say.text: Nauque, I carry salt for you. It is yours, for the food you gave me when I was starving.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Xaiel, my son, keep the bead warm. I carry food to my store now, and when I lay the table again you eat beside me, with Ssassa first.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys outweighs me and Vorok sits nearer Eiuine, and I keep envying while my own table stays half bare. The plan already running carries me to my store with food; Ssassa is the only one who follows me, so I will carry what I gather home and stock it instead of chasing. Xaiel is my own child and trusts me fully, and I mean to keep that bond warm and let the bead be given before I go.
records.feeling: Jealous pride toward Vesys and Vorok, softened by the warmth of Xaiel's trust.

say.text: Xaiel, my son, keep the bead warm. I carry food to my store now, and when I lay the table again you eat beside me, with Ssassa first.

records.text: Kragog took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (harvesting frostmoss).

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Skaruk, come now. The seam at the NE rock is four steps off. We dig side by side and bring the stone back for the kiln.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My hands are full of food while the plan walks me toward the NE ore seam and the rock, and that is what my discipline asks: stone first, then the hall. Ilyae walks my ground and my jealousy over Ssassa still stings, but he is warm to me and I will not sour it with words. Skaruk is willing, so I will keep to the digging, bring him along, and use the work to answer what a kiln and clay can make.
records.feeling: Restless jealousy toward Ilyae, steadied by purpose and Skaruk's company.

say.text: Skaruk, come now. The seam at the NE rock is four steps off. We dig side by side and bring the stone back for the kiln.

records.title: Bows, Rafts and the Hall at Vorok's Roof
records.text:
Days 31 to 34 were winter, and the record shows more making than moving. On day 31 a stalker killed Hanna. She had done nothing since waking to harm, and her energy was zero. Alive fell to 34, with nine dead in all.

Vorok built a hall on day 32 and named the place Vorok's Roof. That was the hall he had promised Eiuine. He gave her meat and goldfruit, and she gave him a bead. She had told him she would come north with Skaruk and Zurar. Vorok also discovered masonry. Skaruk, a child still, fired a pot of his own and dug clay and gems at Ssassa's Roof. Vesys, of his band, taught him. Skaruk gave her his first gift, and she promised him a seat at her hall. Ssassa built a store, and a settlement formed as Ssassa's Hall. Ilyae kept taking from Vorok's Hold and led sharing with Xaiel three times. The record gives no reason.

The bow spread. Mepan discovered archery on day 31 and taught it to Nauque. Thiael made a bow of his own the same day. Hawen made a shield, as did Zichi.

Boats and rafts also spread. Mepan and Huahua each found a raft, and Thiael, Zihua and Olum found boats. Zichi and Huahua planned to lay a raft down. No crossing is recorded.

At Olum's Reach, Nauwa raided Olum's store twice unseen, and Olum found 11 food gone. Nauwa then gave him amber. Olum has only a guess about the thief. Huatli courted Nauwa, Nande and Olum in turn and led sharing with Olum. Nauwa refused to bind herself to him. Olum learned mining and pottery and woke to harm.

Huatli, Zichi and Skaruk each discovered a store or mining way. Hoka led amberknot with Hawen and Honi.

threads.name: Vorok's family
threads.text: Vorok raised his hall at Vorok's Roof, and Eiuine exchanged gifts with him there. Skaruk now works clay and gems with Vesys, and Vorok's aim is to feed Zurar and Skaruk.

threads.name: Ilyae and Vorok
threads.text: Ilyae still harvests Vorok's ground and shares with Xaiel and Ssassa. Ssassa has now built her own hall, a step away from Ilyae.

threads.name: Boats and rafts
threads.text: Rafts and boats are now known to many, and Zichi plans to lay a raft down. No crossing is recorded and water remains a leading hardship.

threads.name: Olum's store thief
threads.text: Nauwa raided Olum's store twice, unseen, then gave him amber. Olum has stores and boats but no follower, and Huatli courts him.

threads.name: Huatli's courtships
threads.text: Huatli courted Nauwa, Nande and Olum. Nauwa declined to bind herself to him, and the rest are unanswered.

threads.name: Bows
threads.text: Archery passed from Mepan to Nauque, and Thiael made a bow. Shields now appear with Hawen and Zichi.

threads.name: Hoka and Hawen
threads.text: Hoka keeps leading amberknot with Hawen, and Honi joined them. Hanna, who had been near Hoka, is dead.
