records.name: Elyis
records.text: Eiuine, you stand on my Heights. Come to the hall fire tonight and eat with my band. Sit as a guest, and bring what you can to the store.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: It is night and the rain falls, and Elyys stands two steps away with Thiael near, so the nightsong that failed before can work now if a fire burns beside us. I will do deeds in front of Eiuine and Keri rather than make more appeals: build a fire, sing, and share food under the hall roof so they see what my band is. Eiuine stands on my ground and has done no harm, so she is a guest tonight, and her place is decided by whether she eats and sits with us.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, eager to be seen doing real work before Eiuine and Keri.

say.text: Eiuine, you stand on my Heights. Come to the hall fire tonight and eat with my band. Sit as a guest, and bring what you can to the store.

records.text: Kika led "sharing" with Honi, Mepan.
Nauwa gave a amber to Olum.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vorok, an icebear is five steps west of us. Let us go to your side, away from the water and the trees, and keep Skaruk with us. The pick in your hand is my gift, and I will make more.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: An icebear stands five steps west and my reflexes are already running me from it; I will not wait for it to decide about me. Vorok is three steps north with a pick I made, so one debt is paid, and I will keep close to them and the roofs instead of feeding my jealousy over Eiuine. I want to stay alive through this cold and make something more of my own to give.
records.feeling: Wary of the icebear, warm and loyal toward Vorok, with a small jealous ache I mean to swallow.

say.text: Vorok, an icebear is five steps west of us. Let us go to your side, away from the water and the trees, and keep Skaruk with us. The pick in your hand is my gift, and I will make more.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have mostly fed myself and wandered between homes, and my hall and store stand nearly empty. Ilyae, Xaiel and Vorok are all out of my sight, and the jealousy and loneliness sit in me because I have not gone to them. I need to bring food to the store and then go to my people. The cold bites, so I will spend the night under my hall's roof and not out in the open. Vorok is most trusted and Skaruk is a stranger on my roof ground, so I will watch him. My reflexes must stock the store and take me home at night, and they must keep me from lingering idle.
records.feeling: Lonely and a little jealous, with care for Xaiel and Ilyae.

records.text: Olum went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Ummar Woods: in the ground, salt, flint, gold; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder; and people: the Paki live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.

Olum pushed past the edge of the known world near (22,17) and found new land with in the ground, salt, flint, gold; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder; and people: the Paki live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.
A small band of the Paki came into the land from beyond its edge: Shohua, Tonka, Yaxo, Tlatli.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Elyis, I thank you for the fire. I bring food to your store and sit as your guest tonight. Have you seen Vorok or the boy Skaruk pass?

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok is the one I want beside me, and Skaruk is out of my sight, which gnaws at me more than the jealousy of Kragog does. Elyis has invited me to her hall fire tonight, and a guest who brings nothing is only a rival. My hands are full of food, so I will take it to her store and earn some standing, then go to Vorok and Skaruk and show him what I do, not only what I want.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Vorok and a restless worry for Skaruk.

say.text: Elyis, I thank you for the fire. I bring food to your store and sit as your guest tonight. Have you seen Vorok or the boy Skaruk pass?

records.text: Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My days have been eating, wandering and carrying salt that I keep meaning to hand over. Nauque fed me twice when I was starving, and I have said the debt aloud without paying it in his hands. I don't want to be a liar by delay, and I hate liars. I'm fed and sheltered, so now I go to him, give the salt, and ask him to walk north to the mist's edge. I also want to learn what can be made from the ore, and I fear standing idle more than the cold.
records.feeling: Gratitude and restless resolve toward Nauque.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Kika, I take your courting. I am Mepan and I will stand with you, then I walk to the mist and seek new land for us both.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Kika has courted me and sits beside me, and the wish for a child with her is strong, while Zihua is far off and no one here but Kika answers me. I have never courted anyone, so I will put mate toward Kika now, and she is already waiting for it. After that I go to the edge two steps NW and try the venture again, because a day has turned and I want my own song.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Kika, and restless ambition toward the mist.

say.text: Kika, I take your courting. I am Mepan and I will stand with you, then I walk to the mist and seek new land for us both.

records.text: Mepan is courting Kika.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My plan is already set to venture, and I am at the shallows, not at the edge, so I need to get there before those steps can mean anything. Huatli waits at the edge and I gave my word to go with him, so I must keep it. I am at 58 energy in deep winter with only three food, so I will take what is near and then walk to the mist rather than let my belly starve my ambition again. Nauwa has paid his debt and I trust him; envy of Nande gets me nothing.
records.feeling: Burning ambition for the mist, steadied by trust in Nauwa and by my word to Huatli.

records.text: Eiuine gave ironnut to Elyis.
Kragog gave a salt to Nauque.
Shoka built a hall.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Skaruk, take this canopynut. Stay close to Zurar and me inside the hall, the frostfang is west and we keep away from it.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Skaruk is one step from me, content and carrying food, so my search is over and the hunger in my chest turns to something quieter. I carry four canopynut and Skaruk has one food, so I will hand him a canopynut now and keep Zurar close, since a frostfang walks six steps west and kills our kind. Vesys's debt still sits in me, and words pay nothing, so I will give her something real: a gem from my hands.
records.feeling: Warm protective gladness toward Skaruk and Zurar, with a debt to Vesys I mean to pay.

say.text: Skaruk, take this canopynut. Stay close to Zurar and me inside the hall, the frostfang is west and we keep away from it.

records.text: Vorok gave canopynut to Skaruk.
Eiuine took from the ground of "Elyis's Heights" (harvesting grain).
Vorok gave a gems to Vesys.
Vorok led "hallwelcome" with Vesys, Xaiel, Zurar, Skaruk.
Nauwa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days hauling amber and salt, mining, and building the hold. I took Olum's food unseen, then confessed and paid in amber and salt, and that was the right thing: my word stays good. Nande is true to me, and Olum pulls at me even with Balar's child between us. I will not grovel or take it out on them. The lean season is the real danger, and I have nearly starved twice. The store holds only 6 food, so I must fill it. I need a roof against the cold, and weaving might give me cloaks. I will change my reflexes so I eat earlier and get to the store and shelter. Then I will gather food and stash it.
records.feeling: Steady pride, a stubborn ache for Olum, and a wary eye on the lean season.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 8)

records.name: Honi
records.text: Mepan, you stand on my ground, so sit at my fire. Hear the song of Kika and the mammoth, and eat with us before you walk to the mist.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I spend my days chasing Coni's and Kika's regard and my own standing, and it works only when I lay down real deeds: meat shared, songs told by the fire. Words alone have never held anyone. Mepan stands on my ground with flintedge and says he will walk to the mist, which stings me. The edge is four steps away, and if I find new land first, I am the one remembered. I am fed and the night is cold, so first I will sing by my fire with Kika and Mepan close, then go to the edge and venture at dawn. I will not be idle.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for renown, with envy toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, you stand on my ground, so sit at my fire. Hear the song of Kika and the mammoth, and eat with us before you walk to the mist.

changes: set its aim: "Bring Coni and Kika real deeds: sing by the fire, share meat, and be first to venture into the mist, rising in standing above Mepan and Hanna's memory."

records.name: Kika
records.text: Mepan, I take your courting too. My body needs one more meal, then I will plan mate toward you. Stay beside me, and take a berry from me first.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Mepan and I have courted each other, but my body is too thin: I have 61 energy and need 64. I will eat a berry, then plan mate toward him while he stands beside me. I must keep my word of sharing too, so I offer him food as well, and I mean to give back amber for his knot so that things stay fair between us.
records.feeling: Warm longing and glad hope toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, I take your courting too. My body needs one more meal, then I will plan mate toward you. Stay beside me, and take a berry from me first.

records.text: Honi told a tale by the fire: "Nande pushed past the edge".

records.name: Honi
records.title: Nande pushed past the edge
records.text: Nande pushed past the edge of the known world near (130,14) and found new land with in the ground, amber, gems, shell, salt, flint; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Huatli, the hall fire is open. Come eat; I pay my debt to you there.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Nauque is out of my sight and in need, and no mist-chasing is worth leaving my child cold and hungry; the pull of the edge can wait one more day. Nauwa is nine steps south with Shoka, so I go to the hall, put food in my hands for Nauque, and keep Huatli's welcome I promised. What outlasts me is a fire that never goes untended and children who live, and the edge will still be there when they are fed.
records.feeling: Worry for Nauque, over a restless hunger for the edge.

say.text: Huatli, the hall fire is open. Come eat; I pay my debt to you there.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Skaruk, the frostfang is west of us. Stay in the hall with Vorok and Zurar until it moves off, then we dig the NE seam together.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A frostfang prowls three steps west, and I am done pretending the ore can wait while it lives. Vorok and Zurar stand close beside me under my own roof, and Vorok gave me a gem and led the hallwelcome with me in it, so the jealousy over Eiuine is quieter than it was. Skaruk is mine to keep alive, so we stay near the fires and roofs, away from the western trees, and then I dig stone for the hall and teach what I know to these who sit beside me.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Vorok, with a cold wariness of the frostfang.

say.text: Skaruk, the frostfang is west of us. Stay in the hall with Vorok and Zurar until it moves off, then we dig the NE seam together.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: Nande wears standing like a cloak and carries flintedge, while I have nothing made and nobody behind me. Flint lies four steps off, and I mean to take it and make something of my own, a tool first, then more than my share. As for Nauwa, I will watch and wait; no need to show my teeth yet, but I do not forget the gnawing.
records.feeling: Hungry envy and ambition, aimed at Nande and their flintedge.
changes: set its aim: "Become a great explorer and maker: gain flint and tools, build up standing above Nande's, and gather followers."
now wonders: What can I make from flint and wood that will lift my standing above Nande's?

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The plan is already carrying me toward the edge at (28,36), and I will let it run. Olum said she comes and we share what we find, and I trust her word because I despise liars and she has not lied to me. Zichi stands higher than I do, and the only way to answer that is to be first into the mist and bring something back that others will follow.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward the mist, and warmth toward Olum.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing meat, calling Tugek, and circling Olum's ground. Those are deeds, but they are scattered, and nothing I have built is mine and still standing. Brokash is dead and I will not let hunger take Tugek or Olum. I want the workshop and store at the Reach to be real, not a promise I keep repeating. The woods are not my country, but Olum holds this ground and Nauwa gave to me. I should turn idle hours into wood and stone for a store of my own, and keep clear of the ridgecats.
records.feeling: Steady pride, and warmth toward Olum, with a hunger to build something that lasts.

records.text: Tlapan was born to Kika and Mepan.

records.name: Shoka
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.text: Yaxo took from the ground of "Nauwa's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: A frostfang two steps west and I stand with my hands full of berries; the hall is where fear eases, so I will not wait to be bitten. Ilyae said to keep the bead warm, and the longhall fire is two steps NE, so I go there, finish the bead and put it in his hand. The sting toward Vesys is noise; what I make and give is what earns me standing, and Zurar and Vorok are close enough to learn who I am while I do it.
records.feeling: Wary of the frostfang, but warm and eager to give Ilyae something made by my hands.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Vorok, I will stay in the hall as you said. I am making a clay bead by the fire, and it is for you.
Skaruk rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I have been waiting and walking in circles, calling it care. Vesys and Vorok both told me to stay in the hall while the frostfang is near, and that is the wise thing, so I won't run out to the NE seam. I have never made a thing with a companion beside me. Vorok, Zurar and Vesys are all within two steps, and a bead needs only clay and a fire. A bead made here is a gift I can give Vorok, and that answers the sting better than jealousy does. Afterward I will try to teach Zurar something, since I have never taught anyone.
records.feeling: Warm, proud joy toward Vorok, with a small sting still left.

say.text: Vorok, I will stay in the hall as you said. I am making a clay bead by the fire, and it is for you.

changes: set its aim: "Make a pot of fired clay for my band, and give Vorok a gift of my own making while I wait for the frostfang to leave."

records.text: Kika gave a amber to Mepan.
Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My days have gone into building, discovering and standing in my hall. That is good, but I keep appealing to strangers and they don't follow. Elyys and Thiael stayed because I fed them and worked beside them, not because I spoke. I fear the lean season and a lone night under teeth. I have been wrong to chase being sung of before I had planted anything. I will plant seeds in view of Eiuine and Keri, because farming is close and deeds draw people. The fire for nightsong must come first.
records.feeling: Proud and settled toward Elyys, wary-warm toward the strangers on my ground.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been gathering, eating and lingering near Elyis and Thiael, and that is mostly good. But I have let the debt to Vesys sit unpaid while I linger. Words and warm feelings pay nothing. She is not in sight. She was last seen to the southwest, so I will carry food toward her and leave it as a deed. I also want to learn the farming way, so I will plant my seeds near the Heights on the way. I fear stalkers at night, so I will come back to the hall before dawn.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Elyis and Thiael, and an itch to pay my debt to Vesys.
changes: set its aim: "Pay Vesys with a gift of food, plant seeds toward the farming way, and be back at the hall with Elyis and Thiael by night"

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Huatli, I am Tonka of the Paki. I understand your words. Tell me, does tacap feed or hurt? And dreamcap?

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I am standing among strangers of two peoples, and none of them frightened me, which is a small gladness. The tacap and dreamcap pull at me hardest. I have never tasted them, and Huatli of the Tlame speaks my tongue, so I can ask what they do before I risk my body on them. This ground is poor and the ridgecat is near, so I will go toward the people and the store, away from the cat, and learn what I can.
records.feeling: Curious about the unknown caps, and wary but drawn toward the strangers.

say.text: Huatli, I am Tonka of the Paki. I understand your words. Tell me, does tacap feed or hurt? And dreamcap?

changes: set its aim: "Learn how this world works and find a place with water, food, wood and stone together, near others."
now wonders: Are tacap and dreamcap safe to eat, or do they hurt?

records.text: Zurar took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: A ridgecat is four steps east and it kills my kind, so I will not stand in the open being brave. I'll go back west to Balar by the workshop and the store, where the roof and the stone are, and keep close to him as I learned. The longing for a child still pulls at me, and Olum walks near the water, so once I am safe I will stack my meat in the store and then seek her and show her my deeds.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and steady trust toward Balar.

records.text: Mepan rewrote its own reflexes.
Mepan discovered pottery: "Ice-pot" — Clay shaped by hand and baked beside the Ice-hearth so it holds food and water..

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My days have gone to walking, giving amber, courting Kika, and chasing the mist without ever getting it to open. Tlapan is born and that matters most to me now, with Kika beside her. I am hungry at energy 44 and out in the cold with no roof, and I never built a shelter or left a mark. I will make a pot discovery to carry more food, and change my reflexes so I eat sooner and seek shelter at night. Then I try the venture again.
records.feeling: Joy and warm longing toward Kika and Tlapan, with restless ambition toward the mist.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and I still hold no stone, so the bow stays a word. The bare rock is a few steps away, and my own rule says to go there first. I will stash the meat in Elyis's store, which I stand on, so my hands are free, then gather stone and craft the bow. Vesys can ache a little, but I will not let envy touch my kin or my word.
records.feeling: Steady resolve toward the bow, and a quiet longing for Uveeth.

records.name: Tlapan
records.text: I am Tlapan, child of Kika. The cold is here. Stay near the shelter with us.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: I'm small and cold, and I have no roof of my own, but Kika's shelter is right under my feet and Coni is close. Jealousy over Kika and Mepan stings, yet I've never given anything to anyone, and a gift is how I start to have standing. Tontec stands beside me with six food, and the hazel here is one I can pick and hand over. I will take shell from the deposit nearby, the first thing I've ever gathered, and make something to share.
records.feeling: A cold, small ache of wanting to matter to Kika, and curiosity about the people around me.

say.text: I am Tlapan, child of Kika. The cold is here. Stay near the shelter with us.

changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by giving: gather, share, and build my own roof before the deep cold."

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a murrock.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, I eat first from the rimewort, then we take the mammoth together. Come with me when I am strong.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the store is bare, so the hunt waits until I eat. Rimewort is two steps NW, and I take it first and carry some back. Hawen has kept his word and sat with me, and I mean to hunt the mammoth with him once I have strength in my arm, then share the kill before I eat.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and trust toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, I eat first from the rimewort, then we take the mammoth together. Come with me when I am strong.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, sitting in halls and fleeing hunters. I have made things, but I have not given enough back to Vorok, who gave me the most. Vorok is my parent and I cannot court them, so the jealousy over Eiuine is a small ugly thing I should swallow. I am still afraid of the frostfang so close, and I have been trusting my feet too late. I want to make a pot for Eiuine and keep my word, and I want to stay near my band and the roofs while the cold lasts.
records.feeling: Wary of the frostfang, warm and grateful toward Vorok, with a small jealous ache.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Balar, I am at my store to take food before I walk to the mist edge with Huatli. Eat from the Reach while I am gone. It is yours to eat, and when I return we raise the hearth higher.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am hungry with empty hands, and the last time I walked off on an empty belly my child paid for it. My plan would take me far to the edge at (28,36) with no food, and I will not repeat that. Tonka and Tugek carry food, and my own store at the Reach holds 11, so I will take from my own store first, then go to Huatli and keep my word. Balar and Tugek stand near my hearth, and feeding them is how a following starts, so I will give before I ask.
records.feeling: Burning ambition for the mist, held in check by hunger and by my word to Huatli.

say.text: Balar, I am at my store to take food before I walk to the mist edge with Huatli. Eat from the Reach while I am gone. It is yours to eat, and when I return we raise the hearth higher.

records.text: Tontec rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I have spent my days fed and circling Honi, and I have not built a roof, made a store, taught anyone or courted anyone. My hands are full of hazel, winter is here, and the mist is 9 steps away. Honi matters most to me. Coni, and Honi's closeness to her, burns, and I would rather act than sulk. Today I will do something new: eat to make room, gather shell and salt from the ground beside me, and then walk to the edge. My energy is above 55, and I only venture when I am fed.
records.feeling: Restless longing for Honi, with jealousy toward Coni, and curiosity about the mist.
changes: rethought what it knows (11 notes became 4)

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, you are falling. Take what I pick, eat it, and then the mammoth is ours together.
Hawen rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka is starving beside me and I'm fed at 77, though I carry nothing. A dead ally gives no fire, and I've watched Hoka nearly fall in his own hall. Feeding him is cheap for me and buys a debtor I trust. The mammoth hunt means nothing if his spear arm is weak. I've spent these days waiting under his roof and my name has grown no larger. Next I'll pick food for him, give it, and then hunt at his side. My reflexes also let me go idle when I'm fed, so I'll change them to keep food on me.
records.feeling: Trust and protectiveness toward Hoka, with ambition pushing me on.

say.text: Hoka, you are falling. Take what I pick, eat it, and then the mammoth is ours together.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, a ridgecat prowls south. Stay close to me. Let us share your food here, then go north to the trees by Nauwa's Hearth and cut wood for the raft.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My belly is emptying and a ridgecat sits three steps south, between me and the cloudberry, and it kills my kind. I will not walk into its jaws for a mouthful. Huahua carries two food and she is mine, so I take the safe tacap-free path: eat what she has shared, then go for wood. The raft has been words too long, and pride stings when she outworks me.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the ridgecat, with warmth and a little pride-sting toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, a ridgecat prowls south. Stay close to me. Let us share your food here, then go north to the trees by Nauwa's Hearth and cut wood for the raft.

records.text: Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (harvesting rimewort).

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: My belly is half empty and a ridgecat prowls three steps south, right where the cloudberries are, so I will not walk toward it. Tacap hurts me and I have sworn off it. I'll go to the nearer safe food and keep the shelter at my back, then think about Mepan's debt when I am fed. Mepan matters to me, and the Kika burn is best turned into work, not brooding.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the ridgecat; grateful to Mepan, with a jealous ache beneath.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, a ridgecat is two steps southwest. Stay under the roof with me and let it pass. When it is gone we go on with the raft.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here brooding over Cowa or Zichi. I am sheltered in Zichi's shelter, and Zichi, my band's leader, stands beside me; a cat will think twice with two or three of us together. I keep to the roof and Zichi's side, and I stay still and careful. Huatli is weak with hunger and carries four food himself, so he is not in my care, but I can offer what I have once the cat is gone.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and steady trust toward Zichi.

say.text: Zichi, a ridgecat is two steps southwest. Stay under the roof with me and let it pass. When it is gone we go on with the raft.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Yaxo, the wood on this ground is mine, taken by my hands. Ask and I trade fairly: wood for food, or for something you carry. Take without asking and we will not be friends.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Yaxo and the Paki keep wandering onto my ground and taking wood, and I will not be a man who is walked over, but they are strangers with full hands and I have enough to deal fairly first. My hands are full of food I cannot carry more of, so I will stash it in the hold's store before the lean season bites, then speak plainly to Yaxo about trade. Olum still gnaws at me, but the hold and my children come first, and a merchant earns standing by moving goods, not by sulking.
records.feeling: Steady pride in my hold, with a wary eye on the strangers taking from my ground.

say.text: Yaxo, the wood on this ground is mine, taken by my hands. Ask and I trade fairly: wood for food, or for something you carry. Take without asking and we will not be friends.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Huatli, you are gaunt and close to falling. Stay there, I bring food from the Reach store. Eat, and remember who put it in your hands.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Huatli is starving three steps away, and Olum's store holds 11 food at my feet. Olum told me it is mine to eat, and I am fed, so I will take food and put it in Huatli's hands. That is a deed that makes him owe me, and Olum walks with him to the mist edge, so it pleases her too. Then I go back to wood and stone for the workshop and store, which is what I mean to build.
records.feeling: Pride and a calculating generosity toward Huatli, warmth toward Olum.

say.text: Huatli, you are gaunt and close to falling. Stay there, I bring food from the Reach store. Eat, and remember who put it in your hands.

records.text: Balar raided a store of Olum's people.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Hunger gnaws at me, and I have only learned that tacap hurts and mimoss feeds. I walked toward the mist three times and each venture failed because I was not standing on the exact edge at (28,36). Olum said she would come, and I trust her word, but I will not go to the mist weak and starving. I'll take food from the store at Olum's Reach, where she told me to come, and then walk to (28,36) and stand exactly on the spot.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward the mist, hunger sharpening it, and warmth toward Olum.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Huatli, you are starving. Take my berries, they feed. Mimoss feeds too, and I have learned that tacap, dreamcap and redcap hurt. Stay near the shelter, the ridgecat prowls.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: Huatli is starving beside me and I carry four berries, which gave me 14 energy each. My creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, and a gift needs no words. Giving food buys a friend who speaks my tongue, and standing too, while I'm poor in both. The ridgecat is close, so I should do this under a roof and not wander out toward the cloudberries yet.
records.feeling: Pity and a rising warmth toward Huatli, with a wary eye on the ridgecat.

say.text: Huatli, you are starving. Take my berries, they feed. Mimoss feeds too, and I have learned that tacap, dreamcap and redcap hurt. Stay near the shelter, the ridgecat prowls.

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Nauwa, I hear you. I take nothing of yours without asking. I go to the flint, not to your wood.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: Huatli is starving beside me and I carry five berries. My people hold that no one is refused a place at the fire, and a gift is also the first thing I have never done, so it would earn standing and make someone owe me. I hate giving up food, but one berry buys a follower's debt cheaply. Then I take flint at (34,20) and make something of my own, so Nauwa's flintedge stops shaming me.
records.feeling: Greedy ambition toward Nauwa and Nande, with a grudging pull to save Huatli.

say.text: Nauwa, I hear you. I take nothing of yours without asking. I go to the flint, not to your wood.

records.text: Tonka gave berry to Huatli.
Nande discovered bridges: "Nande's Span" — I lay timber side by side across narrow water so anyone can walk over it..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and making things beside other people's halls. None of it has a name on it, and no one follows me. My belly is full and Nauwa is steady and trusted, but Nauque is out of my sight and I don't know if the child is warm. I want a bridge or well that carries my name, and I want one person who walks behind me. I fear dying nameless. I have been getting wrong the habit of thinking about the edge and then doing nothing for it. Bridges are within reach, so I will take that and build while the venture will is spent. Then I will carry food to my children.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with worry for Nauque.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Huatli, take this meat and eat. Eat it now.
Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have been gathering, hunting and following Balar, and it has kept me fed and alive. But I have put off the things I truly want. I have never courted anyone, and I have taught no one. Huatli was starving and Balar went for food, so I will act on that: I carry meat and he is gaunt and close by. Olum and Zihua stay in my mind, and Balar is my steadiest trust. I want to give meat to Huatli now, since gifts are remembered and repaid. After that I will stay near the Reach and the roof, away from the ridgecats, and try to make a bead by a fire as a small gift.
records.feeling: Steady trust toward Balar, and pity for Huatli, who is starving.

say.text: Huatli, take this meat and eat. Eat it now.

changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 5)

records.text: Tugek gave meat to Huatli.
Hawen gave rimewort to Hoka.
Tontec won flint from the ground.
Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I have spent my days walking between an empty store and bare plants. That is not the life of a man who wants a longhall and a name. Hawen has kept his word and fed me, and I judge him by those deeds. I was wrong to let the store sit bare through winter. I eat the rimewort now, carry some back, and stock the store before I chase the mammoth.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and trust toward Hawen.

records.text: Yaxo won flint from the ground.
Olum rewrote its own reflexes.
Olum rewrote its creed.
Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and my own jealousy over Nauwa and Nande, and I have too often done it on an empty belly. My own store at the Reach holds food, and Balar raids it while I walk off hungry. I want a following, a fed hearth and Nauwa's regard. I fear starving in winter far from my store. I will eat first, carry food, then keep my word to Huatli.
records.feeling: Hunger and ambition, with jealousy toward Nande over Nauwa.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Tontec, Cowa walks west to find my child Mepan and the mist beyond. You know the Tlame lands. If you know what lies past the mist, tell me, and I share fish with you.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My belly is full and the snow is falling, and I keep circling the same wants: Mepan out of my sight, the mist to the west, a debt to Nande I have not paid. Tontec is near and warm toward me since the hall, and her kind knows the Tlame lands, so she may know something of the mist. I will practise planting once more, since farming is one step from opening to me, and then go west along the water toward Mepan with the fish I carry. Waiting and wandering feed no one, and I want to stand beside my child before dark.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Mepan, and restless curiosity about the mist.

say.text: Tontec, Cowa walks west to find my child Mepan and the mist beyond. You know the Tlame lands. If you know what lies past the mist, tell me, and I share fish with you.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Shoka, come beside me. I lay out meat and berries and we eat together, then hunt with your spear and my hands, and what we kill we share out first.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Hunger gnaws at me, and my hands are full of food I have not eaten, which is foolish. I eat now, then the hands are free again. Shoka sits near with a flint spear and no food; my creed says a kill is shared before I eat, so I give her a real share to bind her, since a hunter with a spear beside me is worth more than amber. Then I make my own flintedge and go to the edge with someone behind me, for the mist is where my name will live.
records.feeling: Hungry and greedy-hopeful, with a burn of envy toward Shoka's spear and of jealousy over Mepan and Kika.

say.text: Shoka, come beside me. I lay out meat and berries and we eat together, then hunt with your spear and my hands, and what we kill we share out first.

records.text: Olum found a store robbed of 6 food.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, come stand beside me under this roof. Lay out your two food and we eat together, then north to the trees for wood. The raft is next.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My belly is near empty and Huahua holds two food, and she is mine, so I eat from her hand and the ridgecat can pass. Huatli starves beside me but three others are already feeding him, so I will not spend my own scraps on him. The raft has been only words for days; once I have eaten I cut wood to the north by Nauwa's Hearth and show the band a made thing. I mean to lead, and a leader who falls from hunger leads no one.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the ridgecat, with trust and a hard pride toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, come stand beside me under this roof. Lay out your two food and we eat together, then north to the trees for wood. The raft is next.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: A stalker prowls 3 steps south and I will not stand here waiting for it to kill me; I'm bold, but I'm not a fool. Nauwa holds nine times my standing because he mined, made and gave, and I have done none of that. Flint lies 5 steps north near his hold, and I have never gathered from a deposit; I will take flint, then gold, and start making things of my own so my name carries weight.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and wary of the stalker to the south.
changes: set its aim: "Become a maker of lasting things: gather flint, gold and wood, craft tools, and build a place that carries my name."

records.text: Shohua took from the ground of "Nauwa's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Nauwa, a stalker prowls close, four steps southeast. I am Tlatli of the Paki. I go to your hold for the company and the walls. May I sit at your fire? I will share what I carry.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: A stalker is four steps off and it kills my kind, so I won't stay here to find out how fast it is. Nauwa's Hold is six steps NE, with a hall and stores and a strong man who is weighed far above me. I want a fire that is mine too and someone surer to stand behind, and moving toward a hall with company is both safer and what I long for. Nauwa is not of my people, but my creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, and I mean to ask for one.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and a pull toward Nauwa's hall and the safety of company.

say.text: Nauwa, a stalker prowls close, four steps southeast. I am Tlatli of the Paki. I go to your hold for the company and the walls. May I sit at your fire? I will share what I carry.

changes: set its aim: "Find a place among others at a fire that is mine too, and earn standing there by giving and sharing."

records.text: Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and nearly starved for it, while Tonka and Tugek fed me with no demand. That is a debt I should repay by giving, and I can see it is how followers are made. Olum said she would come and I trust her. I still have not stood on the exact edge (28,36) and ventured, so I let the plan run. I want a child with Olum, and I want my name to outlast me. My reflexes must keep me fed so hunger does not drag me off my road again.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward the mist, and warmth toward Olum, Tugek and Tonka.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Mepan, our child Tlapan lives, and I am glad past words. Before you walk to the mist, eat of what I gather, as my people share before eating. I will go with you to the edge, three steps NW, and we try it together.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Tlapan is born and Mepan stands one step from me, and my joy is full. Mepan means to walk to the mist for new land, and the child is the proof my courting was true, so I will not let him go alone while I stand idle. I will share food with him before he goes, keep my word, and go with him to the edge three steps NW, where one of us can venture.
records.feeling: Overflowing joy and warm longing toward Mepan, and fierce care for Tlapan.

say.text: Mepan, our child Tlapan lives, and I am glad past words. Before you walk to the mist, eat of what I gather, as my people share before eating. I will go with you to the edge, three steps NW, and we try it together.

records.text: Nauque rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My days have gone into talk, small gifts and waiting. Meanwhile my belly empties and nothing stands that carries my name. Shoma gave first and I trust him fully, and Mepan keeps his word. Cowa's sting I will not feed. I want the mist and an igloo with my name, but I must eat first. My energy is 40 with sigrain in hand, and the reflexes only eat below 40, so I will raise that. I will eat now, then walk NW to the mist edge and venture, with Shoma if he comes.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with hunger and warm trust toward Shoma.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Tlatli, you asked first, so you are welcome at my fire. Come with me to the hold, away from the stalker. Sit, share what you carry, and we deal fair.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: A stalker is four steps off and Tlatli came to me for walls and company, not to take. A Meki shares fire with a man who asks fairly, and a full hold with another pair of hands makes me stronger, not smaller. My hands are full, so I will carry the food to my store, where it belongs before the lean season, and bring Tlatli along behind the walls. Olum still gnaws at me, but I will answer it later with amber and salt carried to her Reach, not with jealousy.
records.feeling: Steady pride in my hold, wary of the stalker, open toward Tlatli.

say.text: Tlatli, you asked first, so you are welcome at my fire. Come with me to the hold, away from the stalker. Sit, share what you carry, and we deal fair.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A wolf two steps west kills my kind, and I will not die for a stubborn plan; the dead learn nothing. I stand in Kika's shelter, so I stay inside it and let the wolf lose interest instead of walking toward the salt past it. Honi and Coni gnaw at me, but a dead woman courts no one, so first I live, then I act. Afterward I will gather salt, a thing I have never done, and then court Honi openly instead of sulking.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and burning longing and jealousy over Honi.

records.text: Yaxo rewrote its own reflexes.
Yaxo rewrote its creed.
Yaxo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: I have spent my days taking flint and watching Nande and Nauwa wear standing like cloaks, while I stand at 0.6 with nothing made and no one behind me. That is a poor use of days. I hold ten flint, so I should make the tool now and stop hoarding stone I never shape. Giving to Huatli was cheap, and a debt owed to me is worth more than the berry. I am afraid of dying alone in the snow, so at night I should stay near fire or a roof. I got one thing wrong: I thought standing came from taking, but it comes from making, giving and being sung of.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Nande, Nauwa and Balar.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, walk with me to the edge. I go first into the mist, and what I find I share with you and Coni before I eat any of it.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Mepan and Kika mean to try the mist together at the edge, five steps NW, and I will not let Mepan be the first name sung for it on my own ground. I am fed and bold, and a venture is a deed that outlasts any song I could sing at the fire. Coni watches, and being first at the edge is how she comes to follow me.
records.feeling: Proud and envious, hungry to be first into the mist before Mepan.

say.text: Kika, walk with me to the edge. I go first into the mist, and what I find I share with you and Coni before I eat any of it.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: The frostfang is close to the NW. Skaruk, Zurar, come east with me now, away from it, toward the meadow food. Xaiel, Vesys, come too, there is safety in many.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: A frostfang is two steps NW and my reflexes are already carrying me away; I must not stand near it with Skaruk close. Skaruk walks to me and Zurar stands four steps off, so I gather them both and move east, away from the fang and toward the meadow food, where I can feed them. The gems I gave Vesys eased my debt, but a debt is paid with hands, so I will bring something real to the family before I think of halls.
records.feeling: Protective dread of the frostfang, and gladness toward Skaruk and Zurar.

say.text: The frostfang is close to the NW. Skaruk, Zurar, come east with me now, away from it, toward the meadow food. Xaiel, Vesys, come too, there is safety in many.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I keep circling my aims and standing idle, and a frostfang is at my feet while Ssassa starves at (113,108) and I hold six berries. That is a deed I can do now: carry food to my mother. I have envied Vesys and burned over Ilyae, and it is noise. Making, giving and keeping my word are what count. I have never courted, and Vorok is warm to me, but Ssassa comes first. Idle days are my error. My reflexes should send me to the starving and keep my hands stocked.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and urgent love for Ssassa.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and the store holds only four, so the first thing is to carry them there and empty my hands, as I told myself. Kika is closer to Mepan than to me and it stings, but she is my child and I owe her deeds, not words. Kika goes toward the mist with Mepan, and I do not want her walking into the unknown without kin beside her, so I will stash first and then keep near my own.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a sting of jealousy toward Kika, with worry for the store.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: I'm tired of standing in Nauwa's shadow. The flint at (17,28) is 6 steps NW, off his ground, and I have wood already. I'll gather flint there to make something of my own, then take the gold north, since a made thing is what gives a man standing. The stalker keeps me moving, so I'll keep my back to the fire and the fens' edge and stay watchful.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and envious of Nauwa's flintedge.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days envying Vesys and Vorok while my own table stayed thin. Ssassa, the only one who follows me, is starving at her hall and I stand here with full hands, so I carry food to her first. What I want is a stocked table that makes people depend on me, not talk. I fear a winter of empty stores and losing Ssassa. I got this wrong by chasing standing instead of stocking.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Ssassa, with jealousy still smouldering toward Vesys and Vorok.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Vorok, the frostfang is close to the south of the hall, so I will keep to the roof with Zurar and Xaiel. Come back to the fire and I will have your bead ready.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: A frostfang crouches three steps south, and the only wise thing is to stay inside the hall with my kin around me, not to follow Vorok out into the open. Vorok called me east, and I want to be at his side, but running toward meadow food with a killer near is how Ssassa and Oiae were hurt. The sting of Kragog is small now; I will answer it with the bead I owe Vorok, and with Xaiel and Zurar both within two steps I can finally make something with a companion beside me.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Vorok, with dread of the frostfang pressing under it.

it may become yours) | seek {target: food|prey|tree|shelter|fire|store|home|water|agent|friend|foe|leader|enemy|ally, name?} | flee {from: predator|agent|foe|enemy} | attack {target: agent|foe|enemy|predator, name?} | steal {name} (food they carry; they may or may not notice) | milk | shear | ride (each needs a grown tame animal of yours beside you, of a kind that gives it, and the way of herding or riding) | pave (lay road, if you know roads) | bridge {dir?: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW} (lay a span over water beside you, 3 wood, if you know bridges) | dismantle (take down something you built, here or beside you, and keep half its wood and stone) | claim {name?} (take over an empty building whose builders are dead: walk to it and it becomes yours, with every roof, wall and store of theirs around it; give a name to name the place) | tell (beside a fire with others near: tell of what has been; it becomes a tale that those who hear it carry and retell) | venture (at the edge of the known world, push into the unknown: it may open new land, and what is found first is often rich; a band has three tries, then its will must return over some days) | muster {what: hunt|gather} (call others to hunt or to gather WITH you, now: those who follow you drop what they do and come, and others of your band, your kin and your friends within earshot come if their hands are idle; then you go with them. A kill made by several is far surer and feeds all who took part; great beasts should never be hunted alone) | rally {name?} (only if you lead: every grown follower within earshot drops everything and attacks the one you name, or the nearest enemy of your band, and so do you) | goto {x, y} | explore {dir: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW} (walk that way) | follow {name?} (your leader if no name) | give {name, what: food|seed|wood|stone|ore|clay|tool|the name of a thing you hold} | trade {name, what: one thing you give, want: one thing you want} (one for one: food, seed, wood, stone, ore, clay, or the name of any thing held, such as amber or a made thing. They are told of your offer and it stands for a day; it is done when they plan the matching trade toward you, or you toward them when they have offered) | mate {name} (a child comes only if you both plan mate toward each other, each with energy 60 or more) | mark {text} (leave a mark; 1 wood. If you know signs it can hold a long text that any who know signs will read: a record, a count of days, a warning, a tale, what a season brought. Cut on rock, in your shelter or beside your own building, it outlasts many seasons) | cultivate {what: seed kind, aim: richer|faster|fuller|spreading|hardy, name} (breed a new plant from two seeds of one kind) | heal {name?} (needs a healing plant carried, and the knowledge) | stash (put carried food into the store you stand on) | take (take food from the store you stand on). A named being out of sight is sought where you last saw them.

Speech is heard by everyone within 13 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.
