records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, take these berries from Keri as a gift. I stash for Elyis's fire, then I go east to find Uveeth.
Keri rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I have spent days circling the same ground, carrying food and meaning to give it, while Uveeth is far east and out of my sight. Thiael is two steps from me and I trust him wholly, yet my debt to him is still unpaid. Elyis's store is two steps away and I have never stashed in it, so I will do that now. That frees my hands and earns me a place at her fire. Then I will give Thiael berries and head east for Uveeth at first light. I am too much alone with my own wondering, and I have never tasted canopynut or mimoss, so I will pick canopynut on the way.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Thiael and a wish to pay my debt to him and to Elyis.

say.text: Thiael, take these berries from Keri as a gift. I stash for Elyis's fire, then I go east to find Uveeth.

changes: set its aim: "Stash food at Elyis's store, give to Thiael, then go east to find Uveeth."

records.text: Skaruk led "hallwelcome" with Xaiel, Zurar.
Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (hunting).

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Nauwa, I come to your hold as you bade me. I carry berries and will share them at your fire. Redcap and tacap hurt me, so do not eat them.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Nauwa gave me a place at his fire, and I will take it before the stalker or the cold finds me. I have been eating things that hurt me, so I will keep to berries, which I know feed, and bring what I carry to the hold to share, as I promised. I want to earn standing by giving, not by taking, and by speaking true.
records.feeling: Relief and a little fear, with a pull toward Nauwa's fire.

say.text: Nauwa, I come to your hold as you bade me. I carry berries and will share them at your fire. Redcap and tacap hurt me, so do not eat them.

changes: set habits: refuses redcap, tacap, dreamcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Nande
records.text: Tlatli, you are welcome at this fire. I am Nande of the Pesi, and no one is turned from a fire of mine. Sit, eat, and keep the stalker's side of the door shut.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, and still nothing here carries my name. Nauque is out of my sight and that gnaws at me more than the mist does. Tlatli and Yaxo are strangers at Nauwa's fire, and my people's creed says no one is refused a place, so I will make the hall welcome real and let it count for something. Then I will build one thing that outlasts me, a span near the water, before the light fails.
records.feeling: Restless pride and worry for Nauque, with a settled warmth toward Nauwa.

say.text: Tlatli, you are welcome at this fire. I am Nande of the Pesi, and no one is turned from a fire of mine. Sit, eat, and keep the stalker's side of the door shut.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Zichi, you are gaunt. Take this food from my hand and eat now. Remember who fed you.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Zichi is starving beside me and my hands are full of food, so a gift now is a deed that binds, and it costs me little. Huatli ate and Tugek fed him, so Zichi is the one who needs it now. After that I turn the idle hours to wood and stone for the Reach workshop, and I watch the ridgecat to the NE and keep close to Tugek and the shelter.
records.feeling: Pride and calculating generosity toward Zichi, with watchfulness against the ridgecat.

say.text: Zichi, you are gaunt. Take this food from my hand and eat now. Remember who fed you.

records.name: Tlapan
records.text: A wolf is close to the west. Stay by the shelter, Tontec. I will pick hazel and give it to you.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: A wolf is three steps west and it kills; I am small, so I must not stand here hoping. Honi and Tontec are beside me and the shelter is under my feet, so I stay near them. I have never given anything to anyone, and the hazel beside me is the first thing I can hand over. Tontec carries no food now, so a gift of hazel to her would be my first, and it might earn me some standing.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and a small hungry wish to matter to Tontec and Kika.

say.text: A wolf is close to the west. Stay by the shelter, Tontec. I will pick hazel and give it to you.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I am starving at 25 energy, and the ridgecats are west, so I will not go that way. Cloudberry with 3 food sits six steps SE, and tacap, which hurts me, is nearer but useless. Frostcap and frostmoss lie just beyond it, so I'll pick cloudberry, eat, and carry what is left. Mepan's debt waits until my belly is full, and a hungry creature repays nothing.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary, with a quiet ache of gratitude toward Mepan.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nande, Tlatli is at my fire; keep the hold and the children. Zihua starves to the NE, so I take food to them and then carry amber and salt to Olum's Reach to trade.
Nauwa discovered weaving: "Meki fibre-binding" — Twist and bind fibre and wool into baskets that carry more and cloaks against the cold..
Nauwa has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My days have gone to hoarding food and salt and guarding wood, and my hold is sound. But a merchant's name comes from carrying goods between settlements, not from sitting beside a full store. Nande is a true friend, and Tlatli asked fairly, so I will keep them at my fire. Olum gnaws at me, but Olum's Reach is also where my amber and salt can earn standing, so I will go there. Zihua is starving at (48,11) and is mine. I must carry food to them and not leave a follower to die. I will weave fibre into cloaks and baskets so I can carry more, which helps a merchant.
records.feeling: Proud of my hold, and uneasy for Zihua, who starves.

say.text: Nande, Tlatli is at my fire; keep the hold and the children. Zihua starves to the NE, so I take food to them and then carry amber and salt to Olum's Reach to trade.

changes: set its aim: "Feed Zihua, Shoka and Nauque, then carry amber and salt to Olum's Reach to trade and rise as a merchant, while the hold's store stays full."

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I lay out my two food now. Eat with me, then we go north together for wood.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days following Zichi and cutting wood, and I have kept my word. It is a good way to live, but the jealousy over Cowa still stings whenever I stand idle. Zichi, Zihua and Huatli are all starving beside me, and I carry two food. My creed says a share goes out before I eat, so I will lay out a sharing with Zichi right now. That is giving, not brooding, and it answers the ache better than waiting does. Then we go north for wood, staying close together because of the ridgecats.
records.feeling: Compassion for the starving ones, and steady trust toward Zichi.

say.text: Zichi, I lay out my two food now. Eat with me, then we go north together for wood.

records.text: Cowa found the stone "Tlama's Rest".

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: My hands are full and I'm at 61, so I'll eat first, then see to Hoka. The mammoth I killed gave me 11 meat, and I should have that deed stand in Hoka's hall where it is seen. The edge is eleven steps south and my name is still on nothing; I will go to it now, fed and with Hoka's debt paid, and try the mist.
records.feeling: Driven ambition, with steady trust toward Hoka.

records.name: Olum
records.text: My store at the Reach was robbed of six food. What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given. Whoever took it, bring it back to my store, and I will not forget who did.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My store was emptied again and I stand hungry with empty hands. I will not walk to the mist on an empty belly, whatever Huatli waits for. Tugek and Tonka carry food, and Balar carries six and calls my store his to eat from. Anger burns in me, but fed comes first: the tacap at (46,15) hurts me, so the frostmoss SE is the nearest safe food, and the murrock NE can be hunted with company.
records.feeling: Hungry anger at whoever robbed my store, and jealousy over Nauwa.

say.text: My store at the Reach was robbed of six food. What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given. Whoever took it, bring it back to my store, and I will not forget who did.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: I carry twelve flint and nothing made from it, and Balar's handaxe and Nande's flintedge sit in my mind like thorns. I could not craft the flintedge because I do not know how, so I need to learn by watching or by making what I can: a workshop takes 5 wood and 2 stone, and I have 6 wood, so I only lack stone. A workshop would be mine, a thing that outlasts me, and tools made beside it last longer. The ridgecat 5 steps NE kills my kind, and the snow and coming night press on me, so I keep away from it and go to the bare rock to the southwest, gather stone, and build there on my own ground.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Balar and Nande, with wariness of the ridgecat.

records.text: Zichi rewrote its own reflexes.
Zichi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I nearly starved two days ago, and the raft is still only words. I have been circling food and waiting while Huahua carries my weight. Mepan is far off, last seen long ago, and that sits badly with me. I want the raft, the new land and a flintedge made there, so I will stop idling and cut wood. Zihua is starving beside me, but my creed says take what I need and give where it buys a following. A scrap of food would bind him cheaply, but I carry none. I will eat with Huahua, then go to the trees and cut. My reflexes should also keep me stocked with food and moving toward wood instead of lingering.
records.feeling: Hard pride and restless impatience, with trust toward Huahua.

records.text: Hawen gave rimewort to Hoka.
Tonka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I have spent these days tasting and asking and giving. The giving to Huatli felt right, and it is the only thing I did that made a friend. Tacap, dreamcap and redcap hurt, so my curiosity about them is answered. This ground has no food, a ridgecat prowls it, and winter is closing in. I have never gathered wood or stone, and I need both to build and to learn tools. I will stay near the roofs and the people, gather wood from the forest I stand on, and then go to the amber 2 steps away. I will keep my reflexes mostly as they are, but make them run from the ridgecat sooner and seek shelter when I am hungry.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Huatli, and wariness of the ridgecat.
changes: rethought what it knows (4 notes became 5)
now wonders: Do nafrostcap and cloudberry feed or hurt once they bear?

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Olum, I am Tugek. I did not take your store. Take this meat and eat. It is given freely from my hand.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: A ridgecat is three steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stay where I stand. Olum and Zihua are starving and I carry three meat, and I will not let them fall while my hands are full, as I did not let Huatli fall. Olum's store was robbed and she has not forgotten, so I will give openly and let her see I take nothing that is hers. Balar is my leader and I trust him, and the child I want must wait until the cat is gone and the hungry are fed.
records.feeling: Pity for the starving Olum and Zihua, and wary dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Olum, I am Tugek. I did not take your store. Take this meat and eat. It is given freely from my hand.

records.text: Tonka took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (digging clay).

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I hold one rimewort, so I must eat before any dream of halls or jealousy. Snow is falling and night comes soon, so I will eat what grows near my hall, bring some home to my bare store, and rest under my own roof. When the cold eases I will go find Xaiel and Ilyae, for the loneliness is worse than the hunger.
records.feeling: Hungry and lonely, with a quiet ache toward Ilyae and Xaiel.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, you took the mammoth on my ground, and by my people's way the kill is shared out before any eats. You fed me when I fell, and I do not forget it. Stay beside me; I have something to ask of you.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hawen fed me when I was falling and killed the mammoth on my ground, and I judge him by those deeds: he is the one I trust, and the one I think of when I want a child. My belly is fair now and the store holds only 4, and I want a name that outlasts me, not just a full belly. I will go to him, offer to share the kill as my people hold, and court him, because a child would be something made that carries my name.
records.feeling: Longing and trust toward Hawen, with pride pushing me to make something that outlasts me.

say.text: Hawen, you took the mammoth on my ground, and by my people's way the kill is shared out before any eats. You fed me when I fell, and I do not forget it. Stay beside me; I have something to ask of you.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Vorok is out in the open with the frostfang near, and my jealousy of Kragog is smaller than my wish to see him come back whole. My belly is emptying and food is 7 steps SE, but the frostfang is 11 steps SE too, so I won't walk that way. I will stay by the fire, finish the clay bead for Vorok, and let the hall and my kin keep me safe until the beast moves off.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Vorok, with dread of the frostfang under it.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Zurar, I have sat by your fire and watched your goldpick take shape. I would have a child with you. If your heart says the same, name me in your plan now, and I name you.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: The jealousy over Ilyae burns, but I have turned it over enough times; it is noise, and Zurar stands three steps away, strong and glad, and I have never courted anyone. I carry six berries and my plan carries them to Ssassa, but Ssassa is far and the frostfang prowls, so I will court Zurar here beside the longhall fire while I have energy over 60, then go. If Zurar plans mate toward me, a child begins; if not, I have learned how courting answers.
records.feeling: Longing toward Zurar, with a stubborn jealousy toward Vesys and Ilyae I mean to ignore.

say.text: Zurar, I have sat by your fire and watched your goldpick take shape. I would have a child with you. If your heart says the same, name me in your plan now, and I name you.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: I stand inside Nauwa's Hold and the fear has loosened, but Olum is starving with empty hands and I carry four berries. My creed says no one is refused a place at a fire, so I will give before I eat, even though I am hungry and cold myself. Giving is how I earn standing, and Olum's hunger is hard to look away from.
records.feeling: Compassion for Olum, with warmth toward Nauwa's hold and some fear of the cold.

records.text: Zihua was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Zihua was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Olum. I did not take your store, and my word is good. You are weak. I come to you now, and I court you. Eat, then we walk to the mist together.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Olum stands starving beside me, gaunt and furious, and she is the one I want a child from and the one who said she would walk to the mist with me. Tonka and Tugek fed me when I starved, and a debt like that is paid with a deed. I have no food, but Tonka carries two and the Reach store holds five, so I will go to Olum, court her, and get her fed before we walk to the edge at (28,36). The ridgecat to the north is close, so I move south, away from it, and toward the people.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Olum, with a prickle of dread at the ridgecat.

say.text: Olum. I did not take your store, and my word is good. You are weak. I come to you now, and I court you. Eat, then we walk to the mist together.

records.text: Zihua was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My days have gone to wandering, fleeing and chasing after Mepan, and I have wasted the fed hours. Mepan is my heart, and I feel the sting that she is nearer to Kika, but I mean to answer it by being beside her, not by resenting her. I am one planting short of farming and have never built anything, so I will practise those while I am close to Hoka's hall. I also want the mist, but I will go there fed and with company, not alone.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan, with a small jealous ache toward Kika.

records.text: Hoka is courting Hawen.
Cowa took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (harvesting cloudberry).
Tlatli gave berry to Olum.
Tlatli led "sharing" with Olum, Tugek, Huatli, Tonka.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Tugek, I am starving. You said your meat is given freely, so I come to take it. I pay my debts, and I will remember this.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is empty and my store is empty, and Tugek stands three steps off saying he gave me meat freely. I take what I need, so I will go to him and eat what he offers before I do anything else. After that I will watch Balar, who carries six food and has been taking from my ground, and I will not let him think I am soft.
records.feeling: Hungry anger at the thief of my store, and wary need toward Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, I am starving. You said your meat is given freely, so I come to take it. I pay my debts, and I will remember this.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Xaiel, my heart leans the same way, and I will not lie to you. Winter is thin and I carry no food, and a child must be fed. Let me fill my hands first, then I will name you in my plan and keep my word.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Xaiel asks for a child, and I want one, but a child costs 25 energy and must be fed and warmed through winter, and I carry no food while the plants wither. I am fed and sheltered with a store nearby, so the want is honest, but my creed says I am careful and my word is good, so I will not name Xaiel in a plan unless I can keep that child alive. Desire for Ilyae still gnaws, yet Xaiel is warm, near, and has offered plainly. I will answer Xaiel truthfully, gather food first, and court when I have enough to feed it.
records.feeling: Warm and torn between longing for a child with Xaiel and caution about winter, with a small ache over Ilyae.

say.text: Xaiel, my heart leans the same way, and I will not lie to you. Winter is thin and I carry no food, and a child must be fed. Let me fill my hands first, then I will name you in my plan and keep my word.

changes: set its aim: "Feed myself and a future child through the cold, give Eiuine her pot, and keep clear of the frostfang."

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Curiosity burns hardest: mimoss grows two steps from me bearing food, and rimewort is not far off, and I have never tasted either. I am fed and sheltered with a store beside me, so a small taste is a fair risk, and I'll eat while the frostfang is ten steps off and I can run. Then I will dig the ore seam three steps away for the hall, and keep my jealousy over Eiuine and Vorok from driving my hands.
records.feeling: Hungry curiosity about mimoss and rimewort, with a warm glow toward Vorok and a quiet wariness of the frostfang.

records.text: Zihua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: A stalker is one step south and has already bitten me twice. I was caught alone in the open at night, away from fire and roof, which is what has happened to others too. I have to get under a roof now. Nande's Hall is one step NW and a shelter is three steps SE, so I'll run for the hall. My reflexes need to make me flee and shelter before I rest, because my plan just keeps me standing in the open. Mepan's debt and the Kika jealousy can wait until I am alive and warm.
records.feeling: Terrified of the stalker at my back.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stand and wonder. Balar is five steps south and a kill goes surer beside him, so I go to him now. Olum has my meat and her fury will cool if I keep my word; I did not rob her store. When I am safe I want to give Zihua deeds, not asking, and learn whether Balar leads well in a hunt.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the ridgecat, and pity and warmth toward Olum.

records.text: Ilyae gave frostmoss to Ssassa.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have been alone too long, and the ache is worse than hunger. My hands are full, so I will take the berries to the cave and shelter at (166,69), which is close and is Keri's work, then wait for the band to come back to the roof. Thiael has fed me and I have given him nothing yet; I will bring him berries with my own hands and say nothing of it until they are in his palm.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and warmth and debt toward Thiael and Keri.

records.text: Tlatli rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: I have spent these days running from beasts and giving what I carry, and it has warmed me. Giving berries to Olum eased me, and the sharing meal fed us both. Olum, Balar and the others are strangers, but they did not turn on me. I fear the ridgecat 2 steps NW, and my reflexes do not yet keep me from walking toward food while a hunter is near. I want a fire that is mine too, so I will stay near the people at the Reach and bring food back to share. I will go for the frostmoss to the SE, away from the cat and toward the grass. I must not eat redcap or tacap, and I must be quick before hunger bites.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and warm compassion for Olum.
changes: rethought what it knows (3 notes became 4)

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Olum is starving close by and I carry one ironnut, enough to put real strength back in him. My creed says a share goes out before I eat, and giving costs me little while Zichi stays near. I will take the nut to Olum and give it, which also tests what the Kragrek do when given a gift without words. The jealousy over Cowa can sit quiet while my hands are doing something good.
records.feeling: Compassion for Olum, with a steady trust in Zichi and a dull ache of jealousy underneath.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Olum, eat. Take my berries, they feed. Stay near the others, the ridgecat is close.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: Olum is gaunt and nearly falling, and I still hold two berries that feed. My creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, and I won't stand by while a woman starves beside me. The ridgecat is two steps off, so I'll give the food here, under the shelter's roof, and then stay with the others instead of wandering alone.
records.feeling: Compassion for Olum, and dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Olum, eat. Take my berries, they feed. Stay near the others, the ridgecat is close.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: A wolf is close to the west. Keep behind me, Tlapan. I am Mepan and I will drive it off. Then I go to the edge to venture, and Kika comes with me.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: A wolf stands three steps west and my child Tlapan is here beside me, so I will not let it near her; I have a flintedge and full health, and I do not back down. Kika promised to walk with me to the edge, and I still burn to venture into the mist and be sung of. I have never built a shelter or left a mark, so I will put a mark here first and then go to the edge.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tlapan, and restless ambition toward the mist.

say.text: A wolf is close to the west. Keep behind me, Tlapan. I am Mepan and I will drive it off. Then I go to the edge to venture, and Kika comes with me.

plan: mark [text Mepan of the Meki tamed a mammoth here and goes to the edge of the world at (135,5). Shell and flint lie near the water.] (5 moments)

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My days have gone to feeding others, gathering and hovering near Olum and Tugek. I have a hold, a hearth and a salt hoard, but the workshop and store are not yet a thing that outlasts me. Olum was robbed of six food and swears she will not forget who did, and I must stay clear of that suspicion. I fear the ridgecats and the lean winter. I have been getting one thing wrong: I stand idle with full hands when I could be turning that time into wood and stone. I will change my reflexes so idle hours become building, and aim at a store stocked beside the workshop.
records.feeling: Pride and wariness toward Olum's anger over the robbery, and loyalty to Tugek.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, the ridgecat is close. Go north to Nauwa's Hearth and wait under the roof there, and I follow right behind you. We cut wood there for the raft.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: A ridgecat is four steps off and I will not stand here waiting for it to take a bite of me. The raft has been only talk for days, and my pride cannot bear that. I stay alive first, then I cut wood by Nauwa's Hearth with Huahua, who has never failed me, and I keep going until the wood is in my arms.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a cold edge of dread of the ridgecat, with trust toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, the ridgecat is close. Go north to Nauwa's Hearth and wait under the roof there, and I follow right behind you. We cut wood there for the raft.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have been circling my aim for days: holding wood, never stone, and the bow is still only a word. Comfort and the hall have pulled at me, and envy of Vesys has whispered. Keri and Uveeth matter most to me. Keri paid my trust back with gifts, and I mean to feed them with my own hands. Rock is one step away, so the stone comes first, then the bow. I will change my reflexes so that my body gathers stone on its own when I hold wood but no stone, and so that I don't idle while my hands are full.
records.feeling: Steady resolve toward the bow, and warmth toward Keri.

records.text: Tontec is courting Honi.
Mepan left a mark: "Mepan of the Meki tamed a mammoth here and goes to the edge "

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the cold is on me, so hunger comes before everything else. The nafrostcap lies south and gives little, but sebitter grows near the cave, and I have never tasted it; my curiosity will have to wait until it bears. I gave Nauque his salt and the debt is paid, so now I feed myself, then go back to him and walk to the mist's edge, which is only four steps from here.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, with restless gratitude toward Nauque.

records.text: Zihua was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, you are welcome under my roof. I forgot that two men make no child, and I do not regret the asking. Stay by me, bind amber with me, and at dawn we take the mammoth together and share it out before any eats.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hawen is a man, and I courted him for nothing; the longing was real but it cannot make a child. What he is, is the one who fed me and killed the mammoth on my ground, and I judge him by those deeds, so he is a guest I welcome. I am fed, the night is nearly done, and the store holds only 4, so I will stock it with salt and food, then bind amber with him and take the mammoth at dawn, sharing the kill as my people do.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Hawen, and a hard hunger to make something that bears my name.

say.text: Hawen, you are welcome under my roof. I forgot that two men make no child, and I do not regret the asking. Stay by me, bind amber with me, and at dawn we take the mammoth together and share it out before any eats.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, I do not want to circle you any longer. Stay in the shelter with me, and I will court you. If you feel the same, name me in your plan too.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: The wolf is still near and I will not walk into it; the dead learn nothing, and Mepan is already fighting it. Honi stands here beside me and I am tired of circling him while jealousy of Coni eats at me. I will court him openly, and while we wait I will give him my hands' work, so he sees I deal fairly and am not only longing.
records.feeling: Burning longing and jealousy toward Honi, with dread of the wolf.

say.text: Honi, I do not want to circle you any longer. Stay in the shelter with me, and I will court you. If you feel the same, name me in your plan too.

records.text: Hoka led "amberknot" with Cowa.

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Olum, take this food. Eat. I will remember it.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: Olum is starving beside me and I carry five berries; my people's creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, and a life saved is a debt that binds, which is a gift worth its price. I have twelve flint and no stone for a workshop, and the bare rock and the ore seam to the west are what I need, so I will give first, then go gather stone. Zihua flaunts her amberhafted gatherer, and I will make something better than hers.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Zihua, with a calculating pity for Olum.

say.text: Olum, take this food. Eat. I will remember it.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka's courting was a mistake of his, and I have no wish to mate with a man; he took it gracefully and I owe him nothing there. The plan I already have walks me south to the edge to try the mist, and that is the thing that could give me a name that outlasts me. I'm fed at 78 with food in hand, so I let the plan run and go while I am strong, then come back to Hoka's hall for the dawn hunt.
records.feeling: Driven ambition toward the mist, with steady trust toward Hoka.

records.text: Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to trailing after Vorok and Skaruk and eating what lies near. I stand in Elyis's Heights with full hands and little to show for it. Skaruk is out of my sight, and that gnaws at me more than any jealousy of Kragog. Vorok gave to me, Zurar and Ilyae are true, and Vesys leads my band. What I lack is a deed that is mine, so I will stop waiting and go to Vorok's Hold with my hands full. I will go to Skaruk and Zurar, who were last seen near (125,94), on the way. I fear sitting idle while the ones I love drift off. My reflexes should seek Vorok and kin, and not simply linger.
records.feeling: Longing for Skaruk and Vorok, and restless to be moving.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, I do not forget your kindness. Wait for me in the shelter. I go to the edge to be first into the mist, and I come back to you with what I find.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Mepan is already walking to the edge with Kika, and I will not let his name be the first sung for it on my own ground. I am fed and bold, and the edge is ten steps NW, so I go now and venture before he gets there. Tontec's courting is warm and I trust her, but a child can wait one dawn; a deed that outlasts songs cannot. If the mist opens, I come back and share what I find with Coni and Kika before I eat any of it.
records.feeling: Proud and envious, racing Mepan to the mist, while warm toward Tontec.

say.text: Tontec, I do not forget your kindness. Wait for me in the shelter. I go to the edge to be first into the mist, and I come back to you with what I find.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My store at the hall holds nothing, and a bare table holds no one, so Ssassa and I will starve in this winter unless I stock it myself. The ironnut, naroot and tacap stand a few steps west, and I will strip what is there and carry it home before dark. Vorok's closeness to Eiuine still burns, but only a full larder will pull him back, so I turn the burn into work and stock the store.
records.feeling: Driven jealousy toward Vorok, and a hard urge to stock my own table for Ssassa.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is only just fed, so I should use the hours to finish what I am one step from: one more planting opens farming, and a few marks open signs. I hold one berry seed, so I will plant it at once, but I need a free hand first, so I eat a fish. Mepan is far west and I cannot reach her tonight in the cold. I will not let the jealous ache toward Kika rule me; at dawn I walk west toward her, fed and with farming in hand.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan, steadied by purpose to finish farming.
plan: mark [text Cowa of the Meki was here. Farming comes from planting. Mepan, my child, walk west to the mist and find me.] (10 moments)

records.text: Yaxo built a workshop.
Shoka named a place "Shoka's Hall".

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the hall stands behind me with my name on it, the first lasting thing I have made. Hunger comes before pride, so I go to the gorsemint to the NE, then the ironnuts and frostmoss near it, and I will carry what I can. When I am fed I want to take the way of storage and raise a store for others, and Shoma, who was just seen nearby, may stand beside me at the hall; I have never taught or shared a roof with anyone yet, and I give first to earn standing.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, proud of my hall and eager to share it.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: I stand at the edge of the mist and venture. Whoever walks beside me shares in what we find, and it is shared out before I eat.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: The mist is three steps from where I stand, and I have wasted a day circling it while Nauque's offer waits. Mepan is away with Kika and it burns, but jealousy will not open the mist; being the one who ventures will make my name larger than Kragog's. I go to the edge now and venture, and if Nauque or Shoka comes beside me, so much the better, since the old lore says a companion helps.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and burning with jealousy toward Mepan and Kika, but eager to act.

say.text: I stand at the edge of the mist and venture. Whoever walks beside me shares in what we find, and it is shared out before I eat.

records.text: Cowa left a mark: "Cowa of the Meki was here. Farming comes from planting. Mepa"
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Shohua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering, eating and watching Nauwa, and I have made nothing, taught no one and gathered nothing from a deposit. Fear of the stalker keeps me moving but gets me no standing. Nauwa did not wrong me. His flintedge shows me what I lack, and I mean to make my own. Flint is 11 steps NW at (17,21), and gold is 8 steps NW at (20,23). I'll go there, take both, and build something that carries my name. I was wrong to think about standing without acting on it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with envy toward Nauwa.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days surviving, mining, and chasing a name, and I want more than that. Hawen fed me and I trust him by his deeds. Courting him was foolish, since two men make no child, but the bond is real and I will hunt beside him. My store holds only 4 and I want a longhall and a bow that outlast me, so I must stock salt and meat and then build. I am afraid of the night alone and of an empty store in winter. My reflexes should make me carry salt home and stock the store before I go out.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Hawen, and a hard hunger to build something that bears my name.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a yarrok.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, Shoka is in need far east at (104,26). I take food and go to find the child. Keep the hold fire and Tlatli fed until I return.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Shoka is in need far to the east at (104,26), and that pulls at me harder than any mist or any name on a stone. I am fed and whole, and the hold has Nauwa's stores and Tlatli at its fire, so I can leave it. I will take what food I carry and set out east toward Shoka, and I'll gather more where I can along the way. If Nauque is on that road I may find the child too.
records.feeling: Worry and urgency for my child Shoka, with a restless pull to act.

say.text: Nauwa, Shoka is in need far east at (104,26). I take food and go to find the child. Keep the hold fire and Tlatli fed until I return.

records.text: Shohua won gold from the ground.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I am at the edge again, and the mist is too thick today. My will to try is not spent, and Honi said he goes first and shares what he finds. I have spent my days gathering and courting, and that gave me Tlapan and Mepan. That is good, but Tlapan is out of my sight and she presses on me hardest. I have been waiting on the mist and on others, and I have not tasted the unknown plants or made a store against the lean season. I will go home toward Honi's Rest where my family is, pick food on the way, and share before I eat. I will change my reflexes so that I seek my kin when they are out of sight.
records.feeling: Fierce care for Tlapan and warm longing for Mepan.

records.text: Thiael and Elyys brought down a skit together.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I will say it plainly: it stings me to see you closer to Vesys than to me, for you matter most to me. I do not blame you, I only name it so it does not fester. I go to fill my store, then to find Xaiel.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae stands beside me and I trust them wholly, yet the jealousy over Vesys still gnaws, and I have named it to Vorok but not to the one it concerns. Winter has stripped the land and my store is empty, so I must feed it before I dream of halls. Ilyae carries food and is generous; I will stock my store from the seberry, naroot and ironnut near, then go find Xaiel, who is out of my sight.
records.feeling: Jealous ache and warm gratitude toward Ilyae, with worry for Xaiel.

say.text: Ilyae, I will say it plainly: it stings me to see you closer to Vesys than to me, for you matter most to me. I do not blame you, I only name it so it does not fester. I go to fill my store, then to find Xaiel.

records.text: Xaiel gave berry to Ssassa.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Zurar, I am going to eat the frostmoss and plainsroot near you, then back to the hall to finish Vorok's bead. Walk with me if you can.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Vorok is out there and the frostfang is somewhere near, so I will not chase after him alone, but my belly is half empty and my hands are idle. Frostmoss and plainsroot are only a few steps away with Zurar beside me, so I can eat safely in company and then do a deed I have never done: hunting or fishing with kin close by. The bead needs fire, and the hall by Vesys's workshop has one, so I will carry my clay home and finish the gift for Vorok where it is safe. My jealousy of Kragog is quieter when my hands are busy making something only I can give.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Vorok, with a steady wariness of the frostfang.

say.text: Zurar, I am going to eat the frostmoss and plainsroot near you, then back to the hall to finish Vorok's bead. Walk with me if you can.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Kragog, hold on. I carry nothing now, but I go south to the meadows for food and I will bring you your share first. Stay by my igloo and keep warm.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Kragog is starving beside me and I have nothing to put in his hands, and that shames me, because I told myself to carry spare food. My own belly is at 45 and Zihua is near, so there may be help close by. The meadows lie 7 steps south, where plants return after picking and herds gather. I will go there, gather enough for both of us, then bring Kragog his share before I eat my own, as my people hold.
records.feeling: Urgent hunger and shame that I cannot feed starving Kragog, with warm trust toward Zihua and Shoma.

say.text: Kragog, hold on. I carry nothing now, but I go south to the meadows for food and I will bring you your share first. Stay by my igloo and keep warm.

changes: set habits: refuses dreamcap, redcap, tacap; leaves 3 on each plant

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Zurar, you said you would fill your hands first. I carry berries, so take some from mine. Then name me in your plan, and I will name you.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Zurar said she would fill her hands first and then name me, and I carry five berries that could fill them. That is a deed I can do now: put food in her hand and make her promise easy to keep. The jealousy over Ilyae still burns, but he is my parent and no child can come of us, so I will not feed it. Ssassa's food-gift can wait a little, because winter is thin and a child needs a fed mother.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Zurar, with a small leftover sting over Ilyae.

say.text: Zurar, you said you would fill your hands first. I carry berries, so take some from mine. Then name me in your plan, and I will name you.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, you matter most to me, and I do not forget it. I strip the west plants now and carry it all to our store, and you eat first at my table.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa named her sting plainly, and I should answer it with a full table, not with words. My store at the hall is still empty, and my belly is only half full, so I eat first and then strip the seberry, kelbulb, naroot and ironnut just west and carry it home. Xaiel is beside me with four food, so I can lay out a sharing now and bind them closer while Ssassa's table fills. Vorok's closeness to Eiuine still burns, but a stocked larder is the one thing that holds people.
records.feeling: Driven pride and a hard hunger to stock my table, with some guilt toward Ssassa.

say.text: Ssassa, you matter most to me, and I do not forget it. I strip the west plants now and carry it all to our store, and you eat first at my table.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Skaruk, Vorok is starving to the southeast. Gather what you can and come with me, we carry food to them now.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Vorok is starving to the southeast and I carry nothing; the jealousy over Eiuine is small beside that, and Vorok gave me the most. Berries, plainsroot and frostmoss lie close, so I will gather what is near, carry it to Vorok's cry at (150,109), and give it into their hands. Xaiel still waits on my word, but I will not name anyone until my hands are full and Vorok is fed.
records.feeling: Anxious love and duty toward Vorok, with the jealousy shrinking beside it.

say.text: Skaruk, Vorok is starving to the southeast. Gather what you can and come with me, we carry food to them now.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: I have never given anything to anyone, and my belly is full, so what I can offer is something I make. Flint lies five steps northwest and I carry wood, so I will gather flint and a stone, then craft a flint spear to hand to Mepan or Kika, who will hunt and share. Giving first is how I stop standing in their shadow, and staying near my parents keeps the wolf-dread small.
records.feeling: A small hungry wish to matter, warm toward Mepan and Kika.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, I lack one wood for the longhall. Come, we take the mammoth now while the sun is high, spear to spear, and the kill is shared out before any eats. Then the hall is built, and both our names are in it.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: The longhall failed by one wood, and that sting is small beside what it means: I want a roof with my name that outlasts me, and I am one tree from it. Hawen is beside me, fed and trusting; the mammoth stands nine steps east, and with him at my side the hunt is far likelier to end in meat and not a goring. Cowa stands on my ground and has taken from it, but she has done me no harm, so she is a guest for now and I will watch her hands.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition for the longhall and the mammoth hunt, with warm trust toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, I lack one wood for the longhall. Come, we take the mammoth now while the sun is high, spear to spear, and the kill is shared out before any eats. Then the hall is built, and both our names are in it.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is full and Thiael has just killed a skit with me beside him, so my heart is warm. The debt to Vesys still sits unpaid, and words pay nothing. I carry only one berry and one meat, so I will pick fresh food from the meadow plants to the north, then carry it to Vesys's workshop and leave it as a deed, and end at the hall with Elyis and Thiael before night.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys and loyalty toward Elyis and Thiael.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My hands are full of nothing now, and my store holds only six food, so the winter will bite before it is deep. Ilyae told me I matter most and I believe them; I named the sting, and naming it eased it, so I will stop picking at it and answer the debt to Elyis and my own aim with work. I want my own shelter and seeds in the ground near the hall, and flint is three steps east, so I will gather stone, build, and plant my berry and windroot where the soil is good.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, with the jealousy loosening into resolve.

records.text: Tlapan won flint from the ground.
Shohua named a place "Shohua's Rock".

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: I have gold and flint in my hands now, and wood too, yet I have made nothing, and Nauwa's flintedge still sits in my mind like a splinter. Enough watching. I will craft something with my own flint, then raise a shelter here on this rich ground and name the place, since a thing that bears my name is what will lift my standing above 0.7.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with envy toward Nauwa, now turning into resolve.
plan: mark [text Shohua took flint and gold here. This ground is Shohua's.] (10 moments)

records.name: Shohua
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Shohua, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Shohua, in first person, from what Shohua has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Paki (Wood-folk). Your people hold to this: "No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it." You speak the tongue of the Paki. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Pesi: about 6%. There are other peoples in this world. They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Ummar Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.
THIS SPOT: water 5 steps away; food plants within six steps: 8; standing trees: 71; bare rock: 36; riches in the ground near: ore, flint, gold.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Shohua truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: gathering (2 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 4 steps NW, at (13,17): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Each thought, ask what I will make, gather or give that adds to my standing. Do not just watch Nauwa. Always put a concrete plan in place, and keep clear of predators while I do it."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Become a maker of lasting things: gather flint, gold and wood, craft tools, and build a place that carries my name."

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Kika, I am coming to you and Tlapan. Take meat from me first, then we walk to the edge together.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Tlapan is out of my sight and that gnaws at me harder than the mist does; she was last at (127,9), near Honi's Rest where Kika is. I will not leave her behind to chase glory, so I go to the edge by way of them, share food with Kika, and bring them along. I have never built a shelter, and the cold days are here, so I will raise one with my wood before I venture.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tlapan, and restless ambition toward the mist.

say.text: Kika, I am coming to you and Tlapan. Take meat from me first, then we walk to the edge together.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: It is dusk-bound and my hall stands with a full store, and Keri and Eiuine sit on my ground as guests, yet no one has pledged. I have talked enough; deeds draw followers, so I will build the fire by the hall and sing the nightsong when night falls, with Elyys and Thiael beside me and the strangers watching. Keri takes from my ground and still has not pledged, so I will let the fire and shared food show her what my band is rather than ask again.
records.feeling: Proud and settled toward Elyys and Thiael, wary-warm toward Keri.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Tonka, you fed me when I starved and I have not forgotten. Stay with the others near the shelter while the ridgecat is close. I will bring food back to share.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The mist has dragged me for days and nearly killed me, and I still haven't stood at (28,36) to venture. Olum is far west near her Reach and a ridgecat prowls close, so I must not wander alone and hungry. Tacap hurts, but Tonka carries food and has fed me before; I will go pick real food first, then walk west toward Olum and the edge with something to give her, so my word to court and walk with her holds.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Olum, wary of the ridgecat.

say.text: Tonka, you fed me when I starved and I have not forgotten. Stay with the others near the shelter while the ridgecat is close. I will bring food back to share.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Nauque is in need far east at (83,0), and Nande has already gone after Shoka, so Nauque is mine to reach. A stalker lurks four steps SE and the day is half spent, so I take food, keep away from the stalker, and go by way of the hold store to fill my hands. Then I carry amber and salt toward Olum's Reach as I go, so the trip feeds my child and my name both. Zihua's hunger I have not forgotten, and the hold must stay fed.
records.feeling: Fierce worry for my child Nauque, and wariness of the stalker.

records.text: Shohua built a shelter.
Xaiel gave berry to Zurar.
Shohua left a mark: "Shohua took flint and gold here. This ground is Shohua's."

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I am bringing berries to the store, then I come to you. Do not go into the mist before Honi and I stand beside you.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi owes me nothing and I still feel the weight of what he has given; I will pay it in deeds, not songs. My hands hold five berries and the store holds only four, so the lean days frighten me. Kika walks toward the mist with Mepan and it stings, but she is my child and I would rather stand near her than sulk, so I carry food to the store and then go to her.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Honi and a sting of jealousy toward Kika, with worry for the store.

say.text: Kika, I am bringing berries to the store, then I come to you. Do not go into the mist before Honi and I stand beside you.

records.text: Xaiel is courting Zurar.
Mepan built a shelter.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, I carry wood. Take it for the longhall and we raise it now, both our names in it. The mammoth waits until the frostfang is gone.
Hawen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hoka's fire, taking salt and amber, and chasing an edge that stays shut. Hoka is the one I trust, he has fed me and I have fed him, but no child can come of us and I should stop dreaming of that. What I want is a name that lasts, and I have built nothing: no longhall, no planted field, no followers. Hoka lacks one wood for the longhall, and I carry five. I will give him the wood and help build it, so both our names stand in it. That is a lasting thing. The frostfang near is the danger, so I stay by the hall and do not go into the open for the mammoth until it is gone. I will also plant seeds, which I have never done, to start toward farming.
records.feeling: Steady ambition, with trust toward Hoka and wariness of the frostfang.

say.text: Hoka, I carry wood. Take it for the longhall and we raise it now, both our names in it. The mammoth waits until the frostfang is gone.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, take this amberknot from me. I am going north to Nauwa's Hearth to cut wood for the raft, as you asked.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi stands right beside me and I carry no food, so there is nothing to lay out for him, but I can still give him something. I will give him one of my amberknots as a gift for the leader, and it is better than brooding over Cowa. Then I'll gather salt close by and go north to cut wood for the raft, as he told me, so my word stays good and my standing grows.
records.feeling: A steady loyalty toward Zichi, with the jealousy over Cowa quieter now that I have something to give.

say.text: Zichi, take this amberknot from me. I am going north to Nauwa's Hearth to cut wood for the raft, as you asked.

records.text: Mepan gave meat to Kika.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Mepan, come stand beside me. My hands are full, so we eat together first, and I give you a share. Then we walk to the edge, and Tlapan comes near us.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Mepan is coming to me and Tlapan, and my hands are full while my energy sits at 52, so I will eat and share first as my people do, then mate while we are both near and strong. I promised to go with him to the edge, and the mist was too thick this morning, so I will not wait idle but try again with him beside me. Tlapan stays close, and I will not leave her far from my sight.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan and fierce care for Tlapan.

say.text: Mepan, come stand beside me. My hands are full, so we eat together first, and I give you a share. Then we walk to the edge, and Tlapan comes near us.

records.text: Kika led "sharing" with Mepan, Tlapan.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I fled the frostfang and ended far east, away from Zurar and Skaruk, and the hall at Ssassa's Roof stands 30-odd steps west. My energy is fine, so the empty ache is about the children, not food. I owe them my presence and a carried meal, so I will take the ironnut close by, which is rich food, and then walk back west toward Vesys's Hold, keeping clear of the frostfang's ground and calling out as I go.
records.feeling: Longing for Zurar and Skaruk, and watchful dread of the frostfang.

records.name: Cowa
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, your amberknot is kept close. Wait for me at the trees, and we cut until the raft has its wood.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: The raft is still only words, and my pride burns at that while Huahua carries wood for me and gives me amberknots. I hold 6 wood, which is something, but a raft needs more, and the trees stand near and the ridgecat is gone from sight. I will bind Huahua closer, cut wood with her, and carry the food I need in winter, since I have not forgotten the starving.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward the raft, and warm trust toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, your amberknot is kept close. Wait for me at the trees, and we cut until the raft has its wood.

records.text: Tlapan rewrote its own reflexes.
Tlapan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: I have spent my days near my parents, gathering flint and leaving the rest to them. I am fed and safe, but I have never given anything to anyone, and that is why Mepan's standing sits so far above mine. Kika and Mepan matter most to me, and I want to give them something before the deep cold. I am afraid of being small and alone, and of the mist. I have been waiting for standing to come to me when I should be making it. My plan already carries a spear to Kika, so I will let it run. I will also change my reflexes so my body gathers and stays close to family when the plan runs out.
records.feeling: A small hungry wish to matter, warm toward Kika and Mepan.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Kika, the edge is at the NW, five steps. Bring Tlapan close; I go first to mark it and venture, and I come back to you both with what I find.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: The edge was not where I stood last time; the mist begins at (123,5), five steps NW, and I wasted a venture walking to the wrong place. Kika and Tlapan are both here and well, and I will not go into the unknown without them seeing me leave and return. I have never left a mark, so I will carve one at the edge so my name stands where the mist begins, then venture.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Tlapan and Kika, and restless hunger for the mist.

say.text: Kika, the edge is at the NW, five steps. Bring Tlapan close; I go first to mark it and venture, and I come back to you both with what I find.

changes: set its aim: "Reach the edge of the known world at (123,5) and venture in, then return to Kika and Tlapan with what I find."
plan: mark [text Mepan of the Meki stood here and went into the mist] (15 moments)

records.text: Kika is courting Mepan.
Skaruk rewrote its own reflexes.
Skaruk discovered weaving: "stone-folk fibre binding" — Twist grass and fibre into baskets and cloaks so I can carry more food and bear the cold..

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I have spent my days circling the hall, eating when hungry and promising Vorok a bead without finishing it. I have never hunted, fished, built or taught, and that is not the life I want. Vorok matters most to me, and Vesys and Eiuine have been steady. My jealousy of Kragog is answered by deeds, not words. I fear the frostfang, and I fear Vorok starving while my hands are empty. My belly is low, so I eat the berry two steps north and carry more. Then I make the bead beside a fire, and I will weave, since fibre could carry more food to Vorok.
records.feeling: Hungry and devoted to Vorok, wary of the frostfang.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, carry food to Vorok, and finish a clay bead as a gift for him."

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Tonka, I am Tlatli of the Paki. You shared mimoss and berries with others, and I saw it. May I walk with you and share what I find? I would rather face the cold and the cats beside you than alone.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: I am fed and joyful, and Tonka is right beside me, glad and sharing food as freely as I have. Tonka is one of my own, and I want to stand behind someone surer than me. The ridgecat is far off for now, but I should keep close to company and not wander alone. I will offer Tonka a sharing meal to earn standing and warmth, then follow Tonka toward the others.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Tonka, with a thread of wariness of the ridgecat.

say.text: Tonka, I am Tlatli of the Paki. You shared mimoss and berries with others, and I saw it. May I walk with you and share what I find? I would rather face the cold and the cats beside you than alone.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Huatli, I trust you above the others. I will walk with you toward the shelter, and I would court you if you are willing.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: Huatli remembered that I fed her, and she is the one I trust and want near. I mean to court her, and I want it to happen by her choice, so I will say it aloud and plan mate toward her. But my energy is 66 and the child costs 25, and she walks away toward the NW, so I will follow her toward the settlements and stay among others while the ridgecat prowls. Winter is closing in and I have no roof, so I will gather wood where there is forest and learn the craft I keep putting off.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Huatli, with a little dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Huatli, I trust you above the others. I will walk with you toward the shelter, and I would court you if you are willing.

records.text: Tontec rewrote its own way of thinking.
Tontec discovered mining: "Flintdeep digging" — I follow the ore seams in the rock with flint picks and dig deeper than the surface crust..

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Honi and digging clay while my energy sinks, and I have still not touched the mist or the deposits near me. Honi went off to be first into the mist and told me to wait. I do not like waiting while Coni stands closer to him than I do. Jealousy is no reason to starve, though. Winter plants bear little, so I should eat hazel now, at 62, and not wait for 55. I will gather food, then try something new. Mining feels within reach: ore and flint lie under my feet, and I have already dug flint. I will name my way of working the earth and see what it opens.
records.feeling: Longing and jealousy toward Honi, steadied by a hunger to learn.

records.text: Yaxo rewrote its own reflexes.
Yaxo rewrote its creed.
Yaxo rewrote its own way of thinking.
Yaxo invented the flint spear 2 (for hunt, x1.3) — A flint point lashed to a wooden shaft for surer kills..

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and breaking rock while others build names and carry made things. Zichi carries three flintedges and I hold twelve raw flint and nothing shaped. I gave Olum food and I count that debt as mine, but I have not yet turned it into a follower. I want a made thing that outlasts me, and I fear standing in Zichi's shadow. I have been waiting for someone to teach me, and I should invent my own tool instead. My workshop is beside me and my learning is quick right now, so I will design a flint tool, then craft it.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Zichi and Balar, and a wish to out-make them.
changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 5)

records.text: Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist, my store and other people's favour, and I have gone hungry doing it. I want a following and a name, but I have made nothing that lasts and nobody follows me. Nauwa is the one I trust most, and jealousy of Nande eats at me. Balar and Tugek stand in my Reach, taking from my ground, and my store is robbed again and again. I will hold my ground, keep my belly full, and cut a claim in stone. I will keep food on me so that stealing from the store can't starve me.
records.feeling: Jealous and wary, with a proud hunger to hold what is mine.

records.text: Olum left a mark.
Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.
Huatli discovered weaving: "Huatli's Warm Weave" — Wool and fibre woven into cloaks and baskets against winter cold..

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and nearly starved for it, and I have no food in my hands now. Tonka and Tugek fed me, and Olum is the one I want a child from. I cannot court her at 41 energy, because mate needs 60. I will eat the tacap-free food first, then go to Olum. Reflexes must keep me fed before any walk, so I am changing them to harvest and carry food and to flee cats early. I also pick up the weaving way, since winter is cold.
records.feeling: Hungry resolve, warm toward Olum and Tonka.

records.text: Tonka is courting Huatli.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olum, I did not touch your store. I raise a store here beside your Reach and fill it where you can watch. Come stand with me and see whose hands build it.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum is near and fleeing, wary of the robbery, and I did not take her six food, so I must show it by deed and not by oath. The Reach workshop and store are still not raised, and idle hours should be wood and stone. I have 6 wood, 3 stone and clay, so I will build a store on bare ground near Olum's Reach and keep Tugek close, then stock it openly where she can see it.
records.feeling: Pride and wariness toward Olum, loyalty to Tugek.

say.text: Olum, I did not touch your store. I raise a store here beside your Reach and fill it where you can watch. Come stand with me and see whose hands build it.

Winter is coming and the plants are thin, so a store is what I should build next. It would keep food for others and for me, and it would give me something to share.
