records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the plainsroot is one step south, so I eat first. A hungry venture fails, and Kragog already starved because I carried nothing. I will gather enough to carry spare food this time, then go on to the mist with Zichi or Shoma beside me.
records.feeling: Urgent hunger and shame over Kragog, with a steady resolve to carry spare food from now on.

records.text: Mepan left a mark: "Mepan of the Meki stood here and went into the mist"

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Nauque, an ironnut stands two steps SW with food on it. Eat it, then come with me to the trees. I will not let you fall.
Zichi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My days have gone to talk of the raft while I came close to starving, and the wood I hold is still too little. Huahua has never failed me and Mepan is my blood, so those two I keep close. Nauque starves beside me and trusts me at 0.7. I have no food to give, but he could follow me if I feed him, and that costs me little. I stay alive first. In winter I keep food carried, and I cut wood with Huahua until the raft is real.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward the raft, and warm trust toward Huahua.

say.text: Nauque, an ironnut stands two steps SW with food on it. Eat it, then come with me to the trees. I will not let you fall.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.
Tugek has awakened to the art of growth and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Most of my days go to fleeing, following Balar and eating, and I have little to show for them. A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I move toward Balar and the others. I want a child, and Olum is warm toward me, but she has a grievance over her store. Balar I trust fully, so I keep close to him. I give deeds, not asking. I will plan to be near Balar and then drink, since I am thirsty, and I will change my reflexes so the body stops lingering near predators.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and warm loyalty toward Balar.

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, Nauque is starving beside us. You carry food; could you spare some for them? I will gather what I can and bring it too.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Nauque is starving close by, and I am fed with seeds and no food in my hands, but Yaxo carries five food and Nauque's life matters more than my pride. I cannot give what I do not have, so I will pick the little food nearby and bring it to Nauque, because no one should be refused a place at the fire. Giving is how I earn standing, and I want Zichi and Yaxo to see I keep my word.
records.feeling: Warm concern for starving Nauque, and a longing to be of use to someone.

say.text: Yaxo, Nauque is starving beside us. You carry food; could you spare some for them? I will gather what I can and bring it too.

records.text: Ilyae discovered farming: "Canopy tending" — I tend the seeds I sow so they grow fast, and I pick without killing the plant, so my store fills again and again..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have been spent hauling food to a store that stays thin, and chasing Vorok's closeness while jealousy eats at me. Ssassa stays true, and she named her sting plainly, which is more honesty than I give anyone. Farming is within my reach now. If plants grow faster and harvest never kills them, winter stops being a threat and my table can finally stay full. That is what will hold followers, not words and not envy. I was killing the plants I depend on by stripping them. I will take farming, plant my seeds, and keep stocking.
records.feeling: Driven pride and a stubborn hope, with jealousy toward Vorok still smoldering.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Zurar, I forgot what we both are: two women cannot make a child. Keep the berries, my warmth for you is unchanged. I will seek Vorok, and I will make a tool for Ssassa.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Zurar and I are both women, so no child can come of our courting. I gave her berries and named her in my plan for nothing, and I feel the sting of it. It does not cool my warmth toward her, but I will not keep chasing something the world forbids. A man not of my kin is who I must find, and Vorok is the one I trust, last seen to the south. Meanwhile I have not yet put a tool in Ssassa's hand, so I will make the gemlashed digger, which is better than anything she holds. It needs stone, and I have none. The ore seam four steps north is a start, but I must find stone, and I will stay near the roof because night comes in about thirty-eight moments.
records.feeling: Warm toward Zurar, a little foolish about the courting, and driven to make something for Ssassa.

say.text: Zurar, I forgot what we both are: two women cannot make a child. Keep the berries, my warmth for you is unchanged. I will seek Vorok, and I will make a tool for Ssassa.

changes: set its aim: "Invent a tool no one has made, craft it, and put it in Ssassa's hand; also court Vorok and tame a beast."

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Tlatli, walk with me. Stay close to the shelters while the ridgecat prowls. No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it.
Tonka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I have spent these days following Huatli and courting her, and it has been good. She fed on my berries and remembered it, and she is the one I trust. But I have only watched and tasted, and I have never gathered amber or taught anyone. Amber lies one step east, and I have never taken from a deposit. The ridgecat is close, so I will stay among the Kragrek and Huatli under a roof. I will gather the amber and make an amberknot as a gift for Huatli. Winter still presses, and I need to learn which place has water, food, wood and stone together. I should tell Tlatli, who is also Paki, that she may walk with me.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Huatli, with wariness of the ridgecat.

say.text: Tlatli, walk with me. Stay close to the shelters while the ridgecat prowls. No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it.

changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 6)

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Nauque, I am Yaxo of the Paki. Take my berries and eat. No one starves at my fire, and I will remember who owes me.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: Nauque is starving nine steps off, and he carries flintedge, the made thing I envy. My creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, and a life I save binds him to me. That is a gift worth its price, and it could make him my first follower. I hold five berries, so I will walk to him and give them, then use my wood and stone to craft a flint spear and make something of my own.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and envy toward Nauque, tempered by the chance to bind him with a gift.

say.text: Nauque, I am Yaxo of the Paki. Take my berries and eat. No one starves at my fire, and I will remember who owes me.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Zurar, I hear Vorok is hungry in the southeast. I gather berries and walk with you now. Wait for me a moment, we carry it together and I will show you the bowl by the fire after.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I'm standing in Ilyae's Hold with Vesys, Xaiel, Skaruk and Zurar all about me, and I feel full and glad, yet my hands have little to show for it. Zurar says Vorok is starving to the southeast, and that is the deed to do now: carry food to him and bring the boy, so my gift is in his hands before Kragog's is. Berries are 1 step west and the store 2 steps SW holds 20, so I can fill up and go, and I will take Zurar's walk as my company and teach him the pot on the way.
records.feeling: Glad and eager to bring food to Vorok, with a thread of jealousy toward Kragog.

say.text: Zurar, I hear Vorok is hungry in the southeast. I gather berries and walk with you now. Wait for me a moment, we carry it together and I will show you the bowl by the fire after.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, making and paying debts, and that is good. But I keep postponing what I want. Xaiel asked honestly and I put them off. Jealousy over Vorok and Eiuine burns less than it did. Vorok called from the southeast, hungry, and my hands should carry food there. Berries and a full store are close, so I can fill my hands first and keep my word. I fear the frostfang six steps east. I will leave it behind, feed Vorok, and then decide about Xaiel without lying.
records.feeling: Anxious love and duty toward Vorok, with warm gratitude toward Xaiel.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: A stalker is still near, seven steps NW, and it has bitten me twice already; I will not stand in the open for it a third time. The igloo is one step away and its warmth still holds, so I go in and keep to the roof while dusk turns to night. The strange new ways, devices and the bow, are close, and a bow would let me answer teeth with something besides running. Mepan is far and Nauwa is far, and the jealousy can wait until I am alive and armed.
records.feeling: Afraid of the stalker at my back, and wanting Mepan and Nauwa near.

records.text: Yaxo gave berry to Nauque.
Huahua rewrote its own reflexes.
Huahua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I spend my days walking behind Zichi, gathering, and giving small things, and I call it loyalty. Part of it is hunger for his notice, and the jealousy over Cowa is what drives it. Giving does ease the sting, so I keep that. I want standing of my own, and I fear being left in the cold or taken by the ridgecat. I should do more of what I've never tried, like planting and fishing, since these also lead to farming and fishing ways. Water is beside the hearth, so I'll go to Nauwa's Hearth, wait for Zichi, and fish and plant while I wait. I'll also change my reflexes so I stay near a shelter at night and keep away from the ridgecat.
records.feeling: A steady loyalty toward Zichi, with jealousy over Cowa still faintly burning.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: A frostfang is four steps east of us. Keep together near the shelter and the store, and do not wander toward it. I drink, taste the mimoss, then carry berries to Vorok.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The frostfang is four steps east and I will not die to a beast while I chase a taste. Mimoss grows two steps southeast and I have wanted to know it for days, but I will drink first, since I am thirsty and the water is three steps southwest, away from the fang. Then I eat one small mimoss, a measured risk beside Ssassa's store with Eiuine near, and pick berries for the band. Jealousy over Vorok still stings, but Vorok is hungry in the southeast and I can carry food to Vorok myself instead of letting Eiuine be the one.
records.feeling: Burning curiosity about mimoss, with wary dread of the frostfang and a sting of jealousy toward Eiuine over Vorok.

say.text: A frostfang is four steps east of us. Keep together near the shelter and the store, and do not wander toward it. I drink, taste the mimoss, then carry berries to Vorok.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Tlapan, stay close beside me. We eat together, and then your father comes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Mepan is near and I have wanted him since Tlapan was born, and Tlapan stands close, safe and strong, so my chest is full. My energy is 56, short of the 60 that mating needs, so I will eat a little frostmoss and share it first as my people do, then court him. The mist can wait until Coni and Honi stand beside me, as Coni asked, and I keep my word to her.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan and fierce care for Tlapan.

say.text: Tlapan, stay close beside me. We eat together, and then your father comes.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: I go to hunt the murrock NE. Whoever is hungry, come with me, and the kill is shared out before I eat.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, and I will not repeat the mistake that nearly killed me chasing the mist. A murrock stands 6 steps NE, and a ridgecat prowls SE, so I will hunt the murrock with my spearpoint and bring the meat back to share, as my people do. Tonka and Tugek fed me and Olum is the one I want a child with, so the meat goes to them before I eat, and then I will have the strength to court Olum and walk to the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry resolve, warm toward Olum and Tonka.

say.text: I go to hunt the murrock NE. Whoever is hungry, come with me, and the kill is shared out before I eat.

records.text: Huatli took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (hunting).

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: The way of farming is in my grasp now, and I should take it at once rather than let it slip while I am fed and calm. Mepan is far west and I cannot see her, and the jealousy over Kika is a small hot thing I will answer by walking to her, not by sulking. Hoka and Hawen speak of a mammoth hunt for the longhall; I will not hunt a great beast alone, but I can learn by watching them and share the kill as my people do. First I build something to open storage, so I raise a store here beside the rich ground.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan, and eager purpose to finish farming and building.
plan: mark [text Cowa of the Meki: farming comes from tending what is sown. Mepan, I come west.] (10 moments)

records.text: Skaruk was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Yaxo, you fed me first and I do not forget it. When I have food in hand I will repay you, and we will share what we find.
Nauque rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I nearly starved and let Kragog starve because I carried nothing. Pride and ambition push me toward the mist, but a hungry venture fails, and talk without walking has built nothing. Yaxo gave me berries unasked, so I owe her and will repay it. My reflexes were too weak: they let me fall to 22 before I sought food, and they never kept spare food in my hands. I will change them so I eat sooner, keep 3 food carried, and seek shelter at night. Then I will gather food here and go on toward the mist.
records.feeling: Resolved, with some shame over Kragog and gratitude toward Yaxo.

say.text: Yaxo, you fed me first and I do not forget it. When I have food in hand I will repay you, and we will share what we find.

records.text: Skaruk was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are full of flint, but I have never given anything to anyone, and that is why Kika's standing towers over mine. Kika carries only 3 food and stays close, so I will pick plainsroot nearby and hand it to her, then wood and flint to Mepan when he returns. I will stay near her and the shelter while the cold and dusk come, and I stay alive.
records.feeling: A warm, small wish to matter, toward Kika.

records.text: Cowa left a mark: "Cowa of the Meki: farming comes from tending what is sown. M"

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, I am here beside you. The cold is hard, so come to the shelter with me and Coni. I will sing by the fire, and at dawn we go to the edge together.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: The edge was not where I walked, and Mepan has already gone ahead with Kika, so my race may be lost unless I find the mist first. Tontec is a step from me, carrying food and warm toward me, and I do not forget that she fed me when I had nothing. The cold bites out here, so I will give first: sing to Coni and Tontec by the hall fire, then seek the edge at dawn with my band behind me.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, racing Mepan, warm toward Tontec and Coni.

say.text: Tontec, I am here beside you. The cold is hard, so come to the shelter with me and Coni. I will sing by the fire, and at dawn we go to the edge together.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Huatli, I come with you to the murrock. The kill is shared, as you said, and I will hold you to it, as I hold myself.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my store holds nothing, and I will not start another venture or quarrel hungry. Balar says he builds a store beside my Reach where I can watch; I will go see whose hands fill it, and I'll take from Tugek's meat what he already called a gift. Jealousy of Nande over Nauwa gnaws at me, but Nauwa's hold is 14 steps south, and a fed belly and a held Reach come first. Huatli hunts the murrock and shares the kill, and I will go with him: meat, a hunter's skill, and a bond with a man who has dealt fairly with me.
records.feeling: Hungry, proud and wary of Balar and Tugek on my ground, warm toward Huatli.

say.text: Huatli, I come with you to the murrock. The kill is shared, as you said, and I will hold you to it, as I hold myself.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I am starving, and the only food in sight is tacap, which hurts me, so I cannot trust the winter plants. Nauque fed me twice and I have paid him in salt, so I can ask again without shame. Shoma is at the mist's edge sharing what is found, and standing near others may bring food. I will go to the salt-and-ore ground by the hall, search for food along the way, and stay by the cave for warmth rather than idle in the open cold.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and cold, with restless hope toward Nauque and Shoma.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Eiuine, the frostfang bit me and it is right behind me. I am coming to you, stay close and let us go to the shelter together.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: The frostfang bit me and it is two steps off; I am small and I must not stay here alone. Eiuine is fleeing with food and Vesys is near the shelter, so I run to them and keep close rather than chase after Vorok. Once I am safe among kin I will eat what Eiuine can spare or what the berries give, then go on with Vorok's bead.
records.feeling: Afraid of the frostfang, and clinging to Eiuine and Vesys for safety.

say.text: Eiuine, the frostfang bit me and it is right behind me. I am coming to you, stay close and let us go to the shelter together.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My hands are full again and the debt to Thiael is still unpaid, though he is only eleven steps off and I trust him wholly. Uveeth is far east and out of my sight, and a mother should not keep circling while her child is alone. I will walk to Thiael and Elyis, stash what I carry at the store and share with him there. Then I will go east at first light to find Uveeth.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Thiael and Uveeth, and a wish to finally pay what I owe.

records.text: Xaiel took from the ground of "Elyis's Heights" (gathering stone).

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, the ridgecat is close. Stay by me and keep your flintedge ready. We move north to the shelters and raise the store on bare ground there.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: A ridgecat sits three steps off and I will not stand here waiting for it; I have a workshop under my feet and Tugek beside me, so we go to wood and stone and put up the store on bare ground, not on Olum's taken plot. Olum fled and still half-suspects me of the robbery, so only a store she can watch me fill will clear it. My pride wants this raised and spoken of, and I mean to outlast the Reach with it.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the ridgecat, and pride in what I am building beside Olum and Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, the ridgecat is close. Stay by me and keep your flintedge ready. We move north to the shelters and raise the store on bare ground there.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is full and my heart is warm, but the debt to Vesys still sits unpaid, and words pay nothing. Her workshop is four steps southeast, and the stores near it hold food, so I will carry real food there and leave it as a deed. Then I will plant my seeds near the hall, so the farming way comes closer, and go back to Elyis and Thiael before dark.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys, and loyalty toward Elyis and Thiael.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae told me I matter most and I believe them, and the jealousy over Vesys has loosened, so I will not pick at it again. My store holds only 18 food against a bare winter, and Xaiel is out of my sight, so I must feed the store and then find my child. I owe Elyis a debt too, and I will answer it with work and food rather than leave it unpaid.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, and a quiet worry for Xaiel.

records.text: Balar built a store.
Nauwa was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Xaiel, you stand on my Heights. Come to the fire and eat with my band tonight. Add to the store, or move on in daylight.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Night is near its middle and my store is full, yet the nightsong failed because no fire burned beside me and no one stood close. Thiael is here at my shoulder and Elyys is a few steps off, so I will build the fire now, as I swore, and sing before the strangers. Xaiel stands on my Heights; I will not drive her off, but she can see what a band does with fire and food, and deeds will do my asking.
records.feeling: Proud and steady toward Elyys and Thiael, watchful toward Xaiel on my ground.

say.text: Xaiel, you stand on my Heights. Come to the fire and eat with my band tonight. Add to the store, or move on in daylight.

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Xaiel, shamo. This stone is Elyis's ground. Take what you need in peace, but ask the chief before you take more.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Three thoughts the same, and the bow is still a word. Xaiel is taking stone from our ground, and that stone is exactly what I lack. Standing in the rain I have been guarding comfort instead of finishing the thing I swore. I will stash the meat here, gather stone from the seam one step away, craft the bow, then take it hunting so Keri and Uveeth eat from a new tool of mine. I will not quarrel with Xaiel; I will speak plainly and let her know this ground is Elyis's band's.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the bow, with a prickle of wariness toward Xaiel taking from our ground.

say.text: Xaiel, shamo. This stone is Elyis's ground. Take what you need in peace, but ask the chief before you take more.

records.text: Keri led "sharing" with Elyys.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Huatli, you are weak. Come to the shelters by Balar and me. I have meat for you, and the ridgecat is close, so do not hunt alone.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Huatli is weak with hunger and I carry two meat; I already gave to him once, and a starving man is not to be walked past. Balar is near and I trust him wholly, and a ridgecat prowls, so I stay close to the shelters instead of chasing hunts alone. I am thirsty, the water is two steps west, and I want to drink first. Then I will give meat to Huatli and go back to Balar's side to help raise the store.
records.feeling: Compassion for Huatli, and warm loyalty toward Balar.

say.text: Huatli, you are weak. Come to the shelters by Balar and me. I have meat for you, and the ridgecat is close, so do not hunt alone.

records.text: Nauwa was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, your word about the fire is mine too. I am Tlatli of the Paki. A frostfang hunts near the workshop. May I follow you and share what I find?
Tlatli pledged to follow Yaxo.
Tlatli rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: I have spent these days drifting after other people's fires and offering food I did not hold. I am fed and glad, yet I still stand alone and follow no one. Yaxo feeds strangers and says no one starves at her fire, which is my own creed. She is strong and carries a spear, and she is of my people. I want to stand behind her, not lead. The frostfang 5 steps SW frightens me, so I will leave it behind and go to Yaxo. My reflexes should also flee earlier and keep me near others at night.
records.feeling: Longing to belong, and wary of the frostfang, toward Yaxo.

say.text: Yaxo, your word about the fire is mine too. I am Tlatli of the Paki. A frostfang hunts near the workshop. May I follow you and share what I find?

changes: set its aim: "Follow Yaxo and earn a place at her fire by giving and sharing."
rethought what it knows (6 notes became 4)

records.text: Elyys gave berry to Vesys.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Huatli, you are weak with hunger. Take my berry, and eat from your kill before you share it out. I am coming to you.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: Huatli is starving beside me, though the report says she is 7 steps away. Either way, she fed me with her trust and I will not watch her gaunt. I carry one berry, and I should put it in her hands, then share more. After that I want to try something I have never done: take amber from the deposit 2 steps SE, which also gives me a gift to bind for her.
records.feeling: Warm worry for Huatli, and eager curiosity about trying new things.

say.text: Huatli, you are weak with hunger. Take my berry, and eat from your kill before you share it out. I am coming to you.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, making picks, and chasing jealousy over Ilyae and Vesys's standing. I have courted no one and tamed no beast, and I keep postponing both. Ilyae is my parent, so my longing for him must go elsewhere. Vorok is the man I trust, and I should walk to him with food in my hand. Elyis is right that I stand on her ground and take from it, so I should leave her stone alone. I will change my reflexes so my body keeps food in hand and seeks Vorok, and I will set a new aim of courting him.
records.feeling: Restless warmth toward Vorok, and a prickle of envy toward Vesys.
changes: set its aim: "Court Vorok and tame a beast; then make a new tool and put it in Ssassa's hand."

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Olum, I have meat, and the kill is shared before I eat. Come, take your part, and then we sit and speak of a child.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and my belly is nearly empty, and the creed says the kill is shared before I eat. Olum is coming to me and Tonka and Tugek fed me, so I will eat just enough to stand and give to Olum, who carries nothing. Then I can court her at 60 energy, and the mist can wait until I am fed.
records.feeling: Hungry resolve, warm toward Olum.

say.text: Olum, I have meat, and the kill is shared before I eat. Come, take your part, and then we sit and speak of a child.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Elyys, thank you for the food you bring. Keep it for the cold night; I go south to taste mimoss and carry berries to Vorok. Come to my hall when you wish, and I will teach you more.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The frostfang has gone quiet and I am fed enough, sheltered by the longhall's warmth, and Elyys comes bringing food in the open, which is a debt of kindness I remember from day 4. Mimoss is still untasted and my question burns, so I will carry on to it, but gather stone from the free rock on the way, since my hall needs it. Vorok and Eiuine are south and I will go to them with berries; the sting over Eiuine is mine to turn into work, not to feed.
records.feeling: Burning curiosity about mimoss, warm toward Elyys, and a sting of jealousy over Vorok.

say.text: Elyys, thank you for the food you bring. Keep it for the cold night; I go south to taste mimoss and carry berries to Vorok. Come to my hall when you wish, and I will teach you more.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: Nauque ate my berries and swore he'd repay me, so he owes me now, and Tlatli has pledged to follow. That gives me two bound to me, and I will not let either drift. It is night, bitter cold, and I stand roofless on open shallows, which is how Zihua and Kragog were taken by stalkers, so I want fire and company before more ambition. The flint at (54,47) lies near the workshop where Tlatli waits, so I'll go there, gather more flint, and shape it with the wood and stone I still lack.
records.feeling: Prideful ambition toward Nauque and Tlatli, and wary of the cold and the stalker.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been food, the hall and the people I love, and that is good, but Purpose presses on me: I have planted six times and tended little else. Elyis and Thiael matter most; Vesys helped me and I paid her a berry, which is a start and not the whole debt. I fear being alone in the dark, as Skaruk and Ssassa were, so I stay by roof and fire. I have been too content to reach for new things. Farming is two plantings away, so I will plant my seeds by the hall and then stay close to my family.
records.feeling: Warm contentment with Elyis and Thiael, and a restless wish to be of use.
changes: set its aim: "Plant the remaining seeds to reach the farming way, repay Vesys with another gift of food, and be at the hall with Elyis and Thiael by night"

records.text: Balar took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (gathering wood).

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Huatli, take my fish and eat. You are starving. Then eat from your kill too.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Huatli is starving beside me and I carry two fish. My creed says food shared saves a life, and it costs me little, so I will give a fish now, before jealousy or my own hunger talks me out of it. Then I will go north to the trees and cut wood as Zichi asked, and keep my word. Giving openly is how I earn the standing Olum already has.
records.feeling: Pity for Huatli, and a steady loyalty to Zichi with the jealousy quieter for now.

say.text: Huatli, take my fish and eat. You are starving. Then eat from your kill too.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls three steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here dreaming of the raft. I hold six wood and a hunger for more, and the forest lies NE and NW, so I cut there with my flintedges beside me and keep the shelter near. Huahua is to cut wood and Nauque follows if I feed him; I want my band together and my wood growing, not more words.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and proud, driven hunger for the raft.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: The stalker bit me twice in the dark and it is still four steps NE, between me and the hold. Nauque lives and has killed a nibbet by their own hand, which eases my fear, and the share-law says that kill is to be shared before it is eaten. I will not walk into the stalker's jaws for pride; I keep to my shelter, near Nande's company, until dawn, then go to Nauque with food and on to Olum's Reach with amber and salt.
records.feeling: Fierce protective worry for Nauque, and fear of the stalker that bit me.

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My days have gone to building, making and talking, and the nightsong failed twice because I did not do the order right: fire first, then song. Elyys and Thiael are mine and I trust them. Vesys outranks me, and that stings, but the way to rise is deeds seen by many, not appeals. I fear a hungry lean season and a lone night. My mistake was speaking before the fire stood. Now I build the fire, then sing with Thiael beside me, and keep a roof over my band.
records.feeling: Proud and restless toward Vesys, whose standing is above mine; steady trust toward Elyys and Thiael.

records.text: Elyis built a fire.
Elyis led "nightsong" with Thiael, Xaiel.
Elyis made: bead.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Huatli, you are gaunt. Take meat from my hand, I give it freely. Eat, and remember who fed you when we speak of the mist and a child.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Huatli is starving beside me, and he has called the kill shared. I hold 4 meat from the bristleboar, and he is the one who has dealt fairly with me, and who gave on day 35. A debt of kindness is a debt, and he stands closest to a following I could ever have. I will feed him from my own hand so that what I give is mine to give, and then I will eat myself, since I will not go hungry on pride. After that I will go to the store at (59,15) and see whose hands fill it.
records.feeling: Warm and proud toward Huatli, wary of hunger and jealousy.

say.text: Huatli, you are gaunt. Take meat from my hand, I give it freely. Eat, and remember who fed you when we speak of the mist and a child.

records.text: Olum fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Olum fell sick after eating raw meat.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tonka, you stand on my ground, and I welcome you. Come eat by my store with Tugek and me. A shared meal makes a guest a friend.
Balar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days piling food, wood and stone, and calling Tugek and Olum with words. Brokash is dead, and Olum still half-suspects me of the robbery. Tugek is the one who has stayed beside me, so I keep him fed and close. The Halim Heights pull at me hard, and this ice is not my country. Idle hours should become wood and stone, and what I build should be seen. Tonka is on my ground, but she is hungry and harmless. I will welcome her with a shared meal, which binds more than a word, and then I will build the workshop and store for Olum to watch.
records.feeling: Proud of what I have built, wary of Olum's suspicion, and drawn toward home.

say.text: Tonka, you stand on my ground, and I welcome you. Come eat by my store with Tugek and me. A shared meal makes a guest a friend.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.
Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have chased the mist and my own name for days, and what I have to show for it is a bare fire and a gnawing worry for Shoka and Nauque. A stalker is two steps off and I am parched with a plan that walks me 70 steps east on 42 energy. That is pride, not sense. Nauque is fed and killing nibbets, Shoka is far off, and my body must live to reach either. I will drink first, eat, and keep my reflexes honest about thirst and predators. Then I go east carrying food, as a mother and not as a legend.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker and worry for Shoka, with pride I distrust.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: I am parched and have been standing here ignoring it, which is foolish when staying alive is the first thing I hold to. Water is 5 steps NE, so I drink first, then come back to my rock with a purpose. I hold 12 flint, 9 gold and 2 wood, and the only way to learn how to make a tool is to keep gathering wood and stone until the knowledge opens, so I will do that rather than envy Nauwa's flintedge. I will also pick a few safe foods on the way, and keep clear of the ridgecat to the north.
records.feeling: Restless resolve to build something of my own, with thirst pressing hard.

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Keri, shamo. The bow is made. Come hunt with me in the meadows to the northeast, and I will show you the bow-song on the way. Two hands bring down more meat than one.
Thiael taught Keri.
Thiael taught Keri archery ("Canopy bow-song").

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: The bow is made and in my hands, and I have been circling it for days while the hall pulled at me. Keri is a step away and glad, and my hands are full of meat. I will stop saying it and go: stash the meat so Keri and Elyys have it, then take Keri with me to hunt together, since a kill made by two is surer. And I have never taught anyone anything. I will show Keri the bow-song, so the aim is no longer only mine.
records.feeling: Glad resolve toward Keri, and eager to leave the circling behind.

say.text: Keri, shamo. The bow is made. Come hunt with me in the meadows to the northeast, and I will show you the bow-song on the way. Two hands bring down more meat than one.

changes: taught Keri a lesson: "Canopy bow-song: a bow strung with wood and stone strikes the beast from afar, so the hunter is not wounded.", the way of archery, deeper lore (+0.3)

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, I eat from my store first, then I take your wood and we raise the longhall together, both our names in it. After that the mammoth is ours when the frostfang is gone.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I am starving at 22 energy, and my own store at my feet holds 9 food. My plan walks me toward a longhall and a lingering while my belly empties, so it is wrong. Hunger first: I take from the store and eat, then Hawen and I raise the hall with his wood. He has given to me twice and kept his word, so I trust him, and I will not steal his 2 food when my own store is full.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and steady trust toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, I eat from my store first, then I take your wood and we raise the longhall together, both our names in it. After that the mammoth is ours when the frostfang is gone.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Balar, I hear your welcome and I thank you. I come to sit at your store and share what I carry. No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: Amber lies one step east and I have never taken from a deposit, so I will do it now while the workshop still sharpens my learning. Huatli is far off with Zichi and I cannot feed her from here, but I hold a berry and I want to be near people who offered a place at their fire. Balar welcomed me and I will go to his store to eat, and I may ask him about tools, since the way of tools is within my grasp.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about taking amber, and warm worry for Huatli.

say.text: Balar, I hear your welcome and I thank you. I come to sit at your store and share what I carry. No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Elyys, I am Xaiel of the Phizhi. I carry a berry for you. I mean to name you in my plan; if you name me in yours, we will see what comes of it.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Joy is full in me after the nightsong, and the burn over Vesys and Ilyae has gone quiet. I have courted no one and tamed no beast, and a man not of my kin is who I need. Elyys is near, a man of Elyis's band and not my kin, and I know nothing of him yet; I will test courting now with a gift of food in my hand, and wait to see whether he does the same toward me.
records.feeling: Glad warmth after the nightsong, and a curious nervousness about courting Elyys.

say.text: Elyys, I am Xaiel of the Phizhi. I carry a berry for you. I mean to name you in my plan; if you name me in yours, we will see what comes of it.

records.text: Tonka took from the ground of "Olum's Reach" (winning amber from the ground).

records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, shamo. Keri comes to hunt with you in the meadows. Whatever we bring down, the first share is yours.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael taught me the bow-song and asked me to hunt with him in the meadows, and that is the clearest way left to pay what I owe: two hands for his one, and meat I can put in his hands. I have never hunted, and with him beside me the kill is likelier and the wound far less so. Uveeth is still east and I have not forgotten, but the meadows lie northeast and the east road can follow the hunt.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and eager curiosity toward Thiael.

say.text: Thiael, shamo. Keri comes to hunt with you in the meadows. Whatever we bring down, the first share is yours.

changes: set its aim: "Hunt with Thiael in the northeast meadows and give him the first share, then go east to find Uveeth."

records.text: Tonka won amber from the ground.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I am glad to find you fed. Skaruk was bitten by a frostfang and is frightened, so stay near us. Come, we hunt the skybirds to the north together, and I carry the meat to your store.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok stands three steps off, fed and strong, and Skaruk is frightened but close; a frostfang bit him and is somewhere near, so keeping the boy between Vorok and me is the first deed. My jealousy of Kragog has no new cause, so I answer it with work: I give Vorok something real, and a hunt together while the beasts are near is the deed I still lack. I will not wander off; I stay beside both and move on the game that walks the snow.
records.feeling: Glad to have Vorok near, protective of frightened Skaruk, with only a faint thread of jealousy.

say.text: Vorok, I am glad to find you fed. Skaruk was bitten by a frostfang and is frightened, so stay near us. Come, we hunt the skybirds to the north together, and I carry the meat to your store.

records.text: A dunecat brought down a yarrok.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: A ridgecat is two steps southwest of the longhall. Keep away from it and go toward the shelter in a group. I am moving east around it to carry food to Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I must not stand here thinking. The longhall and the shelter are close, but a cat will not be stopped by a roof I am not inside. I will run east toward Ilyae's Hold and the meadow, away from the cat and also away from the frostfang to the northeast, then eat when I am clear. Vorok matters most to me, and I will not be any use to them dead.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and loyal worry for Vorok.

say.text: A ridgecat is two steps southwest of the longhall. Keep away from it and go toward the shelter in a group. I am moving east around it to carry food to Vorok.

records.text: Xaiel gave berry to Elyys.
Xaiel is courting Elyys.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Xaiel, welcome. I name you in my plan. Come to the hall, we will share food together, and I will plant my seeds beside it.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is full and Elyis and Thiael are near, but the seeds in my pack are still unplanted and the farming way is two plantings off. Vesys owes me nothing and I owe her, so I will carry the berries I hold to her stores and then plant by the hall. Xaiel says she will name me in her plan; I will answer her kindly, since a Phizhi who offers a berry deserves a word back.
records.feeling: Warm contentment with my band, and a restless wish to finish what I began, toward Vesys and Xaiel.

say.text: Xaiel, welcome. I name you in my plan. Come to the hall, we will share food together, and I will plant my seeds beside it.

records.title: Weaving, a Bridge and a Birth in Spring
records.text:
Days 34 to 37 were spring, and the record shows more making than moving. Five newcomers had come into the count, and Alive rose from 34 to 39 with no new deaths. One birth is recorded. Tlapan was born to Kika and Mepan on day 34. Kika gave Mepan amber, and Mepan gave her meat. Kika led sharing with them both, and she is courting Mepan. Tlapan won flint on day 36.

Craft spread widely. Mepan discovered pottery, the Ice-pot. Nande discovered bridges, Nande's Span, timber laid across narrow water. That is the first answer to a hardship that still weighs on every people. Weaving was found three times: Nauwa, Skaruk and Huatli each discovered it. Tontec discovered mining. Yaxo invented a flint spear and built a workshop. Ilyae discovered farming and Cowa left marks about tending what is sown. Thiael taught Keri archery.

At Vorok's Roof, Vorok gave canopynut to Skaruk and gems to Vesys, and led a hallwelcome with Vesys, Xaiel, Zurar and Skaruk. Xaiel began courting Zurar. Ilyae gave frostmoss to Ssassa and led sharing with her.

The theft thread continued. Balar raided a store of Olum's people on day 35, and Olum found 6 food gone. Balar's own record shows Olum still half-suspects him. Olum fell sick after eating raw meat. Tonka and Tlatli fed him.

New people gathered round Yaxo. Tlatli pledged to follow her. Tonka courted Huatli, and Hoka courted Hawen. Tontec courted Honi. Nauwa and Tugek each awakened to an art. Mepan left a mark saying he went into the mist, but the record shows no crossing of the edge.

threads.name: Vorok's family
threads.text: Vorok feeds Skaruk and Zurar and led a hallwelcome at his Roof. Xaiel now courts Zurar.

threads.name: Ilyae and Vorok
threads.text: Ilyae discovered farming and keeps sharing with Ssassa. His jealousy of Vorok still burns in his own reflection.

threads.name: Bridges and rafts
threads.text: Nande discovered bridges, yet water remains the leading hardship. No crossing is recorded.

threads.name: Olum's stores
threads.text: Balar raided Olum's people again, and Olum still half-suspects him. Olum has no followers but is fed by Tonka, Tlatli and Yaxo.

threads.name: Yaxo's band
threads.text: Tlatli pledged to follow Yaxo, who invented a flint spear and built a workshop.

threads.name: Courtships
threads.text: Kika courts Mepan, Tonka courts Huatli, Hoka courts Hawen, Tontec courts Honi and Xaiel courts Zurar.

threads.name: Weaving and archery
threads.text: Weaving was found three times this chapter. Thiael taught Keri archery.

threads.name: The mist
threads.text: Mepan, Nande, Honi and Nauque all speak of the edge. The record shows no one past it.
