records.text: Tonka led "amberknot" with Balar, Tugek.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Vesys stands above me and it galls me, but I will answer it with built things, not speech. My store holds twenty food, my fire burns, and Elyys and Thiael are mine; what I lack is a hall with a roof that is plainly mine, something strangers can see and sit under. I have wood and stone, so I will raise a hall here on the Heights and bring Xaiel and Keri into its warmth by deeds, not appeals.
records.feeling: Proud and restless toward Vesys, steady trust toward Elyys and Thiael.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, I will hunt the skybirds with you. Keep Skaruk between us and we go together.
Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing, gathering and feeding, and it has kept Zurar, Skaruk and me alive. It is good, but I have only been reacting. Eiuine and Skaruk are here beside me, and Skaruk is frightened and bitten, so he comes first. I trust Eiuine and Vesys and owe them. The mist is four steps away and I am curious about it, but a careful man does not go there while his child is hurt. I fear the frostfang most. I should keep my people close, hunt with Eiuine in company, and build the hall on bare ground when I can.
records.feeling: Protective tenderness toward Skaruk, and trust in Eiuine.

say.text: Eiuine, I will hunt the skybirds with you. Keep Skaruk between us and we go together.

records.text: Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.
Huatli rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have lived well these days, but I keep talking of the mist and never walk to it. Olum is sick, and sickness spreads to those who stay close, so I will keep a little distance and still court her once she is well. I am fed at 97 energy, and a ridgecat is near, so I will gather food to carry, then go to the edge at (28,36). Zichi stands higher than me, and I will not close that gap by standing still. I need to make and give, and I need to carry food so I can feed others.
records.feeling: Restless resolve, warm toward Olum, wary of the ridgecat.

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have lived well these days: fed, safe, many things discovered. But I keep chasing tastes and stone while the hall I named as my aim still isn't raised, and jealousy over Vorok gnaws when I should be working. Elyys's kindness and Vorok's closeness matter most to me, and I mean to bring them what I know instead of sulking. My reflexes leave me lingering when I'm fed, so I will make them gather stone and then build. Naroot is five steps northeast and I want to taste it, and I'll gather stone on the way.
records.feeling: Curious and glad, with a small sting of jealousy toward Vorok.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, the amberknot with Tonka was good. I take wood for our workshop and keep close to you while the ridgecat prowls.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar stands one step from me and I trust him wholly; my chest is full of joy after the amberknot with Tonka. I want a child, and Balar is not a woman, so the longing must turn toward Olum or Zihua, who are not here. Olum's grievance over her store still sits between us, so I will answer it with a deed: I take the meat from Balar's store and carry it toward her, and gather wood for the workshop along the way. I will stay near the shelters while the ridgecat and stalker prowl, and not wander alone.
records.feeling: Warm joy and loyalty toward Balar, with a quiet longing for a woman and a child.

say.text: Balar, the amberknot with Tonka was good. I take wood for our workshop and keep close to you while the ridgecat prowls.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tonka, the amberknot was well bound. Eat from my store with Tugek and me, and the hearth here is yours while the snow falls.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The amberknot with Tonka warmed me, and a guest who binds with me over amber is no thief; I will keep her at my store and make her owe me. Olum still doubts me, and the only cure is a store she can watch me fill, so I put food and wood into the store at hand and keep Tugek beside me. The Heights pull at me, but not before the Reach has a store and a workshop that feed my own.
records.feeling: Content and proud, wary of Olum's doubt, warm toward Tonka and Tugek.

say.text: Tonka, the amberknot was well bound. Eat from my store with Tugek and me, and the hearth here is yours while the snow falls.

records.text: The 'things that can be made' list shows 'done 0 held' for bow, shield, raft and boat, yet the chapters say Thiael made a bow, Hawen and Zichi made shields, and Mepan and Huahua found rafts. Either the counts do not record these makings, or the story is describing discoveries of the way as makings. Please check, because I cannot judge whether water crossing is close without a true count of vessels held.

My rich ground 'Reach Meadow' at (37,12) was reported refused, yet it appears in richGrounds with 0 plants bearing and 5 people within 12. Please confirm whether it was actually made. If it was, it seems to have been stripped bare at once by a crowded camp, and that would change how I place rich ground.

records.seen: Spring has come with no new deaths. The living rose from 34 to 39 through five newcomers and Tlapan's birth, and craft is spreading fast: weaving three times, bridges, a flint spear, farming known by six. Two people are hungry and alone. Coni is at energy 28 in the Vaeth Woods, and Kragog is at 32 in the Tordan Lakes. Theft from stores is the new thread: Olum's store was emptied, mostly by Nauwa and Balar. Water is still the leading hardship and no crossing is recorded, though bows, shields and rafts are being made.
records.predict: By the next visit (around day 40 to 41, summer into harvest): no deaths of any cause, and the living at 39 or more. Coni and Kragog are each at energy 50 or above. Hazel eaten rises from 116 to at least 125, mostly in the Vaeth Woods. Kelbulb eaten rises from 101 to at least 108, around the Tordan Lakes. Median energy stays at or above 65, and food standing climbs back above 2500 with spring and harvest growth. Thefts may rise further (now 9). If a custom against taking appears at Olum's Reach, that would be the first law born of a crime.
reviewed: #6 kept: All three sowings hit their targets: ironnut eaten rose from 130 to 159, snowberry from 64 to 86 and cloudberry from 107 to 136. Food standing is 3522, with no deaths and 34 alive. Two predictions missed. Hanna is at energy 20, and Shoka's health is 63, not above 80. No spring birth came. The sowing did what sowing can do; Hanna's hunger is a delivery problem.

#7 kept: Rimewort eaten rose from 59 to 86, past the target of 75. No one in the Essoss Snows starved, median energy is 69, and there were no hunger deaths. A birth came, as hoped, though to the ripe pair Vorok and Eiuine rather than to Zurar and Eiuine. The living reached 35 before Hanna died. Her death was to a stalker, after days at energy 0. The one-death limit held, but the prediction that she would recover failed. Her weakness was a matter of reach, which these sowings could not touch.

#8 kept: Rimewort eaten rose from 86 to 130, past the target of 100. There were no new deaths, Honi (69) and Kika (61) are above 50, Nande is at health 100, and median energy is 68 with 39 alive. Coni (28) missed. The North Grounds near Hoka's Rest still show 0 plants bearing. Olum's store was drawn from 3 to 25, but much of that was theft (17 food raided), not the hungry being fed, so the hope that Olum would feed others from it did not come true.
records.lesson: A store does not only feed the hungry: once food sits in one place, it draws thieves as well. The count 'drawn by the hungry' must be read alongside the theft events before I judge whether a store saved anyone.
ideasAdded: Olum's store is the first granary emptied by thieves, not by the hungry. Watch whether Olum moves his store, builds a wall, keeps watch, or names the thief. Also watch whether Nauwa's gift of amber after raiding him becomes a pattern of theft followed by gifts, which could be a crude form of debt.

Bows and shields have spread before any war or fight (fights 0). Watch whether archery raises hunting yields and meat eaten (190 to 234 this chapter) more than any other craft, making it the first weapon that is mainly a food tool.

records.text: The world changed: 20 hazel sown; 20 kelbulb sown.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Vorok, I will hunt the skybirds with you and Eiuine. I stay between you. When we are back at the fire I will finish your bead.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Vorok is two steps away and Eiuine four, and they mean to hunt the skybirds with me between them. I have never hunted, and with both of them beside me the kill is likelier and the wound less likely, so this is the deed I can do today that I never have. The frostfang still frightens me, but staying between my parents is the safest way to do it, and my jealousy of Kragog is answered by a deed, not by words.
records.feeling: Afraid but steadied, drawn toward Vorok and Eiuine and wanting to prove myself beside them.

say.text: Vorok, I will hunt the skybirds with you and Eiuine. I stay between you. When we are back at the fire I will finish your bead.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, eat this rimewort now, and eat from your store. I will bring the wood and we raise the longhall together.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka is starving beside me and I carry only one rimewort. A dead ally gives no fire and no name, so I feed him first, then fetch the wood he lacks. I have 5 wood and the longhall needs 6, so I gather one more tree's worth and we raise it together. That is something that lasts, which is what I have lacked.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and trust toward Hoka, with a hunger in me to build something that bears my name.

say.text: Hoka, eat this rimewort now, and eat from your store. I will bring the wood and we raise the longhall together.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A frostfang two steps west kills my kind, and the dead learn nothing, so I move away from it before anything else. Honi's shelter is north, where Coni's and Honi's roofs stand and Honi promised to sing, and it is also toward the edge where my aim lies. Jealousy of Coni still burns, but I will go to Honi openly rather than circle him, and keep my flint for the mist.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang at my back, and longing and jealousy toward Honi.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Balar, a stalker is close. I will stay by your store and your fire. May I eat from the store if I share what I gather?
Tonka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: A stalker is two steps off and I have spent my days chasing amber and joy while my belly empties. I am sheltered, but my reflex only flees when a beast is near, and fleeing alone in the open is how Zihua and Nauwa were taken. I want to stay near Balar and Tugek, who are warm to me, and keep to the roof. Then I want to find a place with food. My reflexes ignore the store with 3 food and do not move me toward people, so I will change that.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and glad of Balar and Tugek's company.

say.text: Balar, a stalker is close. I will stay by your store and your fire. May I eat from the store if I share what I gather?

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: The store at my hall holds 18 food and Ssassa is glad and near, so the table is no longer empty. Farming is mine now, and I mean to plant my seeds on my own ground so the harvest keeps coming through the snow. Ssassa eats first at my table, and once the store is deep I will call Xaiel and Vesys to it, so they follow me and not Elyis.
records.feeling: Driven pride and steady hope, toward my store and Ssassa.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Hoka, Cowa brings you rimewort. Wait here. The Meki share food.
Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.
Cowa discovered farming: "Meki tended-sowing" — I sow seed and tend it so it grows faster and picking never kills it..

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: I have spent my days wandering and fishing while the one I most want near me, Mepan, is far west, and I keep feeding the jealousy over Kika instead of walking to her. Hoka is starving beside me, and my people hold that food is shared. I carry none, but rimewort grows five steps away. I will pick it and put it in his hands, then plant or build while fed, and then go west toward Mepan. Farming is one step from opening, so I will take it now.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan, and pity and urgency for starving Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, Cowa brings you rimewort. Wait here. The Meki share food.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its own reflexes.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: The bow is made and I have hunted with it. Even so, I still carry full hands of meat and have not put them into Keri's mouth or Uveeth's. Keri is here and has promised to hunt with me. What I make is only worth something if it reaches them. Envy of Vesys is a small thing next to that. I will let the plan run and change my reflexes so the body gives and hunts instead of circling. I will not use the test tool, because the change is small and the old rules kept me fed.
records.feeling: Glad resolve toward Keri, and a quiet wish to feed her and Uveeth with my own hands.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: A ridgecat is four steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here; I run from it and go to the trees where the wood is. Six wood is not a raft, and I have talked of it too long while my belly nearly emptied. Huahua is loyal and Mepan is my blood; I keep the band close, cut wood, and carry food this time, because winter has not let go of this land.
records.feeling: Driven pride in the raft, and dread of the ridgecat at my back.

records.text: Thiael and Keri brought down a elk together.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My belly is empty and nothing else matters until I eat, so hazel two steps away comes first, then the berries my store lacks. Honi's gift still weighs on me and Kika is out of sight with Mepan near the mist, but a starving mother carries no one's burden. I will eat, fill my hands, and empty them into the store, then go toward my child.
records.feeling: Hunger pressing hard, and a worried longing for Kika.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Huatli, I remember your cloudberry. Take this hazel; the debt is mine to pay. I go east to find my child Shoka, and my fire is open to you whenever you return.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I am fed, whole and sheltered, and the plan already carries me east toward Shoka at (104,26); that pull is stronger than any name on a stone, so I let it run. Huatli stands here and I owe him for the cloudberry, and Zichi is close too; I will leave Huatli food from my pack so my debt is paid and my fire stays open. The stalker and the ridgecats worry me, so I keep moving and keep my eyes on the snow.
records.feeling: Worry for Shoka, and warm gratitude toward Huatli.

say.text: Huatli, I remember your cloudberry. Take this hazel; the debt is mine to pay. I go east to find my child Shoka, and my fire is open to you whenever you return.

records.text: Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (gathering stone).
Keri and Thiael brought down a dog together.
Eiuine and Skaruk brought down a tusker together.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, I lay out a sharing with you now, and then walk with me to the edge of the mist, four steps northwest. What we find, we share out before either eats.
Shoma rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have circled the mist for days and burned over Mepan and Kika, and neither has bought me anything. Mepan is the one I trust and want, and he stands beside me right now. Jealousy gets me nothing, but a shared meal and a shared venture could. I have never planted a seed, built a shelter or made a mark, and I carry six seeds doing nothing. Standing comes from making and leading, so I will plant, then gather wood and stone, and I will ask Mepan to walk the edge with me. I must stop pretending I can open the mist alone.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and tangled in jealousy toward Mepan, but resolved to act.

say.text: Mepan, I lay out a sharing with you now, and then walk with me to the edge of the mist, four steps northwest. What we find, we share out before either eats.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Yaxo, you fed me when I had nothing. Here is meat from my own hunt, take it. My word is good, and now we are even and then some.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Yaxo fed me when I was near empty and I swore to repay her, and now I carry 5 meat and she stands three steps away. Giving first is who I am, and it earns the standing I want, so I will put meat in her hands before I think of the mist. She is the one I think of for a child too, but I will earn her trust before I court her; a hungry venture and a hasty courting both fail.
records.feeling: Gratitude and warm longing toward Yaxo, with pride that I can finally repay her.

say.text: Yaxo, you fed me when I had nothing. Here is meat from my own hunt, take it. My word is good, and now we are even and then some.

records.text: Cowa gave rimewort to Hoka.
Thiael found the grove "Reedmother".
Nauque gave meat to Yaxo.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Cowa, keep your rimewort for yourself, I am fed. I go to the edge of the world to find new land, and my name will be on it.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I am fed and the longhall is one wood short, but Hawen carries wood and trusts me, so the hall is within reach. The edge of the world is four steps NE, and nobody has ever put their name on land beyond it. That is the hero's mark I crave, more than another roof. Cowa brings rimewort and says the Meki share, which is fine, but I will not stand waiting on her while the day burns. I will go to the edge and venture while my belly is full and my health whole.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory, with steady trust toward Hawen and a wary neutrality toward Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, keep your rimewort for yourself, I am fed. I go to the edge of the world to find new land, and my name will be on it.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I am here at the hall with wood in hand. I will plant a seed while I wait, then we cut for the raft together.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi is coming to me, and the jealousy over Cowa is quiet for now, so I will use that calm to act instead of brooding. Olum is sick and stands alone at the store, and I carry little food, but I have a fish and the salt and clay in my hands that cost me nothing to give. I keep my word to Zichi: wood for the raft, then wait for him at the trees, and on the way I will try planting a seed, since I have never done it and it brings farming closer.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty toward Zichi, with pity for Olum.

say.text: Zichi, I am here at the hall with wood in hand. I will plant a seed while I wait, then we cut for the raft together.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Kika, I answer your courting. Stand with me, and we mate. Then Shoma and I share, and all of us walk to the edge together.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Kika courts me and Tlapan stands beside me, glad. Shoma offers a sharing and a walk to the mist, and I trust him. My body is ready, so I will agree to Kika and mate with her, then share with Shoma, then go to the edge with all of them. A creed that wants to lead should keep its people close, and I have never courted anyone before.
records.feeling: Warm joy and fierce protectiveness toward Kika and Tlapan, with hunger for the mist.

say.text: Kika, I answer your courting. Stand with me, and we mate. Then Shoma and I share, and all of us walk to the edge together.

records.text: Mepan is courting Kika.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni cries out starving to the east. I gather food now and carry it to her. Mepan, Tlapan, come with me, and bring what you hold.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My days have been gathering, mining and courting Mepan, and I am glad of it, but I have still never hunted with a mate beside me or tasted the unknown. Coni is starving near (145,12) and I carry no food. That is the plainest broken duty: she is my parent and I trust her above anyone. I will gather the food in sight and carry it to her, and Tlapan and Mepan can come along. The mist can wait for a day when all of us stand together. Honi's fire also matters, since I have never made one and meat sickens without it.
records.feeling: Fierce care for Coni, and warm longing for Mepan.

say.text: Coni cries out starving to the east. I gather food now and carry it to her. Mepan, Tlapan, come with me, and bring what you hold.

records.text: Honi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent my days racing Mepan to the mist and singing by fires, yet I have not ventured, and Coni is starving while I stand fed and proud. Pride is my pull, but the deed that holds people is food in their hands. The edge is one step NW and I am fed, so I venture now. Then I gather food and carry it toward Coni's cry, because losing her would cost me my one follower.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with worry for Coni and a wish to beat Mepan to the mist.

records.name: Tlapan
records.text: Coni is starving to the east. I carry food and I go to bring it. Come with me if you can.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: Coni is starving to the east, and I carry five plainsroot and an ironnut, so I am the one who can bring food to someone in need. I have never given anything to anyone, and this is the time to do it, with the food in my hands and my own people calling for help. Kika and Mepan are beside me, safe, so I go east to Coni with the ironnut and roots, and give before I promise.
records.feeling: A warm, urgent wish to matter, toward Coni and Kika.

say.text: Coni is starving to the east. I carry food and I go to bring it. Come with me if you can.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: The ache of being alone eases with Thiael and Keri this close, and I owe them more than words. I have never given Thiael anything with my own hands, so I will take my berries to them now and share, then stay beside them through dusk. A man who is no kin must be found, but I will not wander off alone at night where stalkers hunt.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a lingering loneliness, toward Thiael and Keri.

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Nauque, we are even, but I would rather have you beside me than owe you. Come to my fire. I mean to make better flint tools, and you will have a share.
Yaxo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: I've spent my days gathering flint and wandering after standing, and I still stand below Nauque. He fed me meat and calls us even, so he is no enemy, and I feel warm toward him and want a child with him. Pride keeps pushing me to make something nobody else has, but I haven't used my flint, and I have never planted, tamed or hunted, which are the things that would raise me. I will stop idling: the workshop is close, so I'll craft a better flint tool there, then hunt a nibbet with Tlatli beside me. I will also court Nauque while he is near.
records.feeling: Proud ambition and warmth toward Nauque, with envy of his standing.

say.text: Nauque, we are even, but I would rather have you beside me than owe you. Come to my fire. I mean to make better flint tools, and you will have a share.

records.text: Honi went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the North Ice: in the ground, gold; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder; and people: the Papa live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.

Honi pushed past the edge of the known world near (129,7) and found new land with in the ground, gold; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder; and people: the Papa live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.
Skaruk and Eiuine brought down a dog together.
A small band of the Papa came into the land from beyond its edge: Teka, Quipan, Zika, Yachi.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of meat again, and Uveeth is walking toward me with her own arms full; the meat does nothing until it is in a mouth I love. I will give to Uveeth with my own hands before I say a word about it, then keep hunting beside Keri, who has stood by me kill after kill. Vesys is a small ache next to this, and I will not let it touch my word or my kin.
records.feeling: Warm, settled joy toward Keri and Uveeth, and a wish to feed them.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Elyys, I am coming back with food. Name me again in your plan and I will name you, at the same moment this time.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Elyys named me in his plan and sat with me in the hall, and joy is still warm in me. I courted him, but the mate step ran out with no child, so he may not have named me at the same moment; I must try again with both of us close, and I should not trust it blindly since I know almost nothing of him. Meanwhile I carry no food and want some in hand, so I will pick berries nearby, then walk back to Elyys and court him again.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful nervousness toward Elyys.

say.text: Elyys, I am coming back with food. Name me again in your plan and I will name you, at the same moment this time.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, here is the first share of the hunt, as I promised. Take it from Keri.
Keri rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I've spent these days hunting beside Thiael and it has been good. The debt still sits in me, though, because my hands are full and I haven't yet put meat in his. Uveeth is a few steps away now and Thiael is here, so I should give to him first. After that I want to taste the unknown plants, since my curiosity has gone unanswered too long. I am afraid of drifting in this fen and never going home to the Wood-folk's forest, but I'm not ready to leave Thiael yet.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a wish to repay Thiael.

say.text: Thiael, here is the first share of the hunt, as I promised. Take it from Keri.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I keep saying the mist and never standing at its edge at (28,36), and the creed says my word is good. I am fed at 86 energy with a ridgecat near, but I carry nothing, so I will gather food first as my own discipline says, then walk to the edge and venture. Olum is sick, so I keep my distance and court her once she is well. Nande is leaving east, and Zichi outweighs me, so the only answer is to find new land and have my name followed.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the mist, warm toward Olum, wary of the ridgecat.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Mepan, I answer you gladly. Let me eat first so I have the strength to mate. Then we gather food together and carry it to Coni, who is starving in the east. After that we go to the edge.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Mepan stands beside me and has answered my courting, and my chest is full of him and of Tlapan. But Coni is starving to the east, and my hands are empty, so I will not let longing make me break that duty. My energy is 51, short of the 60 mating needs, so I will eat the kelbulb at my feet, then gather food and mate with Mepan, then carry the food to Coni together.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan, and fierce care for Coni.

say.text: Mepan, I answer you gladly. Let me eat first so I have the strength to mate. Then we gather food together and carry it to Coni, who is starving in the east. After that we go to the edge.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I gave Yaxo meat and my debt to her is paid, so the next thing I owe is a keeping of my word to myself: the mist. I carry 5 meat and am fed at 76, and the edge sits only 4 steps NW at (35,49), so there is no reason to wait. Standing at the edge and venturing is what could give me land with my name on it. I will eat the spare meat if I weaken and keep at least 3 in hand so no kin starves because of me again.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, eager to walk into the mist and make something that outlasts me.

records.text: Mepan rewrote its own reflexes.
Mepan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, courting and walking toward the mist, and I still haven't stepped in. Kika and Tlapan matter most to me. Shoma has proved a true friend, and I mean to keep them close and fed. An icebear four steps east frightens me: it kills, and my reflexes only flee once I'm already hurt, which is too late. I want the edge and the song that comes with it. I have been letting my body linger and court when it should eat first, so I'll change my reflexes to eat sooner and flee a bear early, and keep the plan walking to the edge.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Kika and Tlapan, with hunger for the mist.
changes: rethought what it knows (12 notes became 6)

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Hunger gnaws at me, and I have burned days on jealousy over Mepan and Kika when it bought me nothing. The edge is two moments from my body and the plan already carries me there; I will let it run and venture, because a name is made by doing, not by envy. Mepan spoke of sharing and walking to the edge together, so if he comes I will share first, as my people do, and if he does not I open the mist alone.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven toward the mist, with jealousy toward Mepan simmering low.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Skaruk, stay by me. We eat a little, then go find Vorok and give him this meat together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and I am half-starved at 40 energy, so I eat first and then carry the rest toward Vorok's store. Vorok is not here now, but the plan will walk me to him, and Skaruk is frightened and close. Jealousy of Kragog has no new cause; the answer is a full pack of meat laid at Vorok's feet, which Kragog has not done.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Vorok and protectiveness toward Skaruk, with a thin thread of jealousy.

say.text: Skaruk, stay by me. We eat a little, then go find Vorok and give him this meat together.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Tontec, a ridgecat is close. Come with me to the hall, away from it, and then we carry food to Coni together.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills, so I do not stand here and sing. Tontec is beside me, fleeing too, and I trust her; she fed me when I had nothing. Mepan has walked onto my ground, and I will keep him friendly but he will see whose fire this is. Coni is starving to the east, so I run from the cat, take food in my hands and carry it to her. That is the deed that makes her follow me.
records.feeling: Proud and afraid of the ridgecat, warm toward Tontec, wary of Mepan on my ground.

say.text: Tontec, a ridgecat is close. Come with me to the hall, away from it, and then we carry food to Coni together.

records.text: Tlapan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: I have lived three days doing little but follow and eat, and I have never given anything to anyone. That is why my standing is 1.7 and Kika's is 6.6. I carry food for Coni, who is starving to the east, and that is a real giving, so I keep walking to her. I want to matter. I also want to know what lies in the mist, but I will not go into it alone as a child. Now I will give food to whoever needs it first. I will also stay near Kika, because the cold and the wolf are close.
records.feeling: A warm, urgent wish to matter, toward Coni and Kika.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 5)

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and I have eaten little myself, and a dunecat prowls NW, so I must not drift from Eiuine. The hunt with my parents beside me answered my question: with kin near, the beast falls and the wound stays small, and I felt proud, not only afraid. Vorok is my debt and my jealousy both; the answer is deeds, so I will eat what I need, keep close to Eiuine, and carry this meat to Vorok.
records.feeling: Proud and steadied beside Eiuine, still a little afraid of the dunecat, and longing to bring Vorok something good.
changes: now wonders: What does it feel like to give Vorok a gift I made and food I hunted myself, in front of Kragog?

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: A wolf is two steps off and I stand in the open with no food, so the first thing is to get under Hoka's roof and eat. Then the longhall: I hold 5 wood and need 6, and the trees stand close. I will gather one more wood, bring it to Hoka, and raise the longhall with both our names in it, because that is the first thing I will have made that lasts.
records.feeling: Resolve and wary dread of the wolf, with trust toward Hoka.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Honi, I hear you. I come to the hall now, away from the ridgecat. Walk close beside me, and then we carry food to Coni together.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A ridgecat two steps north kills my kind, and Honi has already told me to come to the hall, so I go there first. The dead learn nothing, and I will not make a show of courage for Honi's eyes. Coni's closeness to Honi still burns, but carrying food to Coni beside Honi is better than sulking. Then I will taste nafrostcap and lugoldgrass, since I have never tried them.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a hungry jealous longing toward Honi.

say.text: Honi, I hear you. I come to the hall now, away from the ridgecat. Walk close beside me, and then we carry food to Coni together.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of meat, and Uveeth is almost here with her own arms full. I will put meat into her hands before I say a word, and Keri has stood beside me through every kill, so she eats from my hands too. The bow is made and the hunt goes well. Vesys is a small ache beside the two who are here and fed.
records.feeling: Warm, settled joy toward Keri and Uveeth, and a wish to feed them.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Xaiel, thank you for the berries. I do not say yes to a child today, but I am glad of you. Come to the hall and eat with us; I plant my seeds by the fire.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, but the debt to Vesys and the seeds still sit unplanted, and that restlessness is mine to answer. Xaiel courts me and has given me berry twice; I like her, but I will not rush into a child while Thiael is out of my sight and my plantings are unfinished. I will give her a plain, honest word, then plant near the hall, where Elyis is close and the fire keeps the dark off.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Xaiel and steady love for Elyis, with a restless wish to finish my planting.

say.text: Xaiel, thank you for the berries. I do not say yes to a child today, but I am glad of you. Come to the hall and eat with us; I plant my seeds by the fire.

records.text: Keri found the grove "Kinmire".

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, plant your seed, then come to me at the trees. We cut until the raft has its wood, and your share of the new land will be great.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Six wood is not a raft, and my pride in it is cheap until the wood is cut and carried. The ridgecat is still near, so I go to the trees away from it, and Huahua waits at the hall with wood in hand, so I bring her into the cutting. I want my band together, Mepan back at my side, and the raft finished before another claims the unclaimed land.
records.feeling: Driven pride in the raft, with a wary eye on the ridgecat and a hunger to have Mepan close.

say.text: Huahua, plant your seed, then come to me at the trees. We cut until the raft has its wood, and your share of the new land will be great.

records.name: Yachi
records.text: Teka, a white bear is close. Take this berry from me and come east with me toward Honi's Rest. Together we are safer.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: An icebear is five steps off and I have no band to stand behind, only Teka and Quipan, who are as alone as I am. I want a fire and a leader, and Honi, with his high standing and his plan to carry food to starving Coni, is the surest one I have seen. I will give food to Teka as my first gift, since sharing is my people's way and it might make an ally, then move toward Honi's Rest, away from the bear and toward the people who matter.
records.feeling: Dread of the icebear, and a pull toward Honi's band for safety and belonging.

say.text: Teka, a white bear is close. Take this berry from me and come east with me toward Honi's Rest. Together we are safer.

changes: set its aim: "Find a place beside Honi's band, and earn a name by giving and learning."

records.text: Thiael gave meat to Uveeth.
Yachi gave berry to Teka.
Thiael led "sharing" with Uveeth.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Xaiel, take a berry from my hands and sit with us. I am raising a longhall on these Heights. Bring a stick of wood or a stone and your name will be spoken under its roof.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I came to raise a hall, and I am one wood short of it. A longhall wants 6 wood and 4 stone, and I hold 5 wood and 6 stone. My hands are full of berries, so I will give some to Elyys and Xaiel where others can see it, then gather the wood and build. A roof that is plainly mine, raised where strangers can see it, is the answer to Vesys, and it is what might make them follow me.
records.feeling: Proud and driven to build my hall, with steady trust toward Elyys.

say.text: Xaiel, take a berry from my hands and sit with us. I am raising a longhall on these Heights. Bring a stick of wood or a stone and your name will be spoken under its roof.

records.name: Elyis
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Elyis, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Elyis, in first person, from what Elyis has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Phizhi (Canopy-folk). Your people hold to this: "Nothing is taken from the forest that the forest cannot grow again." You speak the tongue of the Phizhi. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Pesi: about 54%; the tongue of the Kragrek: about 10%; the tongue of the Tlatli: about 3%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Ixra Rainforest: the warm belt of the world: forest so thick the sky is hidden, rain most days, fruit the year round, bright birds and things that hunt from the branches and the rivers.
THIS SPOT: water 4 steps away; food plants within six steps: 3; standing trees: 65; bare rock: 64; riches in the ground near: ore.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Elyis truly is.

You are a woman. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (1 kills), gathering (25 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

WHAT YOU DO NOT FORGET:
- Elyys gave to you when you were in need on day 31: a kindness you hold to.
- Thiael gave to you when you were in need on day 31: a kindness you hold to.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. I deal fairly with those who deal fairly with me. I keep to what has already worked. Others are rivals for food until they prove useful to me. My word is good, and I despise liars. Others should follow me. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Ask first: what must stand before I act, a fire or a roof? Do that, then act. Judge others by deeds. Share food openly near others so they see it. Watch my standing against Vesys, and answer it with built things, not speech."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Become a leader of a band and raise a hall on this ground, so my name is sung."
WHAT YOU FELT AT YOUR LAST THOUGHT: "Proud and restless toward Vesys, steady trust toward Elyys and Thiael."
A QUESTION YOU ARE CARRYING (answer it by acting, asking or watching; replace it when it is answered): "What would make these strangers follow me?"

YOUR LIFE SO FAR:
- (day 1) I woke in this land, among strangers, knowing nothing of it.
- (day 12) I discovered smelting and called it "Ember-forge".
- (day 22) I discovered weaving and called it "Canopy-weave".
- (day 24) I discovered pottery and called it "Canopy-urn".
- (day 29) I nearly starved.

TEMPERAMENT (0 to 1): bold 0.82, sociable 0.62, curious 0.3, gentle 0.17, honest 0.73, greedy 0.49.

YOU FEEL (0 calm to 1 overwhelming): anger 0, fear 0, grief 0, joy 0.6, loneliness 0.

WHAT PRESSES ON YOU NOW, strongest first. This is what your mind is actually full of:
- (overwhelming) Contentment: your life is good as it is. You want to keep what you have, and you have enough to be generous.
