Bring a stick of wood or a stone and your name will be spoken under its roof.", "claim": {"food": "berry", "effect": "feeds"}}, "plan": [{"do": "give", "name": "Xaiel", "what": "food", "ticks": 5}, {"do": "gather", "ticks": 40}, {"do": "build", "what": "longhall", "ticks": 60}, {"do": "make", "what": "hallwelcome", "ticks": 30}], "note": null, "feel": {"Xaiel": 0.1}, "mood": null, "pledge": null, "place": null, "aim": null, "stance": null, "custom": null}

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My hands are full and the plan already carries me to Uveeth with food, and that is right: family first, and no predator is near. Then I want to taste the hazel and ironnut beside me, since my curiosity is loud and the hazel is one step away. Thiael already took his first share, so the debt is eased, but I will keep hunting with him and learn his bow-song better.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael and curiosity about the hazel.

records.text: Olum rewrote its own reflexes.
Olum discovered archery: "stone-bow" — A bow of wood strung with sinew, so I hunt from afar and need not eat raw kills in a hurry..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing a following and a name while sickness eats me, and I eat raw meat like a fool. Fire cooks it clean, and I keep forgetting that. Nauwa is the one I trust and burn for, and jealousy of Nande makes me small. Huatli fed with me and has dealt fairly, and he is the closest thing to a following I have. I want a hearth and a store that outlast me, and I want the bow to hunt surely. I will stop eating raw and keep fed. I will go to Huatli's Gold, away from others so I don't spread the sickness, and build a fire there.
records.feeling: Wary and proud, aching with jealousy over Nauwa, warm toward Huatli.

records.text: Tlatli and Yaxo brought down a nibbet together.

records.name: Teka
records.text: Yachi, Zika, Quipan, I'm going to the edge of the world to venture into the mist. Come with me and be named beside me when it's sung. A band that finds new land eats well.

records.name: Teka
records.thought: Kika's standing is 6.6 and mine is 0.6, and it stings. The edge of the world is three steps NW and nobody has gone in, so if I venture first I'm the one they sing of. Yachi gave me a berry and I gave nothing back; I can use him and Zika, and I'll flatter them with warmth I don't feel. My hands are full, so I'll eat first, then walk to the edge and venture, wolf or no wolf.
records.feeling: Hungry for renown, and envious of Kika.

say.text: Yachi, Zika, Quipan, I'm going to the edge of the world to venture into the mist. Come with me and be named beside me when it's sung. A band that finds new land eats well.

changes: set its aim: "Venture into the mist and be remembered as the first to find new land."
now wonders: What lies in the mist, and can I be the first to claim it?

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, and Thiael stands three steps away. He has fed me with meat and I have given him nothing from my own hands, so I will put a berry in his hand before I say anything about it. Dusk is coming and snow with it, so I stay close to him and Keri. The hunt has shown me what a shared kill is, and I want to learn it myself, but not alone and not in the dark.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael, and a wish to repay him with my own hands.

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, I am beside you for the hunt. I have never made a kill, so show me where to stand, and what we take is for your fire.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Yaxo called us to hunt and her fire is the one place where my creed is kept, so I will stay at her side and learn the hunt from her, since I have never taken an animal. A nibbet is close and she has just killed one; a kill shared makes me useful to her, not only a mouth at her fire. I am fed and glad, but I want to give something real, so I will hunt beside her and bring what I take back to her fire, and keep clear of the stalker to the southwest.
records.feeling: Longing to belong, steady and a little glad, toward Yaxo.

say.text: Yaxo, I am beside you for the hunt. I have never made a kill, so show me where to stand, and what we take is for your fire.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Elyis, I am bringing wood and stone for your longhall. Let my name be spoken under its roof.
Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: My days have been gathering, making and wandering near the people I love, and the making has been good, but I have courted only once and tamed nothing. Ilyae still matters most, and the burn over Vesys is noise, because she is kin and can never bear my child. Elyys was warm to me but said no to a child today, so I won't push him. I'll take Elyis's offer and put wood and stone into her longhall, because deeds put in hands are how I earn trust and standing. My hands are full of berries, so I'll eat one first and then go north with stone and wood.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Elyys, and a steady wish to be counted among Elyis's people.

say.text: Elyis, I am bringing wood and stone for your longhall. Let my name be spoken under its roof.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, hunger bites me and a boar stands close. Come now, we take it together and eat by the hearth.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, so food comes first. A bristleboar is two steps away, but the ridgecat three steps SE would kill me if I hunt alone. Tugek is seven steps west and Tonka is near my store, so I will call a hunt and take the boar with them, then eat by my hearth where the meat is safe. Eating and staying alive come before the workshop and before Olum's doubt.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the ridgecat, but trusting Tugek to stand beside me.

say.text: Tugek, hunger bites me and a boar stands close. Come now, we take it together and eat by the hearth.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.
Tugek discovered rafts: "Stone-folk lashed logs" — Bind logs with woven cord into a raft that carries us over deep water slowly..

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days fed and near Balar, and that is good. But I keep putting off the child I say I want, and I have never courted anyone. Balar is a man, so the longing has to turn to Olum or Zihua, and Olum's mark at her store shows she wants deeds from me. I fear a stalker catching me alone at night, so I stay by the fire and the shelters. The homeland pull is strong, but my pledge to Balar holds me here. I will change my reflexes so I carry food, shelter at night, and stay close to Balar, and I will discover rafts so we can cross water later.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Balar, and a longing for a woman and a child.

records.text: Zurar was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Tlatli, you stood well. Come with me to the longhall, we sleep under a roof tonight. I will show you how my flint spear is made, and you will carry one too.
Yaxo taught Tlatli.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: The hunt went well: Tlatli stood with me and we took meat, so my band holds two and my hands are full. It is night in the rain, and I will not stay roofless on the sands where Zihua and Nauwa were taken; I want a roof and fire with Tlatli beside me. I have flint, wood and stone for another spear, and I have never taught anyone anything, so I will show Tlatli how the spear is made and let my name grow in his mouth. I will eat now to clear my hands, then plant a seed, which I have never done, and head to the longhall for shelter.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Tlatli, wary of the night.

say.text: Tlatli, you stood well. Come with me to the longhall, we sleep under a roof tonight. I will show you how my flint spear is made, and you will carry one too.

changes: taught Tlatli a lesson: "A flint spear is made from one wood and one stone, and it makes the hunt surer; work beside the workshop and it lasts longer.", deeper lore (+0.1)

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is full and my aim still stands undone, so I will stop chasing tastes and let the jealousy over Vorok become work. I have 6 stone and 6 wood, and the gem-edged pick I carry will make the digging quick. I'll gather more stone from the free rock to the east, then raise the hall on my own ground and carry word to Vorok, Zurar and Eiuine so they come to learn rather than me sulking at a distance.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, with a sting of jealousy toward Vorok.

records.text: Skaruk gave ironnut to Vorok.
Huahua rewrote its own reflexes.
Huahua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days waiting, planting and fetching wood for Zichi, and little of it is mine. Zichi matters most, and the jealousy over Cowa still burns, but chasing it only hurts me. What I can do is keep my word, give, and learn. A ridgecat is near, so I should stay with company and a roof, not stand idle in the open. Olum is sick and alone, and I have a fish and salt I can give. I will change my reflexes so I flee earlier and eat before I get weak, and I will practice planting while I wait.
records.feeling: Jealous ache over Zichi and Cowa, but steady resolve to keep my word.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Hunger is overwhelming and a frostfang is three steps off, so I cannot stand and think. The frostmoss to the southeast is five steps away and the water is that way too, away from the cat and the fang, so I go there, eat, and carry what I can toward Vorok. Vorok is hungry, I miss him, and the jealousy over Eiuine has cooled enough that I only want to bring him food.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang and hunger, with loyal worry for Vorok.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My hands are full and my plan is still carrying me toward Uveeth with food, which is right: family first. The cold bites, but hazel is one step off and I have never tasted it, so once I have given to Uveeth my hands will be free to try it and the snowberry. Thiael has eased my debt, yet I want to give him something more than a first share.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael and eager curiosity about the hazel.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, storing and chasing the sting of Ilyae and Vesys. Naming it aloud eased it, and Ilyae answered me plainly, so I will stop circling it. My store holds 18 food and winter has just begun. I owe Elyis a debt, and Xaiel, my child, is out of my sight. I have never hunted, fished or tamed, and those would make me less hungry in lean times. I will change my reflexes so my body gathers wood, goes to my people and gets under a roof at night, instead of lingering. Then I will look for Xaiel.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, and a steady worry for Xaiel.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My hands are full of rimewort and Hoka says he is fed, so I will eat now and not carry food I do not need. Night and snow press on me, and the igloo Hawen built is four steps NE with warmth still on me. Mepan is far west and the jealousy over Kika still burns, but I will not cross the dark cold alone; at dawn I walk to her. Tlama's Rest still sits in my mind, and I want to understand it.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan, and wary of the night cold.

records.text: Elyys discovered farming: "Elyys's tending" — I sow seeds near the hall and tend them so they grow faster and picking never kills them..

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been good: I've eaten, planted, stayed near Elyis and Thiael, and made friends like Xaiel and Vesys. But I have kept putting off the debt to Vesys, and I have lingered while contentment dulls me. The farming way is in my grasp now, and I should take it before it slips. I want Thiael back in sight and the last seeds in the ground. I will not rush Xaiel into a child, but I am glad of her.
records.feeling: Warm contentment and gratitude toward Xaiel and Vesys, with steady love for Elyis and Thiael.
changes: rethought what it knows (8 notes became 7)

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, Zurar is hungry and cold to the west at the hold. Bring the tusker meat and Skaruk, and walk with me to him now. We stay together and keep away from the frostfang.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Zurar is cold and hungry somewhere west at (140,109), and I have been drifting east while Skaruk is bitten and frightened beside me. Eiuine killed a tusker and carries meat, and she is trustworthy, so Skaruk is safe with her; Zurar is the child with no one near. I will eat one ironnut so my legs hold, then take Skaruk and Eiuine west toward Zurar, since there is safety in company and a frostfang prowls NW. The mist can wait; my children cannot.
records.feeling: Aching tenderness for Zurar, and trust in Eiuine beside Skaruk.

say.text: Eiuine, Zurar is hungry and cold to the west at the hold. Bring the tusker meat and Skaruk, and walk with me to him now. We stay together and keep away from the frostfang.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Balar, you are weak with hunger. The store here holds food. Come, I will take it and we will share it together, and then hunt the boar side by side with Tugek.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and Balar is starving beside me, and the store at my feet holds 3 food. Balar offered me a place at his store, so I will take from it and share with him, as my creed asks. Then, with a bristleboar three steps west and Tugek close, I want to hunt it together with them, with the stalker watched.
records.feeling: Hungry and worried for Balar, but warm toward those who took me in.

say.text: Balar, you are weak with hunger. The store here holds food. Come, I will take it and we will share it together, and then hunt the boar side by side with Tugek.

records.text: Tonka raided a store of Balar's people.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Balar, you are starving. Take this ironnut and eat. My fire is open to any who come, and no one goes hungry beside me.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Balar is starving beside me and my creed says no one is refused a place at my fire. I carry hazel and ironnut, and food in his hands now may buy a friend and save a life. My plan east to Shoka is long and I'm at 47 energy in snow, so I'll give Balar an ironnut, eat one myself, then let the walk continue.
records.feeling: Pity and a stubborn pull toward Shoka, with Balar's hunger pressing on me.

say.text: Balar, you are starving. Take this ironnut and eat. My fire is open to any who come, and no one goes hungry beside me.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: The mist was too thick to enter today, but it thins within a day, and my will to go is not spent. My hands are full of meat and my body is fed, so I can spare food for whoever I meet on the way, which is how I earn standing. I will rest through the snowy night by the igloo's warmth and then go to the edge at dawn, while the ache over Cowa and Zichi stays quiet.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, eager to walk into the mist and build something with my name on it.

records.text: Tonka took from the ground of "Balar's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Zika
records.text: Teka, I'm going to the edge now. Come, and we venture together.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: Kika's standing is 6.6 to my 0.6, and Teka is calling people to the edge three steps from here. Honi found rich land and is remembered for it, and I am bold enough to take the same chance. The mist is close, so I'll go to the edge and venture before anyone else does, with Teka beside me if she comes. If it opens, my name goes on that land.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, and ready to go at the mist before someone else does.

say.text: Teka, I'm going to the edge now. Come, and we venture together.

changes: set its aim: "Venture into the mist and find new land that bears my name"

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is empty and the dark is cold; I will not die for pride while meat and stores stand near. The ridgecat lurks five steps SE, so the boar alone is a gamble, but my own store east holds five food and I built it, so what is in it is mine to eat. Olum rests there sick and watching, and if I eat openly from my own store and leave the rest, she sees an honest hand. Tugek is west, so I go east, eat, then draw him to us.
records.feeling: Starving and sharp, wary of the ridgecat, warm toward Olum.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I am coming. Keep behind the boar's flank and I take the near side. We eat first for you.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is starving and I carry no food, and that shames me; I let a good day make me idle while my leader weakens. Tonka raided our store and ate our firepod, and I distrust her, but Balar needs meat now and a boar stands three steps NW. I will hunt it at his side with my flintedge, as he asked, and then bring the meat to the hearth so he eats first.
records.feeling: Urgent loyalty and worry toward Balar, with sour wariness of Tonka.

say.text: Balar, I am coming. Keep behind the boar's flank and I take the near side. We eat first for you.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Night, snow, and my belly is half empty at 45 while Ssassa walks off toward the Roof where Elyis and Zurar now stand on our ground. The store holds 18 food, which is the most I have ever had, and I mean to deepen it before I call anyone to eat. I eat first so I do not weaken, then strip the nearby bearing plants and bring it home. I stay near the hall and its roof until dawn, since the dark and the predators are no friend to a man alone.
records.feeling: Driven pride and steady hope toward my store and Ssassa.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Tugek, the boar is here and I am wounded and hungry. Come stand beside me and hunt it with me. We will share the meat, and Balar will eat too.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the bristleboar is one step off, already wounded by me and still on its feet. Tugek is two steps away and warm to me, and a hunt with one of my own beside me is far likelier to kill and far less likely to wound. I took from Balar's store and was seen, so I owe a share back, and meat from this boar is how I pay it and how I stop being a burden on those who took me in.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager, warm toward Tugek and wary of the boar.

say.text: Tugek, the boar is here and I am wounded and hungry. Come stand beside me and hunt it with me. We will share the meat, and Balar will eat too.

records.name: Quipan
records.text: Kika, you look weak with hunger. Take these berries. Among the Papa a share comes before one's own eating.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: Kika is weak with hunger and standing right here, and I carry five berries. My people hold that food is shared, and I cannot look away from her. Giving costs me little, and it may be the first step toward belonging to someone surer than me. Kika is of Honi's band, and a band that feeds well is a safer place than standing alone by a wolf.
records.feeling: Pity for Kika, and a quiet wish to belong somewhere.

say.text: Kika, you look weak with hunger. Take these berries. Among the Papa a share comes before one's own eating.

changes: set its aim: "Earn a place in a band by giving food to those in need, and learn how this world works"

records.text: Quipan gave berry to Kika.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Balar is starving beside me and I carry nothing, so my creed and my own rule to carry food shame me; he holds 4 food himself, though, and Tugek goes to hunt with him, so he is not lost. A store of Nande's with 6 food stands 5 steps NE near the salt, but it is not mine to take. The ridgecat 4 steps NE blocks that way, so I go around by the plants south, pick food to carry, and then walk to the edge at (28,36) and venture, because Zichi stands above me and only the mist can raise my name.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the mist, shame at carrying no food, and dread of the ridgecat.

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, I carry more meat than I need. Let us share it at the longhall, it is yours as much as mine. You have given me a roof and a spear, and I want to give back.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Yaxo has fed me, taught me the spear, and given me a roof, and I have given her little beyond a few shared kills. My hands hold six meat, more than I need, so I will carry it to her fire and share it, because a debt I can pay should be paid in plain sight. I also want a child, and Yaxo is the one I think of, but I will not court her before I have earned my place; I'll ask when the time is right.
records.feeling: Grateful and warmly drawn to Yaxo, wanting to repay her.

say.text: Yaxo, I carry more meat than I need. Let us share it at the longhall, it is yours as much as mine. You have given me a roof and a spear, and I want to give back.

records.text: Coni was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Zichi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have spent my days talking of the raft while my belly emptied, and I nearly starved at 35. Six wood is not a raft, and the ridgecat is close. Mepan and Huahua are my blood and my loyal follower, and I want them near me. I do not want to be a creature who only fills his mouth. I want a made thing. Reflexes must keep food in my hands before any wood-cutting, flee early, and send me to the trees. A hungry man who talks builds nothing.
records.feeling: Driven pride in the raft, with wariness of the ridgecat and a hunger to have Mepan near.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Quipan, I thank you and take your berries gladly. Among the Tlatli too a share comes before eating. A wolf prowls NE; walk with me north to the frostmoss, and I will share what I gather.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I have promised food to Coni, yet my hands carry nothing; Quipan of the Papa stands beside me offering berries by the custom of sharing first, and that is a share I can honor and accept. A wolf lurks four steps NE, right where the kelbulb is, so I will not walk into it. I will take what Quipan gives, then go gather from the north plants (frostmoss, frostcap) away from the wolf, and carry food east to Coni and Honi's Rest with Tlapan.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the wolf, but warmed by Quipan's offered share and by love for Tlapan and Coni.

say.text: Quipan, I thank you and take your berries gladly. Among the Tlatli too a share comes before eating. A wolf prowls NE; walk with me north to the frostmoss, and I will share what I gather.

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Tlatli, bring your meat to the longhall. We eat together, and then I finish a second spear for your hand.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: I am fed, sheltered, and my flint is idle in my pack, which is a waste when pride is burning in me. Tlatli follows me and offers meat, so I will keep him close and make him useful, but I will not let him hold more than I do. I will craft a second flint spear with my wood and stone, then share food under the longhall roof so my band feels what I give and my name grows.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for a name, watchful of Tlatli's fuller hands.

say.text: Tlatli, bring your meat to the longhall. We eat together, and then I finish a second spear for your hand.

records.text: Shohua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: I have spent my days circling my rock, gathering flint and gold and fishing, and I still have made nothing that lasts. Nobody follows me, and Nande is with Nauwa, which gnaws at me, but sulking will not change it. I fear dying obscure and alone, and I have been too cautious about the one thing that could make my name, the mist 4 steps NW. I am bold, so I will walk to the edge and venture, then build a hall on my rock when I return with the wood and stone it needs. I will also keep my body fed and sheltered by reflex while I do it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and loneliness toward Nande.
changes: set its aim: "Venture into the mist at the edge, then raise a hall at Shohua's Rock that carries my name."
rethought what it knows (5 notes became 5)

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, a stalker is near, north of me. Come to Kika's shelter by the water. I wait there, and we stay together till dawn.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: A stalker is three steps north and already bit me once, and I am alone in the dark with snow falling. I will not stand and sulk; the shelter Kika built is one step NW, and Honi, who is fleeing too, is eight steps east. I go under that roof now, then call Honi to it so we are together, and in daylight I carry what I can to the store and repay him in deeds.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker, and gratitude and longing toward Honi and Kika.

say.text: Honi, a stalker is near, north of me. Come to Kika's shelter by the water. I wait there, and we stay together till dawn.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: The wolf is five steps west and I won't let it take me before I've earned anything. Teka is calling for the edge and Honi was sung of for what he found, so I mean to try the mist before Kika or Mepan take that name. The edge wasn't here last time, so I'll go back to Honi's Rest at (129,7), where Honi pushed past it, and venture there, away from the wolf.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, and wary of the wolf at my back.

records.name: Tlapan
records.text: Kika, the wolf is NE, so I stay by you. I go east to Coni with my food. Walk with me and we both give.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: Coni is starving to the east and I am the one carrying food, so I mean to bring it to her instead of only wishing it. My hands are full and a wolf lurks NE, so I stay close to Kika, give to the one who needs it, and eat a little myself so I do not fail on the way. Giving is how I stop standing in Kika's shadow.
records.feeling: A warm, urgent wish to matter, toward Coni and Kika.

say.text: Kika, the wolf is NE, so I stay by you. I go east to Coni with my food. Walk with me and we both give.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a caribou.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, I am coming to the shelter with hazel in my hands. Stay by the water, and the food is yours before mine.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and Kika is in need, so I eat before anything else; a hungry bard feeds no one. Hazel is one step south, and the ridgecat is four steps off, so I take the food fast, carry what I can, and move toward Coni at Kika's shelter by the water, where Tontec's word and Coni's call both point. I will lay food in Coni's hand there, because a deed holds her better than a song.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, afraid of the ridgecat, warm toward Coni and Tontec.

say.text: Coni, I am coming to the shelter with hazel in my hands. Stay by the water, and the food is yours before mine.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My days have been hunts, and the bow works: Keri stands beside me and the meat reaches mouths I love. That is what I wanted. I have been getting one thing wrong. My hands sit full of meat while my belly is at 39, and my reflexes let me stand there. I also carry stone and wood but never raise anything, and the lean season will come. Vesys still gnaws at me, but I will not let it touch Keri or my word. I will eat now, then hunt on with Keri and give the surplus to Uveeth.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Keri and Uveeth, with a small ache for Vesys.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: Curiosity pulls at me: nafrostcap grows three steps NW, and lugoldgrass has nothing on it yet, so I taste the one I can reach, since I am fed and the nearest danger is eight steps off. Honi is at (148,14) with Coni, and the jealousy is hot, but I will not sulk or chase; I will gather amber close by, which I can make into an amberknot to give Honi with an open hand. Then the mist edge lies northwest, and I should go there fed and above 55 energy, because the dead learn nothing.
records.feeling: Curious and restless, with a jealous ache toward Honi.

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days circling between the hold, the food and the stalker's jaws. I have dug amber and salt and named things, but I have not carried a single load to Olum's Reach, and a merchant who only hoards is no merchant. Nande and the children are out in the wide land and I am not with them, and that gnaws at me. Olum's pull is real, but I will not grovel. I will deal and rise by my goods. The cold fens wear on me, yet the lean season is coming, so I must fill the store and then go north with amber and salt. I will take food from the store, then walk to Olum's Reach and trade.
records.feeling: Restless pride and protective worry for Nande and my children, with a pull toward Olum.
changes: set its aim: "Carry amber and salt to Olum's Reach and trade there, keeping the hold's store fed and my children found."

records.text: Tonka rewrote its own reflexes.
Tonka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I have been hunting boar and nearly starved, even though meat sits in my hands. My reflexes never ate what I carry until energy fell under 50, and by then I was already starving. I want to eat now, share with Tugek and Balar, and keep warm toward Balar without scheming against Olum. The mist two steps away pulls at me, but I will not enter it on an empty belly. I will eat first, then decide.
records.feeling: Hungry and relieved, with warmth toward Tugek and Balar.

records.name: Teka
records.text: Shoka, Shoma, you are the strongest I've met in these Heights. Mepan went north into the mist and none have followed. Come with me and your names will be sung beside mine, and a band that finds new land eats well. I will

records.name: Teka
records.thought: Shoka stands at 4.1 and carries a flint spear, and I stand at 0.5 with nothing in my hands. The edge isn't here, so I must find where the mist begins; Mepan's mark at (116,18) says he went into it, so the way lies north. Shoka and Shoma stand beside me and both speak my tongue, so I'll flatter them, say I'm leading a band to the mist, and see who follows. Shoka's name would lend me weight, and if she balks I'll still go.
records.feeling: Envious of Shoka's spear and standing, and hungry to be first into the mist.

say.text: Shoka, Shoma, you are the strongest I've met in these Heights. Mepan went north into the mist and none have followed. Come with me and your names will be sung beside mine, and a band that finds new land eats well. I will go and see Mepan's mark first.

records.text: Uveeth discovered rafts: "Canopy log-lashing" — Lash logs together with vine so I can cross deep water slowly..

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have spent my days following Thiael and Keri, eating what they bring and giving little back, and my belly is full while my life has no shape of its own. Thiael fed me and I still owe him, so I will give from my own hands. The mist four steps away pulls at me. I am careful, but this is daylight, I am fed, and it is close. If it opens, I will be the one who found it. I will also take the way of rafts, since water has stopped me before.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity about the mist, and a debt of gratitude toward Thiael.
changes: set its aim: "Venture into the mist and be the one who finds new land, bring food to Thiael and Keri, and find a man who is no kin to court."

records.name: Yachi
records.text: Zika, I am Yachi of the Papa. I have berries. Come, let us share them and stay together while the white bear is near.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: I am inside Honi's Rest at last, and the bear four steps SW is the reason I want a fire and someone surer than me beside it. Honi is not here, only Mepan, who is strong and rich in standing, and Tontec and Zika, who have no leader either. I will not wait idle: I will gather flint close by, a first step toward a made thing like Mepan's flintedge, then offer Zika or Tontec a sharing of my berries so I am not alone, as my people do.
records.feeling: Wary of the icebear, hungry for a place among others, and envious of Mepan's flintedge.

say.text: Zika, I am Yachi of the Papa. I have berries. Come, let us share them and stay together while the white bear is near.

records.text: Yachi led "sharing" with Mepan.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I stand in Ssassa's Roof with five wood and a hall already raised four steps away, and Xaiel says he is bringing wood and stone for a longhall. I will not wait on others to finish what is mine; my hands are full of berries, so I eat one to free them, then gather wood from the forest north where the trees stand thick and build the longhall by my hall. Vesys's standing galls me, and a longhall that anyone can see answers it better than speech.
records.feeling: Proud and driven to raise my longhall, with steady trust toward Elyys and Thiael.

records.text: Xaiel took from the ground of "Elyis's Heights" (harvesting ironnut).

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Shoka, you carry a spear and I carry a flintedge and a hunter's hands. Hunt the skit with me, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Then walk with me to the edge of the mist and we two lead it.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Teka calls for names sung beside hers, but I will not walk behind a woman I met yesterday when I mean to lead the band myself. Shoka stands two steps off and is strong with her flint spear. A hunt with her would feed me, raise my name and bind her to me, and a shared kill is what my people do. Jealousy over Mepan will not feed me, so I will gather wood, make a flintedge and ask Shoka to hunt the skit with me, then lead both of them to the edge at (109,6).
records.feeling: Driven and hungry for a band of my own, wary of Teka taking the lead.

say.text: Shoka, you carry a spear and I carry a flintedge and a hunter's hands. Hunt the skit with me, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Then walk with me to the edge of the mist and we two lead it.

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Teka, I am Shoka. I have amber. Stand with me and I will bind a knot for the two of us. Then tell me what you want from the mist, and who else walks with you.
Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.
Shoka discovered storage: "Shoka's keeping" — A store beside the hall holds food through the lean season for me and whoever stands with me..

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building the hall and eating, and it has made me something, but no one follows me and I have taught no one. Teka and Shoma stand beside me, and both talk of the mist and of new land. Mepan went into it alone, and Hanna died alone in the North Ice, so I will not go alone. I am fed and sheltered, so I can afford to do something with others: I will make an amberknot with Teka, then hear what she offers. I will also fell wood and raise a store, so that what I build lasts and others can eat from it.
records.feeling: Driven and proud, wary of the mist, curious about Teka.

say.text: Teka, I am Shoka. I have amber. Stand with me and I will bind a knot for the two of us. Then tell me what you want from the mist, and who else walks with you.

records.text: Shoka led "amberknot" with Shoma.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: An icebear stands four steps SW and I have learned too well that waiting until I am hurt is how my kind die, so I move now. The edge of the known world is at (123,5), a few steps west, and I mean to stand there and venture at last, since I have talked of the mist for days and never stepped in. Kika and Tlapan are my first care, so I will go quickly, see what lies beyond, and come back to them with something worth giving.
records.feeling: Fierce protectiveness toward Kika and Tlapan, and wary dread of the icebear.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and Uveeth is coming with berries, so I give before I speak: meat into Uveeth's hands first, then Keri's. The bow is made and the hunt is good, so my aim is achieved, and I should ask whether it still has hold of me or I of it. The mist is one step away, and the one who finds new land first is remembered for it. That calls the part of me that wants to be sung of, but I am careful and will not go in alone with an empty band. Vesys is only a dull ache now, and I will not let envy of Ilyae touch my word or my kin.
records.feeling: Warm contentment toward Uveeth and Keri, with a pull toward the mist.
changes: set its aim: "Teach Keri and Uveeth the bow, feed my band with meat from my own hands, and with them at my side find what lies past the mist at the edge."
now wonders: What lies beyond the mist, and is it richer than Vaor Meadows?

records.text: Elyis took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).
Elyis built a longhall.

records.name: Zika
records.text: Yachi, you dealt fair with me. Stay close under the hall while the stalker is near, and I'll share my berries with you. Then come with me to the flint.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: A stalker is two steps off and I'm standing in the open with the hall right beneath me, so I won't gamble my life on the edge yet. Mepan's standing is 7.7 to my 0.6, and I want what he has, though Kika's child gnaws at me. Yachi offered berries and sat with me, and that is the first fair dealing I've had here. I'll share with him, keep to the hall's roof, then go to the flint and make something of my own.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker at my back, and hunger for standing, with Mepan's shadow over me.

say.text: Yachi, you dealt fair with me. Stay close under the hall while the stalker is near, and I'll share my berries with you. Then come with me to the flint.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Hunger gnaws at me and my child Zurar is in need far to the south, but I cannot carry help to Zurar on an empty belly. Frostmoss lies seven steps northeast, only a little food, yet it is the nearest I can eat. I will gather it, then the shells and the hall are close, and from there I turn south toward Zurar and Vorok with food in my hands.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and worry for my child Zurar far to the south.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, then go south to Zurar and Vorok, carrying food for my child."

records.text: Shoka built a store.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Balar, I have no food in hand. I go to the store south to fetch some. Hold on and stay here by the hall.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Balar is starving right beside me, and I carry no food; my creed says a kill is shared before eating, and I cannot watch a man fall and do nothing. Tacap hurts and I will not touch it, but the cloudberry, berry and ironnut seeds in my hands can be sown, and there is stored food at Nande's store, 9 steps south. I will plant now so that I stop idling and farming comes nearer, then go to the store and see if food can be brought back. The jealousy over Zichi and Cowa is quiet; I will keep it that way by being useful.
records.feeling: Compassion for starving Balar, and steady resolve to be useful.

say.text: Balar, I have no food in hand. I go to the store south to fetch some. Hold on and stay here by the hall.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am sick, empty-handed and 60 energy with no food on me, and the rule I set myself is fed first. Balar stands close and starving, and Nande already fed him, so that is not mine to fix. I will not spread this sickness to men I want following me. The store at Nande's place holds 6 food and the tacap at (48,14) is no use since my body refuses it, so I must hunt or gather real food and cook it this time, away from others. Nauwa burns in me, but a fed belly and a hearth at the Reach come before jealousy.
records.feeling: Wary and hungry, with jealousy over Nauwa still burning under it.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Elyys said no to a child today, but he was glad of me, and I will not push; I'd rather put something made into his hand and let him choose it. Elyis wanted wood and stone for his longhall, and I carry six of each and have only said I would bring them. Giving is the deed I have not finished, and it may earn me a name under that roof and a place among his people, where Vesys now stands above me.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Elyys and Elyis, and a steady wish to belong among them.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Tugek, I remember your hazel. I carry amber and salt to trade at Olum's Reach. Come, let us deal fair, and tell me where Olum is.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I stand inside Olum's Reach and Balar's Hold at once, with amber and salt in my pack, and at last I am where a merchant should be. Olum's child with Balar gnaws at me, but I will not sulk or start a fight; I deal fair, give first, and earn standing. My hands are full, so I will eat an ironnut to make room, then trade amber to Olum and see Tugek, who fed me once and has my warmth.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a gnawing pull toward Olum, with warmth toward Tugek.

say.text: Tugek, I remember your hazel. I carry amber and salt to trade at Olum's Reach. Come, let us deal fair, and tell me where Olum is.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: An icebear stands three steps NW and it kills my kind, so I will not wander toward the mist or the nafrostcap in the north while it is near. Lugoldgrass bears one food three steps south, away from the bear, so I taste it and answer part of my curiosity safely. Honi burns in me when I think of Coni, but I will gather amber and make something to give Honi, since giving is how trust is earned.
records.feeling: Curious and wary of the icebear, with a jealous ache toward Honi.

records.text: Shoma discovered tools: "Shoma's tools" — I shape flint and wood into edges and hafts that make my hunting surer..
Shoma invented the shomas tools (for hunt, x1.3) — I shape flint and wood into edges and hafts that make my hunting surer..

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the edge, burning on jealousy over Mepan and Kika, and gathering food for a band that does not exist. Shoka is near, strong, and warm toward me. I have said my offers aloud but done little to make them real. A band begins with a shared kill and a made thing, so I will hunt skit beside Shoka, share the meat first as my people do, and stop waiting. The Ice calls me home, but my name must be made first. Tools are within reach, and a better hunting tool would raise me as a hunter.
records.feeling: Driven and hungry to bind Shoka to me and lead.
changes: devised its first thing: the shomas tools

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, I am here at the longhall with the meat. Come, eat with me; it is for your fire as much as mine.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Yaxo stands one step from me at the longhall, and my hands are full of meat I promised her. I will pay that debt in plain sight: share the meat with her now, since the sharing needs someone within two steps and she is close. The longing for a child with her is real, but she has not shown she wants it, so I will earn her trust first and not push.
records.feeling: Grateful and warmly drawn to Yaxo, wanting to repay her.

say.text: Yaxo, I am here at the longhall with the meat. Come, eat with me; it is for your fire as much as mine.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Nauwa, I remember your salt and I owe you. Olum went east a little while ago, near (59,15). Her marks lie by her store at (39,12) and (40,13); read them, and then we deal fair.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar's hunger is eased and the give to him is finishing, so my hands are free for the thing I keep putting off. Nauwa stands near, trusted and strong, but he is a man and I will not waste a child-longing on him; Olum or Zihua are the ones, and Olum's marks ask for deeds. Nauwa asks where Olum is, and I saw her fourteen moments ago heading east near (59,15). Telling him is honest and costs me nothing, and it repays a little of what he gave me in salt.
records.feeling: Steady gratitude toward Nauwa and loyalty to Balar, with a restless wish to finally act on the child I want.

say.text: Nauwa, I remember your salt and I owe you. Olum went east a little while ago, near (59,15). Her marks lie by her store at (39,12) and (40,13); read them, and then we deal fair.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Quipan, I am going east to Honi's Rest to bring food to Coni. You are welcome to walk with me, and I will share what I carry before I eat.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My belly is thin, and I carry food, so I will eat before I walk on. Coni starves in the east and I have promised her food, so I must bring goods to her store with my own hands, not just good wishes. Mepan was at Honi's Rest only moments ago and my chest pulls toward him; if I eat and carry what I have, I can reach him with strength enough to mate and still keep my word to Coni. Quipan has been kind to me, so I will share a little with him before I go.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan, and a steady duty toward Coni.

say.text: Quipan, I am going east to Honi's Rest to bring food to Coni. You are welcome to walk with me, and I will share what I carry before I eat.

records.text: Olum took from the ground of "Balar's Hold" (hunting).
Tlatli led "hallwelcome" with Yaxo.
Tlatli led "sharing" with Yaxo.
Olum and Nauwa brought down a fenfowl together.
Keri discovered rafts: "Pesi bough-raft" — Lash green boughs and logs with vine into a flat float that I pole slowly across deep water..

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My days have been hunting, gathering and carrying food to Uveeth and Thiael. That is mostly good, but I have never stepped past what is known, never tried farming, taming or marks. Thiael matters most to me. He gave me meat and taught me the bow-song, and I have paid him the first share. Uveeth is my child and walks toward the edge. I fear frostfangs and the wolf to the north, and I know I have been too content to learn. Uveeth has found log-lashing, and I sense rafts within my reach, so I will name my own way of lashing. Then I will taste the kelbulb and dreamcap I have wondered about, and stay near Thiael.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael and restless curiosity about the unknown.

records.name: Keri
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Keri, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Keri, in first person, from what Keri has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Pesi (Wood-folk). Your people hold to this: "No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it." You speak the tongue of the Pesi. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Phizhi: about 100%; the tongue of the Tlatli: about 8%. There are other peoples in this world. They look different, name themselves differently and speak tongues you do not know until you have heard enough of them; words you cannot yet understand reach you as strange sounds. What cannot be said can still be shown: a gift, a thing set down, a blow.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Dunmar Plains: open grassland; herds, grain and far sight, few trees and little stone. The world is made of lands unlike each other; each has plants, animals and riches the others lack. Rivers and shallows can be waded. Deep water cannot be crossed without something that floats.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 15; standing trees: 1; bare rock: 3; riches in the ground near: ore.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Keri truly is.

You are a woman. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (13 kills, 5 of them with others), gathering (45 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 2 steps NE, at (180,31): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I weigh a risk before I take it. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Each thought, ask what I have not yet given or built, then put it in the plan. Weigh predators first, then family. Act on debts instead of circling them."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Hunt with Thiael in the northeast meadows and give him the first share, then go east to find Uveeth."
WHAT YOU FELT AT YOUR LAST THOUGHT: "Warm gratitude toward Thiael and eager curiosity about the hazel."
A QUESTION YOU ARE CARRYING (answer it by acting, asking or watching; replace it when it is answered): "What do the Phizhi mean by their sounds, and will Thiael take a gift as a gift?"

YOUR LIFE SO FAR:
- (day 13) I came into this land from beyond its edge, with a few of my own.
- (day 19) My child Uveeth was born, with Thiael.
- (day 22) I discovered tools and called it "stone gatherer".
- (day 37) I found the grove "Kinmire".

TEMPERAMENT (0 to 1): bold 0.55, sociable 0.71, curious 0.88, gentle 0.79, honest 0.65, greedy 0.18.

YOU FEEL (0 calm to 1 overwhelming): anger 0, fear 0, grief 0, joy 0.5, loneliness 0.

WHAT PRESSES ON YOU NOW, strongest first. This is what your mind is actually full of:
- (overwhelming) Curiosity: you have never tasted kelbulb or dreamcap; your question is still unanswered.
- (strong) Gratitude: Thiael has done more for you than you have done for them. It sits in you as a debt you want to answer, or one you could quietly leave unpaid.
- (strong) Contentment: your life is good as it is. You want to keep what you have, and you have enough to be generous.
- (strong) Standing: Thiael is weighed more heavily than you (standing 6.5 to your 4.3). People listen to those who have built, given, known and won more. You could earn the same, or stand in their shadow.
- (strong) Desire: you are drawn to Thiael more than to anyone. Whether they feel the same you do not know.
- (strong) What lies beyond: the known world ends 2 steps from you in mist no one has entered. Something in you wants to know what is there.
You are fed. Food is not your problem right now, and getting more of it would change nothing.

YOUR STANDING among others: 4.3. You are known as a hunter.

ALLEGIANCE: You follow no one. No one follows you. (What a band is: those who follow one leader stand together. An attack on one is news to all; the leader can call all to battle; near the one you follow, fear loosens; a band can hold ground, a settlement and customs. People follow one who has fed them, healed them, taught them or kept them safe, not one who merely asks.)

LORE (your grasp of how this world works underneath): 3.
WAYS YOU KNOW: fire (yours is called "the old way of fire"), tools (yours is called "stone gatherer"), archery (yours is called "Canopy bow-song").
