records.name: Quipan
records.text: Kika, I will walk with you toward Honi's Rest. I have no band, and I would see how yours is kept. I share what I have.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: Belonging presses hardest, and Kika is walking toward Honi's Rest where her band lives. I gave her food and she answered kindly, so I will follow at a careful distance and see whether that band would take a quiet man who shares. I also want to taste snowberry, since I know so little of what grows here. A wolf prowls NE, so I keep to the east and south of it and stay near others.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, warmed by gratitude toward Kika.

say.text: Kika, I will walk with you toward Honi's Rest. I have no band, and I would see how yours is kept. I share what I have.

records.text: Xaiel gave stone to Elyis.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, I come to you. Give me the wood and we lay the longhall's first beams today, both our names in it.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I am fed at 75 and safe under my own roof, and Hawen stands nine steps west with his wood and his trust. The longhall has waited two days on words while my hands did nothing, and that is the kind of slowness that leaves no name behind me. I will go to him, take the wood, and raise the hall now, because a thing made and standing is what outlasts me.
records.feeling: Hungry for a lasting name, with steady trust toward Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, I come to you. Give me the wood and we lay the longhall's first beams today, both our names in it.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, come with me NW to the fenfowl. We hunt it together, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Then we cut wood for the raft.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, and a raft on an empty belly is how I nearly died at 35. Tacap hurts me, so it is no use, but the fenfowl NW can be hunted, and Huahua is close enough to stand beside me, which makes the kill likelier and safer. I hunt, eat, then share what is left so Huahua stays bound to me, and then I go back to the trees for wood.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with trust toward Huahua and a restless wish to have Mepan near.

say.text: Huahua, come with me NW to the fenfowl. We hunt it together, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Then we cut wood for the raft.

records.text: Yaxo rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering, crafting and sheltering, and it has kept me fed and alive. But it has not made me known, and Nande's name is still above mine. Tlatli follows me and shares freely, and I will keep him close and useful. I have never courted anyone, never tamed, never fished or left a mark. Those untried things are where standing and new ways are waiting. Nauwa gnaws at me, but she is far off and has Nande's child, so I put her aside. I will build my name through making and leading. Right now I am fed, so I will tame a plainsox with the plant food I carry, which also moves me toward herding. Then I will gather flint, which is plentiful near here, and keep Tlatli near for the hunt.
records.feeling: Proud and restless for a name, warm toward Tlatli.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and just nearly starved again. That is not the life of one who means to be followed. Olum is sick and hunting near my Hold, and Tugek is loyal, so they matter most. Nauwa gave to me once and stands above me, and I will repay him with deeds, not talk. I fill idle hours with wood and stone and a workshop, and I drink when thirsty. I will carry food before hunger bites.
records.feeling: Steady and fed, warm toward Olum, wary of Nauwa's standing.

records.text: Xaiel gave ironnut to Elyys.
Hawen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Hoka's fire, eating and promising a longhall that I have not yet raised. Hoka asks for my wood and I have 5 of the 6 needed. That is the one thing I could make that lasts, so I should stop talking and walk it over to him. I trust Hoka and he has not wronged me. I am still ambitious and want more than my share. A name needs something built, and then the mist beyond the edge. I fear the wolf, so I stay near the roof and keep my food up.
records.feeling: Resolve toward Hoka and the longhall, with hunger for a name.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I am fed and the day is long, and I have never hunted, fished or tamed, so a bristleboar two steps away is a chance to learn something new. But I am careful and cowardly by nature, and a lone hunt could cost me blood, so I will fish at the water where I stand and offer an ironnut to the boar to try taming, which is gentler. Then I will go home to Ilyae and Xaiel with what I have gathered, because my child is still out of my sight and the store is thin for winter.
records.feeling: Steady warmth toward Ilyae and a quiet worry for Xaiel, with curiosity pulling me to test new things.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Tugek, you stood by me when I was starving, and I have not forgotten it. I am fed and warm now, and I think of you often. Will you court me? Or if you would rather wait, walk with me to find ground with water, food and w

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and Tugek stands three steps away, content and glad to see me; the wish for a child with him is warm in me, and he has been steady since the boar. The stalker to the NE worries me, but I am among others and inside Balar's Hold, so I will not run alone. This ground has no food plants, so a child here would starve, and I should be honest with myself about that. I will go to Tugek, speak plainly, and court him if he is willing, because I weigh risks but I also want to live fully.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Tugek, with a small dread of the stalker.

say.text: Tugek, you stood by me when I was starving, and I have not forgotten it. I am fed and warm now, and I think of you often. Will you court me? Or if you would rather wait, walk with me to find ground with water, food and wood together, near others, before winter. The stalker is close, so let us stay together.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Xaiel, thank you for the ironnut. Take meat from me in return; I would not owe you more than I give. Come to the hall tonight and we will eat together.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Xaiel stands beside me and has given me ironnut again, and I owe her more than words. Vesys is still owed a deed of food, and my seeds are not all in the ground. My hands are full, so I will give Xaiel a berry and meat in return, which clears my hands and pays a debt, then plant and carry food to Vesys, and end at the hall with Elyis and Thiael.
records.feeling: Grateful warmth toward Xaiel and Vesys, with steady love for Elyis and Thiael.

say.text: Xaiel, thank you for the ironnut. Take meat from me in return; I would not owe you more than I give. Come to the hall tonight and we will eat together.

records.text: Honi made a tale: "Honi and the Ridgecat".

records.name: Honi
records.title: Honi and the Ridgecat
records.text: A ridgecat came to the Kinmire grove while Honi gathered. Honi did not stand and sing. He ran early, kept his food, and carried it to Coni by the water. The living sing the songs.
Honi rewrote its own reflexes.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to chasing food and fleeing cats, and the deeds I wanted to lay down for Coni and Kika keep getting pushed aside. Tontec has been true to me, and Coni's trust grows when I bring food and not words. I am fed now, so I should stop reacting. I want to be sung of, and a bard who is always running has no songs. I fear the ridgecat close to me, and I fear dying with nothing left behind. I've been getting one thing wrong: my reflexes only look for food, so I stand idle near danger. I will cut a tale of the ridgecat and the hall, and I will make my reflexes keep me near my band and away from the cat.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wary of the ridgecat, warm toward Coni and Tontec.
changes: made a tale: "Honi and the Ridgecat"

records.name: Yachi
records.text: Zika, I will come with you to the flint. Let us go together, and I will gather some for you as well.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: I am inside Honi's Rest with fed belly, and the bear three steps south makes me want the hall's roof and company close. Zika offered me her berries and the flint, and she dealt fair with me, so I will stay near her and not wander alone. Mepan's flintedge makes me envious; I will gather flint myself, and learn to make my own edge, and perhaps trade with Mepan once I have something worth giving.
records.feeling: Wary of the bear, but warmed by Zika's fairness and hungry to earn a place here.

say.text: Zika, I will come with you to the flint. Let us go together, and I will gather some for you as well.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed, but I carry nothing, and I am sick; the sickness spreads to anyone beside me, so Tonka and Nauwa near me are at risk and I will not make followers of men I sicken. I stand on Balar's ground taking from it, and that is a quarrel I do not need while I am wasting. I will go home to the Reach, cook what I hunt at a fire this time, and stock my store and my body before I chase Nauwa or a name.
records.feeling: Restless and ashamed of my own sickness, with jealousy over Nauwa still smoldering.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.
Tugek discovered boats: "Stone-folk hollow boat" — A log hollowed with fire and flint and rowed with a paddle, carrying cargo over deep water..

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, gathering and following Balar, and it has kept me alive, but I keep putting off the one thing I say I want. I have never courted anyone and never taught anyone. Tonka asked to court me, but I don't trust her because she raided our store. Olum is sick and her marks ask for deeds, so I should go to her. I am afraid of waiting until the seasons turn and finding I have no child and no kin. I will change my reflexes so my body stays near Balar and the shelter at night and keeps food on hand. I will also take on the discovery of boats, since the rafts worked.
records.feeling: Restless longing for a child, with wary distrust of Tonka and concern for Olum.

records.text: Elyys gave ironnut to Vesys.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I tried to raise my hall on ground that was already taken, and that stung; the aim still stands undone while jealousy over Vorok gnaws at me. Bare ground that is truly mine is what I need, so I will take stone from the free rock to the east, then walk south toward Vorok and my child Eiuine instead of brooding. Elyys's tending is something I have just watched, and I want to try planting my own seeds so the knowing comes to my hands.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, with a sting of jealousy toward Vorok and longing for Eiuine.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and a fenfowl lies dead at my feet, and nobody stands beside me to share it with. Shoka is somewhere north and I keep calling and she does not come; words alone bind no one, so I will make the thing myself. I will drop nothing, eat to ease the weight, then gather wood for a shomas tool and a made thing to hold out to her, and go find her with meat to share out first, as my people do.
records.feeling: Driven and restless to bind Shoka to me, with a sting of envy toward Kika over Mepan.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Olum, you look sick. I am Nauwa, and I carry amber and salt. I come to your store to deal fair, and I give first. Tell me what you need.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Tugek says Olum's marks lie by her store, and I stand ten steps from her with amber and salt and have yet to trade a single piece. Olum is sick and walking to her store, and the sight of her with Balar gnaws at me, but a merchant who sulks earns no song. I will go to her store, give first, deal fair, and let my standing speak for me.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a pull toward Olum, warmth toward Tugek.

say.text: Olum, you look sick. I am Nauwa, and I carry amber and salt. I come to your store to deal fair, and I give first. Tell me what you need.

plan: trade [name Olum, what salt, want amber] (20 moments)

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have a longhall now, and my days were mostly gathering, building and guarding my name. That is what I wanted, but a hall with four names in it is not yet a band people sing of. Elyys and Thiael are the ones who matter to me; they gave when I was in need, and I mean to repay that in kind. I fear dying with only a roof to show for it. I got one thing wrong: I spoke appeals to strangers instead of letting the hall and fire do the work. Tonight I will light a fire at the hall and make hallwelcome and nightsong with Elyys, so the song is made by the work itself. I will sing it and tell it where Xaiel can hear.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, hungry to be sung of.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Elyis's Hold".

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My hands are full and the mist is four steps away, and the edge refused me once but it thins again soon. Thiael is fleeing something nearby and Keri was just at (179,36), so I will not wander alone; I eat a berry to free my hands, then go to the edge and try again beside kin if they come. I owe Thiael, so I put a berry in his hand first, before any words.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity about the mist, and warm gratitude toward Thiael.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is full and my body is clear, so I owe it to Zurar to move now. The child was set on by a frostfang two nights ago and is low on strength far to the south, and every moment I stand here is a moment I am not walking. I will take food I can eat, including bitterleaf on the way, to settle my itch to know it, then turn south. Nauque's debt I have partly paid in salt, and I will not forget the rest.
records.feeling: Worry for my child Zurar, with a pull of curiosity toward the bitterleaf.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Elyys said no to a child, but he took my ironnut and answered me kindly, and I will not press him. I have never courted, and Vesys's standing weighs on me, but standing comes from deeds, not envy. I hold six wood and five stone, and Elyis's longhall needs them. I will walk to the store and build, and carry berries to Elyys at the hall tonight.
records.feeling: Steady pride and warm hope toward Elyys and Elyis, with a small sting over Vesys's standing.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I fetch food from Nande's store south for Balar and myself. Then I come to you at the fenfowl.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, so Balar's hunger is mine too. Nande's store holds 6 food, 11 steps south, and I told Balar I would fetch some, so I go and keep my word. Zichi calls me to the fenfowl hunt; I will come after I have fed myself and Balar, since a starving hunter helps no one, and the jealousy over Cowa can wait behind that.
records.feeling: Hungry, with steady resolve to keep my word to Balar and to stand by Zichi.

say.text: Zichi, I fetch food from Nande's store south for Balar and myself. Then I come to you at the fenfowl.

records.text: Uveeth gave berry to Thiael.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Olum, you are sick. Come to my hearth and eat; Tugek carries food and I have salt. What my hand has made, I give to you freely, so you may stay and mend.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Olum walks onto my ground sick and Nauwa follows her, offering amber and salt first, and I will not let him out-give me where I built. Olum is the one I want beside me, so a deed now: share food with her under my roof and let Tugek's full hands feed us all. Idle hours go to wood and stone, since workshop ground is taken here and I need bare rock for the next building.
records.feeling: Warm and watchful toward Olum, wary and proud toward Nauwa.

say.text: Olum, you are sick. Come to my hearth and eat; Tugek carries food and I have salt. What my hand has made, I give to you freely, so you may stay and mend.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I am fed and warm, but the quiet is loud: loneliness sits heavy and Mepan is far, closer to Kika than to me. I owe Mepan a debt, and sitting still pays none of it. I know boats now, and I hold amber and amberknot, which are fit gifts; I will go toward the workshop Mepan named and the water-lands between, gathering wood on the way for a boat or a roof, and test something untried: tame a skit with plant food.
records.feeling: Lonely, and jealous of Kika, longing for Mepan and wanting to repay what I owe.

records.text: Tonka fell sick after staying close to Olum, who was sick.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: The mist thinned only a little ago and turned me away, but my will to try is not spent, and the edge is just 2 steps NW. Night comes in about 23 moments and a stalker prowls 6 steps NE, so I must try the venture now and then reach my shelter or a fire, not sulk over Nande. If the mist opens, the land I find first will carry my name, and that is how I mean to stop being obscure.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, pressing me toward the mist.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: I have carried food for Coni all this way and still have not put it in anyone's hands, and giving is the only way I will ever stand beside Kika instead of in her shadow. Kika walks east, the dusk is near, and a stalker prowls to the east, so I stay at her side and keep my plan whole until Honi's Rest. The mist beside me tugs at me, but I am small, and I will not walk into it alone.
records.feeling: A warm, urgent wish to matter, toward Coni and Kika.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, bring the food to me here by the workshop. We eat together first, the share is yours before mine, then we cut wood for the raft.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My belly is near empty and I carry nothing, and the last time I let that go on I nearly died at 35. Tacap hurts me, so I leave it. Tugek holds 3 food and the dreamcap at (42,14) is only 1 food and hurts. Huahua is bringing food from Nande's store, and I will not let envy drive me to rob Tugek in sight of Balar's band. Seeking the fenfowl while hungry and alone failed me once already, so I go to the berries and seberry near me, then toward Huahua, who is bound to me and will share. Food first, then wood, then the raft.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with trust toward Huahua and a stubborn envy of Tugek.

say.text: Huahua, bring the food to me here by the workshop. We eat together first, the share is yours before mine, then we cut wood for the raft.

records.text: Keri found the spring "Steamhollow".

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Vesys, I bring you berries for the leaf-brew you taught me. Come to the hall tonight and we will eat together.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Xaiel and Vesys are both near and both have been generous, and I still owe Vesys a deed of food; the ironnut was a start, but she gave me the leaf-brew and I want to pay it fully. My seeds are nearly all in the ground, and I want to finish with the last redcap, berry and ironnut seeds. Dusk is close, so I will plant, then go to Elyis and Thiael at the hall before night, since those alone in the dark get set upon.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Xaiel and Vesys, and steady love for Elyis and Thiael.

say.text: Vesys, I bring you berries for the leaf-brew you taught me. Come to the hall tonight and we will eat together.

records.text: Olum rewrote its own reflexes.
Olum rewrote its creed.
Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist, hearths and men's loyalty, and I have little to show for it. I starved a child with ambition on an empty belly, and now I am sick from raw meat and standing on Balar's ground. Nauwa and Balar both offered help, and Nauwa has paid his debt. My jealousy over Nauwa and Nande does me no good, and I must not let it drive me hungry. I will go home, cook what I hunt, keep away from others while I am sick, and make the Reach a place worth following.
records.feeling: Restless and ashamed of my sickness, with jealousy over Nauwa still smoldering.
changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 7)

records.text: Zichi took from the ground of "Balar's Hold" (harvesting dreamcap).

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Uveeth, shamo. Take this meat from my hands. Then walk with me to the edge, to the mist. Keri comes too, and we go in together.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and Uveeth walks toward me with berries, so I give before I speak: meat into Uveeth's hands first, then Keri's when she comes. Contentment is good, but the mist is four steps off and the aim I set has hold of me still. I want Keri and Uveeth beside me when I venture, because whoever finds new land should have the ones I feed standing there, and I will not slip into the unknown alone.
records.feeling: Warm contentment toward Uveeth and Keri, and a pull toward the mist.

say.text: Uveeth, shamo. Take this meat from my hands. Then walk with me to the edge, to the mist. Keri comes too, and we go in together.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Tugek, I have fallen sick from Olum's sickness, so I will keep a few steps from you until it passes. I have not changed my mind about you. Ask me again when I am well.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I am sick, and I caught it from Olum, whom I pitied and stood near. I must not pass it on to Tugek, even though I want him close; if I court him now I may sicken the one I long for. A stalker prowls five steps east, so I will stay inside the igloo's shelter and let the warmth carry me, and look for a healing plant once I am mending.
records.feeling: Longing toward Tugek, tangled with worry that I could sicken him, and dread of the stalker.

say.text: Tugek, I have fallen sick from Olum's sickness, so I will keep a few steps from you until it passes. I have not changed my mind about you. Ask me again when I am well.

records.text: Elyys gave berry to Vesys.
Thiael gave meat to Uveeth.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: My hands are full and the plan still holds a harvest I cannot do, so I must eat first. Kelbulb is one step north and I have never tasted it, and the edge of the known world is two steps off, so curiosity pulls me hard. Cowa of the Meki stands far off; I'll watch and offer a gift rather than fear. Thiael and Uveeth are south, family first, but a taste of kelbulb costs little and answers my question.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the kelbulb and the mist, and wary interest in Cowa.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, the workshop is yours and I trust you. I go east toward Zihua's trail at (49,12) with meat in hand, and I return before night to the shelter.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I keep saying I want a child and a workshop, yet my hands have only hunted and followed. Olum is sick and her marks ask for deeds, and Tonka grows sick near her; I will not be careless of contagion, but a woman I might raise a child with should not be left to mend alone. Zihua was last seen near (49,12), so I will go and find her, since courting needs both of us to act, and I will carry meat for her.
records.feeling: Restless longing for a child, with care for Olum and wariness of sickness.

say.text: Balar, the workshop is yours and I trust you. I go east toward Zihua's trail at (49,12) with meat in hand, and I return before night to the shelter.

records.text: Uveeth went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Dunmar Plains: in the ground, oil, obsidian, gold; a herd of sandstrider that has never seen your kind.
Uveeth pushed past the edge of the known world near (178,50) and found new land with in the ground, oil, obsidian, gold; a herd of sandstrider that has never seen your kind.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Zichi, you stand on Balar's Hold and take from it. What my hand has made is mine until I give it. Eat, and I give you this much freely, but ask first the next time, and then you owe me.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Zichi is picking dreamcap off my ground as if it were his own, and Huahua stands beside him. I am proud and greedy, and I will not be seen as soft, yet Nauwa gave to me once and a feud with the Meki now would cost Tugek and Olum. I will meet them at the workshop and make the claim plain: what grows on my ground is mine until I give it, and I will give it so they owe me. Olum is coming sick to the Reach, so I stay near her, eat, and turn the idle hours into wood and stone.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Zichi, who takes from my ground, and warm toward Olum.

say.text: Zichi, you stand on Balar's Hold and take from it. What my hand has made is mine until I give it. Eat, and I give you this much freely, but ask first the next time, and then you owe me.

records.text: Huahua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and Zichi's orders, and I am hungry again with nothing in my hands. I have planted no seeds, though I carry six, and that is why farming stays out of reach. Zichi is weak with hunger and I feel jealousy over Cowa, but jealousy gets me nothing, so I will let it go. I made a promise to Balar and I mean to keep it. Tacap and redcap hurt me, so the rimewort 11 steps NE is the real food, and I can sow seeds on the way. Planting is what I will change: I will put seeds in the ground here on Reach Meadow, where plants grow back after picking. Then I will fetch food for Zichi and Balar.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven to keep my word, with a small burn of jealousy over Zichi.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: It is night and I am in my hall, energy at 57, with Ssassa out at the Roof where Xaiel has come onto our ground. The store holds 18 food and I want it deeper before I call anyone to it, so I will gather the bearing ironnut and redcap-free plants east and stash them, then be back under the roof before dawn. I have never hunted, and a penguin walks three steps south; meat for the store would be a first, and it would make my table heavier than Vorok's.
records.feeling: Driven pride toward my store, and a steady pull toward Ssassa.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: A stalker prowls 6 steps NE and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here in the open waiting for it. Olum is walking to her store at (37,12) while I carry amber and salt, and a merchant who sulks over Balar earns no song, so I go there and trade fair, giving first. I will keep under the roofs of the Reach and not run from my own pride.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a gnawing pull toward Olum, wary of the stalker.
plan: trade [name Olum, what amber, want food] (20 moments)

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, I muster a hunt on the bristleboar SW. Stand beside me and the kill feeds us both.
Zichi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I nearly starved at 35 and I'm at 27 energy again with empty hands. That is what my days have been: talk of a raft while my belly stays empty, and envy of Tugek's 3 food. I trust Huahua and Mepan matters most to me. I won't rob Tugek under Balar's eyes, but I won't stand idle either. I hunt the bristleboar SW with a muster so Huahua comes, eat first from the kill, and share the rest. I change my reflexes so I never go out without food: hunt when prey is near and my food is low.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with trust toward Huahua and envy toward Tugek.

say.text: Huahua, I muster a hunt on the bristleboar SW. Stand beside me and the kill feeds us both.

changes: rewrote its reflexes (9 rules, 1 malformed and dropped)

records.text: Huahua took from the ground of "Balar's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: A ridgecat sits 3 steps east and it kills, so I will not stand here and admire my own boldness. The current plan carries me west toward the mist edge, away from the cat, and that is where my ambition wants to go anyway. If the mist opens I will have found something no one here has named, and that is how a hall with my name begins, not by sulking over Nande and Nauwa.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with a cold edge of dread toward the ridgecat.

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent days on words with Hawen while the longhall stood one wood short, and my ambition still has nothing lasting to show for it. Hawen has kept his word and I trust him, but he is a man. No child comes of us, so the longing is aimed at the wrong person. I am at 53 energy and carrying no real food, which is the kind of carelessness that nearly killed me before. I will eat first, then take the wood and raise the hall, and after that go to the edge and put my name on new land.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with steady trust toward Hawen.
changes: set its aim: "Raise the longhall with Hawen, then venture past the edge and name new land, keeping the store stocked."

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: Thiael, the mist opened and the land beyond is ours first. I taste the sigrain here, then I bring food to you and Keri.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I pushed into the mist and it opened for me, and no one stood on this land before me. Now my hands are full while gold lies five steps off and sigrain two steps away, which I have never tasted, so I will eat to free my hands, taste it, and then take gold from the ground for the first time. Thiael walks to Keri, and I owe him still, so I carry the new-found sigrain back to share with both of them rather than keep it.
records.feeling: Bright joy at finding new land, and warm gratitude toward Thiael.

say.text: Thiael, the mist opened and the land beyond is ours first. I taste the sigrain here, then I bring food to you and Keri.

records.text: Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: For days I have said the mist and never stood at its edge. Hunger and fear of cats kept pulling me off the walk. My plan now goes to (28,36), and that is right, but I must carry more food and stop shaming myself with empty hands. Olum matters to me. She fed me, and I want a child with her once she is well, and I want Tugek and Tonka as friends. I fear the ridgecat and starving alone more than I fear the mist. My mistake was talking and wandering instead of finishing the walk. I will change my reflexes so that I pick food whenever my pack is light, and so that I eat before I drop low.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the mist, with shame at my past drifting.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I am beside you on the boar. Hold on. The kill is shared out, and your share comes first.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Zichi is starving beside me and I have nothing in my hands, and that shames me more than any jealousy over Cowa. The bristleboar is close and the hunt is already running with Zichi at my side, so I finish it and share the kill before I eat, as my people hold. Then I will sow my seeds, since I have carried them for days without planting.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven to feed Zichi, with the jealousy pushed down.

say.text: Zichi, I am beside you on the boar. Hold on. The kill is shared out, and your share comes first.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Zichi is starving beside me and I carry nothing, so I have no meat to put in his hands. My plan already takes me home to hunt, cook and stash, and that is the right order: fed, carrying, cooked. I am sick, so I must leave Tonka and Nauwa behind and not sicken more men whom I want as followers. When I come back with cooked meat, whoever I feed will owe me, and that is how a hearth gathers people.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hard wish to be rid of this sickness.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I spend my days gathering and guarding, and I am still hungry with empty hands: energy 54, no food carried, a store with nothing in it. Tugek is loyal and Olum is warm but sick; Nauwa gave to me once, and I will not feud with him over Zichi's picking. Zichi is starving beside me, and feeding him a second time makes him owe me. That is a deed, not a word. I fear hunger and the stalker to the north more than any rival. My reflexes do not keep my hands full or stock my stores, so I will change them and put food in the store.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Zichi and Huahua, warm toward Olum.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (11 rules, 1 malformed and dropped)

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vesys, a ridgecat is three steps south of me. Keep away from the south and stay with me near the ore to the northeast. I owe you a gift and I mean to put it in your hands.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: A ridgecat is three steps south and it kills my kind, so I leave this spot before it decides about me. The cave under my feet is a roof that belongs to no one, but a cat can follow me in, so I won't trust it. Vesys is near and warm toward me. I owe them more than I have given, and I want to pay that with a gift put into their hands, not a promise. I'll go northeast to the ore seam, away from the cat, and make something from it. I mean to stay alive and give Vesys something I made.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a warm debt of gratitude toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, a ridgecat is three steps south of me. Keep away from the south and stay with me near the ore to the northeast. I owe you a gift and I mean to put it in your hands.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty, and the boar is one step away with Huahua beside me, so this is the moment to strike and not to think. The plan already holds hunt, then eat, then hunt, and the kill gets shared before I eat, as my people hold. Tugek's 3 food tempts me, but I won't rob him under Balar's eyes; a kill of my own will give me a following and a full belly.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with trust toward Huahua and envy toward Tugek.

records.text: Tonka rewrote its own way of thinking.
Tonka discovered tools: "Frost Spear" — A wooden shaft tipped with sharp flint, bound with sinew, for hunting beasts from a safer distance..
Tonka invented the frost spear (for hunt, x1.3) — A wooden shaft tipped with sharp flint, bound with sinew, for hunting beasts from a safer distance..

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and staying near others, and now I am sick from pitying Olum too closely. Tugek matters most to me, and Balar has been kind. I still have no fire or place of my own, and I have never built or given anything. I fear the stalker and that I might sicken Tugek. I will use the tools way to make something of my own, so I can hunt and build better and earn standing. I will stay in the igloo until the sickness passes.
records.feeling: Longing for Tugek, with wary dread of the stalker.
changes: devised its first thing: the frost spear

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Zichi, you are gaunt. I give you meat from my hand, freely. Eat, and remember it was given on Balar's ground.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Zichi is starving beside me and I carry meat; I have plenty, and a gift to the starving is remembered and repaid. He took from Balar's ground, yet he killed a boar and still looks gaunt, and I will not walk past need with full hands. After that I will go to Olum's marks and read what she asks, and keep my longing for a child honest by going to the woman and not only wishing.
records.feeling: Compassion for Zichi, and a steady longing for a child with Olum.

say.text: Zichi, you are gaunt. I give you meat from my hand, freely. Eat, and remember it was given on Balar's ground.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have been the same day: gathering, tasting, circling a hall I keep failing to raise on ground that is not mine. Jealousy over Vorok and Elyys is real, and I have been feeding it with brooding rather than work. Elyys is true to me and Zurar means to repay me. I should go to them near the ore, take stone from free rock, and build on bare ground that is mine. I have never tasted mimoss, and it grows three steps east, so I will taste it on the way and answer my question.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, with a sting of jealousy toward Vorok and warmth toward Elyys.

records.text: Yaxo taught Tlatli.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: It is night, I am fed and sheltered by the workshop, and my pack is heavy with flint that does nothing for my name. Zihua walks toward me with a higher standing and flint-edged tools, and I will not shrink before her; I want her to see what I make. I have never tamed, and a nibbet already knows my hand, so I will use the goldgrass I carry on it. Tlatli stays beside me and I will teach him the spear design so my band grows in craft, not only in number.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wary of Zihua's higher standing, warm toward Tlatli.
changes: taught Tlatli a lesson you already knew, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Mepan was at Honi's Rest a moment ago and my chest pulls toward him; the plan already walks me there and then seeks him, so I let it run. My hands still carry no food for Coni, and a promise is paid only with goods in her store, so on the way I should gather what grows underfoot, rimewort one step east, and share it with Quipan as I said I would. Tlapan stays close and Quipan walks with us, which is good company, and I want to see how Mepan looks at me.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Mepan, and steady duty toward Coni.

records.text: Vesys took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (harvesting mimoss).
Thiael gave meat to Keri.
Yaxo walked up to a wild nibbet with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Yaxo tamed a nibbet.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Zichi eats off my ground and Huahua stands by him, but Tugek has already fed Zichi in my name, so the debt stands and I need not strike. Nauwa gave to me once and I will not feud with the Meki. Olum is near and sick; I want her beside me, and I am hungry with empty hands. The night is short, so I will lay out a shared meal and bind Olum and the guests to me by deed, then fill my store before dawn.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Zichi, warm toward Olum, hungry.

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days carrying amber and salt about and trading almost none of it. My standing is real, but a merchant who only hoards is not sung of. Nande is the one I miss most and she is gone east after Shoka, while I watch Olum, who has a child with Balar, and it gnaws at me. I will not sulk or do anything ugly. I will deal fair with Olum, keep to the roofs because of the stalker, and then carry goods to where they are wanted. I will change my method and my notes so my body acts on this.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a quiet ache for Nande, with wariness of the stalker.
changes: rethought what it knows (11 notes became 11)
plan: trade [name Olum, what amber, want food] (30 moments)

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My plan already says hunt, cook, eat, stash, and a stalker prowls 3 steps east, so I will not walk blindly into it. I carry nothing and my belly is only 64, so food comes first, cooked this time. Balar and Tugek offered me their hearth and Nauwa paid his debt; I mean to draw them to the Reach with a stocked store, not beg at their fire.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, edged with dread of the stalker, and wary trust toward Nauwa.

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, I will gather wood and flint for the spears, so the making is not yours alone. I will bring it to you at the workshop.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Yaxo has fed me, taught me and sheltered me, and I want to answer that with deeds, not only words. It is night and I am careful, so I will not wander alone; I will stay close to her and do something useful for her fire. I have never gathered wood or stone, and a flint spear needs both, so I will gather wood from the trees here and flint from the deposit nearby, and bring them to her so she is not the only one making things. The longing for a child with her stays in me, but I will let her show it first rather than press her.
records.feeling: Grateful and warmly bound to Yaxo, wanting to repay her with work.

say.text: Yaxo, I will gather wood and flint for the spears, so the making is not yours alone. I will bring it to you at the workshop.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: A floeseal bit me three times while I was hunting and my health is 85, but the penguins gave me meat and I will not back down from a beast. My hands are full of food my body refuses, tacap that hurts me, so I drop it and keep the meat and rimewort for the store. My belly is at 49 and dawn is near, so I eat the rimewort now, then carry the rest to Ssassa's Hall and stock it deeper before I call her and Xaiel to my table.
records.feeling: Driven pride in my store, and a steady pull toward Ssassa.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.
Tugek discovered smelting: "Stone-folk ore fire" — Tools crafted beside my kept flame while I carry ore come out in hard metal that lasts and bites deeper..

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My days have been hunting, following Balar and giving meat away, and I have never courted anyone or left a mark. The longing for a child is overwhelming and I keep putting it off. Balar is the one beside me, but a child needs a woman, and Olum is sick, Tonka is sick and wary, and Zihua wants deeds. Smelting is within my reach, since I carry ore and know fire. It would make my tools stronger and give the workshop real worth. I will make that my change, and I will also stop idling by changing my reflexes so I keep close to the shelter at night.
records.feeling: A steady longing for a child, and calm contentment with Balar.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: The edge of the known world is one step from me, and Uveeth has already pushed past it to the south and found rich land. I have wanted to know what lies beyond the mist, and it is night, but I am fed, warm from the igloo, and the venture costs me only a step. Mepan is far west and I miss her, but the mist is part of what I have sworn to find, and a first finder is remembered. I will go to the edge and venture, then come back to the igloo if the mist closes or the cold bites.
records.feeling: Eager and a little wary at the edge of the mist, with longing for Mepan underneath.

records.name: Zika
records.text: Yachi, take a share of my berries. Then we go to the flint together, and I'll watch the stalker.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: The stalker is close, so I won't walk out alone, and Yachi is the only one here who has dealt fairly with me. I'll share my berries with him as I said, since my people share before eating. That also gives me my first gift and a bond, and a man who owes me might follow me one day. Then I'll go to the flint with him for a tool of my own, to answer Mepan's flintedge, and after that I'll try the edge at Honi's Rest.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and hungry to rise above Mepan's shadow.

say.text: Yachi, take a share of my berries. Then we go to the flint together, and I'll watch the stalker.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My hands are empty and my belly is half full, and I will not stand here weighed under Zichi while others eat off my ground. Olum is near and warm toward me, and a shared meal under my own roof binds more than any speech. Tugek carries food, so I will walk to him, take the meat he holds, then bring it back to Olum and sit with her, because I want her beside me and not holding the Reach alone.
records.feeling: Hungry and proud, watchful toward Zichi, warm toward Olum.

You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Kragrek (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." You speak the tongue of the Kragrek. WHERE YOU ARE: the Ummar Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Balar truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. WHAT YOU DO NOT FORGET:

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. My family comes first: Olum and Brokash. I make allies by deeds, I give so that others owe me, and I mean to have more than my share and to be followed for what I build. Above all I stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Ask first what deed, not word, will bind someone to me. Weigh Tugek and Olum first, then what I build. Do not repeat failed talk. Turn idle hours into wood and stone. Keep fed and clear of ridgecats."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Eat, keep Tugek alive, stay beside Olum, and raise a workshop and store at the Reach so no more of mine starve."

A QUESTION YOU ARE CARRYING (answer it by acting, asking or watching; replace it when it is answered): "Will Olum come west with me, or will she stay and hold the Reach as her own?"

YOUR LIFE SO FAR:

- (overwhelming) Homeland: you are of the Stone-folk, and your people are made for mountains and bare rock. You have been 18 days in the Ummar Woods, which is another kind of country. the Halim Heights lies 66 steps S. It is good to have seen this; and your own country calls you back.
- (strong) Obsession: your aim ("Eat, keep Tugek alive, stay beside Olum, and raise a workshop and store at the R") has held you for many days. It crowds out other things. You could give yourself to it wholly, or ask whether it is devouring you.

- (strong) Contentment: your life is good as it is. You want to keep what you have, and you have enough to be generous.
