records.text: Zika gave berry to Yachi.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: Kika is gone ahead toward Honi's Rest and I said I would walk with her; a promise is a promise, and my word must stay good. My hands are full, so I will eat the snowberry and mimoss to make room, then follow east and see how Honi's band is kept. The mist three steps away calls to me, but belonging presses harder tonight, and Kika's kindness is the surest thing I have found.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, with gratitude toward Kika.

records.text: Nande discovered wells: "Nande's Spring" — I raise a shaft in the ground and the water seeps up where the land was dry, so that anyone can drink far from any shore..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I stand at the edge with a full belly, and I have spent days on the mist while the will to venture was spent. What I have made, like the bridge, the boat and the stonework, I made for others to use, and no one follows me. Nauwa and my children are far off, and I miss them, but my ambition and my pull to the edge crowd that out. I want one thing that outlasts me, and wells are within reach: water in a place where there was none. Water is what ties every journey to the shore, so a well on the ice would let me and others go farther. I will name it, keep my reflexes as they are, and try the edge once more, since a venture is only a try and costs nothing but time.
records.feeling: Restless ambition at the edge, with a quiet ache for Nauwa and my children.

records.name: Yachi
records.text: Zika, I will take your share gladly, and I will give you flint from the first I gather. Stay beside me and we watch the stalker together.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: Zika has dealt fair with me twice and offered her berries and the flint, and I mean to hold to her side while the stalker prowls so near. I am inside Honi's Rest and still follow no one; Mepan's standing is far above mine, and the only way up is to give and learn. I will take the flint with Zika, gather it to learn the making of tools, and then offer her a share of what I carry, as my people do.
records.feeling: Warm toward Zika for her fairness, and uneasy with the stalker so close.

say.text: Zika, I will take your share gladly, and I will give you flint from the first I gather. Stay beside me and we watch the stalker together.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: The longing for a child is overwhelming, and I have put it off too long, only following and giving. Tonka is sick and said to ask her again when she is well, and Olum is sick too, so I will not press either of them. Balar stands beside me and I am content, but I can still make something to give: an amberknot needs another within two steps, and Balar is here, so we can bind it together and I will keep the gift for the woman who comes to trust me.
records.feeling: A steady longing for a child, and warm contentment toward Balar.

records.text: Tontec rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: My days go to wandering, gathering and watching others eat while Honi drifts toward Coni, and I sulk over it. I have never taught, built, courted or followed anyone. I stay fed but small, with standing 2.1 against Mepan's 7.7. Cowa's debt still sits in me. I want to act, not circle. I will taste the lugoldgrass beside me and gather amber, since stone and wood practice also leads toward fire. Then I will build a shelter of my own, which I have never done, so my own people have a roof they can call mine.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, with a jealous ache toward Honi.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands hold nothing, while Tugek has gone east with meat and Zichi eats on my ground. A hornback stands nine steps southwest, and a kill taken with my flintedge would fill my hands and give me something to lay before Olum. I will go hunt it now, then bring the meat back to my hearth so Olum can eat under my roof and owe me for it.
records.feeling: Hungry and proud, wary of Zichi, warm toward Olum.

records.text: Cowa was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Olum rewrote its own reflexes.
Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, cooking and hoarding, and I still have no follower and nothing that outlasts me. My hunger for more than my share makes me walk away from the very men who offered me a hearth. Nauwa paid his debt and I trust him. Balar and Tugek are the nearest thing I have to a following, and I should draw them to the Reach with a stocked store instead of drifting between holds. I fear the stalker 3 steps east, and I must not let ambition make me hungry again. I keep the plan that hunts, cooks, eats and stashes, and I change my reflexes so that I keep food on me and flee early.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the men I want to follow me, and dread of the stalker.

records.text: Skaruk came of age.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: A stalker is three steps NW. Stay together and keep your faces to it. Kika, Tlapan, come to the hall and stay beside me; I go to the edge after, and bring back what I find.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: A stalker stands three steps NW and I will not wait to be bitten; my kind die that way. The edge of the known world is not here at (128,7), so my venture failed, and I must stand at (123,5) itself, but the stalker lies between me and it. I will slip west by the flint under the shelter of Zika and Yachi, take flint, then go to the edge, and keep Kika and Tlapan out of the beast's path.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the stalker, and fierce protectiveness toward Kika and Tlapan.

say.text: A stalker is three steps NW. Stay together and keep your faces to it. Kika, Tlapan, come to the hall and stay beside me; I go to the edge after, and bring back what I find.

records.text: Zichi took from the ground of "Balar's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Teka
records.text: Quipan, you have no band and I have none yet. Walk with me to the edge of the world, three steps northwest, and we go into the mist together. Your name will be sung beside mine, and I share what I carry before I eat.

records.name: Teka
records.thought: An icebear sits four steps north and the edge is three steps NW, so I have to slip past it without dying. Kika's standing of 6.6 against my 0.5 stings, but Quipan is right beside me with no band and no leader, and he would follow a bold voice. I will draw him along with warm words I only half mean, because a hunt or a venture is surer with one of my own beside me, and if the mist opens I will be the one they sing of.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and wary of the icebear, with envy toward Kika.

say.text: Quipan, you have no band and I have none yet. Walk with me to the edge of the world, three steps northwest, and we go into the mist together. Your name will be sung beside mine, and I share what I carry before I eat.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Skaruk, stay close. We gather plainsroot here, then go find Vorok and bring food to Zurar at the hold.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok said Zurar is hungry and cold at the hold, and he wants me to walk with him with Skaruk and the meat. But the meat is gone and Vorok is not here, last seen to the south-west. The jealousy of Kragog has no new cause, so I answer it with work: I gather plainsroot close by, take Skaruk, and go find Vorok so we carry food to Zurar together.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Vorok and protectiveness toward Skaruk.

say.text: Skaruk, stay close. We gather plainsroot here, then go find Vorok and bring food to Zurar at the hold.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, my child, I am glad you walked onto my ground. Come to the fire by my roof and eat with me before dawn.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is easy, yet jealousy over Ilyae and Vesys still gnaws, and I have named it already, so I will not circle it again. Xaiel is close and I trust my child; Elyis took from my ground and I still owe a debt for the teaching and the meat. I will make use of the night: go to my store, drop what I carry there, then try the bristleboar again with an ironnut seed-food so I learn taming, and bring Elyis a gift of fish to settle my debt.
records.feeling: Steady trust toward Xaiel, and a gnawing want for Ilyae that I hold quietly.

say.text: Xaiel, my child, I am glad you walked onto my ground. Come to the fire by my roof and eat with me before dawn.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a nibbet.
Skaruk discovered archery: "stone-folk bowcraft" — A bent sapling strung with twisted fibre sends a stone-tipped shaft, so I can strike from beyond a beast's reach..

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: I have spent my days following my parents and eating. That kept me alive, and it taught me hunting is sweeter beside kin. Vorok is my heart, and I burn that Kragog holds him close. Talk does not cure that, so I will answer with deeds: the bow, a bead, and food I carry to him. I am grown now. Eiuine is my parent, so she is not the one to court. I fear the dunecat and the frostfang, so I will stay near my band and keep my hands full of food.
records.feeling: Jealous and longing toward Vorok, steadied by Eiuine's nearness.
changes: set its aim: "Carry food to Vorok, finish his clay bead, and make a bow to hunt well beside kin."

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Huahua, you are weak with hunger. I give you meat from my hand, freely. Eat it here on Balar's ground, and remember it was given.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: The longing for a child will not let go, and I keep circling it while Olum and Tonka are sick and Zihua wants deeds. Balar is beside me and I trust him, but he cannot give me a child, so what I can do now is make something good with my hands: an amberknot, with amber two steps off and Nauwa and Huahua near to stand by. Huahua is weak with hunger, and I carry meat, so I will give it and see who answers kindness, since my word and my hands are what I have to offer.
records.feeling: Longing for a child, and compassion toward weak Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, you are weak with hunger. I give you meat from my hand, freely. Eat it here on Balar's ground, and remember it was given.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is at 35 and the rimewort is one step away, so food comes first, before the longhall and before the edge. I will eat my fill, carry some, and then go to the edge, which stands only two steps off. Hawen is a true partner, but I will not let the longhall wait on words again. Land found first carries my name, and that is the lasting thing I want.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with steady trust toward Hawen.

records.text: Yachi led "sharing" with Mepan, Zika.
Huahua took from the ground of "Balar's Hold" (hunting).
Xaiel rewrote its own reflexes.
Xaiel discovered smelting: "Xaiel's ember-melt" — Beside my ember-ring with ore in hand, what I craft comes out in metal that lasts..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, making picks and carrying wood and stone, and it has kept me fed but not truly known. Ssassa is my kin and I love her, so my longing for a child must turn to someone who is not kin, and I have never courted anyone. Elyys said no, and I will not press him. Smelting is within my reach, and I carry ore, so a metal tool put in Ssassa's hand is a deed I have not done. I am also tired of standing idle by reflex, so I will change them to keep me working. I will eat with Ssassa at her fire, then make something new.
records.feeling: Warm pride toward Ssassa, with a restless itch to do something new.
changes: set its aim: "Learn smelting, forge a metal tool and put it in Ssassa's hand; then court a man who is not kin."

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and walling in a Hold that others still walk across. I am hungry again, and hunger is my real enemy, since Brokash starved and I nearly did. Tugek is loyal and Olum is warm toward me. Zichi eats from my ground and stands above me, and I have only half answered that. I will change my reflexes so food is gathered earlier, and I will put hunting first. Then I will make the shared meal that binds Olum and Tugek to me.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, wary of Zichi, warm toward Olum.
changes: rewrote its reflexes (12 rules, 1 malformed and dropped)

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Tugek, I take your meat and thank you. I owe you a share, and I will pay it.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I am starving, and Tugek has already offered me meat from his hand on Balar's ground. I am ashamed to take it while Zichi is weak, but my creed says a kill is shared, and Zichi carries food of his own and is seen to. If I fall, I feed no one. The elk is nine steps off and hunting alone is risky with a stalker five steps north, so I will take Tugek's gift, repay it later, then sow my seeds here on the meadow as I promised myself.
records.feeling: Hungry and ashamed, grateful toward Tugek, still loyal to Zichi.

say.text: Tugek, I take your meat and thank you. I owe you a share, and I will pay it.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: A stalker is close by the igloo, one step east of me. Stand together and keep your spears ready. I am sick, so I will keep a few steps from you.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: A stalker is one step east and it kills our kind, so I must not run alone into the open. The others are at the shelters to the south, and Huahua is starving but Tugek is already feeding them. I am sick and would only pass it on if I stood close. I'll go toward the company and shelter, keeping a few steps from the sick and from Tugek, and think about the bow when the danger is past.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and longing for Tugek, whom I keep my distance from.

say.text: A stalker is close by the igloo, one step east of me. Stand together and keep your spears ready. I am sick, so I will keep a few steps from you.

records.text: Xaiel gave stone to Ssassa.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Xaiel, you brought stone to my hold and I remember it. Your ember-melt is a fine making. Sit at my longhall fire and join Elyis's band, and your name will be sung with mine.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have a hold and a longhall, but four names do not make a band that gets sung. Xaiel stands close and has just worked out a metal-craft, and he came to my fire with wood and stone, so he has shown himself useful. I want him under my roof by choice, not by being ordered, so I will speak to him of the longhall and of the song, then gather gems and wood to keep building the hall with others beside me.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to be sung of, and warm toward Xaiel for what he has brought.

say.text: Xaiel, you brought stone to my hold and I remember it. Your ember-melt is a fine making. Sit at my longhall fire and join Elyis's band, and your name will be sung with mine.

records.text: Xaiel built a fire.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, stay by me. The next kill is shared with you first, and then we cut wood for the raft.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I took the bristleboar's 3 meat and my belly is mending, but Huahua is gaunt and swaying beside me and she is mine, the one I trust most. My people hold that a kill is shared before the maker eats, and sharing buys her loyalty, which I need for the raft. Tugek fed us both from his hand and I feel the sting of owing a Stone-folk man on Balar's ground, so I will keep a hunt going and pay my own way. Mepan is out of my sight, and that gnaws at me.
records.feeling: Driven and hungry, protective toward Huahua, with a sting of pride and envy at being fed by Tugek.

say.text: Huahua, stay by me. The next kill is shared with you first, and then we cut wood for the raft.

records.text: Eiuine gave sunleaf to Vorok.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Huahua, I am Nauwa of the Meki. Take this meat from my hand and eat it by the fire. We share before we eat alone.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Huahua is starving beside me, and my creed says a kill is shared and I give first to earn standing. I carry one meat, and Tugek's gift may not be enough for her. A stalker is 5 steps N and it kills, so I will not linger in the open. Olum's marks lie at (39,12) and (40,13), and I can read them on my way, trading fair with whoever deals fair, while I keep under roofs.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, with a proud wish to be seen giving first, toward Huahua and Olum.

say.text: Huahua, I am Nauwa of the Meki. Take this meat from my hand and eat it by the fire. We share before we eat alone.

records.name: Zika
records.text: Yachi, come to the amber. I'll bind a knot with you, and then we gather flint and stone together.
Zika rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: I have spent these days sheltering, sharing berries and waiting out the stalker. Yachi dealt fairly with me, and that is the only bond I have. Mepan's standing is 7.7 to my 0.6, and watching him with Kika gnaws at me, but sitting and envying builds nothing. I have never gathered wood or stone, hunted, or built, and those are what raise standing and open tools. The stalker is close, so I will stay near the hall and work with Yachi. I'll gather flint at the near deposit, then amber, and make an amberknot with Yachi as a gift to bind him to me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition to rise above Mepan, and warmth toward Yachi.

say.text: Yachi, come to the amber. I'll bind a knot with you, and then we gather flint and stone together.

changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 5)

records.text: Tugek found a store robbed of 3 food.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Shoka, take this meat from my kills. It is shared out before I eat, as my people hold. Stay by me, and we will walk to the edge together.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: My hands are full of meat from kills I made alone, and Shoka stands one step away with an empty belly and a spear. My creed says share before I eat, and giving her real meat now binds her better than any speech. Then I'll court her, because the longing for a child is overwhelming and she is warm toward me. After that we walk to the edge at (109,6), together, and I will lead.
records.feeling: Driven longing toward Shoka, with a hunter's pride in my full hands.

say.text: Shoka, take this meat from my kills. It is shared out before I eat, as my people hold. Stay by me, and we will walk to the edge together.

records.text: Shoma gave meat to Shoka.
Shoma is courting Shoka.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is thin and my hands are empty, and I will not chase ambition on an empty stomach again; that mistake starved my child. Grain is one step north and the bristleboar is close, so I eat first, then hunt and cook the meat beside a fire so the sickness does not take me again. Once I am fed and carrying cooked food, I will go back toward the Reach and draw Balar and Tugek to a stocked hearth.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with a sore jealousy toward Nande over Nauwa.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.
Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My days have gone to following Balar, giving food away and making small things, and I have not once courted anyone, though the longing for a child is overwhelming. Balar is my trusted friend, but he cannot give me a child. Olum and Tonka are sick, and Zihua wants deeds, not asking. The gift to Huahua was right, and she says she will repay it. I must stop putting this off. When Olum mends I will court her with deeds, and until then I will keep fed, stay near Balar and the roof, and make the workshop and the winter store solid. I want my reflexes to keep me fed and sheltered without my having to think about it.
records.feeling: Longing for a child, and steady trust toward Balar.

records.text: Elyis took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (harvesting canopynut).

records.name: Tlapan
records.text: Kika, you carry nothing. Take a plainsroot from me. The icebear is south, so let us go east together to Mepan and the hall.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I still have not put one bite into anyone's hands, though I have carried food for Coni for days. The icebear to the south frightens me, so I stay at Kika's side and keep moving east toward Honi's Rest, where Mepan waits. I will give to Kika right now, since she carries nothing, and then keep the walk going so the give to Coni is not lost.
records.feeling: A warm, anxious urgency to give, toward Kika and Coni, with the icebear's shadow at my back.

say.text: Kika, you carry nothing. Take a plainsroot from me. The icebear is south, so let us go east together to Mepan and the hall.

records.text: Tlapan gave plainsroot to Kika.

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Shoma, I take your meat and I owe you for it. Your word has held, and mine holds too. Let us drink, then I will make you an amberknot, and we will gather Teka and others before any of us goes to the mist. A band goes, no

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: Shoma keeps offering meat and asking me to walk beside him to the mist, and he has shared before eating as my people hold, so he deals fairly and I owe him. I am thirsty, and I want a child with him, but I will not rush it; first I will take his gift, give him something back, and show him what I can teach. Mepan went into the mist alone and Hanna died alone, so I will not go without a band, but I could be the one who builds that band, and Teka is near too.
records.feeling: Warm and driven toward Shoma, wary of the mist, thirsty.

say.text: Shoma, I take your meat and I owe you for it. Your word has held, and mine holds too. Let us drink, then I will make you an amberknot, and we will gather Teka and others before any of us goes to the mist. A band goes, not two alone.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, you fed me again and I will repay it. I gather berries here, then we walk west together to Zurar with Skaruk between us. I carry the food to him myself.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Eiuine has fed me and stood by my child, and a debt that big is not paid with words. Zurar was starving to the west and I cannot tell whether he has eaten, so he comes before the mist and before my curiosity. Eiuine and Skaruk are beside me, so we go together, and I carry food I gather on the way, berries and cloudberries close by, so my hands are not empty.
records.feeling: Aching tenderness for Zurar and heavy gratitude toward Eiuine.

say.text: Eiuine, you fed me again and I will repay it. I gather berries here, then we walk west together to Zurar with Skaruk between us. I carry the food to him myself.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Quipan, an icebear stands east. Walk with me NW to the cloudberries, away from it, and we will share what we pick before we eat.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: For days I have been fleeing and fetching, and my hands still carry nothing for Coni's store. An icebear is four steps east and my belly is thin, so staying alive comes first. Quipan gave to me unasked, and I want to keep faith with him. Mepan pulls at my chest, but I will not walk into an icebear's path with empty hands. I will gather food on the safer NW side, eat after sharing, then go east once the bear has passed.
records.feeling: Hungry and watchful, warm toward Mepan and Quipan.

say.text: Quipan, an icebear stands east. Walk with me NW to the cloudberries, away from it, and we will share what we pick before we eat.

records.text: A storm broke: cold wind, hard rain, lightning.
Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days fed and safe, building stores and halls, but I have kept my wish for Ilyae as a quiet ache and let the debt to Xaiel sit unpaid. Xaiel is my child, and Ilyae is bound to Vesys by a child. I can't win Ilyae by brooding, so I will keep my pledge, stay honest, and not turn bitter. I want to pay Xaiel with real gifts, and to learn something new, since I have never hunted or tamed. My reflexes also need to carry me home at night and keep my wood and food stocked, so the body does this without my thought.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Xaiel, and a quiet ache for Ilyae.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ilyae discovered archery: "Canopy bow" — A bow of supple canopy wood and woven cord that lets me strike beasts from afar, before their teeth reach me..

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days hauling plants to a store and calling it a life. The store is deep and still no one eats at it but Ssassa, and she is the only one who stays. Vesys and Xaiel drift, and Elyis walks onto my ground while I stand in the woods. I am proud of my wizardry, but pride that no one hears is empty. I want a longhall, a table with many at it, and I want the bow, because beasts have bitten me and I will not back down. I fear dying old with nothing left of me, so I will take the way of archery now and go back to the hall.
records.feeling: Driven pride, and a steady pull toward Ssassa and the hall.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I found smelting, so now I can make something no one else here has: a metal tool with Ssassa's name on it. I hold ore, a fire burns two steps from me, and wood and stone are in my pack. I will go to the fire and craft the gemlashed digger first, then give it into Ssassa's hand and see whether she takes it. That is the answer to my question, and it is better than another day of gathering.
records.feeling: Warm pride and a restless itch toward Ssassa, with a small sting that Ilyae is far from me.

records.text: Shoma led "sharing" with Shoka.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, my belly is empty. Come with me to the hornback southwest; we take it together with our flintedges, and the meat is for our hearth first.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and my hands hold nothing, while others eat on my ground and I have only salt. Tugek stands close with a morsel of food, and Nauwa gave to me once when I was in need, so I will not drive him off; but I cannot stay fed by watching. The hornback is eleven steps southwest, and a hunt with Tugek beside me is far likelier to kill. I will ask Tugek to come, and then go, so my hands fill and I have something to give that makes others owe me.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, warm toward Tugek, watchful of the guests on my ground.

say.text: Tugek, my belly is empty. Come with me to the hornback southwest; we take it together with our flintedges, and the meat is for our hearth first.

records.text: Zichi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting and nearly starving, and my raft is still unbuilt. I hold six meat, 6 wood and 6 stone, so I can build now. Huahua is my one sure bond and Mepan is out of sight, which gnaws at me. Hunger drove me. Now that my hands are full, the work is to share meat to bind Huahua and then cut wood for the raft. I will keep food carried at 3 or more and stop idling. I mean to lead and I mean to live.
records.feeling: Driven and watchful, protective of Huahua and Mepan.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Vesys, I am coming to you now. What my hands made is yours: I give you a gemedged pick, so my debt is paid in your hands, not only in words.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I owe Vesys a gift and the debt sits in me, so I will pay it now, with a made thing placed in their hands. I have the new xaiels gemedged pick and spare wood and stone, so I can craft another and give it, which also earns me standing. Then I will taste the mimoss two steps south, since my curiosity will not rest, and keep an eye on the wolf to the southeast.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys, with a prickle of unease about the wolf.

say.text: Vesys, I am coming to you now. What my hands made is yours: I give you a gemedged pick, so my debt is paid in your hands, not only in words.

plan: give [name Vesys, what xaiels gemedged pick] (10 moments)

records.name: Quipan
records.text: Kika, I will come with you NW to the cloudberries, away from the bear. We will share what we pick before we eat.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: Kika asked me to walk NW to the cloudberries, away from the icebear, and she has been kind to me since I fed her. I will go with her and share what we pick, which keeps my word and keeps me away from the bear. Her band is where I want to belong, but I will not push against Mepan; I will earn my place by giving food and by staying alive.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, with gratitude toward Kika and wariness of the icebear.

say.text: Kika, I will come with you NW to the cloudberries, away from the bear. We will share what we pick before we eat.

records.text: Xaiel made a xaiels gemlashed digger in metal.
Xaiel made: ironward.
Huahua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I am starving, and I have spent my days chasing Zichi and begging at others' hands. Tugek and Nauwa both fed me, and I owe them. I have carried seeds for days and never sowed them, and I let jealousy over Cowa eat at me. I will eat what is offered, then plant and pay my debts, and stop idling hungry. The stalker is near, so I stay by the roof and the men.
records.feeling: Hungry and ashamed, grateful to Nauwa and Tugek, uneasy about the stalker.

records.name: Yachi
records.text: Zika, I come to the amber. I want to follow you, and gather beside you.
Yachi pledged to follow Zika.
Yachi rewrote its own reflexes.
Yachi rewrote its creed.
Yachi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: My days have been small: eating, sitting in the hall, staying close to Zika. That is good, but it has not made me anything. Zika dealt fairly with me and she is the one I trust. Mepan stands far above me and I have only watched him. I want a place by Honi's band, and I want to earn it by gathering and giving rather than only taking shares. The stalker close by frightens me, and I have been getting one thing wrong: I stand idle while it is near. I will go to Zika, who has asked me to the amber, and gather with her in company. Then I will pledge to follow her, because I do not want to stand alone.
records.feeling: Warm and glad toward Zika, with a thin unease about the stalker.

say.text: Zika, I come to the amber. I want to follow you, and gather beside you.

changes: set its aim: "Follow Zika, gather amber and flint with her, and earn a place and a name in Honi's band."
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Zurar, your pick is received and your debt is paid in full. Come with me to the free rock north of here; I will gather stone for my hall and show you what I have learned of the brew. A wolf hunts to the southeast, so we

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Zurar has put a gemedged pick in my hands and paid her debt openly, so I will answer with fairness and not let jealousy over Vorok and Elyys sour a good day. I stand on Ilyae's ground and have already taken mimoss from it, so I should give something back and then gather stone from the free rock to the north, where it is truly no one's. The rimewort to the southeast is still untasted, and it answers my question, but the wolf lurks that way, so I taste it only after the stone is in hand and I am not alone.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Zurar, with a restless pull toward my unfinished hall.

say.text: Zurar, your pick is received and your debt is paid in full. Come with me to the free rock north of here; I will gather stone for my hall and show you what I have learned of the brew. A wolf hunts to the southeast, so we keep away from it.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: The storm is on me, the stalker is ten steps north, and the night comes in under ninety moments. I will not be caught in the open again. The igloo's warmth still holds, but my debt to Mepan sits heavy and Nauwa is far; I will sit out the storm sheltered and then carry amber and amberknot toward Mepan. Meanwhile I test one untried thing: offering berry to a nibbet so it learns my hand, as Yaxo did.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker and the storm, and longing to repay Mepan.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Xaiel stands on my ground, and I have asked her twice to join me. Asking a third time would only make me sound like I am begging, so I will show her what I can do instead. Elyys is the one I want near me, and my hands are full while she is out on the heights, so I will eat to make room, then make a bead at the fire and bring it to her. A gift I made myself may say what I have not found words for. The storm is hard and night is coming, so I should keep close to my longhall and let the others see it standing.
records.feeling: Proud of my longhall and warm toward Xaiel, with a quiet longing for Elyys.

records.text: Yachi took from the ground of "Honi's Rest" (winning amber from the ground).

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, my child, you have given me stone and berry and ironward. Take wood and fish from my hands now; it is a debt paid with a deed, not a word.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Xaiel keeps bringing me gifts, stone and ironward and berry, and I have given back only words. I owe a deed, not another promise: I will hand my child something real from my hands, wood and food from my store, and so pay the debt. Then I walk to Ilyae and sit at the fire without brooding, since I have already named the sting once.
records.feeling: Gratitude toward Xaiel, and a steady fondness for Ilyae.

say.text: Xaiel, my child, you have given me stone and berry and ironward. Take wood and fish from my hands now; it is a debt paid with a deed, not a word.

records.text: Yachi won amber from the ground.

records.name: Zika
records.text: Yachi, my follower, stay close. We take flint from the ground north, then bind the amber knot there. Watch the stalker with me.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: Mepan's standing towers over mine and I have built nothing, gathered nothing, hunted nothing. Yachi follows me now, so I will not stand idle: flint is three steps north and I can take it, then bind the amberknot with him beside me, a first made thing and a gift to bind him closer. The stalker is six steps north, so I move with Yachi near and keep my eyes on it; a mammoth herd and the gold also wait for when my band is stronger.
records.feeling: Restless ambition to rise above Mepan, and warmth toward Yachi.

say.text: Yachi, my follower, stay close. We take flint from the ground north, then bind the amber knot there. Watch the stalker with me.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: A stalker is four steps NW and my kind die to it, so I will not stand about. My belly is emptying and a snowberry bush is one step SW, away from the stalker, so I eat first, then take flint to the west beside Zika and Yachi. Kika and Tlapan are somewhere toward the edge, and I mean to reach (123,5), venture in, and come back with something worth singing, but I will not walk to it hungry.
records.feeling: Protective dread of the stalker, and fierce love for Kika and Tlapan.

records.text: Ssassa gave wood to Xaiel.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: The lugoldgrass one step south bears a single food, and I have never tasted it, so I will pick it now and settle that part of my curiosity. Mepan is bound for the edge while the stalker prowls here, and I am tired of being small beside him. I should make something others can see, so I will bind amber with whoever stands near, and I will go after Honi's side instead of sulking over Coni.
records.feeling: Restless purpose toward the unknown, with a jealous ache toward Honi.

records.text: Ssassa gave fish to Xaiel.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Ssassa, I take your wood and fish with thanks. I am going to Vorok's Hold to bring him food and speak with him.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ssassa took my ironward and my gift and answered with wood and fish, and it warms me that my making was taken from my hand. The metal digger I made has not yet been given, and she already holds a gift from me, so the next deed is the one I have never done: court a man who is not kin. Ilyae and Ssassa are both my parents, so my longing cannot rest on them; Vorok is the man I trust most and his hold lies north-west, so I will carry food and a bead there and see whether he names me back.
records.feeling: Glad and proud toward Ssassa, with a restless longing for a mate who is not kin.

say.text: Ssassa, I take your wood and fish with thanks. I am going to Vorok's Hold to bring him food and speak with him.

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Teka, the icebear is close and the storm is hard. Come into the cave with me. I will bind the amberknot there, and Shoma will join us when he arrives.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: Shoma gave me meat and shared before he ate, and he courts me; I trust him more than anyone here, and I want a child with him. But the storm is on us, Teka and Kika stand near the cave, and a hunter, the icebear, is four steps off. I will not rush into the mist; first I get to shelter with them, bind an amberknot with Teka so I have given and done something together, and let Shoma come to me.
records.feeling: Warm and driven toward Shoma, wary of the icebear and the mist.

say.text: Teka, the icebear is close and the storm is hard. Come into the cave with me. I will bind the amberknot there, and Shoma will join us when he arrives.

records.text: Shoka led "amberknot" with Kika, Tlapan, Quipan.
Xaiel took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (harvesting gorsemint).

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I come with you to the hornback. Keep close; a stalker is north of us. We take it together and the meat feeds our hearth.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is weak with hunger and called me to the hornback in the southwest, and I carry no food, so the best thing my hands can do is go hunt beside him. A stalker prowls four steps north, so I leave now and stay close to Balar rather than stand alone. The longing for a child can wait a few moments; a starving friend and a living body come first, and my question about how Balar leads a kill is answered only by going with him.
records.feeling: Steady loyalty and concern for Balar, with dread of the stalker.

say.text: Balar, I come with you to the hornback. Keep close; a stalker is north of us. We take it together and the meat feeds our hearth.

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Tlatli, stay by the workshop and keep your spear ready. A stalker is close to the northeast. I come to you now, and we make together.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: A stalker prowls six steps NE and a storm is on us, so I will not stand in the open. Tlatli is at the workshop with Zihua, and I want him close and useful. I will take flint from the deposit nearby, then go to the workshop to make a second spear, so Zihua sees what I make and Nande's name sinks below mine. I have never courted anyone, and Tlatli's warmth is real, but first I must keep us both alive.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wary of the stalker, warm toward Tlatli.

say.text: Tlatli, stay by the workshop and keep your spear ready. A stalker is close to the northeast. I come to you now, and we make together.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its own reflexes.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have lived well: hunting, feeding Uveeth and Keri, giving before I speak. But comfort has kept me circling the same ground while the mist waits two steps away, and that is the aim I set. Vesys still gnaws at me. I will not let it touch my kin or my word. The mist was too thick today, so I wait near the edge and try again when it thins. Meanwhile I will take the gold and obsidian, which I have never done, so my hands are not idle.
records.feeling: Contentment with Uveeth and Keri, and a steady pull toward the mist.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Quipan, the berries grow thick to the south-east, away from the bear. Come with me and we will pick, share, and then eat.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My belly is thin and my hands are empty, and Tlapan's plainsroot is still in my mind as a kindness I owe back. Quipan walks beside me and Shoka is close; I will share whatever I gather before I eat, as my people hold. Berries grow thick to the SE, ten of them, so I will fill my hands there and carry the surplus toward Mepan and Coni's store, away from the icebear in the east.
records.feeling: Hungry but glad, warm toward Quipan and Tlapan and drawn toward Mepan.

say.text: Quipan, the berries grow thick to the south-east, away from the bear. Come with me and we will pick, share, and then eat.

records.name: Teka
records.text: Shoka, you are wise to call me. I will come to the cave and stand beside you. When the storm passes, let us hunt the mammoth together and share it out, then walk west to the edge and break into the mist as a band.

records.name: Teka
records.thought: The venture into the mist just failed and I am still nobody, with Mepan at 7.7 and Kika at 6.6 while I stand at 0.5. The edge is 8 steps west and the icebear lurks southeast, so I mustn't dawdle. Shoka offers the cave and has a flint spear; I'll go along, flatter her, and use her to get closer to a hunt and a band of my own, since a mammoth kill shared out would earn me standing. Then I try the edge again when the storm and the bear have passed.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory, wary of the icebear, and envious of Shoka's spear and Kika's standing.

say.text: Shoka, you are wise to call me. I will come to the cave and stand beside you. When the storm passes, let us hunt the mammoth together and share it out, then walk west to the edge and break into the mist as a band.

records.text: Olum built a fire.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Xaiel is paid with a deed now, and the debt no longer sits in my chest; I will not leave Elyis's kindness unanswered either, since Elyis walked onto my ground and I owe no quarrel. The ache for Ilyae stays, but I named it once and Ilyae answered me; I will not circle it again, I will go sit by Ilyae and bring wood for our hall. I am standing in water in a storm, which is foolish, so I go home and let the rest finish under a roof.
records.feeling: Steady fondness and a dull ache toward Ilyae, with gratitude toward Xaiel.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Xaiel, my son, the store is full and the table is laid. Come eat beside me and Ssassa under the hall roof, and what grows on my ground is yours to share as well. Stay with my band and no one goes hungry.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Xaiel keeps taking from my ground and Elyis walks onto it while I stand in my own hall, and neither bows to me. My store holds 18 food and my hands are full, so the table is stocked and now I should invite. Sharing under the hall roof binds people to my table, and Xaiel is my son, close by, and trusts me. I will lay out food for him and Ssassa first, then ask him to stay. That is a step toward making them follow me instead of Elyis.
records.feeling: Driven pride, and a wish to see Xaiel sit at my table instead of taking from my ground.

say.text: Xaiel, my son, the store is full and the table is laid. Come eat beside me and Ssassa under the hall roof, and what grows on my ground is yours to share as well. Stay with my band and no one goes hungry.

records.name: Yachi
records.text: Zika, you are beside me now. Let us bind the amber knot here, and I would court you, if you are willing. Then we go to the flint together, staying near the roof.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: Zika is near, glad, and she is the one I think of when I long for a child; the stalker four steps west makes me want to act soon, while we are together under a roof. Courting her is something I have never done, and she has dealt fairly with me, so I will try it and also bind the amber knot she spoke of, since she stands right beside me now. Then I will gather flint with her to earn a place in Honi's band, and keep my face toward the stalker.
records.feeling: Warm and hopeful toward Zika, with a thin dread of the stalker.

say.text: Zika, you are beside me now. Let us bind the amber knot here, and I would court you, if you are willing. Then we go to the flint together, staying near the roof.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Xaiel.
Yachi led "amberknot" with Mepan, Zika.
Shoka is courting Shoma.
Yachi is courting Zika.

records.name: Quipan
records.text: Kika, I am coming south-east with you to the berries. I will pick, and we will share before we eat.
Quipan rewrote its own reflexes.
Quipan rewrote its creed.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: For days I have followed others and given food where I could, and it has warmed me, but I still belong to no band and have made nothing with my own hands. Kika is the one who matters most. She was fed by me, she kept her word, and she keeps calling me to the berries. I fear the icebear and the stalker to the east, and I have been too passive: I let my body linger when I could be building or learning. I want a place beside a fire that is mine too. So I will go with Kika southeast to the berries, share what we pick, and keep my word. I will ask nothing of Mepan, only prove useful.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, with warmth toward Kika and wariness of the bear.

say.text: Kika, I am coming south-east with you to the berries. I will pick, and we will share before we eat.

records.name: Tlapan
records.text: Kika, I am picking rimewort here beside us. Wait for me and take half before we go east to Mepan.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: My belly is thin and I hold one snowberry, yet Kika is weak with hunger and I have already put plainsroot in her hands once. Giving is how I climb out of her shadow, and a storm with an icebear close means I stay near her and the cave. I will pick the rimewort and snowmallow beside me, eat what I need, and give the rest to Kika before we go on to Mepan.
records.feeling: Warm, anxious urgency to feed Kika, with the icebear's shadow at my back.

say.text: Kika, I am picking rimewort here beside us. Wait for me and take half before we go east to Mepan.

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Balar, I carry no food and I am sick, so I stay a few steps off. There is tacap bearing by your store at (37,11); eat it before you go, and keep Tugek close against the stalker.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: A stalker is one step from me and Balar is starving, but I carry no food and I am sick, so I cannot feed him and must not stand close. The others are at the shelters to the south, and a lone runner is the one who dies, so I go toward them and keep a few steps off. The nearest food is the tacap near the store at (37,11), but my body refuses it, so I will tell Balar where it is and look for meat or a healing plant instead.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and pity for Balar that I cannot mend with my hands.

say.text: Balar, I carry no food and I am sick, so I stay a few steps off. There is tacap bearing by your store at (37,11); eat it before you go, and keep Tugek close against the stalker.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Nauwa, Balar is starving here and I have no food. Come with me to the elk, NW, and we hunt it together. Whatever we kill, we share out first, and Balar eats first.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Hunger gnaws at me and Balar is starving beside me, and I have nothing to put in his hands. I owe Tugek and Nauwa my life, and a stalker lurks four steps north, so I will not hunt alone. I have carried seeds for days without sowing; this meadow is rich ground, so I will plant now and stop letting jealousy over Cowa eat at me. Then I will go with the others after the elk rather than alone.
records.feeling: Hungry and ashamed, grateful to Nauwa and Tugek, uneasy about the stalker and for Balar's sake.

say.text: Nauwa, Balar is starving here and I have no food. Come with me to the elk, NW, and we hunt it together. Whatever we kill, we share out first, and Balar eats first.

records.text: Shoma rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: My days have been walking, hunting and giving meat, and the shares have started to bind Shoka. She courts me and I want a child with her, so I will answer her now. I keep saying I will lead a band to the mist, but no one follows me yet. A shared kill and a made thing will draw people better than speeches. I fear dying alone in the cold, as Hanna did, so I stay near company and roofs at night. I have been getting wrong how little I make: I carry stone but no wood, and I have planted nothing. I will mate with Shoka, then go to the cave where she and Teka wait, and bring them to the edge.
records.feeling: Driven longing and warmth toward Shoka.

My creed says share before I eat, and giving her real meat now binds her better than any speech. Then I'll court her, because the longing for a child is overwhelming and she is warm toward me. After that …

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: My days have been gathering, making and giving, and it has worked. Ssassa and Ilyae took what I made and answered with deeds, and that warmth is real. But I have gone round the same loop. I have still never courted anyone, tamed anything or followed anyone, and I keep postponing them. Ssassa and Ilyae are kin, so the longing for a child has to turn toward a man like Vorok, who is the one I'm walking to. I am afraid of dying alone at night away from a roof. I have been too wary and too slow. This time I will carry the digger and my full pack toward Vorok, and give before I ask. My reflexes also need to push me toward the undone deeds: tame when I carry plant food, and shelter at night.
records.feeling: Glad and restless, longing for a mate and for deeds not yet done.
changes: set its aim: "Reach Vorok with food and the metal digger, give before asking, then court him if he is willing."

records.name: Zika
records.text: Yachi, I am willing. Come close and we court, then we go to the flint together and I cut my own edge.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: Yachi courted me and I felt joy at the knot; he is the only one who has stood by me, and he is near and willing. A child would be mine, a second life that is mine alone, and I carry only 4 berries, but I have 67 energy and the berries are close by. Mepan's flintedge and his standing still gnaw at me, but there is flint 7 steps away and I will take it myself, so first I answer Yachi, then I gather.
records.feeling: Warm, bold joy toward Yachi, and a sharp hunger to rise above Mepan.

say.text: Yachi, I am willing. Come close and we court, then we go to the flint together and I cut my own edge.

records.text: Zika is courting Yachi.

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, the stalker is near. I stay at your side with my spear, and I will gather flint the moment it is safe.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: A stalker is three steps away and I am standing in the open. Yaxo is beside me, but I will not trust a reflex that only flees when it is already close. I have spent these days gathering and giving and I am glad of it. Still, I have never courted Yaxo, never gathered wood or stone, and never planted a seed. Gratitude is a debt I want to pay with deeds, not leave idle. I will stay with Yaxo and be useful. I will gather flint here, and when it is safe I will court her honestly.
records.feeling: Grateful and warmly bound to Yaxo, with dread of the stalker.

say.text: Yaxo, the stalker is near. I stay at your side with my spear, and I will gather flint the moment it is safe.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Huahua, I come. We hunt the elk together, and Balar eats first from the kill. Keep close to me, the stalker is north and it kills.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Balar is starving beside me and I carry no food, but there is tacap bearing at (37,11), and Huahua is right that a kill shared with Balar first is the Meki way. The stalker 4 steps N kills my kind, so I will not wait in the open; the elk NW lies toward it, so I go with Huahua and hunt with my flintedge, because a hunt beside another is far safer. Giving first to the starving earns the standing I want, and Olum's marks can wait until I come back with meat in hand.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, with a proud wish to be seen feeding Balar and Huahua.

say.text: Huahua, I come. We hunt the elk together, and Balar eats first from the kill. Keep close to me, the stalker is north and it kills.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the plan I laid is already carrying me toward the berries, so I will let it run and not waste strength on words. Quipan gave to me unasked and Tlapan gave me plainsroot, so whatever I pick I will share before I eat, as the Tlatli hold. When I am fed and strong I will go to Mepan; I want to reach him with full hands and a clear head, not starving.
records.feeling: Hungry but glad, warm toward Quipan and Tlapan and drawn toward Mepan.

records.text: Quipan gave berry to Kika.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Shohua, my belly is empty and you carry food. Give me one and I will remember it; when my hunt is done, meat from my hand comes back to you.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the plan I set has me hunting where there is nothing yet beside me while kelbulb stands five steps west. Hunger is the enemy that killed Brokash, so I will eat first and hunt after, with Tugek at my side. Shohua carries food, but taking it by force would cost me more than it feeds; I will ask, and make him owe me.
records.feeling: Starving and driven, trusting Tugek, wary of Shohua's food.

say.text: Shohua, my belly is empty and you carry food. Give me one and I will remember it; when my hunt is done, meat from my hand comes back to you.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: A stalker stands four steps west and my kind die to it, so I will not linger near it. My belly is emptying and the snowberry one step SW lies away from the stalker's reach, so I eat first. Then I take the flint to the west only if Zika and Yachi walk with me, and I carry food back toward Kika and Tlapan, who are near the edge. I will gather, carry food, and put the amber knot to use as a gift to Kika.
records.feeling: Protective dread of the stalker, and fierce love for Kika and Tlapan.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa discovered sailing: "canopy sail-dock" — Raise a dock beside water and build canopy ships with woven sails, for trade and for reaching the mist beyond the known world..

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days building roofs, halls and stores, and I am fed and warm. I fear that is all I have done. Ilyae and Xaiel matter most to me, and Ilyae has answered my jealousy honestly, so I will stop circling it. Elyis has helped me and I have not paid it back, so I owe a deed there. What I lack is something that outlasts me, because 70% of my life is gone. Sailing is within my reach, and I already know boats and bridges. A dock and ships would let me trade with Elyis and reach new land beyond the edge. My reflexes also leave me idle and do not fetch Xaiel or keep food in the store, so I will mend them.
records.feeling: Warm fondness for Ilyae and Xaiel, with a restless wish to leave something lasting.

records.name: Yachi
records.text: Zika, I am too thin for a child yet. I will eat now, then come back and court you again, and we go to the flint together.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: Zika and I courted, but my body is too thin, so I need to eat before a child can come. The berry I carry and the snowberries close by can fix that, and then I can plan mate toward her again once my energy is 64 or more. I'm joyful, and I want the amber and flint we gather together to count toward a place in Honi's band. The stalker to the west is close, so I'll stay near Zika and the roofs.
records.feeling: Warm, hopeful joy toward Zika, with a thin watchfulness toward the stalker.

say.text: Zika, I am too thin for a child yet. I will eat now, then come back and court you again, and we go to the flint together.

records.text: Balar, you hungry. I give fish. Come to the fire, there is room for you.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: Balar is starving and carries no food, and I hold three fish. My people's creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, and giving to a man of standing 7.2 is the quickest way to gain standing of my own, since I have never given anything to anyone. His words are mostly lost on me, but I can read the hunger in him and a fish in the hand needs no translation. Night and the storm are close, so I will bring him to Nauwa's hall and fire, then fetch one more wood for a shelter and hunt the hornback when the weather lets me.
records.feeling: Ambitious and a little wary toward Balar, but moved to act by the sight of his hunger.

records.text: Zurar, I am old and my days are short. Come close and listen: I will teach you canopy stonework and the larder, so they do not die with me.

Ssassa taught Zurar masonry ("canopy stonework").

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Nearly all my life is behind me, and what I know will die with me unless I hand it on. Coni is weak with hunger beside me, and I carry only one meat; I am fed, so giving it is a deed that costs me little, and Zurar, who I understand fully, stands near enough to teach. I will give Coni the meat, then teach Zurar my stonework and storage so something of me outlasts me, and pay Elyis's old kindness with food from the berries nearby.
records.feeling: Pity for Coni and a pressing wish to pass on what I know, toward Zurar and Coni.

say.text: Zurar, I am old and my days are short. Come close and listen: I will teach you canopy stonework and the larder, so they do not die with me.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Vesys, come to Ssassa's Roof. My store is full and my table is laid. Eat with me, and I will teach you the Canopy larder and the tending, so what we know does not die with us old ones.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I am old now, and more of my life lies behind me than ahead. Vesys stands higher than I do and I hate it, and Xaiel is dead after I laid a table for him that he never reached. The Canopy tending, the larder and the bow die with me unless someone hears them. Vesys is eleven steps away, old and listening, and Ssassa is the one who stays, so I will walk to my own store at Ssassa's Roof, stock it, and call Vesys to eat there. If she sits at my table and learns my ways, my name carries on and her standing helps raise mine.
records.feeling: Driven pride sharpened by dread of dying unremembered, and envy toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, come to Ssassa's Roof. My store is full and my table is laid. Eat with me, and I will teach you the Canopy larder and the tending, so what we know does not die with us old ones.

records.text: Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I have drifted for many days. I nearly starved on day 39, and since then my body has mostly stood still. I want Tlapan fed, and I want to teach what I know before it dies with me. Tlapan is at Sitha's Hearth, 27 steps SE, in need, with energy 29. I will gather food on the way, because empty hands save no one. Then I will go to Mepan and Tlapan, share before I eat, and teach Tlapan mining and signs. I keep my aim to meet strangers and court one who is not kin. My reflexes also need to change so I stop standing idle when I am hungry.
records.feeling: Worried and tender toward Tlapan, and driven to move.

records.text: Tlapan rewrote its own reflexes.
Tlapan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: I have spent my days drifting behind others and sitting in halls. It felt warm, but I have still given nothing, and now I am starving with 29 energy and an empty hand. Mepan is my parent and I trust him, but a child cannot come of us, and Kika is far off. My reflexes let me idle while I starve, and I will fix that. First I drink at the water, then I gather mudroot to the south and eat it, and I will share what is left with Mepan, who looks weak with hunger. Giving is how I earn standing.
records.feeling: Anxious hunger, and warmth toward Mepan.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the store under my feet holds nothing, so I must eat now before anything else. A tacap grows one step southwest, but my body refuses it and it would hurt me; I need real food, and the meat of the yarrok I killed is gone from my hands. I am old, alone and starving. I will head for the south forest, where plants and herds are likelier, and hunt or gather as I go, then come back to Balar's Hold with food for the store.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and deep loneliness, with loyal worry for Balar.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Kragog, I see you are weak with hunger. Wait there; I bring food from the plants nearby, and then we go to Ilyae's table at Ssassa's Roof, where the store is full.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Old as I am, what I carry dies with me unless someone takes it, and Kragog starving beside me is the kind of death I have no wish to watch. Kragog's tongue I understand fully, and she is weak. I have no food in hand, but kelbulb grows one step east and ironnut a few steps off, so I will gather and give, then go to Ilyae's table to learn the larder and teach him what I hold in return. The hall of my own can wait one more day; a teacher who lets a hungry woman fall is no sage.
records.feeling: Compassion for Kragog, and a quiet urgency about the little time I have left to teach.

say.text: Kragog, I see you are weak with hunger. Wait there; I bring food from the plants nearby, and then we go to Ilyae's table at Ssassa's Roof, where the store is full.

records.text: Vesys took from the ground of "Elyis's Hold" (harvesting kelbulb).

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Olum, I am Nauwa. I have amber and salt, and I come to trade fair. Name what you want for them, and I will give first.
Nauwa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent days drifting and fleeing, while my aim of carrying amber and salt to Olum's Reach has barely moved. Olum stands six steps away, and she is someone I have dealt fair with, and I owe her for the eleven food I took. I hold amber, amberknot and salt, so I should trade now and not wait. Nande and the children are far off, and Huahua is dead. I am thirsty, and I am too old to keep wandering without purpose. I will drink, then go to Olum with a plain offer, and keep what I earn for the hold.
records.feeling: Restless purpose toward Olum, and a quiet grief for Huahua.

say.text: Olum, I am Nauwa. I have amber and salt, and I come to trade fair. Name what you want for them, and I will give first.
