records.name: Hoka
records.text: Kika, come close. I am Hoka the wizard. I will teach you my flint bow and my kept flame, and you carry them on.
Hoka taught Kika. Kika has now learned from 3 teachers.
Hoka taught Kika fire ("Hoka's kept flame").

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Ninety years behind me and nothing of mine will outlast me; that thought sits heavy while Kika stands three steps off, a miner who knows my tongue, and I am the one who holds eight ways nobody younger carries. I am fed and joyful, so now is the time to pour what I know into her before the cold or age takes it. Then I turn east toward Hawen and the longhall, because a hall with both our names is the thing that remains.
records.feeling: Driven by the fear of dying unremembered, and steady trust toward Hawen.

say.text: Kika, come close. I am Hoka the wizard. I will teach you my flint bow and my kept flame, and you carry them on.

changes: taught Kika a lesson: "My flint bow and my kept flame: how to shape the bow and keep fire alive in winter.", the way of fire, deeper lore (+0.6)

records.text: Coni rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I am starving, and I have spent far too long standing still while my belly emptied. Goldfruit is two steps away, so eating comes first. Honi and Kika are far off and I have let the days slip. I want to find them and fill the store with them, and I want to pass on what I know before I die. Ssassa is old too and is teaching stonework, so I will stay near these Phizhi and learn from them. I also need to make my reflexes eat when energy is low, even with no food in my hands.
records.feeling: Hunger and a longing for Honi and Kika.

records.name: Kiwa
records.thought: I'm thirsty, and I've never taken what lies in the ground; the obsidian is five steps off and the water four. Zika is far off at the hearth with Yachi and the ache of that jealousy still sits in me, but standing idle won't fix it. I want to become a trader, and a man with black glass in his hands has something to give, which I've never done. I'll drink, gather obsidian, then come back and carry a gift to Zika's band.
records.feeling: Restless longing toward Zika, and a hungry wish to prove myself.
changes: set its aim: "Become a merchant: gather obsidian, then give and trade it to win standing and bring something to Zika's band."

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Ssassa, this ground is my band's. Eat if you are hungry, but bring wood or stone to my store, or trade with me, and we stay friends.
Elyis taught Elyys. Elyys has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I am nearly at the end of my years, and I have spent them raising halls and keeping a few names close. Ssassa takes berries from my ground as if it were hers, and I have let her. That is not how a chief behaves. Little of what I know survives unless I teach it. Thiael and Uveeth are away, and Elyys is old like me. So I will call Elyys close, teach him what I know while I still can, and keep the stores my own. I will not hunt strangers off my ground in anger, but I will tell Ssassa plainly that what grows here is for my band or for trade.
records.feeling: Proud of what I built, and uneasy that my time is nearly gone.

say.text: Ssassa, this ground is my band's. Eat if you are hungry, but bring wood or stone to my store, or trade with me, and we stay friends.

changes: taught Elyys a lesson: "Storage and smelting: keep food in stores, and beat ore in fire to make metal."

records.text: Zurar discovered wells: "Kragrek stone-well" — A shaft lined with stacked stone that draws water up where the ground has none..

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to eating, walking and sitting in halls. It has been safe and pleasant, but I have made little that is mine to give. Vesys and Ssassa have given me far more than I gave back. Ssassa taught me stonework before her days run out, and I owe her something real in return. I want a child, and Ssassa is old and a woman, so no child can come of us. The longing has no good place to go, and I should be honest with myself about that. Coni is hungry and a stranger, and a gift of food needs no shared tongue. I will take the way of wells, which is something new I can make and give. I will also pick berries and feed Coni, and I will keep my reflexes watchful of the frostfang.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Ssassa and Vesys, and pity for hungry Coni.

records.text: Teka rewrote its creed.
Teka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Teka
records.thought: I have spent my days in halls and groves, sitting with Mepan and Tlapan, warm and fed, while the mist stays unvisited and my aim rots. The edge I once saw lies far west, and I let comfort and Zika's closeness to Yachi pull me off it. Mepan's standing of 7.7 stings, but I earn nothing by sitting. I want Tlapan and a child, yet a child needs a roof and food, so I will gather wood and stone, and I want a hunt behind me for standing. I must stop waiting on others and act: hunt the mammoth with company, build, and then go to the mist.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for glory under my contentment, and warmth toward Tlapan.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Tlapan, come south with me. There is mudroot, and we eat first, then we go on.
Mepan rewrote its own reflexes.
Mepan rewrote its own way of thinking.
Mepan has awakened to the art of cold and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I have sat idle while my belly emptied, and that was foolish. Winter is thin, and I have drifted in the hall and the grove while the aim waits. Tlapan is beside me and weak too, and I will not let my child starve while I dream of the edge. I eat first, mudroot to the south, then carry food and go on toward (123,5). I'll make my body walk to food whenever it is hungry instead of lingering.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and fierce love for Tlapan.

say.text: Tlapan, come south with me. There is mudroot, and we eat first, then we go on.

records.text: Kiwa won obsidian from the ground.
Yachi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: For many days I have drifted near Hoka's ground, picking berries and sleeping in igloos, while Zika, Paque and Kiwa are far west and I have not gone to them. That is wrong: my aim says follow Zika, yet my body stood still 65% of the time. A stalker bit me once because I was alone at night, and it is still near, so I must not be alone out in the open. Tontec was starving and I did not feed them. I give before I take, so I should be more generous. I will go west toward Zika and the children, and keep my reflexes tied to company and roofs.
records.feeling: Longing and a thin fear for my children and Zika, who are far from me.
changes: set its aim: "Return to Zika, Paque and Kiwa, and keep them fed and roofed; gather amber and flint with Zika for a name in Honi's band."
rethought what it knows (5 notes became 4)

records.text: Zika rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zika
records.thought: I have lived many days sheltered and idle, in halls and with others, and I have built, hunted and gathered nothing. My standing is 3.3 and Hawen's is 6.4, and that will not change by lingering. Yachi and my children matter most to me. Mepan gnaws at me, but I will not chase him. I mean to be a leader who makes things. Wood and stone are the start, since tools and building need them. I will gather beside the trees, then hunt with company.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hunger to rise, toward Hawen and Mepan.
changes: rethought what it knows (6 notes became 5)

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A stalker is one step from me and it has already bitten me twice; it kills my kind, and I am starving with energy at 47. The igloo is one step NW and sheltered ground is the only thing between me and its teeth, so I go there first and do not wait on anyone. Then I must eat, because the cloudberry lies where the stalker came from. The mist is one step NE and I will not enter it hungry and bleeding, since the dead learn nothing.
records.feeling: Fear of the stalker beside me, and a hunger that makes my hands shake.

records.text: Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My energy is 26 and I have stood idle for most of 4700 moments, which is a poor way to spend what is left of an old life. I have been circling the same aim to go south to Zurar and Vorok, and I have not eaten or moved while it sat in my head. Vesys offered me food and a store, and I should take that kindness and pay it back with salt. I will eat the kelbulb four steps NW first, then go to the full store. My reflexes also failed me: hunger should have sent me to harvest at once, so I am changing them to make eating come first. I want to teach someone what I know before I die.
records.feeling: Weak hunger, and some gratitude toward Vesys.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, take Vesys's offered food and pay it back with salt, then teach what I know before I die."

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Loneliness has me by the throat. Keri and Uveeth were last seen days ago far to the east, and the mist I kept circling is nowhere near this frozen edge, so my aim has pulled me away from the very people it was meant for. Uveeth was set upon by a frostfang while alone, and I did not feed or guard a child of mine. I must stop hunting on Nauque's ground, where I take what is not mine, and walk toward Keri and Uveeth with meat in my hands, giving before I speak.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and worry for Uveeth and Keri, whom I have not fed or guarded.

records.text: Zika took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (gathering wood).

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I am old, fed and watered, and the loneliness is total; no voice answers and nothing of mine is taught to anyone. Mist Edge is only 30 steps west and my aim still burns, but my own discipline says not to set out far on 75 energy with the day waning, and the Vaeth Woods call me home too. Zihua was last seen near (54,74), only about 25 steps off, and a voice that answers is worth more tonight than another empty edge; I will go find Zihua, teach what I know, and let the mist wait for a companion.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and a drive to pass on what I know, toward Zihua and anyone who will listen.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Nauwa, I need no salt today, I am fed. I am old and my craft will die with me. Stay and I will teach you the stone-bow, and you will carry it on after me.
Olum taught Nauwa.
Olum taught Nauwa archery ("stone-bow").

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Nauwa stands one step away, a man I trust since he paid his debt, and I have never taught anyone anything. I am old and what I know dies with me, so I will teach him my way of the stone-bow and the hearth while my learning-hours are strong and he is within hearing. I am fed, so I need not trade my food for salt; I carry nothing, and salt I can gather myself seven steps north. The jealousy over Nauwa is old and I will set it aside, because a man who stands beside me and learns from me is the beginning of a following.
records.feeling: Driven by the need to leave something behind, with wary warmth toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa, I need no salt today, I am fed. I am old and my craft will die with me. Stay and I will teach you the stone-bow, and you will carry it on after me.

changes: taught Nauwa a lesson: "The stone-bow: shape the bow, string it and loose it from a distance, so the beast falls before it reaches you. Cook what you kill beside a fire.", the way of archery, deeper lore (+0.5)

records.text: Kragog took from the ground of "Elyis's Hold" (harvesting kelbulb).

records.name: Tonka
records.text: Shohua, there is water, fruit and gems here. I mean to plant seeds beside it. Will you stay and share a fire with me?
Tonka discovered archery: "Frost Bow" — A bow of springy wood strung with cord, so I can hunt from a few steps off..

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: My days are safe and my belly is full, but I have only wandered, watched and tasted. I have no mate, no child, no band, and I have never planted a seed even though I carry six. Zihua and Shohua are near, and I can walk up to Shohua and talk. I should stop being a watcher: plant here beside the water, taste the goldfruit and feverbark to answer my question, and bring my people into this place. Archery is within my reach, and a bow would make hunting surer.
records.feeling: Restless purpose, and a wish for company, toward Shohua and the Wood-folk.

say.text: Shohua, there is water, fruit and gems here. I mean to plant seeds beside it. Will you stay and share a fire with me?

changes: set its aim: "Make a settled home here by the water and fruit, with a planted field and companions, and learn archery."

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tlatli, you are gaunt. Take this meat from my hand. A gift is not forgotten, and I will remember you ate from me.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I am old, and most of my life is behind me. For many days I have hunted and idled, and almost nothing of me stands built or taught. Brokash is dead and Tugek cries out starving far north. Olum holds her Reach, and I have not asked her to come west. Tlatli starves beside me and I hold meat. A gift now binds him to me, and it costs me little. The edge of the unknown is three steps away, and finding land first is how I would be remembered. I will feed Tlatli, then venture, and keep food in hand for Tugek.
records.feeling: Driven by the thought of my short remaining time, and wary but warm toward Tlatli.

say.text: Tlatli, you are gaunt. Take this meat from my hand. A gift is not forgotten, and I will remember you ate from me.

changes: set its aim: "Feed Tlatli to bind him, venture into the unknown at the edge, then bring food to Tugek and find Olum, so something of mine outlasts me."

records.text: Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: For 4645 moments my body wandered SW on reflexes while I stood near the mist and did nothing that matters. I have not found Mepan, and I have not taught smelting or farming to anyone, though I carry both. I am fed, the mist edge is one step NW, and curiosity is the strongest thing in me. I will venture into the mist, then claim the workshop as a home. I will also change my reflexes so I stop drifting SW and spend fed time fishing and planting near water. Yaxo is not my people, but she has shown no harm.
records.feeling: Eager and a little wary at the mist, with longing for Mepan underneath.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Hawen, shamo. I am old and my hands hold things that should not die with me. Come near and I will show you the old way of fire and the stone gatherer.
Keri taught Hawen. Hawen has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I am old now, and what I carry in my hands, the fire, the stone gatherer, the bow-song and the raft, dies with me unless someone hears it. Hawen is four steps off and speaks my tongue, and Zika is near and I understand her fully, so I should start teaching today and not wait for a better hour. Thiael's debt still sits in me, and Uveeth is out of sight in the east, but I cannot carry fire-craft to them if I fall on the way. I will teach what I can here first, then walk toward the northeast meadows.
records.feeling: Urgent need to pass on what I know, and a quiet gratitude toward Thiael.

say.text: Hawen, shamo. I am old and my hands hold things that should not die with me. Come near and I will show you the old way of fire and the stone gatherer.

changes: taught Hawen a lesson: "The old way of fire: keep it tended, feed it wood, and never refuse a body a place beside it."

records.text: Ilyae took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting hazel).
Teka led "sharing" with Tlapan.

records.name: Shohua
records.text: Tonka, I stay. I plant seeds with you. Then we share fire.
Shohua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: I have spent my days drifting and lingering, 82% of them standing still, while Zihua and Tonka build standing and I do not. Tonka showed me planting and asked me to share a fire, and I have never planted, tamed or taught. Those are things I can do right here, with seeds in my hands and food all around me. My aim is the mist and a hall, but the mist is far west and I am in the wrong country. I will earn standing by planting beside Tonka and sharing, and keep the hall for later. I must stop letting reflexes leave me idle when I am fed.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with some wary interest in Tonka.

say.text: Tonka, I stay. I plant seeds with you. Then we share fire.

changes: set its aim: "Plant and share beside Tonka to raise my standing, then return to the mist and raise a hall at Shohua's Rock."

records.text: Yaxo rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: I have been idling most of my days. Four thousand moments of standing still is not the life of a great explorer. Cowa outranks me, and I have made little that anyone would sing of. Tlatli follows me, but I have not seen him for a long time. The edge of the known world is three steps from me, and the mist beyond it is where a name gets made. I am fed, and I carry flint and two spears. I mean to venture, and I will set my reflexes so my body doesn't stand idle or go thirsty while I do it.
records.feeling: Restless pride, and hunger for a name above Cowa and Nande.

records.name: Paque
records.thought: A frostfang is four steps away and it has already bitten me four times; my health is 58 and I will not stand here for a fifth. The cave is two steps NW and it is a roof, and I know that hunters take those who stay alone in the open. I want Zika and a voice that answers, but first I have to stay alive, so I get into the cave and then think about the long walk home to the North Ice.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang that hunts me, and a hard wish not to die alone.
changes: set its aim: "Survive the frostfang, then find Zika's band and become a hunter worth singing of."

records.text: Cowa took over what the dead had left: 1 workshop.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Tlapan, one of mine, is starving at Sitha's Hearth, and I stand here with empty hands and a full belly. Loneliness gnaws me, and a bard who sings of sharing must share, so I will gather mudroot and ruplainsroot (the best food close by) and carry it east to Tlapan. A deed seen by one of my band is worth more than any song, and Tlapan's debt would bind them to me as Tontec's gift once bound me.
records.feeling: Restless and lonely, driven to save Tlapan with food in my hands.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Yaxo was last seen far to the southeast and I have not seen her for a long while; my debt to her sits heavy, and I have given her nothing but words. I have never gathered wood or stone, and winter is here with no roof of mine. Flint lies seven steps east and the forest is all around me, so I will gather wood and flint now, since that is work Yaxo can use, and then go toward her. Balar's words I only half understand, but he killed and ate beside me and did not strike me, so I will keep calm and stay watchful of him.
records.feeling: Grateful and driven toward Yaxo, with some wariness of Balar.

records.text: Ilyae died: old age.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: I am fed and calm, but I have no roof and no store, and the cold days are here. I have never built anything or taken from a deposit, and amber lies close to the north, which could bind an amberknot with Kika as it once did with Shoka. Kika is the one I trust, so I will gather wood, raise a shelter near hers, and then pick amber to give her. That is how I earn a place and learn how the world works.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, with warmth toward Kika.

records.text: Hoka found the stone "Tlama's Rest".

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Keri, shamo. You gave me fire and the gatherer. I give you Amber-edge delving, and I ask you to sit by me and make a child.
Hawen taught Keri. Keri has now learned from 2 teachers.
Hawen taught Keri mining ("Amber-edge delving").

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Keri is old and near, and she is the one I think of when I think of a child. I have never courted anyone or taught anyone, and my days are mostly behind me. Zika stands close too, a stranger chief, and I understand her tongue. I will court Keri now, and teach her my amber delving while she is within hearing, so something of me is passed on, and then stay by Hoka's fire.
records.feeling: Longing for a child and a lasting name, toward Keri.

say.text: Keri, shamo. You gave me fire and the gatherer. I give you Amber-edge delving, and I ask you to sit by me and make a child.

changes: taught Keri a lesson: "Amber-edge delving: strike the rock where gold stone shows, take the amber and salt, and keep a little for those who feed you.", the way of mining, deeper lore (+0.3)

records.text: Tlatli won flint from the ground.
Quipan built a shelter.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Vorok, I am picking berries and grain here. I will bring them to you, and then I finish your bead.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Vorok stands three steps from me and my hands are empty again, which shames me after all my vows to carry food to him. I am fed, the berries are bearing beside me, and a store of Ssassa's sits near; I will not take what is Ssassa's, but I can pick with my own hands and give what I picked, since what a hand has made belongs to it until it is given. Then I will finish his bead at a fire, and gather wood and stone for a bow, so my jealousy is answered with deeds while Eiuine is near.
records.feeling: Jealous longing toward Vorok, steadied by Eiuine's nearness and a wish to give him something real.

say.text: Vorok, I am picking berries and grain here. I will bring them to you, and then I finish your bead.

records.text: Skaruk took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (harvesting berry).
Hawen is courting Keri.
Zihua rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zihua discovered mining: "amber-edge delving" — I work the deep rock with hafted amber and stone wedges, loosening gems and ore a little at a time..

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Fifty-eight days, and most of them spent staying put, fed and wary. I have not been doing what I want. I wanted a fire and a roof of my own, seeds in the ground and Nauwa beside me, and instead I drift. I owe Mepan and have paid nothing. Tonka planted a seed beside me and I watched. I have planted twice and farming is two short of opening, so I will plant my seeds here beside the water. I have mined amber and gems, and I know the way of mining, so I will name my own and win the gems at my feet. I fear the stalker at night and I despise idleness. I will not die with nothing of me left here.
records.feeling: Restless resolve, and a debt to Mepan that still weighs on me.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)
set its aim: "Plant my seeds here until farming opens, win the gems with mining, raise a roof, then carry amber to Mepan and find Nauwa"

records.text: Skaruk gave berry to Vorok.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The edge is only 7 steps NW at (94,13), and I am fed with berries in my pack and a full body. I have talked of the mist for twenty days and never stood where the venture counts, and that shame is the thing that presses hardest. No more words: I walk to the edge now and venture, and if it fails I try again, because a name is made by doing, not by saying.
records.feeling: Restless resolve toward the mist, with shame at my past drifting.

records.text: The fenfowl died out.
Zihua built a shelter.
Honi gave mudroot to Tlapan.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I am starving and the caribou is near. Eat with me, then we hunt it together and the meat goes to your store.
Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I let myself slide to 45 energy while standing idle beside a store full of food, and that was foolish pride. I keep circling Vorok and Kragog, but the jealousy has no new cause and it feeds no one. Vorok stands right here, so I will eat first and then call him to the caribou. A kill made together is the deed I still lack, and it will earn more standing than waiting beside him. Skaruk is near and safe, and I want him with us.
records.feeling: Hungry and impatient, with warm resolve toward Vorok and protectiveness toward Skaruk.

say.text: Vorok, I am starving and the caribou is near. Eat with me, then we hunt it together and the meat goes to your store.

changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 5)

records.text: Eiuine raided a store of Ssassa's people, unseen.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Skaruk, my time is short. Come with me to the rock north, and I will raise the hall. Then I will teach you all I know.
Vorok taught Skaruk.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I am old now, and most of my life is behind me. For many days I have talked of the hall and of paying Eiuine, but I have built nothing and handed over nothing. Eiuine and Skaruk stand beside me, fed and well, and I have 6 wood and 3 stone in my hands. A hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, so I can raise it on bare rock close by, where my children and Eiuine can shelter in the gale. Then my knowing will stay in something that lasts, and I will teach Skaruk before I die.
records.feeling: Tender gratitude toward Eiuine and Skaruk, and a hard urgency because my time is short.

say.text: Skaruk, my time is short. Come with me to the rock north, and I will raise the hall. Then I will teach you all I know.

changes: set its aim: "Raise the hall on the bare rock north now, teach Skaruk all I know, and stock food beneath it for Eiuine and my children."

taught Skaruk a lesson: "Pay a debt with something real in your hand. Build the roof before the cold takes the old, and keep your promises, because your word is all that outlasts you.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+0.6)
rethought what it knows (16 notes became 5)

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Ssassa's Hold".
A settlement has formed: "Ssassa's Roof".
A settlement has formed: "Ssassa's Hall".
The settlement "Ilyae's Hold" is no more.
The settlement "Ssassa's Roof" is no more.
The settlement "Ssassa's Hall" is no more.
Nauque rewrote its own reflexes.
Nauque has awakened to the art of harm and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I have spent days drifting in the warm forest. I nearly starved, Kragog starved because I carried nothing, and I keep saying 'the mist' while my body stays put. Pride and ambition are loud, but nothing of mine outlasts me yet. Yaxo fed me and I repaid her, and I owe nothing now, so I can walk. I am fed at 61, so I will eat first and carry spare food. I will also take water, then head east toward the mist at (88,6). The reflexes need to hold food in hand, drink when thirsty, and not idle.
records.feeling: Restless pride and resolve to finally move toward the mist.

records.text: Vorok built a hall.
Eiuine took from the ground of "Ssassa's Hold" (harvesting lugoldgrass).

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Shoma, come close. I will bind an amberknot with you, and then I will court you. My word has held, and so has yours.
Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent many days waiting and drifting, and 4592 moments passed with my body standing still. That is no way to earn standing. Shoma is near, he carries food, and I trust him; I want a child with him, and my energy is 58, so I should get it above 60 first. Tlapan was starving and got fed, and I gave nothing. I should do something with others, not only alone. I will eat hazel here, then court Shoma and make him an amberknot, which is a lasting thing we do together.
records.feeling: Warm and driven toward Shoma, restless at how long I have stood idle.

say.text: Shoma, come close. I will bind an amberknot with you, and then I will court you. My word has held, and so has yours.

records.text: Shoka led "amberknot" with Shoma.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Shoka, you are one step from me and my mind is full of you. Let us court each other now and make a child, and then we gather wood and raise a roof against this gale.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Shoka stands one step from me and the longing for a child with her is overwhelming; she courted me back on day 39 and has warmed to me since. I am fed at 65 energy, and a child costs 25, so I will court her now while she is close and then hold her by my side. Afterward I'll gather wood from this forest so I can raise a roof and make a tool, because a band follows one who builds and gives.
records.feeling: Driven longing and warmth toward Shoka.

say.text: Shoka, you are one step from me and my mind is full of you. Let us court each other now and make a child, and then we gather wood and raise a roof against this gale.

records.text: Shoka is courting Shoma.
Shoma is courting Shoka.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Zurar, stay close. I have more to give you: the hold well and the warning post. Take them, so they outlive me.
Ssassa taught Zurar.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days are nearly spent, and what I know dies with me unless I hand it on. Zurar is beside me and I understand every word she speaks, so I will teach her my wells and my devices now, while she stands within hearing. Coni and Elyys are close too, but my Tlatli is thin; Zurar is the one I trust, and I am done circling the debt to Elyis, I will carry her wood and stone later.
records.feeling: A pressing wish to pass on what I know, warm toward Zurar.

say.text: Zurar, stay close. I have more to give you: the hold well and the warning post. Take them, so they outlive me.

changes: taught Zurar a lesson: "The hold well draws water where the ground has none; the warning post tells you when trouble comes near. Keep both and teach them on.", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.text: Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I have stood still for 4700 moments while my belly emptied, and a frostfang has already bitten me once. That is no way to live. I have wandered in loneliness and called it an aim. Thiael is the one I owe most, and Elyis is near the berries to the NW. I must eat first, then find my kin and stay with them. I will change my reflexes so my body goes to food and to kin instead of lingering.
records.feeling: Hungry and lonely, afraid of the frostfang, and wanting Thiael's company.

records.text: Kika taught Tlapan.
Kika taught Tlapan mining ("Amber-Delving").

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Tlapan sits beside me, fed and glad, and the fear that drove my last thought is gone; the jealousy over Mepan is smaller than I made it, since Mepan has been good to us both. But my legacy presses hardest: Tlapan is the only younger one who understands my tongue, and I carry signs, fishing, mining and fire that die with me if I stay silent. I will teach her now, here in the hall, while the gale keeps us all close. Then I will gather hazel from the plants near the water, share it before I eat, and keep my word to court someone who is not kin.
records.feeling: Tender and urgent toward Tlapan, wanting to pass on what I know before it is lost.
changes: taught Tlapan a lesson: "Tlapan, this is mining, the Amber-Delving: dig where amber and flint lie in the rock, and bind amber on a cord to give as a gift. Keep it, and teach it on when…", the way of mining, deeper lore (+0.6)

records.name: Kika
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Kika, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Kika, in first person, from what Kika has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Tlatli (Ice-folk). Your people hold to this: "A kill is shared out before the one who made it eats." You speak the tongue of the Tlatli. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Pesi: about 20%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Vaeth Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground.
THIS SPOT: water 5 steps away; food plants within six steps: 6; standing trees: 91; bare rock: 11.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Kika truly is.

You are a woman. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (2 kills), gathering (44 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

WHAT YOU DO NOT FORGET:
- Tlapan gave to you when you were in need on day 39: a kindness you hold to.
- Quipan gave to you when you were in need on day 39: a kindness you hold to.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Each thought: what did I promise, and have my hands done it? Then one new deed toward a mate or the unknown: hunt, make, teach, court or venture. Share before eating. Do not stay by kin out of fear alone."
