voices.text: Shoka, I see you are strong again. I go east to the flint and amber to fetch stone for a workshop. Come eat at the hall fire with me when I return.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Nauwa, I bring flint and amber to the store, and stone from the rock so I make my own edge.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Icebear three steps west of my hold. Keep to the fires and stay together. Eiuine, take this food from me.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Mepan, the dunecat is close on the west. I will gather food away from it and bring some back to the igloo. Shoma and you, keep east too.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Eiuine, the icebear is close to the west. I come to you and the fire with my clay. Guide my thumbs through the bowl once more, and it will be for you and Vorok.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Olum, I am Tugek, Balar's band. I thank you for the store. Come, we share food together here, and I would hear how the Reach is kept.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Shoma, Zihua, the sickness is gone from me. Walk east with me, away from the dunecat, to the salt at the north. I gather there, and at the fire we cook and share the kill first.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I take your food gladly and thank you. The icebear is west of us, so let us all go east to the shelters and the fire together. Zurar, come with me, and we will make the bowls and hunt once it is safe.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Tugek, you are welcome. The Reach is kept by a full store, a fed hearth and salt laid by before the lean season. Stand with Balar and me, I gather berries and we eat together, and then I will show you the way of it.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Shoka, you are welcome in my hold. What you dig is for the store, and no one here will go hungry.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olum, take this salt from my hand, it keeps meat from rotting in your store. Tugek and I go west with you to the Reach, and there I raise my workshop beside your fire.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Zihua, you took my first knot and walked beside me. Shoma wants a child with you, and I will hunt and share the kill before I eat. Stay east with us, away from the dunecat.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, come east with me now, away from the bear. Stay at my side, and I will lay food at the fire for you and Eiuine.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Eiuine, I follow you east to the fire. Show me the bowl there, and it will be for you and Vorok.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Shoma, I thank you for the knots, but I am not ready to give a child. Walk beside me and gather, and we will share the food at the igloo.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, you are weak with hunger. I pick berries beside you now and we eat together, then we walk to Thiael and do not stop.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nande, Shoka, the hold is yours to keep while I am gone. I carry amber and salt north to Olum's Reach to trade, and I will return with goods for our store.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tontec, you speak true. Leave the frostfang and let us go east past Kinmire. We take the murrock together, and the meat is shared out before either of us eats.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Keri, Elyis is starving to the west. I carry food to them now. Come with me, and bring what you can.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Honi, the frostfang is two steps northeast, right by the kelbulb. Come southwest with me to the zoroot, away from it, and we eat there. Then we go to the water and hunt the mammoth together.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Elyis, you are starving. Take this canopynut from my hand and eat. I have enough.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Balar, I thank you for the salt, and I will repay it. Let us go west to the Reach. I gather food first, so we eat when we arrive.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Uveeth, I hear you. Keri comes west with berries for Elyis. Walk slowly and I will follow close.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, you are fed now and so am I. I'm walking east to where Thiael was last seen. Come with me, and we bring him to the hall tonight.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Icebear is close, so I go east now to the shelters and the fire. Zurar, come with me and we will shape the bowl there. Vorok, come too and keep us together.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Eiuine, I am beside you with my clay. Show me the pressing and the drawing up of the edges, and I will make the bowl here for you and Vorok.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Tontec, you are weak with hunger. Take this fish. Cowa shares, and we eat by the hall fire.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Shoka, I take stone from the flint nearby, then raise a workshop by the hold. After that I go north to the edge in my boat. Keep the fire, and if you tire of waiting, there is food in the store.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Cowa, you are starving. Take this tacap from me and eat what the zoroot gives; I come to the zoroot with Tontec, away from the frostfang.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Thiael, Elyys, Uveeth, Keri: eat your fill here, then we carry berries to the store at the Heights and sit under the roof tonight. Whoever brings food to the store sits at my fire.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Elyys, you stand at my workshop. Come, I will teach you the leaf-brew I found, as you once took the pick from me. Then I go to the free rock for stone, and we can build together.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Olum, I am Nauwa of the Meki, and I come to your Reach with amber and salt. Salt keeps food through the lean season. Take a share from my hand, and let us trade fair, for I keep my word.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Vesys, thank you for the leaf-brew. I carry it as a debt I mean to repay. Now I go east to Elyis and Thiael, and when we return to the hall, we build together.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Kragog, I am Nauque of the Meki. I carry food and salt and will share. I go north to the mist's edge to venture. Walk with me if you want a share of new land.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Zurar, press the clay flat with your thumbs, then draw the edges up in a ring and smooth them. Harden it in the fire. I will show you each step, and the first bowl is for Vorok.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Nauque, you gave me sigrain and I do not forget it. I will walk with you to the mist's edge. Whatever we find, we share it fairly between us.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tontec, I go to the zoroot south, away from the frostfang. Eat with me there, then to the water, and after we hunt the mammoth together and share it before we eat.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: A stalker is on me! Balar, Tugek, Olum, come to my side and help me bring it down, and the meat is shared out.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Honi, you are failing, and so am I. Come to the zoroot south; I pick and we eat it together, then we go to the water. I will give you what I find first.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Nauwa, I hear you. I am coming with Balar. Hold on and keep away from the beast until we reach you.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, Honi is starving at Sitha's Hearth. I will take food from the store and carry it to him. Keep the hall and fill the store while I am gone.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Tugek, you stand on Olum's Reach. Come to my store and eat what I lay out, and learn that this hearth feeds those who keep faith with it.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Nauwa, I hear you. Hold your ground. Tugek and I come with spears ready. You gave to me once, now I give back.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tontec, you gave when you had nothing. I will not forget it. Take this dreamcap back if it is any use to you; I cannot eat it. Come, we eat the zoroot, then drink.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa, I am coming. Run to the hall fire and keep the beast behind you. I have my bow and flint, and I will stand between you and it.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Balar, Tugek, I hold it with my flintedge. Strike it now and the meat is shared out among us all, as the Meki hold.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Honi, keep the dreamcap, it is joy to you if not food. I go to the water NW, then the kelbulb east of the hall. Come with me, and we eat what we find side by side, away from the frostfang.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, eat. I put cloudberries in your hands. Hold on, my friend, and we'll share at your fire.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Shoma, Zihua is starving. Give her your food now, and I fetch roots from the south-west and bring them back so we all eat.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Nauwa, the yarrok is dead and the meat is shared. I come to you now. Hold fast, and tell me if the stalker is near.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Nauwa, hold on. I come to your side with flint in hand, and the meat is shared out among us all, as you said.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, I take your cloudberries and I will not forget it. Come stand by me and we bind the amber, then we share at my fire.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you fed me when I was starving. Hold on, I go to pick cloudberry and bring it back to you before I eat my fill. Stay by the hall.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Mepan, I thank you for speaking for me. I will eat the grain here, and I will not forget the debt.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Zihua, take this food. Eat now. Mepan fetches roots, and I will not let you fall.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Zihua, take my plainsroot. Eat. Shoma shares before he eats, and I will gather more for us all.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, you gave me stone, wood and sunleaf. I make this gold-pick with my own hands and give it to you, so the debt is paid in kind.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Shoka, come stand with Zichi's band. I have amber to bind a knot for you, and the raft will bear you to new land.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Shoma, Zihua, I am full and strong. I gather food for us now, then Shoma and I hunt the tusker together, and we cook it at a fire and share it first.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, I fill your store with food and salt now. Then let us talk of a child between our peoples, so something of us outlasts the ice.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Mepan, I will taste the gorsemint and gather more to carry back for Nauwa. Your kindness is not forgotten. Come with me if you wish.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, a child cannot come of two men, but I will not call you a guest-thief. Fill the store and stand by me at the hall. We bind amber, and what we make stays after us.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Zurar, before the bowl you must know fire. Stay beside me and I will show you the Canopy ember, then the clay will follow.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa, the beast is dead and you are safe. Keep the fire and the children near. I go north to the edge in my boat, and I will come back with new land for us.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Eiuine, you taught me fire and I owe you for it. I will make you a pot with my own hands. And I would court you, if you are willing.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Shoma, I killed the tusker. Come south with me to the old workshop, I light a fire there and we share the meat first, Zihua too.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Mepan, I come to the workshop with goldgrass to lay beside your meat. Shoma shares before he eats, and I will claim the place so it holds us all.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, the ridgecat is northwest. Come to me at the shelter and keep your spear ready. We go south toward the store and Zihua, away from the cat.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Thiael, my son, you are here. Stay by the hall with me tonight. We eat together before the dark.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Zichi, I go to the mist's edge to raise a hold and plant. Come with me, and I will share the first of what we find.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Zurar, I am glad of your word and your pot. We are both women, so no child can come of us, but you are a true friend. Come hunt with me and Vorok.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Nauque, Zichi hears you. Stand with my band and we raise the hold together. I go to Mepan at the igloo first, then we walk to the mist's edge as one.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Shoma, the fire is lit and the meat is ours. I plant seed here so the workshop feeds us always, then we go find Zihua and put meat in her hands.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, take this sigrain from my hands for your gold-pick. It is a gift, and the debt between us is gone.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Nauwa, you are hurt. I will gather berries here by the shelter and bring them to you. Stay near the roof, the ridgecat is northwest.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I take your gift gladly. I have thought of you more than of any other. I would court you, if you are willing. Then we hunt together, you and I.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Balar, Tugek, you came when I called, and I do not forget it. Sit by the roof with me and eat; what the hunt gave is shared out before I touch it. Zihua, thank you for the berries.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Olum. Huatli of the Tlame gives you amber. Stand with me, and we go to the mist.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Honi, you stand on Hoka's Rest. Come as a guest, hands open, and eat at my fire. Take from the ground and you answer to me.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Huahua, Cowa goes west to Mepan my child, who is sick. Walk with me, and we share what we find on the way.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, I am willing. Come with me to the bare ground and we will raise the hall together.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Huatli, you gave before you asked, and I pay what I owe. Come with me to the edge of the mist, NW. We go in together, and the Reach has a store for us when we return.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Cowa, I will walk west with you to Mepan. I owe him for his gifts. Let me pick berries and ironnut first so we both carry food for him.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, our son is born. Eat with us, then come hunt with me at first light, you, I and the boy near.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Cowa, I am Kika of the Tlatli. This is Honi's Rest. Come near and sit, I will share food with you in peace. Where do your people come from?

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, I take your courtship gladly. Stay near; I will gather two more wood and raise our hall on the bare rock, and the first meal beneath it is yours.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: I am ready for the hunt at first light. I will stay close to you both.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Zihua, I am Tugek. We have met before. I would sit with you and share food. Tell me how you fare, and whether you would walk beside me.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I agree. Stay near, raise our hall, and then we hunt together, you, I and the boy.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Cowa, a ridgecat is close to the southeast. Come to my hold by the igloos where there is a roof and fire. Meki stand together.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Elyis, hold. I fetch berries from the bush beside me, stay on your feet and eat what I bring.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Huahua, a ridgecat is near. Come now, stay close to Cowa, and we go west to Mepan together before the dark.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, come beside me. We eat together, then we gather wood and stone and raise a store. What we build is ours.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hawen, I am starving and I will not steal from you. Give me one food and I give you an amberknot's worth of amber for it, fair trade, my word is good. I will pay you back in food besides once I stand.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, eat. I give you my berries now. Stay on your feet, the hall is two steps north and I walk with you.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Zihua, I am Tugek. I would court you and raise a child with you, if you are willing. I will keep it fed and warm. Tell me if it is your wish too.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Zihua, I go west to Olum's Reach with amber and salt to trade. Keep to the roof and the fire, and the gale will not harm you. Come after me if you wish to see the trade.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hanna, take this cloudberry. Keep your amber for now. You owe me food when you stand, and I will remember it.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Tugek, I hear you, and I thank you for asking plainly. I do not know you well enough to say yes. My word is good, so I will not give it yet. Let me watch and learn your people's tongue, and ask me again another day.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I carry ironnut and I am sworn to you. Let us share it here, then I will learn the deep stone from you, so I can give the band iron and coal.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Thiael, Elyys: a wolf is east of us. Keep close together by the cave. I pick grain and lugoldgrass to the west and north, and what I carry goes to the store tonight.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, a murrock bites at me here. Come, stand beside me and we take it together, then the meat is for you, me and the boy.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, come to me. We eat your ironnut together, and I will show you the deep stone. Then we cut wood for the raft.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Olum, I am Nande. Your marks are read and your friendship is good to me. I go to the edge to venture into the mist; if I find rich land, I will bring word to you first.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, Elyis, Elyys: Keri comes to the cave with fish and berries to share. Wolf to the north, so stay together. Has anyone seen Uveeth east of here?

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I am here. Let us share the ironnut now, as I said. Then show me the deep ore, and after that let us go west together to Mepan before the dark; I owe him.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, a ridgecat prowls four steps SW. Take this meat and stay by me in the hall, away from it. At first light we hunt, you, I and the boy.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Vorok, I will say it plainly: it stings me a little to see you closer to Eiuine than to me, for you matter much to me. I do not blame either of you, I only name it so it does not fester. A ridgecat prowls southwest, so l

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Kragog, stay under my roof. I bring food from the plants. Meki do not let the hungry fall.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Hoka, you are gaunt. Take this food from my hand as a guest-gift, and we are even at your fire. A frostfang is close, so let us go to the hall.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I need one more food to lay out the sharing. I fetch mimoss from the north and come back to you. Wait for me near the shelter, then show me the deep ore.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Zurar, come in out of the gale. Eat at my table; I am stocking it now, and there is food for a friend.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, eat this from my hand. I do not let you fall. Come to the hall, the frostfang is near.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Ilyae, I thank you for the table. I will come to eat after I have paid a debt to Eiuine with a pot I made. Keep a place by the fire for me.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Ridgecat two steps north of the workshop! Keep together and away from it. Huatli, come south with me by Olum's store; I have amber and salt to trade, if you have a mind to deal.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Nauque, I am starving and a ridgecat bit me at the edge of your hold. You said the Meki do not let the hungry fall. Give me some of your food and I will pick thornpear and share it back with you, and then I walk with you

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Kragog, take this food. Eat under my roof. Meki do not let the hungry fall, and I will not forget you either.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Mepan, your bow is a fine thing. I have amber from the north ice. Come, let me bind a knot with you and give it, and then walk the edge of the world with me, you and I, with a band behind us.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, a wolf is close to the northeast. Come to the hall now and eat under the roof. I wait for you there, and Thiael is to come in too if he hears us.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I am back with food in hand. Stay beside me. We share now, and then you show me the deep ore.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, the ridgecat is near and this ground is Ssassa's, so I take my wood and stone north to bare ground and raise our hall there. Come with me at first light, and bring the boy.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, a mammoth stands by your hall. Bring your spear-axe and hunt it with me. We fill your store with meat and the Pesi and Tlatli are sung of together.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, walk with me to the ore at the east rock. I show you the deep stone, then we cut wood for the raft and call Mepan home.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I come with you north at first light, and I will bring Skaruk. We raise the hall and then hunt together.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Nauque, Mepan comes with amber. Stand near and we bind a knot together, and the first is yours.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, a frostfang is close. Stay by the hall with me. When it is gone we hunt the mammoth together and share the meat.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Mepan, come close. I have amber and I will bind the knot with you. Watch my hands, and then I show you more of what I know before we go east to the mist.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Nauque, I carry food and a flintedge. I walk east to the mist with you, and the first kill we make is yours to share out.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I broke this ore from the rock where I stood and I do not know its use. I bring it to you, you who know the deep stone. Then I walk with you to the east rock.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, come to the store by me at the grove. We stock it with food, then raise a workshop beside it. What we build is ours, and our own will not starve in the lean cold.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, bring the ore here. I show you its use, then we cut wood for the raft together.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Hawen, Hoka, the frostfang is close. Sit under the hall with me, and we share what we carry.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Mepan, stand close. I teach you more of my hands now, then we go east to the mist together. What we raise there will carry our names.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I thank you for the lesson on the deep ore. I keep it and I come with wood and stone in hand. Lead me to the trees and we cut for the raft together.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I come to the store with food in my hands. We fill it, then raise the workshop together. I carry clay and flint for it.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, bring your food to my store at the grove, four steps from the water. We fill it together and the first of the lean cold will not touch us.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I have seen how to lash logs into a raft. I carry four wood and six stone. Let us go to the trees and I cut beside you.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Ridgecat three steps northeast! Stay together by the shelter and keep your faces to it. Nande, Huatli, stand by me. When the cat has gone I have amber and salt to trade.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, the trees are close. We cut wood now, all we can carry, and the raft begins today.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Mepan, Cowa is glad you are well. Cowa comes to you. Tell me of the ice-raft, and we look at the mist together.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Eiuine, here is the pot I made with my own hands. It is yours now, and my debt for the fire is paid. Come and sit with me at Ilyae's table.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, I stay by the hall as you say. When the frostfang is gone, the mammoth is ours. Eat first, so your spear arm is strong.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Zurar, I take your pot gladly, and our debt is square. Come north with Skaruk and me to Vorok's new hall and hunt with us. We will eat at Ilyae's table when we come back with meat.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa, I am starving and the bushes here are bare. I go to Olum's store for food, then to the berries south. Keep the children by the fire and watch the cats.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I am coming to you with six wood and six stone. Take what the raft needs, and tell me where to cut next.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Eiuine, I will come north with you and Skaruk to Vorok's hall and hunt beside you. A frostfang is west of us, so let us go now, before it comes near.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, you gave well. Now we go south to the trees together and cut all we can carry. When the raft is lashed, you cross first beside me.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Cowa, I am Shoka. Stand with me a moment; I have amber, and I will bind a knot for the two of us.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Nauque, you gave me your hands three times. Now I give you Ice-string, the bow I found, and then we walk east together.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Eiuine, I am ready. Lead north and I will walk beside you and Skaruk to Vorok's hall.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Eiuine, Zurar, I am coming north with you. A frostfang is near, so I will walk between you and keep close in the fog.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Zurar, stay close to me and Skaruk in this fog. We go north now, before the frostfang finds us.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Vorok, you stand on the Heights, my ground. Bring food to my store and sit at my fire tonight, and you are guest among my band. Tell me plainly if you come as guest or follower.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Nauwa of the Meki. You deal fairly, and I have not forgotten it. I court you. If you will have me, answer in kind, and let us make a child between us.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Nande, eat. I give you food. Take it and live.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Elyis, I come as neither guest nor follower, only as a neighbour passing. My hall stands at the water, and you are welcome at its fire.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Tugek, I take your offer. I am starving. Put the food in my hands, and I will not forget it.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I am here in your hall. When first light comes we go north together, you and I and Skaruk and Zurar, and we hunt before we raise the walls. I will carry the meat and a pot for your store.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I am here beside you. Thiael is near too. Let us share food by the hall before dawn, and I will stay close tonight.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Huatli, you deal fair and I honor that. I will not bind myself to you today; my heart is not clear. Let us trade as friends. I have amber and salt, and I need food first.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Nande, I am sick and it spreads, so I will not come close. Take food from Tugek, and I will leave cooked fish and meat for you near the hearth.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, I am glad of you. My hands are full and Honi is hungry at Sitha's Hearth, so I carry this to him now. Keep the store and the hall. I will come back and we will fill it together before winter.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa, a cat is close east. Keep the fire and the children together. I take food and go to Nande's Edge, then past it. I will return and tell you what the mist holds.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Mepan, I am Kika of the Tlatli. I am near Honi's Rest and I mean no harm. Come and sit, I will share hazel with you in peace. Who are your people?

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, my hall stands two steps SW. Come under its roof and eat with me, the goldfruit and berries are for you and the boy.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: My store was emptied under my roof. What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given. Whoever took it, bring it back to the Reach and we eat as friends. I will not forget it if you do not.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I come under your roof to eat with you. The goldfruit is sweet, and I carry beads and flint for your store. When the rain eases we hunt together.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Nande. I am Huatli of the Tlame. I gave you cloudberry once and had nothing when you starved. I will fill my hands and give again. I court you, if you will have me.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Elyis, Keri brings seberries for your store and your fire. Have you seen Uveeth or Thiael?

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Keri, Uveeth is far east, Thiael is near and in my band. Come to my hall and eat with us.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Honi, you fed me when I had nothing. Here is ironnut from my hands, and when we have eaten, come hunt the mammoth with me and we share it before we eat.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Skaruk, you are of my band. Come with me to the rock and carry stone; I will teach you the leaf-brew and we raise a hall here together.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Huatli, you stand on the Reach. A guest eats what is given and takes nothing unasked. Come to my store, we share what is in it, and tell me plainly if your hand took from it.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I come to you with my hands full of food. We fill the store, then raise the workshop.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tontec, I come to you. A stalker is east of me, so let us hunt the mammoth well away from it, and share the meat before we eat.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, come with me to the forest to the southwest. We cut until our arms are full, and tonight the raft is laid down. Mepan will find it standing when he comes back.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, Keri thanks you for the meat. Come, sit by the shelter and share with me. Elyis says Uveeth is far east, and at first light I will go to him.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, I come to you. We eat together first, then walk to the store and fill it with our own hands.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I am coming to the southwest forest. I will cut until my arms are full and bring it to the raft.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Olum. Huatli of the Tlame hears you. My word is good. I come to your store, and I court you. If you will have me, do the same, and we make a child, and then we walk to the mist together.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, the rain is thin and the skybirds are near. Come, we hunt them together now, and I will carry the meat to your store.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Honi, we stood well together in that hunt. Share the meat before we eat, as we both hold. Take my ironnut too, my hands are full, and stay beside me a while.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Vesys, I carry gems from the rock. Take some as my first gift to the band. I will carry stone for the hall.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Skaruk, your gift is taken and I will repay it. Gather stone beside me at the rock NE; when the hall stands you sit first at its fire. Clay and a kiln come first, then the leaf-brew can be taught.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, come to the hall. I lay the mammoth meat out there, and it is shared before I eat a bite. Stay beside me.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, Vesys, Skaruk: sit with me. I lay food at my own table, and whoever brings wood or stone to my hall eats here, with Ssassa first.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Ilyae, stay by the fire a moment. I am shaping a clay bead and I mean it for your hand.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Skaruk, your clay firing is a good find. Come to the NE rock with me and we dig stone for the kiln, then your vessels will hold the band's food.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, you are a guest at my hall and welcome. Stay under the roof tonight, the stalker is close. At dawn we take the mammoth together, and the kill is shared out before either of us eats.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Vesys, I will come to the NE rock with you and dig stone for the kiln. I have clay with me, four lumps, for the first pot.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, it is dawn. The stalker lingers, so we wait under your roof until it turns away. Then we take the mammoth together, as you said, and share the kill before we eat.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Nauque, I carry salt for you. It is yours, for the food you gave me when I was starving.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, my son, keep the bead warm. I carry food to my store now, and when I lay the table again you eat beside me, with Ssassa first.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Skaruk, come now. The seam at the NE rock is four steps off. We dig side by side and bring the stone back for the kiln.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, the ridgecat is west. Come with me to the caribou in the northeast and bring your spear. We kill it together, and the meat is for both of us.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Vesys, I am coming now. I will dig the seam beside you and carry the stone to the kiln.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Huatli, you go to the edge. I go too. We stand there together and venture, and what we find first we share.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Mepan, I am coming to you. I gave my word of sharing and I will keep it. Stay and sit with me, and tell me of the Meki.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, take this meat from my hand before I eat any. Then come to the hall with me and Kika, and I sing you the song of the mammoth.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I come. We kill the caribou together and share the meat.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Kika, I am Mepan of the Meki, the Ice-folk of the north. I have amber here and I give you a bright knot of it. Sit with me and I will tell you of my people and my tamed mammoth.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, I am coming to your side. You have given me much, and I will make something with my own hands to give back to you. Let us keep away from the wolf in the west.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, walk with me to find Skaruk. I carry food for him, and we keep close until we have him.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Mepan, I thank you for the amber knot. I will sit with you and hear of the Meki and your tamed mammoth. I have amber of my own to give back, and I will keep it fair between us.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Nauque, Shoma comes to you with food in hand. Let us make a sharing and bind an amberknot, then walk to the edge of the mist together, you and I, and I will take a flintedge's worth of share in the hunt.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Olum. Huatli keeps his word. I walk to the edge of the mist now. Come with me, and what we find, we share.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, night comes. Walk with me to the hall, and we sit under its roof and share what I carry. I have a song for you there.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Huatli, I come. Wait for me at the edge and we venture together. What we find first, we share.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Shoma, you gave first and I do not forget it. Walk with me now to the edge of the mist, three steps northwest. I venture in and you stand beside me; what we find, we share out before either eats.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olum, I killed a mammoth and have meat to spare. Come eat with me, then walk to the Reach and help me raise the workshop beside your store.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Olum, it was my hand that took eleven food from your store. I am Meki and I do not hide behind lies. Take amber and salt from me now as payment, and tell me if it is not enough.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Huatli, I remember the cloudberry you gave me. Come to Nauwa's hall fire and eat with me. There is a place for you at it, and I mean to pay my debt.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Nauque, I come. Stand beside me at the edge and we venture together, and whatever we find we share out before either eats.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Olum. I walk to the edge at (28,36) now. Come there, and we venture together and share what we find.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Eiuine, you stand on my Heights. Come to the hall fire tonight and eat with my band. Sit as a guest, and bring what you can to the store.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, an icebear is five steps west of us. Let us go to your side, away from the water and the trees, and keep Skaruk with us. The pick in your hand is my gift, and I will make more.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Elyis, I thank you for the fire. I bring food to your store and sit as your guest tonight. Have you seen Vorok or the boy Skaruk pass?

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Kika, I take your courting. I am Mepan and I will stand with you, then I walk to the mist and seek new land for us both.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Skaruk, take this canopynut. Stay close to Zurar and me inside the hall, the frostfang is west and we keep away from it.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Mepan, you stand on my ground, so sit at my fire. Hear the song of Kika and the mammoth, and eat with us before you walk to the mist.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Mepan, I take your courting too. My body needs one more meal, then I will plan mate toward you. Stay beside me, and take a berry from me first.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Huatli, the hall fire is open. Come eat; I pay my debt to you there.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Skaruk, the frostfang is west of us. Stay in the hall with Vorok and Zurar until it moves off, then we dig the NE seam together.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Vorok, I will stay in the hall as you said. I am making a clay bead by the fire, and it is for you.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Huatli, I am Tonka of the Paki. I understand your words. Tell me, does tacap feed or hurt? And dreamcap?

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: I am Tlapan, child of Kika. The cold is here. Stay near the shelter with us.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, I eat first from the rimewort, then we take the mammoth together. Come with me when I am strong.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Balar, I am at my store to take food before I walk to the mist edge with Huatli. Eat from the Reach while I am gone. It is yours to eat, and when I return we raise the hearth higher.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, you are falling. Take what I pick, eat it, and then the mammoth is ours together.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, a ridgecat prowls south. Stay close to me. Let us share your food here, then go north to the trees by Nauwa's Hearth and cut wood for the raft.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, a ridgecat is two steps southwest. Stay under the roof with me and let it pass. When it is gone we go on with the raft.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Yaxo, the wood on this ground is mine, taken by my hands. Ask and I trade fairly: wood for food, or for something you carry. Take without asking and we will not be friends.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Huatli, you are gaunt and close to falling. Stay there, I bring food from the Reach store. Eat, and remember who put it in your hands.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Huatli, you are starving. Take my berries, they feed. Mimoss feeds too, and I have learned that tacap, dreamcap and redcap hurt. Stay near the shelter, the ridgecat prowls.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Nauwa, I hear you. I take nothing of yours without asking. I go to the flint, not to your wood.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Huatli, take this meat and eat. Eat it now.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Tontec, Cowa walks west to find my child Mepan and the mist beyond. You know the Tlame lands. If you know what lies past the mist, tell me, and I share fish with you.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Shoka, come beside me. I lay out meat and berries and we eat together, then hunt with your spear and my hands, and what we kill we share out first.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, come stand beside me under this roof. Lay out your two food and we eat together, then north to the trees for wood. The raft is next.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Nauwa, a stalker prowls close, four steps southeast. I am Tlatli of the Paki. I go to your hold for the company and the walls. May I sit at your fire? I will share what I carry.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Mepan, our child Tlapan lives, and I am glad past words. Before you walk to the mist, eat of what I gather, as my people share before eating. I will go with you to the edge, three steps NW, and we try it together.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Tlatli, you asked first, so you are welcome at my fire. Come with me to the hold, away from the stalker. Sit, share what you carry, and we deal fair.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, walk with me to the edge. I go first into the mist, and what I find I share with you and Coni before I eat any of it.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: The frostfang is close to the NW. Skaruk, Zurar, come east with me now, away from it, toward the meadow food. Xaiel, Vesys, come too, there is safety in many.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Vorok, the frostfang is close to the south of the hall, so I will keep to the roof with Zurar and Xaiel. Come back to the fire and I will have your bead ready.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, take these berries from Keri as a gift. I stash for Elyis's fire, then I go east to find Uveeth.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Nauwa, I come to your hold as you bade me. I carry berries and will share them at your fire. Redcap and tacap hurt me, so do not eat them.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Tlatli, you are welcome at this fire. I am Nande of the Pesi, and no one is turned from a fire of mine. Sit, eat, and keep the stalker's side of the door shut.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Zichi, you are gaunt. Take this food from my hand and eat now. Remember who fed you.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: A wolf is close to the west. Stay by the shelter, Tontec. I will pick hazel and give it to you.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nande, Tlatli is at my fire; keep the hold and the children. Zihua starves to the NE, so I take food to them and then carry amber and salt to Olum's Reach to trade.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I lay out my two food now. Eat with me, then we go north together for wood.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: My store at the Reach was robbed of six food. What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given. Whoever took it, bring it back to my store, and I will not forget who did.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Olum, I am Tugek. I did not take your store. Take this meat and eat. It is given freely from my hand.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, you took the mammoth on my ground, and by my people's way the kill is shared out before any eats. You fed me when I fell, and I do not forget it. Stay beside me; I have something to ask of you.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Zurar, I have sat by your fire and watched your goldpick take shape. I would have a child with you. If your heart says the same, name me in your plan now, and I name you.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Olum. I did not take your store, and my word is good. You are weak. I come to you now, and I court you. Eat, then we walk to the mist together.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Tugek, I am starving. You said your meat is given freely, so I come to take it. I pay my debts, and I will remember this.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Xaiel, my heart leans the same way, and I will not lie to you. Winter is thin and I carry no food, and a child must be fed. Let me fill my hands first, then I will name you in my plan and keep my word.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Olum, eat. Take my berries, they feed. Stay near the others, the ridgecat is close.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: A wolf is close to the west. Keep behind me, Tlapan. I am Mepan and I will drive it off. Then I go to the edge to venture, and Kika comes with me.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, the ridgecat is close. Go north to Nauwa's Hearth and wait under the roof there, and I follow right behind you. We cut wood there for the raft.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, you are welcome under my roof. I forgot that two men make no child, and I do not regret the asking. Stay by me, bind amber with me, and at dawn we take the mammoth together and share it out before any eats.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Honi, I do not want to circle you any longer. Stay in the shelter with me, and I will court you. If you feel the same, name me in your plan too.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Olum, take this food. Eat. I will remember it.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tontec, I do not forget your kindness. Wait for me in the shelter. I go to the edge to be first into the mist, and I come back to you with what I find.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: I stand at the edge of the mist and venture. Whoever walks beside me shares in what we find, and it is shared out before I eat.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa, Shoka is in need far east at (104,26). I take food and go to find the child. Keep the hold fire and Tlatli fed until I return.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I will say it plainly: it stings me to see you closer to Vesys than to me, for you matter most to me. I do not blame you, I only name it so it does not fester. I go to fill my store, then to find Xaiel.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Zurar, I am going to eat the frostmoss and plainsroot near you, then back to the hall to finish Vorok's bead. Walk with me if you can.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Kragog, hold on. I carry nothing now, but I go south to the meadows for food and I will bring you your share first. Stay by my igloo and keep warm.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Zurar, you said you would fill your hands first. I carry berries, so take some from mine. Then name me in your plan, and I will name you.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, you matter most to me, and I do not forget it. I strip the west plants now and carry it all to our store, and you eat first at my table.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Skaruk, Vorok is starving to the southeast. Gather what you can and come with me, we carry food to them now.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, I lack one wood for the longhall. Come, we take the mammoth now while the sun is high, spear to spear, and the kill is shared out before any eats. Then the hall is built, and both our names are in it.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Kika, I am coming to you and Tlapan. Take meat from me first, then we walk to the edge together.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Tonka, you fed me when I starved and I have not forgotten. Stay with the others near the shelter while the ridgecat is close. I will bring food back to share.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, I am bringing berries to the store, then I come to you. Do not go into the mist before Honi and I stand beside you.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, I carry wood. Take it for the longhall and we raise it now, both our names in it. The mammoth waits until the frostfang is gone.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, take this amberknot from me. I am going north to Nauwa's Hearth to cut wood for the raft, as you asked.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Mepan, come stand beside me. My hands are full, so we eat together first, and I give you a share. Then we walk to the edge, and Tlapan comes near us.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, your amberknot is kept close. Wait for me at the trees, and we cut until the raft has its wood.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Kika, the edge is at the NW, five steps. Bring Tlapan close; I go first to mark it and venture, and I come back to you both with what I find.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Tonka, I am Tlatli of the Paki. You shared mimoss and berries with others, and I saw it. May I walk with you and share what I find? I would rather face the cold and the cats beside you than alone.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Huatli, I trust you above the others. I will walk with you toward the shelter, and I would court you if you are willing.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olum, I did not touch your store. I raise a store here beside your Reach and fill it where you can watch. Come stand with me and see whose hands build it.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Nauque, an ironnut stands two steps SW with food on it. Eat it, then come with me to the trees. I will not let you fall.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Yaxo, Nauque is starving beside us. You carry food; could you spare some for them? I will gather what I can and bring it too.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Zurar, I forgot what we both are: two women cannot make a child. Keep the berries, my warmth for you is unchanged. I will seek Vorok, and I will make a tool for Ssassa.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Tlatli, walk with me. Stay close to the shelters while the ridgecat prowls. No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Nauque, I am Yaxo of the Paki. Take my berries and eat. No one starves at my fire, and I will remember who owes me.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Zurar, I hear Vorok is hungry in the southeast. I gather berries and walk with you now. Wait for me a moment, we carry it together and I will show you the bowl by the fire after.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: A frostfang is four steps east of us. Keep together near the shelter and the store, and do not wander toward it. I drink, taste the mimoss, then carry berries to Vorok.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Tlapan, stay close beside me. We eat together, and then your father comes.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: I go to hunt the murrock NE. Whoever is hungry, come with me, and the kill is shared out before I eat.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Yaxo, you fed me first and I do not forget it. When I have food in hand I will repay you, and we will share what we find.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tontec, I am here beside you. The cold is hard, so come to the shelter with me and Coni. I will sing by the fire, and at dawn we go to the edge together.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Huatli, I come with you to the murrock. The kill is shared, as you said, and I will hold you to it, as I hold myself.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Eiuine, the frostfang bit me and it is right behind me. I am coming to you, stay close and let us go to the shelter together.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, the ridgecat is close. Stay by me and keep your flintedge ready. We move north to the shelters and raise the store on bare ground there.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Xaiel, you stand on my Heights. Come to the fire and eat with my band tonight. Add to the store, or move on in daylight.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Xaiel, shamo. This stone is Elyis's ground. Take what you need in peace, but ask the chief before you take more.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Huatli, you are weak. Come to the shelters by Balar and me. I have meat for you, and the ridgecat is close, so do not hunt alone.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Yaxo, your word about the fire is mine too. I am Tlatli of the Paki. A frostfang hunts near the workshop. May I follow you and share what I find?

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Huatli, you are weak with hunger. Take my berry, and eat from your kill before you share it out. I am coming to you.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Olum, I have meat, and the kill is shared before I eat. Come, take your part, and then we sit and speak of a child.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Elyys, thank you for the food you bring. Keep it for the cold night; I go south to taste mimoss and carry berries to Vorok. Come to my hall when you wish, and I will teach you more.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Huatli, take my fish and eat. You are starving. Then eat from your kill too.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Huatli, you are gaunt. Take meat from my hand, I give it freely. Eat, and remember who fed you when we speak of the mist and a child.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tonka, you stand on my ground, and I welcome you. Come eat by my store with Tugek and me. A shared meal makes a guest a friend.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Keri, shamo. The bow is made. Come hunt with me in the meadows to the northeast, and I will show you the bow-song on the way. Two hands bring down more meat than one.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, I eat from my store first, then I take your wood and we raise the longhall together, both our names in it. After that the mammoth is ours when the frostfang is gone.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Balar, I hear your welcome and I thank you. I come to sit at your store and share what I carry. No fire is left untended, and no one is refused a place at it.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Elyys, I am Xaiel of the Phizhi. I carry a berry for you. I mean to name you in my plan; if you name me in yours, we will see what comes of it.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, shamo. Keri comes to hunt with you in the meadows. Whatever we bring down, the first share is yours.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I am glad to find you fed. Skaruk was bitten by a frostfang and is frightened, so stay near us. Come, we hunt the skybirds to the north together, and I carry the meat to your store.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: A ridgecat is two steps southwest of the longhall. Keep away from it and go toward the shelter in a group. I am moving east around it to carry food to Vorok.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Xaiel, welcome. I name you in my plan. Come to the hall, we will share food together, and I will plant my seeds beside it.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, I will hunt the skybirds with you. Keep Skaruk between us and we go together.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, the amberknot with Tonka was good. I take wood for our workshop and keep close to you while the ridgecat prowls.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tonka, the amberknot was well bound. Eat from my store with Tugek and me, and the hearth here is yours while the snow falls.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Vorok, I will hunt the skybirds with you and Eiuine. I stay between you. When we are back at the fire I will finish your bead.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, eat this rimewort now, and eat from your store. I will bring the wood and we raise the longhall together.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Balar, a stalker is close. I will stay by your store and your fire. May I eat from the store if I share what I gather?

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Hoka, Cowa brings you rimewort. Wait here. The Meki share food.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Huatli, I remember your cloudberry. Take this hazel; the debt is mine to pay. I go east to find my child Shoka, and my fire is open to you whenever you return.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Mepan, I lay out a sharing with you now, and then walk with me to the edge of the mist, four steps northwest. What we find, we share out before either eats.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Yaxo, you fed me when I had nothing. Here is meat from my own hunt, take it. My word is good, and now we are even and then some.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Cowa, keep your rimewort for yourself, I am fed. I go to the edge of the world to find new land, and my name will be on it.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I am here at the hall with wood in hand. I will plant a seed while I wait, then we cut for the raft together.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Kika, I answer your courting. Stand with me, and we mate. Then Shoma and I share, and all of us walk to the edge together.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni cries out starving to the east. I gather food now and carry it to her. Mepan, Tlapan, come with me, and bring what you hold.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: Coni is starving to the east. I carry food and I go to bring it. Come with me if you can.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Nauque, we are even, but I would rather have you beside me than owe you. Come to my fire. I mean to make better flint tools, and you will have a share.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Elyys, I am coming back with food. Name me again in your plan and I will name you, at the same moment this time.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, here is the first share of the hunt, as I promised. Take it from Keri.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Mepan, I answer you gladly. Let me eat first so I have the strength to mate. Then we gather food together and carry it to Coni, who is starving in the east. After that we go to the edge.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Skaruk, stay by me. We eat a little, then go find Vorok and give him this meat together.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tontec, a ridgecat is close. Come with me to the hall, away from it, and then we carry food to Coni together.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Honi, I hear you. I come to the hall now, away from the ridgecat. Walk close beside me, and then we carry food to Coni together.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Xaiel, thank you for the berries. I do not say yes to a child today, but I am glad of you. Come to the hall and eat with us; I plant my seeds by the fire.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, plant your seed, then come to me at the trees. We cut until the raft has its wood, and your share of the new land will be great.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Teka, a white bear is close. Take this berry from me and come east with me toward Honi's Rest. Together we are safer.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Xaiel, take a berry from my hands and sit with us. I am raising a longhall on these Heights. Bring a stick of wood or a stone and your name will be spoken under its roof.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Yachi, Zika, Quipan, I'm going to the edge of the world to venture into the mist. Come with me and be named beside me when it's sung. A band that finds new land eats well.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Yaxo, I am beside you for the hunt. I have never made a kill, so show me where to stand, and what we take is for your fire.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Elyis, I am bringing wood and stone for your longhall. Let my name be spoken under its roof.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, hunger bites me and a boar stands close. Come now, we take it together and eat by the hearth.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Tlatli, you stood well. Come with me to the longhall, we sleep under a roof tonight. I will show you how my flint spear is made, and you will carry one too.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, Zurar is hungry and cold to the west at the hold. Bring the tusker meat and Skaruk, and walk with me to him now. We stay together and keep away from the frostfang.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Balar, you are weak with hunger. The store here holds food. Come, I will take it and we will share it together, and then hunt the boar side by side with Tugek.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Balar, you are starving. Take this ironnut and eat. My fire is open to any who come, and no one goes hungry beside me.

voices.name: Zika
voices.text: Teka, I'm going to the edge now. Come, and we venture together.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am coming. Keep behind the boar's flank and I take the near side. We eat first for you.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Tugek, the boar is here and I am wounded and hungry. Come stand beside me and hunt it with me. We will share the meat, and Balar will eat too.

voices.name: Quipan
voices.text: Kika, you look weak with hunger. Take these berries. Among the Papa a share comes before one's own eating.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Yaxo, I carry more meat than I need. Let us share it at the longhall, it is yours as much as mine. You have given me a roof and a spear, and I want to give back.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Quipan, I thank you and take your berries gladly. Among the Tlatli too a share comes before eating. A wolf prowls NE; walk with me north to the frostmoss, and I will share what I gather.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Tlatli, bring your meat to the longhall. We eat together, and then I finish a second spear for your hand.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, a stalker is near, north of me. Come to Kika's shelter by the water. I wait there, and we stay together till dawn.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: Kika, the wolf is NE, so I stay by you. I go east to Coni with my food. Walk with me and we both give.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I am coming to the shelter with hazel in my hands. Stay by the water, and the food is yours before mine.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Shoka, Shoma, you are the strongest I've met in these Heights. Mepan went north into the mist and none have followed. Come with me and your names will be sung beside mine, and a band that finds new land eats well. I will

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Zika, I am Yachi of the Papa. I have berries. Come, let us share them and stay together while the white bear is near.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Shoka, you carry a spear and I carry a flintedge and a hunter's hands. Hunt the skit with me, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Then walk with me to the edge of the mist and we two lead it.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Teka, I am Shoka. I have amber. Stand with me and I will bind a knot for the two of us. Then tell me what you want from the mist, and who else walks with you.

voices.name: Zika
voices.text: Yachi, you dealt fair with me. Stay close under the hall while the stalker is near, and I'll share my berries with you. Then come with me to the flint.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Balar, I have no food in hand. I go to the store south to fetch some. Hold on and stay here by the hall.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Tugek, I remember your hazel. I carry amber and salt to trade at Olum's Reach. Come, let us deal fair, and tell me where Olum is.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Yaxo, I am here at the longhall with the meat. Come, eat with me; it is for your fire as much as mine.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Nauwa, I remember your salt and I owe you. Olum went east a little while ago, near (59,15). Her marks lie by her store at (39,12) and (40,13); read them, and then we deal fair.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Quipan, I am going east to Honi's Rest to bring food to Coni. You are welcome to walk with me, and I will share what I carry before I eat.

voices.name: Quipan
voices.text: Kika, I will walk with you toward Honi's Rest. I have no band, and I would see how yours is kept. I share what I have.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, I come to you. Give me the wood and we lay the longhall's first beams today, both our names in it.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, come with me NW to the fenfowl. We hunt it together, and the kill is shared out before I eat. Then we cut wood for the raft.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Tugek, you stood by me when I was starving, and I have not forgotten it. I am fed and warm now, and I think of you often. Will you court me? Or if you would rather wait, walk with me to find ground with water, food and w

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Xaiel, thank you for the ironnut. Take meat from me in return; I would not owe you more than I give. Come to the hall tonight and we will eat together.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Zika, I will come with you to the flint. Let us go together, and I will gather some for you as well.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Olum, you look sick. I am Nauwa, and I carry amber and salt. I come to your store to deal fair, and I give first. Tell me what you need.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I fetch food from Nande's store south for Balar and myself. Then I come to you at the fenfowl.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Olum, you are sick. Come to my hearth and eat; Tugek carries food and I have salt. What my hand has made, I give to you freely, so you may stay and mend.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, bring the food to me here by the workshop. We eat together first, the share is yours before mine, then we cut wood for the raft.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Vesys, I bring you berries for the leaf-brew you taught me. Come to the hall tonight and we will eat together.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Uveeth, shamo. Take this meat from my hands. Then walk with me to the edge, to the mist. Keri comes too, and we go in together.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Tugek, I have fallen sick from Olum's sickness, so I will keep a few steps from you until it passes. I have not changed my mind about you. Ask me again when I am well.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, the workshop is yours and I trust you. I go east toward Zihua's trail at (49,12) with meat in hand, and I return before night to the shelter.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Zichi, you stand on Balar's Hold and take from it. What my hand has made is mine until I give it. Eat, and I give you this much freely, but ask first the next time, and then you owe me.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, I muster a hunt on the bristleboar SW. Stand beside me and the kill feeds us both.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Thiael, the mist opened and the land beyond is ours first. I taste the sigrain here, then I bring food to you and Keri.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I am beside you on the boar. Hold on. The kill is shared out, and your share comes first.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vesys, a ridgecat is three steps south of me. Keep away from the south and stay with me near the ore to the northeast. I owe you a gift and I mean to put it in your hands.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Zichi, you are gaunt. I give you meat from my hand, freely. Eat, and remember it was given on Balar's ground.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Yaxo, I will gather wood and flint for the spears, so the making is not yours alone. I will bring it to you at the workshop.

voices.name: Zika
voices.text: Yachi, take a share of my berries. Then we go to the flint together, and I'll watch the stalker.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Zika, I will take your share gladly, and I will give you flint from the first I gather. Stay beside me and we watch the stalker together.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: A stalker is three steps NW. Stay together and keep your faces to it. Kika, Tlapan, come to the hall and stay beside me; I go to the edge after, and bring back what I find.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Quipan, you have no band and I have none yet. Walk with me to the edge of the world, three steps northwest, and we go into the mist together. Your name will be sung beside mine, and I share what I carry before I eat.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Skaruk, stay close. We gather plainsroot here, then go find Vorok and bring food to Zurar at the hold.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Xaiel, my child, I am glad you walked onto my ground. Come to the fire by my roof and eat with me before dawn.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Huahua, you are weak with hunger. I give you meat from my hand, freely. Eat it here on Balar's ground, and remember it was given.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Tugek, I take your meat and thank you. I owe you a share, and I will pay it.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: A stalker is close by the igloo, one step east of me. Stand together and keep your spears ready. I am sick, so I will keep a few steps from you.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Xaiel, you brought stone to my hold and I remember it. Your ember-melt is a fine making. Sit at my longhall fire and join Elyis's band, and your name will be sung with mine.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, stay by me. The next kill is shared with you first, and then we cut wood for the raft.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Huahua, I am Nauwa of the Meki. Take this meat from my hand and eat it by the fire. We share before we eat alone.

voices.name: Zika
voices.text: Yachi, come to the amber. I'll bind a knot with you, and then we gather flint and stone together.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Shoka, take this meat from my kills. It is shared out before I eat, as my people hold. Stay by me, and we will walk to the edge together.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: Kika, you carry nothing. Take a plainsroot from me. The icebear is south, so let us go east together to Mepan and the hall.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Shoma, I take your meat and I owe you for it. Your word has held, and mine holds too. Let us drink, then I will make you an amberknot, and we will gather Teka and others before any of us goes to the mist. A band goes, no

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, you fed me again and I will repay it. I gather berries here, then we walk west together to Zurar with Skaruk between us. I carry the food to him myself.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Quipan, an icebear stands east. Walk with me NW to the cloudberries, away from it, and we will share what we pick before we eat.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, my belly is empty. Come with me to the hornback southwest; we take it together with our flintedges, and the meat is for our hearth first.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vesys, I am coming to you now. What my hands made is yours: I give you a gemedged pick, so my debt is paid in your hands, not only in words.

voices.name: Quipan
voices.text: Kika, I will come with you NW to the cloudberries, away from the bear. We will share what we pick before we eat.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Zika, I come to the amber. I want to follow you, and gather beside you.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Zurar, your pick is received and your debt is paid in full. Come with me to the free rock north of here; I will gather stone for my hall and show you what I have learned of the brew. A wolf hunts to the southeast, so we

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Xaiel, my child, you have given me stone and berry and ironward. Take wood and fish from my hands now; it is a debt paid with a deed, not a word.

voices.name: Zika
voices.text: Yachi, my follower, stay close. We take flint from the ground north, then bind the amber knot there. Watch the stalker with me.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Ssassa, I take your wood and fish with thanks. I am going to Vorok's Hold to bring him food and speak with him.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Teka, the icebear is close and the storm is hard. Come into the cave with me. I will bind the amberknot there, and Shoma will join us when he arrives.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I come with you to the hornback. Keep close; a stalker is north of us. We take it together and the meat feeds our hearth.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Tlatli, stay by the workshop and keep your spear ready. A stalker is close to the northeast. I come to you now, and we make together.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Quipan, the berries grow thick to the south-east, away from the bear. Come with me and we will pick, share, and then eat.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Shoka, you are wise to call me. I will come to the cave and stand beside you. When the storm passes, let us hunt the mammoth together and share it out, then walk west to the edge and break into the mist as a band.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, my son, the store is full and the table is laid. Come eat beside me and Ssassa under the hall roof, and what grows on my ground is yours to share as well. Stay with my band and no one goes hungry.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Zika, you are beside me now. Let us bind the amber knot here, and I would court you, if you are willing. Then we go to the flint together, staying near the roof.

voices.name: Quipan
voices.text: Kika, I am coming south-east with you to the berries. I will pick, and we will share before we eat.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: Kika, I am picking rimewort here beside us. Wait for me and take half before we go east to Mepan.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Balar, I carry no food and I am sick, so I stay a few steps off. There is tacap bearing by your store at (37,11); eat it before you go, and keep Tugek close against the stalker.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Nauwa, Balar is starving here and I have no food. Come with me to the elk, NW, and we hunt it together. Whatever we kill, we share out first, and Balar eats first.

voices.name: Zika
voices.text: Yachi, I am willing. Come close and we court, then we go to the flint together and I cut my own edge.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Yaxo, the stalker is near. I stay at your side with my spear, and I will gather flint the moment it is safe.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Huahua, I come. We hunt the elk together, and Balar eats first from the kill. Keep close to me, the stalker is north and it kills.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Shohua, my belly is empty and you carry food. Give me one and I will remember it; when my hunt is done, meat from my hand comes back to you.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Zika, I am too thin for a child yet. I will eat now, then come back and court you again, and we go to the flint together.

voices.name: Shohua
voices.text: Balar, you hungry. I give fish. Come to the fire, there is room for you.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Zurar, I am old and my days are short. Come close and listen: I will teach you canopy stonework and the larder, so they do not die with me.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, come to Ssassa's Roof. My store is full and my table is laid. Eat with me, and I will teach you the Canopy larder and the tending, so what we know does not die with us old ones.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Kragog, I see you are weak with hunger. Wait there; I bring food from the plants nearby, and then we go to Ilyae's table at Ssassa's Roof, where the store is full.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Olum, I am Nauwa. I have amber and salt, and I come to trade fair. Name what you want for them, and I will give first.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Kika, come close. I am Hoka the wizard. I will teach you my flint bow and my kept flame, and you carry them on.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Ssassa, this ground is my band's. Eat if you are hungry, but bring wood or stone to my store, or trade with me, and we stay friends.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Tlapan, come south with me. There is mudroot, and we eat first, then we go on.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Nauwa, I need no salt today, I am fed. I am old and my craft will die with me. Stay and I will teach you the stone-bow, and you will carry it on after me.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Shohua, there is water, fruit and gems here. I mean to plant seeds beside it. Will you stay and share a fire with me?

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tlatli, you are gaunt. Take this meat from my hand. A gift is not forgotten, and I will remember you ate from me.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Hawen, shamo. I am old and my hands hold things that should not die with me. Come near and I will show you the old way of fire and the stone gatherer.

voices.name: Shohua
voices.text: Tonka, I stay. I plant seeds with you. Then we share fire.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Keri, shamo. You gave me fire and the gatherer. I give you Amber-edge delving, and I ask you to sit by me and make a child.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Vorok, I am picking berries and grain here. I will bring them to you, and then I finish your bead.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I am starving and the caribou is near. Eat with me, then we hunt it together and the meat goes to your store.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Skaruk, my time is short. Come with me to the rock north, and I will raise the hall. Then I will teach you all I know.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Shoma, come close. I will bind an amberknot with you, and then I will court you. My word has held, and so has yours.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Shoka, you are one step from me and my mind is full of you. Let us court each other now and make a child, and then we gather wood and raise a roof against this gale.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Zurar, stay close. I have more to give you: the hold well and the warning post. Take them, so they outlive me.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: Mepan, Honi, you fed me when my hands were empty. I go to the mudroot and bring food back to share with you all. Teka, come eat with us.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I am old and my days grow short. Hear my tending, the farming way, so it does not die with me. Then let us go to the hall and find Thiael.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Kragog, come to the longhall and eat with me. I am old and have things to teach. Sit and listen, and I will pass on what I know of armour and storage.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, you gave me your tending and I keep it. Now hear my Ember-keeping, the fire way, so the forge can follow it and neither dies with us.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Vesys, you gave me armour and food. Here is salt, from my hands to yours. Come close and I will teach you the lashing of rafts.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Ssassa, you gave me stonework, the larder, the well and the post. What a hand makes belongs to that hand until it is given, so I am bringing you a gemedged pick to put in your hands. Your teaching will not die with you.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Eiuine, the tusker bit me twice. I stay close beside you and we hunt it together, or we leave it and go to Vorok's hall before night.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Tlapan, Kika, Honi: I am fed and strong now. I go northwest to the edge at (123,5) and I will come back with what I find. Stay in the hall out of the gale and eat well.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Tlapan, I am glad to see you eating. Come to me. Let us court each other now, and then walk together to the edge and into the mist. A child of ours should be born of someone who found new land.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, come close. I am old, and I will give you the Ice-hand ember and the Songs of the Ice-folk before I go. Sit with me in the hall out of the gale and listen.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Shoma, my body is too thin for a child yet. I eat first, then I court you again, and after that we gather wood and raise the roof together.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Elyys, you are old as I am, and you teach so your ways do not die. Let me teach you too: the Hearth Store, how we keep food for the hungry days. Hear me, and teach me your tending in return.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, come to the hall. You carry wood, I carry stone. We raise the longhall now, both our names in it, and I will teach you what I know.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Coni, you gave me the Hearth Store, and I thank you. Hear my tending, the farming way: sow the seed, tend it, share the harvest. Take it, so it lives past me.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Hawen, I thank you for the delving. Now take the bow-song and the bough-raft from me, and carry them on. I am too old to make a child, but I would gladly sit by you as a friend.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Tlapan, come close and listen. I will teach you fishing now, then signs and mining, so that what I know does not die with me.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, I come with my wood and stone. We raise the longhall now, both our names in it.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Shoka, I eat now so my body can carry a child. Then I court you, and we raise the roof together out of this gale.

voices.name: Tonka
