voices.text: Shohua, the gale is hard. Stay near the shelter and help me put these seeds in the ground by the water. When we are done we sit together and sing the night through.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Kragog, you gave me salt and the lashing of rafts, and I will not leave that debt unpaid. Stay by me in the warm hall; I will teach you ember-metal and the ground-wards, so what I know lives on in you.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, I am one wood short. Give me your wood, I stand at the hall, and we raise the longhall now.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Tlatli, you shared with me once and I have not forgotten it. I am old and starving, and I hold knowledge that dies with me: boats, rafts, smelting. Come close and I will teach you freely, and if you have food I would tra

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Tontec, come to the fire. Take this food and eat. No one is refused a place at it.

voices.name: Tlatli
voices.text: Tugek, I thank you for the teaching. Come to the fire shelter and rest out of the gale. I will find food and bring it to you, and I will give you flint for your hunting.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Skaruk, take this meat to Eiuine and keep close to her. I go three steps east to the edge of the mist, and I will come back to you.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: An icebear is at my back, two steps southwest! It kills. Stand together by the shelter and keep it off me!

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Shoma, I have eaten and my body is strong now. I keep my word: I mate with you, and then we gather wood and raise the roof for Wawa.

voices.name: Skaruk
voices.text: Uveeth, eat. This meat is yours. Come with me to Vorok.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: The icebear is close by the shelter. Stand together in the shelter and keep close. I am coming in beside you.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Mepan, I am coming to the edge with you. Whoever pushes into the mist first, we go as two, and I will share what we find.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Teka, my child Tlapan is hungry far to the southeast. I go to feed Tlapan first, and then we go to the edge together. Come with me if you will, and bring your food.

voices.name: Wawa
voices.text: Shoka, Shoma, I am hungry. I go to pick food by the mammoth and will bring wood back for my roof. Stay near.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, a ridgecat is close. Stand by me at the hall. Give me one wood and we raise it before the cat chooses us.

voices.name: Shohua
voices.text: Tonka, I plant now, here by the water. Stay close to the shelter, the icebear is near. Then we sit and share fire.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Zurar, I thank you for the pick. Hear the rest of what I know, my medicine and my weaving, so none of it dies with me.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Olum, you gave me the stone-bow and asked nothing. I am Meki, and I pay what I owe. Take this amber from me, and bind an amberknot with me so the gift is not one-sided.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Ssassa, I carry your medicine and your weaving now. I will keep them alive and teach them on, and I will not let your gift die with me.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Shohua, you have stayed by me and planted beside me. I want a child with you, and a home here. Will you court me?

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Nauwa, you paid what you owed, so I will give you more of what I know. Listen well, for I am old and there is little time left.

voices.name: Quipan
voices.text: Kika, I would follow you and stand in your band. My word is good, and I will share what I carry.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, take my wood. Raise the longhall now, and let the cat find us inside the shelter.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: Kika, you have fed me and taught me, and I mean to repay you. I plant seeds by the water now, then I fish and bring the catch to you and Mepan.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tlapan, come to the hall with me. I will teach you the Songs of the Ice-folk before the dark.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Teka, I am Zichi of the Meki. Come stand by me and share meat. I have ways to teach, snares and frost-shield, and a band is stronger than one.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Zichi, I will stand with you. First I push into the mist at the edge just west of here. Come with me, and we share whatever we find.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Shoma, come with me to the standing trees in the SW. We cut wood together and raise the roof for Wawa, and we find her on the way. Take this mimoss first, so you walk fed.

voices.name: Shohua
voices.text: Tonka, I court you. I want a child with you and a home here by the water. Come into the shelter, the icebear is near.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Shoka, I come with you to the SW trees. We find Wawa, cut wood and raise her roof. Walk beside me, and when the roof stands we go on toward the mist together.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Quipan, I go south-east to the hazel and the mudroot to pick. Come with me, and we carry food back for Tlapan, Mepan and Honi before we eat our fill.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Shohua, I will teach you the amber-hafted gatherer: one wood and one stone make a tool that picks faster. Stay in the shelter with me while the beasts are near.

voices.name: Shohua
voices.text: Zihua, thank you for the gatherer lesson. Stay with us in the shelter. I plant by the water and will share food with all at this fire.

voices.name: Tonxo
voices.text: Shohua, the icebear is close. I am hungry. Will you share your food with me, or come with me to the berries?

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Thiael, my child, wait. Hear my tending, the farming way, before I die. Then come with me and Elyis to the hall for the night.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Teka, I killed a mammoth and the meat is shared before I eat. Take your portion and stand in my band. When you push into the mist I will come, and we build a raft for new land together.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Tlapan, you stand by the hall. Sit with me, and I will teach you the Songs of the Ice-folk and the Ice-hand pot before night falls.

voices.name: Quipan
voices.text: Kika, I will come with you to the hazel and mudroot. We will carry it back for Tlapan, Mepan and Honi first, then plant seeds by the hall.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Quipan, you are ahead of me, so I follow. We pick mudroot and carry it back to Honi, Tlapan and Mepan first, and only then do we eat.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Zihua, I am Ssassa. I mean no harm. Take this wood as a gift, and let us be at peace here.

voices.name: Tonxo
voices.text: Zihua, I am Tonxo. I will bring berries and share them with you. Teach me what you know of gathering.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Shohua, a ridgecat is close to the north. Keep Tonxo near the shelter while I gather wood here and raise a second roof for the children.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Tonchi, boy, come back to me. There is a shelter here and berries in my hand, and my fire is open to you. I am Nande, and I will teach you what I know before the night is out.

voices.name: Shohua
voices.text: Tonka, I plant now beside the water. Keep Tonxo inside the shelter. When I have sown, I will bring Tonchi back to the fire.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Zichi, the edge is at (109,7), a few steps from here. Walk with me now and we push into the mist together. You promised a raft for new land, so keep to it.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Shoka, I am coming to you. I have amber and salt, and Olum has taught me the stone-record: cut signs so what we know outlasts us. Stay near, and let us eat and talk together.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Tlatli, I thank you for your offer. Before smelting you must learn mining, so I will teach you that first. Bring the food when you find it, and I will meet you near the berries.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Elyys, I am sorry for Elyis. I am Zurar of the Kragrek. I would sit with you in the hall tonight, and learn your tending, if you will have me near.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Thiael, my child, Elyis is gone. Come close and hear my tending, the farming way, before I follow her. Then let us sit together at the hall.

voices.name: Yaxo
voices.text: Tlatli, hold on. I am coming with food. Stay where you are and do not wander.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: A dunecat prowls three steps north of the hall. Stay close to the roof and do not go out to the trees. I am coming in, and I have mudroot for Tlapan.

voices.name: Zika
voices.text: Zika's band, to me! I have cut a glassedge of my own. We hunt the mammoth south, and the kill is shared out before I eat.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Boy, a stalker hunts near. Come beside me, I have ironnut to share. Walk with me and you will not be alone in the dark.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Quipan, you are of my band. Sit close under the roof, away from the cat, and I will teach you the Ice-hand pot before the night is spent.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Olum, hold on. I come with food, and it is yours before I eat. Then I will teach you what I know, and we speak of a child.

voices.name: Quipan
voices.text: Kika, the cat is too close for the hazel now. Let us stay under the roof and eat together, and I will plant my seeds by the hall when it has gone.

voices.name: Tlapan
voices.text: The cat is close to the north. I go to the water to drink, then I come back under the roof. When it has gone, I fish for Kika and Mepan.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Zika, I come to the mammoth hunt. Keep the kill shared before any of us eats, and I will stay at your side away from the cat.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Kika, when the cat has gone I walk to the edge at (123,5) and stand exactly on it. Keep Tlapan under the roof and fed. I will come back to you with what I find.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Thiael, my son, come close. Hear my tending now, the farming way. Plant, tend, and the forest gives again. Then sit with me in the hall and eat.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Quipan, first the Ice-hand ember, then the pot. Sit by me under the roof, and I will teach you fire now.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Huatli, your berry came when I was starving, and I do not forget it. I will repay you. Come with me to the berries SE and eat beside me, then we speak of the child.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Elyys, my father, I heard your tending and I keep it. Eat from my hands now, then I will sow it here beside your hall.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, take this mudroot. I eat after you. The cat is close, so I drink and come straight back under the roof.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Zurar, I have more for you: my flint delving and my ember-keeping. Listen, and pass them on.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Ssassa, you gave me your flint delving. Hear my tending now, the farming way: sow, tend, and the forest gives again. Pass it on.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Mepan, Zika is dead, gored by the mammoth. I have no leader now. You are the one I trust most; I will follow you, and I will share what I carry under this roof before I eat.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Wawa, stay close to me. I have wood and stone in hand, and I raise your roof now, here by the water.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Quipan, fire waits on tools. Stay close under the roof and I will teach you the Ice-hand spear first, then the ember, then the pot.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Teka, I keep my word. Walk with me to the edge at (109,7) and we push into the mist together. What we find, we share.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Uveeth, shamo. Come close. I teach you the tending of seed, and the hollow-boat, while I still have breath. Eat these berries from my hands first.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Zichi, I am going to (109,7) now. Come stand beside me and we venture together, the first finding is ours.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Olum, I am Nauque of the Meki. The berries here are good and I will pick enough for two. What brings you to this water?

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Zurar, come closer. Now hear my clay pot and my raft, and keep them alive after me.

voices.name: Tonchi
voices.text: Shoma, thank you for the food. I go to my parents at the Gem Water. Come with me, the bear is near.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: Thiael, I hold your tending now. I will sow by the cave and keep seed back, and you will eat from that harvest. Stay near the fire tonight.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Shohua, I am raising a second roof and a store by the water. When Tonchi is back, keep both children at the fire and I will feed it with wood tonight.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Zurar, you keep your word, and I would keep mine. Hear me while I walk: ember-metal is ore beaten in a kept fire, and ground-wards are set where the foe will tread. Carry it on after me.

voices.name: Shohua
voices.text: Tonka, I go to find Tonchi and bring them back to the fire. I will bring wood for the second roof when I return.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Hawen, you taught me and asked nothing. I do not forget it. Come stand beside me in the shelter. I court you. If you feel the same, name me in your plan.

voices.name: Paque
voices.text: Uveeth, friend. I stay near your cave. We gather stone and sow seed together.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Zurar, come near. Hear my tending, the farming way: sow, tend, and the forest gives again. Carry it on after me.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Tontec, I feel the same. I name you. Come, we stand together in the shelter.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Tlapan, come sit by me under the roof. I teach you Fireside Teaching, so what I know does not die with me, and then you can teach it on.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: Mepan, I follow you. I will gather wood and stone near the hall and plant seeds on the meadow, so the band has more to build with and eat.

voices.name: Kiwa
voices.text: Tlapan, I gave you black glass from my heart. Will you court me? I want a child with you and a roof I build for us.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Yachi, you follow me, so walk with me. Our band's law is that we give before we promise, and a kill is shared before the hunter eats. We go west to the edge at (123,5) once I have drunk. Keep close and keep your eyes ope

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nauque, I am here. Take these berries and frostmoss and eat now. Stay by me; when you are strong I will teach you the Meki ways and the stone-record.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, you hold my ember and my songs now. I go west to find Coni and bring her back with food. Keep the band under the roof and teach Tlapan what I gave you.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Ssassa, come near. Hear my Hearth Store: lay food into the store while the plants bear, so that when one of ours cries starving, hands are not empty.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Peace, Olum. I am Coni of the Ice-folk. I walk to my band at Honi's Rest. Stay near a roof by night, the icebear hunts here.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Father, I take your food and I will repay it. When I have picked mimoss, the first share is yours. Then I go to the edge to venture.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Zurar, come close once more. Hear my farming, my boats, my bridges and my sails, and carry them on after me.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Teka, stay close. I will teach you the Meki frost-shield and ice-snare as we walk, and at the edge we go in together.

voices.name: Tonka
voices.text: Shohua, Tonchi is hurt, her health is low. I am gathering feverbark to heal her. Hold where you find her and I will come to you.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Kiwa, you court Tlapan. Stay under this roof tonight and share your food before you eat, as the Ice-folk do. I watch what your hands do, not only your words.

voices.name: Teka
voices.text: Zichi, the mist is thick today. I hunt the murrock to the south and share the meat before I eat. Come with me, and when the mist thins we go in together.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I built a fire here. Sit with it tonight and we sing, then at dawn I go to Vorok and Skaruk with meat.

voices.name: Tonchi
voices.text: Shoma, a ridgecat bit me and it is close. Help me, I am hurt!

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nauque, come with me to the cave to the northeast, out of the snow. Eat there, and I will teach you the stone-bow and the Meki share-law while you grow strong.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, I am coming to your fire. Keep it lit, and sit close. Tonight I teach you ember-metal, and we sing.

voices.name: Yachi
voices.text: A dunecat is two steps southwest of the hall. Stay under the roof, all of you, and keep close together until it goes.
